text:
Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2025 soabã Burkĩna Faso tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn get kibay kũun na tũ sorã taoor soab a Wẽndengũudi Lui Modɛɛs Wedraoog zẽka a naoor n tɩ zĩnd Memoryall Toma Sãnkara tɩ b maan kiuug pʋgẽ pipi lamus b sẽn yãk n waoogd a Toma Sãnkar ne a tũud-n-taas piig la a yiibã b sẽn kʋ wã waoor tẽegre. Lamusã yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 4 soabã yɩ a tẽegrã naoor a yiib soaba. Tẽeg-kãng soabã yaa Seɛsse CSC taoor rãmba, la kiba-kɩtbã ne Minitɛɛr dãmbã n maan-a.

CSC taoor soab a Wẽndgũudi Lui Modɛɛs Wedraoogo, ne kʋdemdã, kiba-kɩtbã la gilg-n-ges yel-soalma Miniisr a Pẽgdwẽnde Zɩlbɛɛr Wedraoogo, n paas Miniisr sõangda Amadu Diko sẽn get gʋʋlgã, ne Mali Miniisr a Bukar Dɛne sẽn get koomã ne kʋʋra wã, la Nizɛɛr neb zẽka b naoor n zĩnd zĩigẽ wã.

Miniisr Pẽgdwẽnde Zɩlbɛɛr Wedraoog koeesã pʋgẽ, a pẽga Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm Tarwore, a sẽn yãk yam tɩ kiuug pʋgẽ pipi lumus fãa bɩ Manitɛɛr dãmbã  maand waoor n tẽegd Kapitɛnd Toma Sãnkar ne a tũud-n-taas piig la a yiibã b sẽn kʋ wã yelle. A wilgame tɩ waoorã, yaa na-kẽnd-sõngo, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b rɩk yam a pʋgẽ, n tõog n kell n kẽng ne yam nins Kapitɛnd Toma Sãnkar sẽn da gãneg n na n tʋmã. Miniisrã togsame tɩ Memoryall Toma Sãnkara nin-naand-kasengã meeb ligd sẽn kẽ nan ka yɩɩd koabg  piig 10 % pʋgẽ ye, tɩ yaool n yaa Milyaar ka tɛk la b rat n paam n me-a. Yaa rẽ tɩ b rat tɩ ni-buiidã fãa kẽes b  toog tɩ b tõog n baas-a. Miniisr Pẽgdwẽnde Zɩlbɛɛr Wedraoog boonda nin-buiidã tɩ b kɩs b nug bũmb tɩ b tõog n me Memoryall Toma Sãnkarã t’a yɩ wa b sẽn datã.

Miniisrã koees poore, CSC taoor soab a Wẽndgũudi Lui Modɛɛs Wedraoog me rɩka koɛɛga. Yẽ me koeesã pʋgẽ, a kell n pẽg tẽngã zãadb yam yãkrã. A wilgame tɩ b yam yãkrã boonda burkĩn-bi wã la nin-sabls tẽnsã kamb tɩ b mobg taaba, la b naag taab zĩig fãa n zab ne nasaar wẽnsã ne b yam-soaadɩ wã, tɩ Kapitɛnd Toma Sãnkar sẽn da tuk sor ning n dat tɩ b vʋɩɩmd ne burkĩnd la zug zẽkrã tõog n yɩ vẽenega.

A Wẽndengũudi Lui Modɛɛs Wedroog ratame tɩ nin-buiidã kẽes b toog ne b nug bũmb tɩ Memoryall Toma Sãnkara wã, na n sõnga nin-sabls tẽnsã zãadb tɩ b politikã toeem na-kẽndre, n kẽng taoore, ne sɩda, la bʋ-tɩrse, tɩ b zamaanã gãand bãane.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 21 yʋʋm 2025 soabã Miniisr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã la tẽngã kamb sẽn be we-loorã zẽk a naoor n tɩ zĩnd Asãmbleẽ wã, tɩ Depite rãmbã taoor soab a Wʋsmaan BUGMA ne a pporẽ dãmbã pidis no-rɩkdga, tɩ Risi na n tõog n sõng Burkĩna Faso ne kʋʋra, b sẽn boond tɩ Nikilɛɛre. Yaa nug tikr b sẽn da maan Sẽntpetɛrsburg sigr rasem 19 yʋʋm 2025, la Asãmble wã sẽn kõ sore, tɩ b na n lugl-a, tɩ Burkĩna Faso rãmb sek b mens ne kʋʋra wã.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2025 soabã Miniisr ning sẽn get yõ-koglgã sigla sull sẽn na n vaees raasã tɩ b boond tɩ « Ladeli ». Ladeli wã yaa tẽng gãand bãan rãmb 1100 n be a pʋgẽ. 

Ladeli sɩnga a tʋʋmdã Waogdgo, Sãnkaryaare. Sãnkaryaar vaeesgã pʋgẽ, b paama neb sẽn da koosd koosem tɩ ka tũud soay n yõge. B sẽn yõg b rãmbã ra koosda: bõn-pusdum, rã-toose, la te-wẽns buud toor-toore. Yõ-koglgã Miniisr a Masmuudu SÃANA wilgame tɩ sodaasã sẽn tʋm tʋʋmd ningã b fãaga neb ka tɛk yõore. Bala, b ka tõe n bãng tɩ tẽng gãand bãanã rãmb na n bee weoogẽ wã n zabd wĩndg la yʋngo, tɩ neb be Waogdg n dɩk zabrã n maan b paoong pukr sor ye. A wilgame tɩ b rãmbã sẽn da koosd teed ninsã sõngda nin-wẽnsã la tẽngã bɛɛb sẽn be weoogẽ wã tɩ b tʋmd b tʋʋm-yookã. 

Miniisrã kell n kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ bõn-pusdmã sẽn pus Laglẽ la Tuudbweoog wakat sẽn loogã yaa bõn-pusd-kãens buudã n yɩ sabaabo. Miniisr SÃANA kõo Ladeli wã sor tɩ b na n maana vaees raas wʋsgo. Sãnkaryaar nengẽ wã, b rɩka raarã tõr n kell n tʋm tʋʋmdã. La bũmb ning sẽn wa ne Sãnkaryaar vaeesgã, yaa sull ning tẽngã zãadb sẽn sigl tɩ b sigind tẽngã sẽn na yɩl tɩ bũmbã fãa tũ sor wala sẽn segd tɩ b boond tɩ Laabalã n da kẽng zĩigẽ wã n na n tɩ yõk tab-wẽngã koaasda, tɩ Sãnkaryaar raag biisã n yik-b tɩ b kõn tʋm b tʋʋmdã, yaa rẽ n wa ne b sigl Ladeli wã. Sãnkaryaar vaeesgã poore, sapaolg kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2025 yaa Bobodɩʋlaso raagã la b vaeesda rãmbã.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2025 Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor soab a Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, tɩ zĩndame tɩ b pak nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paal b sẽn boond tɩ Nimerikã rasem a yapoe tig-kaseng naoor pissi soaba, Waogdg ka, Sɩyao wã zak pʋgẽ. Tigrã kʋlens pakr wakate Kapitɛnd pẽga tẽng gãand bãanã rãmb sẽn be weoogã pʋg n tʋmd wĩndg la yʋngã. A  wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, bala, tẽngã nu-gãag zabrã wɛɛngẽ wã tẽeb la saagr beeme. A kell n togsame tɩ nasaar wẽngã ra magdame t’a na n lebsa Burkĩna Faso yõ-koglgã poorẽ, la kibay sẽn yi zabrã pʋg rasem a yopoe wã pʋgẽ, wilgdame tɩ bɛ wã raab ka na n tol n pid ye. Bala, zĩig fãa, nin-wẽnsã ne tẽng gãand bãanã rãmb lebga « wãamb zoe n bas a biiga ». Yaa rẽ t’a  kos nebã tɩ  b yik tɩ b  yals yĩngr maan yĩn-kiiri, n tags tẽng gãand bãana rãmb yelle. Sẽn kẽed ne Nimerikã wɛɛngẽ, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR yeelame tɩ yaa yʋʋm pissi, la Burkĩna Faso be-a pʋgẽ. Nebã sẽn seg taab n na n zĩnd rasem a yopoe wã pʋga,

a ratame tɩ b ges yʋʋm pissi wã sẽn loogã pugẽ tʋʋma, n bal n gese, b zoe kẽn n taa yae, la b rat n kẽng-a n ta zĩ-bʋgo. A wilgame 2023 tɛka, b kẽng taoor Nimerikã tʋʋm wɛɛngẽ la b segd n modgame n kell n kẽng taoor n paase. Bala, a ratame tɩ ka la yʋʋm a nu sẽn wata, bɩ b mik tɩ yaa wa b sẽn da be a pʋgẽ yʋʋm koabga. A kell n togsame tɩ Burkĩna Faso segd n lʋɩs-a-la taoore, n tõog tɩ ãndũni wã fãa pʋgẽ, bɩ Burkĩna Faso zĩnd sʋka. A wilgame tɩ rũnda-rũnda tʋʋmd ka le tõe n tʋm t’a ka be sʋk ye. B sã n dɩk Nimerikã n kẽes sʋka, a na n sõngame tɩ nin-yend sẽn dɩk neb ka tɛk tʋʋm n tʋmdẽ wã, bɩ rẽ kolg weoogo, t’a leb n kẽesd tẽngã laogo. A na n sõngame tɩ gosneem tʋʋma kẽng taoore. Yaa laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ, tɩ yaa kaorengã, tɩ yaa yõ-koglgã zĩigẽ, bãmb fãa segdame tɩ b kẽes Nimerikã sʋka, sẽn na yɩl tɩ bũmbã fãa kẽng taoore. A kell n togsame tɩ b ka tõe n zab ne ninsaal yam raabã n tõog t’a ka zĩnd sʋk ye. B sã n dat zab ne-a t’a sa zãnga, rẽndame tɩ b kẽes Nimereikã zĩig fãa. Tɩ bala, tõnd tẽngã tara a tʋʋmde, yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ gosneem kẽesd a toogo, sẽn na yɩl tɩ Nimerikã tall n tʋm lebg vẽenega. Tʋʋm-noya fãa sã n kẽes-a sʋka, a na n sõngame tɩ b zab ne ninsaal yam daabã. Yaa rẽ tɩ Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR rat tɩ neb nins sẽn tʋmd a pʋgẽ wã sẽn tar bãngr buud toor-toorã,

bɩ b rɩk-a  kẽes sʋk gosneem tʋʋm-noya pʋgẽ t’a  yaa bũmb sẽn tõe n sõng tɩ bɛ wã sã n na n ling n kẽ n maan sãoong bɩ b gɩbl tao-tao n seg-a t’a ka paam n ta ye. A wilgame tɩ rũndã zugã ned fãa ratame tɩ bũmb sã n yɩ pẽrɩ bɩ a togs tẽng gãand bãanã rãmb zĩig pʋgẽ tɩ b gɩbl tɩ ra sãam ye. Nimerikã fãaga neb ka tɛk yõya. Bala, a sõngdame tɩ b beool n seg nin-wẽnsã tɩ b ka tʋm yook ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b rat tɩ b kẽes-a karen-dotã pʋse, la zĩig fãa.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Oni rãmb yiisa b yʋʋm 2025 magb sebr n wilg tɩ rapã sõor paooga pagbã. Ãndũni wã gilli, yaa neb tus-kẽemd a yopoe la zak n be a pʋgẽ. B gɛɛlã sebr wilga woto :

-Pagbã sõor yaa tus-kẽemd a nu 5,6 la zaka.

-Rapã sõor yaa tus-kẽemd a yiib 2,2 la zaka

Yaa rẽ tɩ Oni sagend pagbã tɩ b maan gũusg ne rapã yõy wẽgbo, la b waoog-b sõma, tɩ bala, b sõorã ka yɩɩd tus-kẽemd a yiib la zak ye :

-Rapã sʋka, rap tus-kẽemd a ye n zoe n kẽ kãadem.

-Rap nins sẽn kẽ kãadmã sʋka tus-kʋʋng 130 n be bãens rotẽ.

-Rap milyão 70 n be namsg pʋgẽ, zug kaoolg bãas wɛɛngẽ.

Rẽ wilgdame tɩ yaa rap tus-kẽemd a yembr masã, n wẽnd rap sẽn tõe n wa kẽ kãadem, bãmb tus-kẽemdã pʋgẽ:

– Rap koabg pʋgẽ rap pis-nu 50 % n ka tar tʋʋma

-Rap koabg a tãab 3 % n wẽneg n kẽed ne taab pag ne rao wɛɛngẽ

– Rap koabg a nu 5 % n ya labe rãmba, n ka kẽed kãadem ye

-B koabg pʋgẽ bãmb piig 10 % n ya buud a yembre, bɩ rogem

– Bãmb sʋkã neb pis-tã la a yiib 32 % n zoe n tar yʋʋm 66

Rẽ wã, m tãp sõmse gãd-y rapã kãenkã, la b zã-b ne waoore, tɩ rapã sõor na n paooga ãndũni wã pʋgẽ.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2025 soabã, Burkĩna Faso Miniisr ning sẽn get koobã la gʋʋlgã yiisa Miyaar a 5 n na n teel neb nus sẽn pa tat b poor tɩ b paam rũms n  gʋʋle. Ned ning sẽn tɩ yals tɩ b na n dɩk kũunã n taas b rãmb yaa Miniisr sõangda Dogtɛɛr Amadu Diko.

 Yẽ n zẽk a naoor n kẽng Maane babg ning b sẽn boond tɩ Kʋlsẽ wã Miniisr Yɩsmayɛll Sõmbi yʋʋr yĩnga, n tɩ kõ sor tɩ b sɩnge. Tɛɛndbã raab  ne b sẽn na n teel b rãmb ne rũmsã, ya b na wags-taab ne rũmsã zãabo, tɩ b tõog n yɩ sõma.

Yaa neb 83590 n paam tɩ b na n teel-b ne : pĩisi, kurkuiimba, la noos tɩ b gʋʋle. Pĩisã ne kurkuiimbã zĩigẽ, ned fãa na n paama  pe-raoogo, la pe-yãans a tã, e b rɩɩb yolg a naase, n paas b tɩbg ligdi. Kurkur-n-daoogo, la kurkur-n-yãans a tã, ne b rɩɩb yolg a nu, la b tɩbs ligdi. Noosã zĩigẽ,  yaa no-raoogo, la no-yãans piiga, ne b rɩɩb teedo, la b koom yũub teedo, n paas b rɩɩb yolg a yoobe, ne b paas b tɩbsg ligdi.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 12 yʋʋm 2025 soab na-zakẽ wã tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn zabd ne :ninsaal yam daabã  ne wẽgbã, la tʋʋm kɛg buud toor-toor sẽn tõe n wa tiis tẽngã taoor kẽnd tɩ b boond tɩ Koraaga, taoor soab a Faruk Azarya Sorg leb n yii Telvzõ nasnall yʋng wakat 9h00 n karem Koraagã mooneg a tãab soaba. Moonegã pʋgẽ, a wilgame tɩ tẽngã soab ne a gosneema la tʋʋm-noy buud toor-toor sẽn zabd wẽgbã, la b zabd ne nin-wẽnsã la ninsaal yam daabã, n maod ne kɛgã na leb poorẽ, tẽngã burkĩnd lebg n wa a zĩigẽ wã, wẽgdb sull n baas n ket n be doandã la bʋ-kaoodbã tʋʋm-noorẽ. Doane wã neb piig la a zak n da be be n deesd yaood tus pissi, n digd tus pis-tã neb nins sẽn yit tẽn-kɩrensẽ wã n wat ne laog gaolen-tẽngẽ wã Waogdgo, la b rãmbã yaool n tar b sɛba.

A wilgame tɩ yʋʋù sigr kiuug 2024 b ra kẽnga ne gomdã bʋʋdo, tɩ bʋ-kaoodbã yeel tɩ kaset ka be ye. Sa-sik kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2025 b leba ne gomdã, la vaeesgã sẽn maana, b wa n mikame tɩ bʋ-kaod-bɛd la bʋ-kaod-bãoones n kẽes b nug ninsaal yam daabã wɛɛngẽ, tɩ b ne doand dãmbã ra rat n sãam bʋʋdã tɩ gomdã kell n sa.  La sẽn zĩig sẽn ka zemse, b mikame tɩ neb nins sẽn tɩ togs tɩ b gũus n bãng zãmbã rãmba, b togsa sẽn ya b rãmba. B sẽn togs kibarã kɩtbã,  a yaa bũmb sẽn tõe n wa ne zu-loees b yõya koglg wɛɛngẽ. APẽndwẽnde Erik Zinaaba

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2025 Dĩna, n fão lekoll karen-biig sẽn ya bi-pulg n tar yʋʋm a yopoe Kombisr sorã zugu, tẽng ning b sẽn boond tɩ Gõaagẽ wã. Fãobã poore, nin-buiidã sũur puugame, tɩ b ning lorã bugum. Tẽng gãand bãanã la Sapɛɛr põmpi wã siga zĩigẽ wã, la b wilgame tɩ b na n maana vaeesg n bãng yellã sẽn sɩng toto.

Pĩndã bi-beesã ra gɩta pagb la rap Tuudbweoog sorã zug n deesd b montɛy la b ligdi. Pagb nins sẽn yikd pĩnd n kẽnd n pɩɩsd soaya tɩ b boond-b t’a Sɩmo pagbã, la sẽn tʋmd-b tẽngã pʋgẽ wã, b ra veooda kẽer n kẽed moogã n tʋmd-b sẽn ka sakda.  La sẽn zems yʋʋm 2024, zu-loe-kãng ra sɩnga weoog kolgre, tɩ bala, b ninga sorã kõntaale la Lampadɛɛr dãmba. Rẽ ra kɩtame tɩ bi-beesã ra ka le tõe n solg n tʋm  tʋʋm-beedã ye.  La yellã yaa “pẽg pag n yaag yal a zẽedẽ”. Tɩ bala, yʋʋmd a yembr poore, bi-beesã tõe n le wa paama solgr zĩiga, tɩ Arõndiisma 4 Delgasẽoespesɛll rãmb sã n ka yik n pĩnd n beoole.

 Rõmpõe ning sẽn be Wẽndyaawẽnd noorẽ wã ne Terã bãng sʋka, Lampadɛɛr rãmb pis-naas n segd be be. Rũndã sapaolg kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2025, Lampadɛɛr dãmb pis-naas sʋka, bãmb pissi la a tãab n ki. Yaool n yaa zĩ-kãng la bi-beesã sẽn da gɩtã. Sagdã zak sẽne  likã rat n lebga wʋsgo. Yaa rẽ tɩ m bõosd Arõndiisma 4 Meer t’a lebs Tuudbweoog sorã Lampadɛɛr rãmba, la a ra bas tɩ kɩɩm kẽ roogẽ t’a yaool n pag ragno-pĩir ye. A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Sapaolg kiuug rasem a 7 yʋʋm 2025 soabã Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR reega nin-sabls nins sẽn dog Amerik la Eropo, la Karayiib soolmẽ wã Waogdgo. Gom-zug tẽngã zãadb sẽn yãk n deeg-bã, yaa” ne y waoongo, yãmb tẽngẽ wã”. Sõasgã pʋgẽ, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR wilgame tɩ neb nins sẽn da yõg nin-sablã n kẽes yembdã ne b sõangdbã  sã n  wʋm tɩ nin-sablsã  rat n sooga b mense, a namsd-b-la wʋsgo, la sẽn ya a soab fãa, nin-sabls tẽnsã kom-bɩɩb  yam pukame.

 A wilgame t’a na n tʋmame tɩ Burkĩna Faso yɩ makre, tɩ neb a taabã bãng tɩ bãmb me tõe sooga b mense. Yaa neb ta bãmb 700 n zẽk b naoor n sig Burkĩna Faso, n na n wilg b sũur belem ne tẽngã taoor soaba a Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE. Tẽngã taoor soab pẽg-b lame, n wilg-b tɩ b yaa Burkĩna Faso no-rɛɛsdba. Bãmb sẽn yi nasaar tẽns n wa zĩnd Burkĩna Faso n gilg n maan b sẽn datã n lebg n kuus ne laafɩ wã, bãmb na n yɩɩ kaseto, tɩ nebã bãng tɩ nasaar wẽnsã sẽn ningd nebã zutẽ tɩ Burkĩna Faso la AES tẽnsã ka gãe bãanã, a ka tar tikr zĩig ye. Tẽngã taoor soab yeel-b-la woto:” tõnd maoorã ka Burkĩna Faso na paam a burkĩndã  bal ye. Burkĩna Faso maooda nin-sabls tẽnsã yĩnga, la nin-sablg buudã fãa na paam a burkĩndã”.  

A wilg-b lame tɩ sẽn kẽed ne b na paam Burkĩna Faso sɛb n tõe n zĩnd Burkĩna Faso wa b sẽn date, gosneerã taoor ra togsame tɩ yaood n be tɩ segd n yao, la yẽ yãka yaoodã n base. B sã n dat n pags tʋʋm-noy bɩ b wa pagse, tɩ gosneer na n maoome tɩ bũmb ra maan-b ye. B na n yãag-b lame tɩ b tõog n tʋm n nafe. Sãambã no-rɛɛsa Dogtɛɛr Arikana Sisombori-Kao togsame tɩ bãmb me na n yãaga tẽngã taoor dãmba, b yam yãkr buud fãa pʋgẽ. A wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, ne Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, ne a gosneerã taoor soaba. A pẽg-b lame, tɩ bala, b sakame tɩ bãmb na n lebg n leb b yãgrẽ wã.

Tẽegre, b  waa Burkĩna Faso zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2025 n gilg n seg neb ka tɛka, la b kõ kũun buud toor-toore. Wẽnd na leb n wa ne-b yʋʋmd sẽn wata. A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2025 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE reega a na-taaga Zenerall Abduramaan TIYANI Waogdgo. Ya a sẽn yi Mali n lebg n kuusẽ la a tũ Burkĩna Faso t’a ne Faso tẽngã taoor soab zĩnd ne taab n sõse. B sõasgã pʋgẽ b goma yõ-koglgã yell AYEYƐSA “AES” tẽnsã pʋsẽ. Rẽ poore, b kell n goma Nizɛɛr ne Burkĩnda zoodã, la b tẽnsã zãab yelle. Nizɛɛr tẽngã taoor soab sẽn be naamẽ wã tɛka, yaa naoor a yiib masã, la a zẽk  a naoor n wa Burkĩna Faso. Kaagrã yaa sẽn yɩl n kell n paas tẽns a yiibã zood pãnga.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ

Sa-sik kiuug rasem a 6 n tãag a rasem a 9 yʋʋm 2025 Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã tʋʋm-noor a ye b sẽn boond tɩ « SIG-eDMP » boola kiba-kɩtb sõor na ta bãmb 50  Zɩnyãre Reezõ de Wubri wã soolmẽ tɩ b zĩnd n pʋɩ taab yam sẽn kẽed ne pagbã ne b kambã sẽn maand kaalem b rogmã wakate, bɩ b rogmã poore. B zĩndgã ne taabã tʋlsem yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ kiba-kɩtbã kẽes b toog tɩ b sõng taab n  sagl nin-buiidã, tɩ b naag taab n zab ne-a t’a kolg weoogo. A Silvi Yeri Yul/ Tarwar « DSF »  pag ning sẽn get nin-buiidã ne b zagsã rãmb laafɩ taoor soab wilgame tɩ pagbã ne b kambã sẽn kiid rogmã wakatã , naoor wʋsgo, a mi n naaga ne neb nins sẽn segd n beool n segl n gũud pagã t’a sã n kẽ logtor yirã bɩ bũmb ra paoog n yɩ sabaab n tiis-a wã, yaa bãmb rãmbã n mi n ka kẽes b toog tʋʋlle, n wat ne rẽ.

Wakat ninga b tata ne pagã, n mik tɩ b ka reng n beool n bao zɩɩm bɩ teed kẽer n dʋʋg n da gũud-a ye. A Silvi Yeri Yul/Tarwar wilgame tɩ kiba-kɩtbã sã n sak n kẽes b toog ne sagls la vẽnegr buud toor-toore, wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ, b na n mikame tɩ b tõoga maoorã. B tʋlsmã sã n pidi,  kambã ne b ma rãmbã kũum rogmã wakat bɩ rogmã poor sã n ka sa me, bɩ a kolg weoogo. A wilgame tɩ bãmb kõo sɩd tɩ kiba-kɩtbã sã n kẽes b toog ne sagls la vẽnegr buud toor-toore, nin-buiidã me na n sak n lʋɩɩsa b toog n yãag pagbã ne b kambã tɩ b paam tɩbsgo, la b ges b pʋsã n tãag b rogem sasa.

Porfesɛɛr Adma Watara wilgame tɩ b sã n yeel tɩ pag kũum tũu ne rogem, yaa pagã sẽn na n wa kẽnd ne rasem 42 pʋga. Rẽ poore, rasem nins sẽn pʋgdã a sã n maan kaalem yaa pʋgã n yɩ sabaabo. Kambã rẽ yaa wala pag sã n dog a rasem a yopoe pʋgẽ tɩ biigã wẽneg n maan kaalem. A kaalmã sabaab tũu ne a rogmã wakate. Sasa kẽere, biigã tõe n kii pʋgẽ wã n yaool n yi, ka rẽ  bɩ a yi n wẽneg n maan kaalem rasem yopoe pʋgẽ.

Burkĩna Faso kom-kũumã ket n beeme. Yʋʋm 2010 kamb tus koabg pʋgẽ bãmb 198 n maan kaalem tɩ tũ ne b rogmã sabaabo. Rũndã zugã pagb tusr bɩ pagb kosbs-wae n maand kaalem sẽn tũ ne b pʋsã sabaabo. Vaeesgã wilgame tɩ Burkĩna wen-vɩɩs a naasã pʋgẽ kamb sẽn maand kaalem b rogmã wakat bɩ b rogmã poore, b sõorã yaa kamb 15000. Yʋʋmd pʋgẽ yaa kamb 9000 bɩ 6000 n maand kaalem sẽn tũ ne rogmã sabaabo. B sõorã sẽn ya wʋsgã wilgdame tɩ kambã kũum ket n yaa wʋsgo. Yaa rẽ la bãngdbã ges tɩ segdame tɩ b sagl nin-buiidã tɩ b kẽes b toog n beool tɩ b gɩdg-a. A gɩdgrã soay yaa wʋsgo. Pipi, ya b reng n segl pagã rogem teedo, a yãagdba, la bũmb nins fãa sẽn na n tɩ sõng-a logtorã yir tɩ bũmb ra paooge, n wa ne zu-loees ye. B modg tɩ b sã n bool logtor yir n togs tɩ b talla pʋg-pʋʋg n watẽ bɩ logtoɛɛmbã zoe n segl n bao zɩɩm bɩ teed buud fãa sẽn segd n tũ ne a rogmã n dʋʋge, la b maneg zĩigã n gũud-a. Zĩ-kãngã kibayã taasg na n sõngame tɩ nebã fãa yɩ wʋmdba, la b sak n kẽes b toogo.

OMS no-rɛɛs a Kolotɛɛr Hẽnd sẽn get laafɩ wã yell wilgame tɩ OMS yãagda bãmb a laafɩ wã yel-gɛtb ne sagls la toglg buud toor-toore. A wilgda sor ning b sẽn na n tũ tɩ pagbã ne kambã tall laafɩ b rogem wakate, la b rogem poore. A kẽesd a toog maoorã pʋgẽ sẽn na yɩl tɩ pag sã n doge, bɩ biigã ne a ma tar laafɩ. OMS tʋlsem ya b tõog n yã yam n zab ne kambã ne b ma rãmbã kũum rogmã sabaab poorẽ t’a tolg n sa. A wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso rãmb rɩka na-kẽndr n dat t’a sã n ka sa zãng me, bɩ a ra le yɩɩg tus koabgã pʋgẽ neb pissopoe ye. Burkĩna Faso rãmb zoe n tõogame tɩ b maoorã kẽng taoor n yɩɩd nin-sabls tẽnga. Nin-sabs tẽnga, neb tus koabg pʋgẽ yaa neb kobs-naas n maand kaalem sẽn tũ ne rogmã sabaabã. Rasem a tãabã pʋgẽ yɩɩ logtoɛɛm-bɛd n wa n wegs koe-zutã.

Baasgã wakate, logtoeem-bɛdã welga kiba-kɩtbã sul a yiibu. Sull fãa bala koe-zut nins b sẽn wilgã n togs a me sẽn tagsd tɩ b sã n tũ sor ninga b na n tõogame tɩ nebã wʋm la b sak n tũ. Kiba-kɩtbã wilgame tɩ b na n giga Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã n sõs ne nin-buiidã n wek b yamã la b tall-b n kẽes maoorã pʋgẽ. B na n maana sõs buud toor-toore, Televizõ rãmb pʋse, Radiyo rãmb pʋse, la b yi n kẽng  n tɩ sõs ne-ba. B na n sõs ne-b ne buudã goam la b maan nin-naandse, nogoom dãmba, la b tũnug ne bũmb buud fãa b sẽn tõe n tũ n taas-b kibayã.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Sig-noy kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2025 soabã Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã pʋgẽ kʋdemdã la rog-n-mik la yel-gɛtbã maana b raarã naoor a yiib soaba. Kʋdemd la rog-n-mik raar naoor a yiib soabã Pãngsoab boola nin-buiidã tɩ b kẽes b toog n ges kambã wubr pʋgẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ b yãk gom-zu-kãngã: Moos wubri, a yaa pʋʋgo, burkĩndlim, bãng-n-vʋɩɩmde, kʋdemd la rog-n-mik pʋgẽ.

Lamus raare, sig-noy kiuug rasem 15 yibeoog wakat a yopoe sasa nebã sega taab zama kõn bãng n sõd Pãngsoab samandẽ wã. Sẽn ya kʋdemd la rog-n-mik raarã, maana b arzũm raar  fãa b sẽn mi n yit wa tãp makr tɩ b boond tɩ yiisgã.

Yiisgã sẽn wa n sa, Pãngsoab  yika Ragno-neng “rap noore” n kẽ kn tɩ yi Ragno-bɛɛgẽ wã “Pagb noore”. B sẽn yi be, neb nins sẽn get sigrã siglg yell waa ne no-ra-pɛɛla, la pe-ra-peelse, tɩ Pãngsoab rɩk b nug n sɩɩs pesgã n kɩs Waogdgnaaba, tɩ b kẽng n tɩ kʋ n bõos tɩ tẽngã gãand bãane, la b bõos sa-ko-sõngo, sigl-sõngo, la laafɩ n kõ nebã tɩ b tõog n ko ne yĩn-maasem. Rẽ poore, b kɩsa Kaadyoognaaba, la Bagnaaba. Rũmsã fãa kõbg fãa ya a yembre. Kosgã me yaa kos-yɛnga.

Pãngsoab sẽn dɩk rũmsã n kɩs-b poore, b yikame n kẽ. Wiidnaab sẽn ya kug-zĩidbã taoor soabã rɩka koɛɛg Pãngsoab yʋʋr yĩnga. B togsa kiba-kɩtbã Pãngsoab sẽn kɩs rũmsã tɩ b kʋ bũmb ning yĩnga. B wilgame tɩ Pãngsoab yeelame tɩ b sã n dat tɩ kʋdemdã la rog-n-mikã kẽng taoore, segdame tɩ kambã la nin-buiidã fãa paam wub-sõngo. Rẽ la b na n tõog n bãng sõng la yook n bake, n tõog n bãng naag taab n vʋɩɩmd yõodo, la b waoog kasemba, tɩ b zĩnd-n-taar tall yamleoogo. Pãngsoab ratame tɩ kambã tõog n kelgd b roagdbã nin-kẽemsã la pʋg-yãansã saglse, n me wa tõog n dɩk n taas b kamb la b yagense, tɩ b sẽn paam bũmb ning fãa bɩ yɩ ba-yirã zãng n paame. Pãngsoab kɩsa rũms tɩ b kʋ n bõos tɩ tẽngã gãand bãane, la sigrã me yɩ sõma. Wiidnaab koeesã poore, kiba-kɩtbã la nebã kẽnga yĩn-wɩsgrã zĩig sẽn be Pãngẽ wã, n na n tɩ kelg sõs-kẽenga. B renga taoor n da zĩ n gũud Pãngsoaba.

Pãngsoab sẽn wa n watẽ, b pʋg-tãpã ra yãkda b fut n tɩʋʋd tẽng tɩ b tabg naam tabgre, la b gengd naam gengre. B sẽn wa n kolgdẽ, zama wã yika yĩngri. Pãngsoab sẽn kẽ n zĩndi, b kõo zama wã noor tɩ b zĩndi. Pãngsoab zĩndame tɩ b kom-dibli la b yagengs wa n ning-b kãnga, n wilg naam sẽn waoogd toto.

Pãngsoab zĩndgã poore, Wiidnaab leb n dɩka koɛɛg Pãngsoab yʋʋr yĩnga. Wiidnaab wilgame tɩ Pãngsoab pẽgda Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE ne a gosneema. B wilgame tɩ Pãngsoab sũur sẽn nooma, b maana Pẽgr kaset sɛb tɩ b kõ Depite rãmbã taoor soab a Wʋsmaan BUGMA n paas gosneerã taoor soab a Rĩmtallba Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO, la miniisr ning sẽn get tẽng gãand bãanã a Selɛstẽ SẼEMPOORE.

Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR yãka a Selɛstẽ SẼEMPOOR t’a zĩnd gosneemã yʋʋr yʋʋr yĩnga. Miniisrã koees pʋgẽ, a pẽga Pãngsoaba, b sẽn yãk gom-zugã tɩ ya kambã wubr yellã. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ zu-loees nins tõnd sẽn paamdã, a yãgrã fãa yaa wubrã kaalem, la tõnd sẽn bas d rog-n-mik vʋɩɩmã na-kẽndr n kẽng n tɩ kẽ neb a taabã tũudmã, n wa ne rẽ. Koeesã rɩgsg wakate Pãngsoab boola Miniisr kʋdr a Saglmay WEDRAOOGO, t’a me wa kõ a sũur koeese. A Saglmay wilgame t’a ra kẽ a Zezi Kiris tũudmã pʋgẽ, la f sã n tũud sor t’a ka kẽngd ne-f taoor bɩ f lebge.

Tigrã koe-zug yaa Waogdg Gʋngẽ Bɩnnaab wegs-a. Bɩnnaab wilga kambã wub-sõng yõod sẽn ya a soab n wilg nebã. Koeesã sẽn wa n kolgd weoogo, a NAANA Bibɛt tɩ b boond t’a Bibɛtkoɛɛg wa n deeme. Zĩtẽng yarsã reemame, t’a Bukasutg rãmb me tãoo solmde.

Wakat piig la a ye sẽn wa n looge, Pãngsoab yik n kẽ. Sõasdbã yɩɩ Saonaab a Kãoonga, Nemdnaab a Rɩtaam 2, Mise BADINI, Dogtɛɛr Patrik KƲRAOOGO, n paas pag a yembre. Saonaab wilga naamã zãab na-kẽndr sẽn segd n yɩ a soaba, la zu-loees nins sẽn be a pʋgẽ tɩ b segd n demse. Mise BADINI wɛgsa rog-n-mikã la kʋdemdã yõod n wilgi.

Dogtɛɛr KƲRAOOG togsa rog-n-mik wubrã, b pʋg-belengo, la b pʋg-kũuni, b pag pʋg puusgu, la b sẽn da zãad b burkĩnd toto. A wilgame tɩ moaag ra zoeta yãnde, a ra zoeta paoore

emdnaab a Rɩtaam 2 wɛgsa tẽn-gãongã koosg zu-loeese, la kiid faad pʋɩɩb yell n wilg zama wã. Sõasgã wa n tɩ baasa ne sʋgsgo, la leoobo.

Neb nins fãa sẽn zĩnd zĩigẽ wã sũur yɩɩ noogo, tɩ b kot Wẽnd ne ba-rãmba, la yaab rãmb tɩ b kell n yãag-b tɩ b maandẽ-a wakat fãa. D wa n sãeega taab zaabr wakat a 4 sasa. Wẽnnaam la Naabazɩɩdwẽnd leb n deega rog-n-mikã la kʋdemdã yel-gɛtb kosgo. A pipi yʋʋmdã saga nii kiuugã rasem 16 n pek rũmsã zɩɩm. A naoor a yiib soabã saga nii badaar zaabre, tɩ rẽ wilgdẽ tɩ b kosg reegame. Wẽnd na kell n kõ-d a taab yaka, n kɩt tɩ d maan n bãge.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Sig-noy kiuug rasem a 8 yʋʋm 2025 soabã karen-do-kaseng a ye sẽn be Wubrtẽng soolmã tẽn-bil a ye b sẽn boond tɩ Nakambtẽnga, tʋʋm-kaseng n zĩnd be. Buudã karen-do-kẽeng a ye b sẽn boond tɩ INSETA n yiis a pipi karen-biis sẽn karem buudã goam n paam bãngr kaset seb-bedr b sẽn boond tɩ Lisãasã. Tʋʋm-noorã geta Pastɛɛr rãmbã kaorengo, la ned buud fãa sẽn karem buudã goam n paam bãngr kaset sebre, n dat n kẽng taoor ne bãngr kaset sɛb wala: Lisãase, Metriisi, Bake, Dogtora…

INSETA pipia karen-biisã kaoreng balb sɩnga Zɩnyãr soolmã Nakamtẽnga, yibeoog wakat 09h sasa. Balbã maana  Miniisr ning sẽn get karen-bi-bãoonesã la buudã piuugri a Zak Sostɛnd DẼNGARA, a Hawa KẼNDRBEOOGO, ned ning Ministɛɛrã sẽn zĩnig t’a get buudã goamã, la karen-biisã karen-saamb kasenga Dogtɛɛt Sãmwɛll KORGO, n paas Burkĩna Merka wã taoor soab kasenga.

DCRP/MEBAPLN

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2025 soabã, a yɩɩ daar sẽn ka wẽnd a taab Burkĩna Faso la ãnduni wã tẽns a taab pʋsẽ.  Yaa Wanyiyã lagem-n-taar sull kaseng ning b sẽn boond tɩ SENAVESE wã n bool nin-buiidã tɩ b sak n yi n zulum yiib n wilg tɩ b bee ne tẽngã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE. Waogdgo, yɩɩ Palaasdelarevolisẽo la b seg taaba. Yɩɩ pagba, rapa, karen-biisi, la goosneerã taoor soab a Zã Emanwɛɛl WEDRAOOGO, n paas miniisr dãmb kẽere.

Koeesã   rɩsg sẽn wa n sɩnge, SENAVESE wã taoor soaba a Onoore SAMADULG wilgame tɩ ninbuiidã yiime n wilg b belem ne tẽnga taoor soaba, la b leb n wilg nasaar wẽnsã la neb nins fãa sẽn dat n sãam Kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE naama tɩ b gũus tɩ ninbuiidã yasa a wɩla.

Sãn yaa ne Amerik Zenerallã a Mikayɛl Lãgle sẽn wilg tɩ kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE rɩkda Burkĩna Faso sãnma sẽn na n yɩlẽ n paam n koglg a mengã , n basd ninbuiidã, a wilgame tɩ yaa paoogr meng a sẽn paoog tẽnga taoor soaba . A Onore Samadulgu sokame gese rẽn yĩnga Burkĩna Faso naaga Amerik soolme ? bɩ a Lãgle rat n lebga Burkĩna Faso neda ? sãn mikame t’a yaab rãmba sẽn yi nasaara nins yẽ sẽn yaa b yamb rũnda rũnda wã ra yaa Burkĩna Faso faso neba, bɩ a wilg tɩ rẽnda tõe n sõngame t’a paam n yi Burkĩna tẽng n bɩɩga. A wilgame tɩ nasaar wẽngã, ne aa tʋʋmd n taasã sẽn yaa nin-wẽnsã ka tar b zĩig Burkĩna Faso ye.A kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ AYEYƐSÃ ninbuiid gãda taaba, rẽnd nasaar wẽngã ne a tẽng-n-tɛɛndbã fãa ka na n tõog tɩ b raabã pid ye.

A Labidi NABA, SENAVESE wã tãb biig a yembr wilgame tɩ tigs kãnga yaa ãnduni wã fãa tigsga, a tʋlsma yaa ninbuiidã fãa yãag tẽnga taoor soaba so-sõng ninga a sẽn dɩka zugu, la b wilg nasaar wẽengã, sẽn tar sɩlem ninga n dat n sãam tẽngã t’a raabã ka na n tol n pid ye. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ sãn n yaa ne yẽ, koeegã ka lʋɩ muk tʋbrẽ ye, bala zama wã sẽn yi wʋsgã yaa kibar sẽn kõt bɛ wã t’a maan gũusgu.

Gosneerã taoor soaba a Rĩmtalba Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOG rɩka koeeg tẽnga taoor soab yʋʋr yĩnga. A koeesã pʋgẽ a reng n tẽega naong ning yaab rãmba sẽn paam yemdã wakatã, ket n yaa na kẽnd kãng la b sẽn le rat n dɩkã, bala ninsabls wʋsg sẽn be nasaarã wã maasme n ket n dat n zãmb b saam biisã n paam b noor rɩɩbo.A wilga neb nĩns fãa sẽn dat Burkĩna Faso ne wẽngã tɩ b gũus b meng tɩ wakat kãng loogame, bala Burkĩna Faso sẽn vɩɩmd bũmb ning yʋʋmd 1987 soabã ka na n le yɩlem ye. Yʋʋm 1987 soabã, nasaar wẽengã talla wogb bũud toor-toore, n wilg t’a Tama SÃNKAR yaa naab sẽn nams a ninbuiidã la a kʋʋd ba, woto yɩɩ sabaab t’a tunug ninsabls tẽns neb kẽere la Burkĩna Faso tẽng kamb sẽn ka tar tagsg tɩ ka b mensa bal n paam n kʋ-a, rũnda rũnda wã, tõnd be yʋʋù 2025 soabã. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ ninbuiidã segd n tik n yikame n naag taab n yals tẽnga taoor soab poorẽ, bala yaa zunoog meng-meng ne-ba tɩ b paam taoor soab sẽn yaa bi-bɩɩga n leb yaa ned sẽn yaa ges yɩɩg soaba.

A Rĩmtalba Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG kell n dɩka tẽnga taoor soab koees n taas ninbuiidã fãa a wilgame tɩ tẽnga taoor soab yeelame t’a taas ninbuiidã ta sũur ka kiuusd ye, tɩ ba tʋʋm yoodã bũud toor-toor sẽn tʋʋmdã, a pɛlg ket n yaa kãe-kãe, t’a na n tʋʋm tẽnga na yi nin-wẽnsa nugẽ, la a tõog n kẽng taoore.

Gosneerã taoor soab pasaame tɩ ninbuiidã sẽn yi wʋsg woto wã yaa bũmb sẽn paasd tẽnga taoor soab raoodo, tɩ bala ninbuiidã sãn be a poorẽ, raabem ka be ye. A baasã a koeesã n wilg tɩ zaama wã sẽn tigs woto wã na n namsa neb –kẽere, kẽer na n kẽeme n mak gõeem n koonge.

Tʋʋl nif kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2025 soabã yaa raar sẽn ka na n tol yiime bala, Burkĩna Faso sẽn yãk a toogo, ãduni wã tẽns wʋsg pʋsẽ ninbuiidã yiime n wilg b belem ne Kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, bala a yaa ned la ning sẽn na n kɩt tɩ ninsabls tẽnsa tõog n paam b soog-n-meng sɩd sɩda, la b tõog n kẽng taoore.

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2025 soabã ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kaorengã, la buudã goam na kẽng taoorã sigla seg-taab-kaseng Waga deemill sɛkã roogẽ. Tigsgã taoor yɩɩ gosneema taoor soab a Rĩmtallba Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO, tɩ ba-yãkdgã ya a Zak Sostɛnd DẼNGARA, minisr ning sẽn get kaorengã la buudã goam na kẽng taoorã. Gom-zut b sẽn tik n maan tigsgã, yaa «Afirik zamaana buud goama:  koees sẽn na wa ne manegre, bʋ-sɩd la nin-buiidã burkĩnd pukri, tɩ d me Afirik ning tõnd sẽn datã». «Buudã goam bee sʋka : Ned fãa buud gomd daar sẽn  yãk n kõ ãndũni wã yʋʋm pissi la a nu kɩdengo».

Gosneemã taoor soab sẽn lʋɩ tʋʋmdã taoorã, a rɩka koɛɛg ne moore. A koɛɛgã rɩkr wilgame,  tɩ wakat sẽn looge,  karen-dotã pʋsẽ, karen-biig sã n da gom buudã gomde, b sɩbgd-a lame, hal n ning-a bãnd t’a taabã laad-a. Rẽ fãa yaa nasaara wã sẽn da kẽes nin-sablsã zutẽ,

 tɩ b yĩm b buudã gomde, la b rɩk yẽ rẽ wã, t’a paam n maan nebã a yembse. La rũndã-rũndã, nin-sablsã nin pukame. Rẽ n so tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda n kẽesd buudã goam karen-dotã pʋsẽ, la tẽngã tẽn-kugr pʋgẽ. Na-kẽnd-kãng wilgdame tɩ d raabã sẽn ya na lebg d sẽn yiẽ wã, a na n paama pidsgu. A Rĩmtallba Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b tik b buudã goama,  tɩ rẽ bal n tõe tɩ b tẽngã kẽng taoore, a yidgrã wɛɛngẽ.

Buudã goam ra-kasengã siglg taoor soab a Awa Kẽndrbeoog wilgame tɩ yaa sũ-noog ne-ba, tɩ bala gosneerã taoor soab sẽn zẽk b naoor n wa lʋɩ tigsgã pʋgẽ. Rẽ zoe n yaa bũmb sẽn wilgd tɩ buudã goam rɩk n kẽes sʋkã be a na-kẽnd-sõng zugu. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsã rãmb segd n tika b kʋdemdã, la b rog-n-mikã. La b sã n dat n maan rẽ,  rẽndame tɩ  b tik b buudã goama. Bala, «pag ka geta a pog-to peoogo, n lub a wam zaok ye». A koeesã baasgẽ, a wilgame tɩ nin-sablsã ka tõe n yidg tɩ b sã n ka b tik b buudã goam ye.

Tigsgã pʋga, karen-biisã maana reem n bẽd n wilg nin-buiidã tɩ buudã goam tara yõodo.

B kell n wilga buudã goam yõod sẽn tõe n kẽng ne ninsaal taoor toto. Tigsgã baasa ne sũ-noogo, tɩ b kõ taab sɛk yʋʋmd sẽn wate, n na n le segd taab rasem a yopoe wã b sẽn yãk tɩ ya nin-sabls tẽns buudã goam tẽegrã.

A Zill KAFAANDO, ne a Pẽgdwẽnde Erik ZINAABA

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2025 soabã pʋgẽ, ministɛɛr ning sẽn get karen-bi-bãoonesã la buudã goam na kẽng taoor tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn tʋmd buudã goam na piuugã yãka Waogdg Samandẽ, “BCD’ Ekoall a ye b sẽn yãk n zãmsd kambã buudã gaom kaorengo, la a gʋlsgo, ne nasaara wã goam kaoreng zĩiga, n tɩ yaas n kõ sore,  tɩ b na n maan nin-sabls tẽnsẽ buudã goam ra-yopoende. Rasem a yopoe wã pʋgẽ, yaa tõnd sẽn dog ne goam ninsã la b na n zĩnd ne taab n ges b sẽn tõe n gãneg soay nins n tõog  t’a yɩ yidgrã la taoorã kẽnd zab-teoogo, nin-buiidã fãa yĩnga. B sɩnga buudã ra-yopoendã arzũma wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 21 n na n tall-a n tɩ tãag kiuugã rasem 26.

 Burkĩna Faso rãmb yãka gom-zu-kãngã: Buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsg na kẽng taoor yĩnga, bɩ ned fãa kẽes a meng t’a yɩ sabaab n pak tɩlgr la yidgr sor n kõ nin-buiidã fãa. La sã n ya ne Reezõ di sãntrã, bãmb tika : Buudã goam kaoreng na kẽng taoore: A yõod paoongo, la a alkaol rɩkr ne nin-buiidã yidgr yĩnga.

Bũmb nins sẽn wa ne koe-zutã yãkre, b wilgame tɩ buudã goam kaoreng gʋlsg sɩngr zãrame. A yaa sabaab tɩ neb kẽer tar-a n tʋmd nafd b mense, tɩ rẽ zoe n wilgdẽ t’a yõodã waoogame. La b sã n leb n na n ges yɩɩga, b mikdame t’a karemdbã sõor ka waoog ye. Rẽ fãa wilgda vẽenega, tɩ buudã goam  kaoeng bãngr kom la ko-yũud ket n tara nin-buiidã. Neb sẽn namsd a pʋgẽ yaa kom-bɩɩbã. Burkĩna Faso kamb sõor na ta pisopoe la a zak n ket b ka mi b buudã goam kaoreng la gʋlsg ye.

La b gesame n mik tɩ Fãrendã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsg me sɩngr zãrame. La ba ne rẽ fãa nin-buiidã ket n ka tõe n yidg b mens ye.

B ka tõe n yidg b mensã yãgre, yaa Fãrendã sẽn ka b buudã goama. Yaa rẽ la b yãk rasem a yopoe tõre, n na n zĩnd n tags buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsg zugu, n bao yam n pʋɩ taab tɩ zu-loɛɛgã yã tɩɩm. Sẽn sigl-b ra-poendã rãmb wilgame tɩ buudã goam kaoreng sõngda biig t’a yam weke. A leb n sõngda ned t’a ket n tar waoor ning a sẽn dog n mik tɩ nebã waoogd taab toto wã.

A Hawa Sawadgo, miniisrã sẽn yãk ned ning t’a be Ministɛɛrẽ wã n get buudã goama wilgame tɩ buudã goam kaoreng sõngda ned buud fãa t’a mi ned sẽn yɩɩd-a la a waoogd-a. Tẽegre, yaa yʋʋm 1961 la b sɩng-a, n da dɩkd-a n kẽesd Ekoallsẽ wã, la a ka zãag zĩig ye. Sẽn leb n wa ta yʋʋm 1979, b leb n waa ne-a, yẽ ka zãag zĩig ye.

Rẽ fãa wilgdame tɩ buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsgo, b ra ka rɩk-a n lʋɩɩs taoor boto ye. Tɩ bala, nasaara wã belga nin-buiidã n yãk bãensã a sẽn da sog b nusã la b nao wã, n leb n kẽ b zutẽ wã n soge. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ b ra yetẽ tɩ yaa nasaara wã buud gomd bal n tõe n sõng-b tɩ b yidgi. La Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOOR ne gosneer yãka yam n dɩk-a n lʋɩɩs taoore, t’a be tẽngã tẽn-kugr pʋgẽ. Rẽ yaa paoong ne burkĩn buudã fãa.

Burkĩna Faso rãmb kɩdemda buudã goam ra-kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsẽ buud goam ra-yopoende. Nin-sabls tẽnsã zãng yãka gom-zu-kãngã: Nin-sabls tẽns buud goam sẽn na n sõng tɩ nebã paam yẽsg ne taaba, la lagem-n-taar ne taaba, tɩ tõnd tõog n me Afrik ning tõnd sẽn datã.

Waogdg soolmã komber tʋma ned t’a wa b yʋʋr yĩnga. Koeesã rɩkr pʋgẽ, nin-kãng soabã wilgame tɩ ra-kasen-kãngã tʋlsem yaa nin-sabls tẽnsã zãadb na naag taab noor a ye sũur a ye, tɩ b kambã paam buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsgo, n lebg n bãng b yaab rãmbã soalma, b sɩɩlse, b kibaya, la b yel-bũn gãnegre. Yaa neb ka tɛk n zĩnd zĩigẽ n dɩk koees buud toor-toore. Ekoallã karen-biis maana reem la Tayatr sẽn tar seem tɩ nin-buiidã naag taab n gese. Zʋgnall Rãamd taoor soabã karma Ekoall Samandẽ. Sẽn na yɩl tɩ kamb nins sẽn ledg bãmb zĩigã tõog n paam buudã goam n yãag b mense,   a Rãamd taoor soabã a Yɩrɛne TẼEDRBEOOG kɩsa Zʋgnall Rãamde la kaoreng sebr sẽn boond tɩ “Nonglem yaa bãaga”, tɩ ministɛɛrã taoor rãmb reeg n kõ Ekoallã karen-saam-dãmb ne b karen-biisi, la b yãk n pʋɩ zãma wã sẽn da be zĩigẽ wã.  M kota Wẽnd tɩ b yãag neb nins fãa sẽn tʋmd buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsg na kẽngrã, tɩ b tõog n tʋm n pidis tẽngã taoor rãmb yam yãkrã.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba                                                                                                      

Pengdouendé Eric Zinaaba

Sẽn tũ ne b sẽn seg taab yʋʋm sar kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, depite rãmba kõ sor tɩ b sẽn yõk neb nins n wilg tɩ b kẽesa b toog naam-wẽ dɩk vaalã sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm 2015 soabã, depite rãmb 70 wã sẽn zĩnd zĩigẽ wã sʋka, yaa depite rãmb 67 n wilg tɩ bãmb ratame tɩ b kõ nin-bãmba sor tɩ b yi bãensa roogẽ.

Depite rãmba sẽn kõ sorã, yaa gosneerã masa n na n dɩk na-kẽndr n kõ neb 63  sẽn da kẽes b mens  naam-wẽ n dɩkã sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm 2015 soabã, pʋgẽ pemsem. Gosneerã wilgame tɩ nin-bãmba na n yiime n kẽes b toog n zab ne nin-wẽnsã.

Nand tɩ depite rãmba kõ sore, b reng n talla sogs bũud toor-toor n sogs gosneerã. Pipi, yaa tɩ nin-bãmba sẽn na n paam pemsema a ka na n wa ne no-koeem ninbuiidã sũ-pũur sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm 2014 soabã pʋgẽ wã zugu ? Minisr ning sẽn get sari wã yell wilgame tɩ « ayo ». Minisrã wilgame tɩ neb 63 sẽn be bãensã roogẽ wã sʋka, neb sõor sẽn yɩɩd bãmb pistã sɩbgr n zoe n sa, sẽn ketã, ka yɩɩd neb a wɛ ye.

Tẽegre , sor kũun kãnga na n sõngame tɩ b yẽs neb nins sẽn da be bãensa roogẽ wã sɩbgre, tɩ beegr bũud ka le be b zug ye.

Kibarã yii faso.net

Yʋʋm sar kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, Burkĩna Faso tẽnga taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE maana nug tikri, nug tikrã pʋga, b wilgame tɩ Zeneral Musa GƐLLO n lebg sodaasã taoor soab b sẽn boond tɩ Etamazoorã.

Nin-kãnga ledaa Zeneral Selestẽ SẼMPOORE sẽn lebg sodaasã minisrã zĩiga.

Nand tɩ tẽnga taoor soab nan ka yãka t’a lʋɩ Burkĩna Faso sodaasã taoore, Zenerla Musa Gɛllo ra yaa sodaasã sull b sẽn boond tɩ Birgad ɛspesɛl dẽtɛrvãsẽo rapiidã taoor soaba. Tẽegre yɩɩ yʋʋm sar kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2024 soabã sẽn loogã la b paasa naama t’a lebg Zenerale.

Kibarã yii Faso.net

Yʋʋm sar kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, Burkĩna Faso tẽnga taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE sega Sãntarafirik tẽnga taoor soaba a Fostẽ Arkãz Towadera Waogdg silg-yirã.

Yaa zood la tʋʋmd n taar kaagr la Sãntarafirik tẽnga taoor soab wa n kaag Burkĩna Faso, a waoongã kell n yaa sẽn na n paas tẽnsa a yiibã zood pãnga. Tẽnsa a yiibã taoor dãmb zĩnda ne taab Burkĩna Faso na-zakẽ wã. B soãsga pʋga b goma tẽnsa a yiibã ne taab tõkr yelle, la gom zut a taab sẽn kẽed ne ninsabls tẽnsa yelle. Sẽn le paasde, b goma yõ-koglgã, la tẽnsa taoor kẽnde, la b na tõog n zab n n soog b menga b arzekã taoor kẽnde, la ninbuiidã tɩlgre.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2024, Sãntr Kasa Famigliya yaa mugma Salom zãmsg tʋʋm-noor a ye sẽn be Waogdg Arõndiisma a 9 wã pʋgẽ. B maana b karen-biis zãmsg baasg tigr zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 2024 yʋʋm 2024 soabã.

Yaa karen-biis 21 n paam fut sẽebo, sʋnd wʋgbo, la ragend tʋʋma zãmsgo. Yaa  4 soab masã la b sẽn maand tigrã, la b pʋda vukã a 4 soabã yʋʋr tɩ Ana Bruni, n tẽegd b karen-saamba ye sẽn maan kaalem tʋʋlg kiuug yʋʋm 2024 soabã.

Yaa minisr ning sẽn get sõng-taabã la zagsã zãab la b yãk t’a lʋɩ tʋʋmdã taoore. La a yãka  ministɛɛrã seb-gʋnd a Dezɩɩre Kõmpaoor t’a kẽng n tɩ zĩnd a yʋʋr yĩnga. Miniisrã sẽn tʋm a soabã wilgame tɩ kom-bɩɩbã sẽn paam zãmsgã, a yaa bũmb sẽn na n sõng-b vɩɩma pʋgẽ. A wilgame t’a sũur nooma ne-ba. A kell n kos-b lame tɩ b tall yam b tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ. A Dezɩɩre Kõmpaoor wilgame tɩ ministɛɛrã na n maana a pãng sẽn tõe n yãag Kasa Famigliya rãmb tɩ b tõog n yãag kom-bɩɩbã tɩ b paam n bãng nus tʋʋma, tɩ b vɩɩmã tõog n yɩ neer beoogo.

Tʋʋmdã ma-yãkdg a Rooz SANU togsa karen-biisã tɩ b sẽn paam bãngr kaset sɛb n na n yi n sɩng tʋʋma, b bãng tɩ wakat ninga, b na n sega yal buud toor-toore, la zu-loeesã na n sõng-b lame tɩ b tõog n kẽng taoore. Bala, bũmbã fãa ka  n yɩ naana ye. La zu-loɛɛeg sã n wa kẽ sʋk me, bɩ b tall raoodo, tɩ b raabã na n pidame. B modg n tʋm tɩ yaa tʋʋmd bal n yiisd ninsaal  naong pʋgẽ. A kos-b lame tɩ b modg tɩ b tʋʋma yɩɩg b goama. Sẽn paam-b zãmsgã no-rɛɛs a Abdul Mubarak SOOR wilgame tɩ b sũur yaaa noogo.

A togsame tɩ bãmb sẽn paam zãmsgã lebga ned kam pak a toor n tʋʋmde, la a modg n zãms a taab tɩ bãngr segda n pʋɩɩbo. Museyẽer Dõ Ãnderya Piyo Kiristɛni Salom lugundã wilgame t’a sũur nooma ne kom bɩɩbã sẽn paam bãngrã. A wilgame tɩ vɩɩmã pʋgẽ segdame tɩ ned fãa tik bũmb n maandẽ. Rẽ n ya Salom tʋlsem. B kõo karen-biig fãa paama bãngr kaset sebr ning b sẽn boond tɩ « SEKUPE » wã.

Tẽegre, yaa  yʋʋm 2011 soabã, la Sãntrã paka a kʋɩlense. La yaa yʋʋm 2014 soabã, la a paama a sɛb nins sẽn wilgd t’a tara sor n tʋma a tʋʋma. Mugma Salom rãmb maanda b yʋʋm 50 rõandã la yaa yʋʋm 36 la b be Burkĩna Faso.

Zɩll KAFAANDO

Jules KAFANDO

Nasẽozĩni tʋʋm-noorã bee Burkĩna Faso 1966 yʋʋmdã. Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, b sega kiba-kɩtbã Nasẽozini tʋʋm-noorã ro-kaseng sẽn be Waogdgã. Sɛkã võore, yaa sẽn na n wilg-b zems-n-taar na-kẽndr b sẽn gãneg n na n tʋm ne Burkĩna Faso.

Madam Karoll Foloor Semerzeniyak sẽn ya Nasẽnzĩni tʋʋm-noorã taoor soab wilgame tɩ yaa sula 33 n naag taaba, la bãmb pissi la a nu wã  tʋmda nin-buiidã vʋɩɩm sõmblem paasg wɛɛngẽ.

A togsame tɩ tʋʋm-noorã bee Burkĩna Faso n yãagd gofneerã, a maoorã buud fãa pʋgẽ, sẽn na yɩl t’a tʋm tɩ nin-buiidã vʋɩɩm yolse. Tʋʋm-noorã yãagda gofneer kaorengã wɛɛngẽ, yõ-koglgã wɛɛngẽ, rɩɩb wɛɛngẽ, la zu-loees a taab wala fu-gobse, la pĩ-gãase. Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã pʋgẽ, b tara no-rɛɛsdba. A wilgame tɩ raab sẽn wa n be babg ning fãa, bãmb sõndame tɩ zu-loɛɛgã paam welgre. B sõngda kom-bɩɩbã la pagbã, b  vʋɩɩmã manegr wɛɛngẽ. 

Yʋʋm 2023 n na n tãag yʋʋm 2025 b gãnega tʋʋma, n na n yãag gofneem tẽngã zãab pʋgẽ, la b sõng-b tɩ zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã, tɩ nin-buiidã paam laafɩ, la b paam bũmb nins fãa sẽn segd ne-ba.

Yʋʋm 2023 Nasẽozini sõnga tẽngã zãad-b ne Milyaar 445, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b tõog n manes bũmb nins fãa, b sẽn dat n mange. B leb n yẽsda ne gofneem tɩ b mao tɩ ninsaal yalẽ wã paam waoogre. Madam Karoll Foloor Semerzeniyak togsame tɩ Nasẽozĩni tigs-kaseng naoor 79 sẽn loogã, a wilga sullã taoor rãmb tɩ b ges n yols yalã tɩ Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã vʋɩɩm maneg n paase.

A wilgame tɩ Nasẽozini rãmb sakame n na n yãag Burkĩna Faso tẽngã zãadba, b sẽn be maoor ningã pʋgẽ. Sõasgã kell n yɩɩ tʋʋma b sẽn tʋm tɩ looge, la b sẽn gãneg tʋʋma n na n tʋm la b rɩk n taas kiba-kɩtbã.  Sẽn kẽed ne a Barbara Manzi nengẽ wã, Madam Karoll Foloor Semerzeniyak togsame tɩ “zaamẽ saag looga ne a waoodo”. Yẽnda waame n na n tʋm tẽngã zãad-b sẽn dat tɩ b tʋm ne taab toto wã.

Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, sull ning sẽn get kibayã kũun rot remsg tɩ b boond tɩ SEYƐSE wã taoor soab a Lui Modɛɛs WEDRAOOG tɩ kaaga gosneerã taoor soaba.

 B sẽn yãk-a t’a lʋɩ sullã taoor loogr poore, a yãka yam ne a poorẽ dãmb kẽer n tɩ kaag miniisr Apolineer KELEM. Sõasgã poore, tʋʋm-noor taoor soab fãa wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo. Bala b sẽn segd zu-loees nins kibayã kũun rot kiblg wɛɛngẽ wã, a na n paama tɩɩm masã. A Modɛɛs WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ saglsã na n sõnga bãmb tɩ b tõog n tʋm tɩ kibayã kũun rot kẽn wa sẽn segde. Bũmb zãnga, Burkĩna Faso sẽn be yõ-koglg kaalem pʋgẽ wã. A Modɛɛs WEDRAOOG ne a poorẽ dãmbã pʋlmame tɩ b na n maana bũmbã fãa ne zemsgo, wala noyã sẽn gãnegã.

Tẽegre, yaa yʋʋm a nu la paspoor kiid tɩ b lebg n maan a to.

Sull ning b sẽn boond tɩ MuvmaFasomapatri wã ne rog-n-mik nanambs sull b sẽn boond tɩ bas-m-yam naaga taab n lugl sul-kasenga. Yaa na-zakẽ miniisrã a Mill ZERBO sẽn get gosneer tʋm-tʋmdbã la b yãk t’a yɩ b ba-yãkdga. «Burkĩna Selbal Baara» yaa buud a yiib  goama. «Selbal» yaa silmiidri rat n yeel tɩ laafɩ. «Baara» wã yaa bãmbarende rat n yeelame tɩ « tʋʋmde». Sullã tʋlsem ya a tigim rog-n-mik nanambsã tɩ b yɩ no-gãn-yende, n yãag tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b zab ne bɛ wã.

Tʋʋmdã siglg taoor soaba a Onoore SAMANDULGU, wilgame tɩ sullã na n boola rog-n-mikã taoor dãmb tɩ b kẽes b toogo,  tɩ b naag taab n zab ne nasaar wẽnsã, la a sõangdbã. Sullã na n sagenda nebã, n zãmsd-b tẽng-n-bi-tɩrlem na-kẽndre, la a sõogd ned nind fãa sẽn tʋmd ne nin-wẽnsã nugu.

 A wilgame tɩ yaa yʋʋm katɛka, la nasaar rãmbã sẽn wẽgd Burkĩna Faso nebã. A yõga nin-sabls n kẽng nasaar tẽns  tɩ b tʋm yembdo. La rũnda, leb n yaa ne yembdã tʋʋmd neng a to n lebg n watẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ b rat tɩ nin-buiidã gãd taab nus la b ra bas t’a paam n tikd tẽngã kamb n pidisd a raabã wa sẽn loogã ye.

A pẽga tẽngã taoor dãmba, b sẽn yãk yam n dɩk tẽns a tãabã n naag taab n na n tʋma. A Onoore SAMANDULGU pẽga kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE ne a miniisr dãmbã, b sẽn maood n dat tɩ tẽngã yi nin-wẽnsã nugẽ wã. A Sayidu SANU sẽn wa n zĩnd miniisr Basolma BAAZIYE yʋʋr yĩngã pẽgme, n wilg tɩ b yam-yãkrã yaa sõma, la a na  taas tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b ges b sẽn tõe n dɩk na-kẽndr ning  n yãag-ba.

Naaba a Saag me sẽn zĩnd kadensã miniisr yʋʋr yĩngã pẽgame, la b kell n kos nebã tɩ b bas welgre, sũ-kiiri,  la beem buud toor-toore, la b gãd taab nusi, tɩ ba-yirã bɛ yaa nin-yende. Rog-n-mik nanambsã kosa tẽngã kamb tɩ b gãd taab nusi, tɩ b fãa sã n naag taaba, b tõogda nin-wẽnsã ne b sõangdbã. B kell n bẽda tigsgã pʋg n wilg b su-sãams ne yel-beed ning sẽn zĩnd Barsaolg tɩ neb ka tɛk maan kaalmã.

Tigsgã poore, na-zakẽ miniisrã wilgame tɩ gosneer rɩka noor n dat tɩ b tek tẽn-kugrã no-rɩkd 34 ne a 147 wã. No-rɩkr 34 gom-rulg a 4 gomda tẽngã tãb-kaoor zab-yʋʋ yelle. Bʋ-kaoorã miniisr togsame tɩ tekrã yaa sẽn na  yɩl tɩ Burkĩna Faso kambã tõog n lebg n paam tẽng-n-biilim la b ba-yirã nonglem. No-rɩkr 147 soabã, ra wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso sã n dat n kẽ sull kaseng pʋgẽ, segdame tɩ b reng n maan sʋkr vot, tɩ nebã kõ-b tagsg tɩ b yaool n kẽ.

Miniisr Edaso Rodirik BAYALA wilgame tɩ no-rɩk-kãng kõta sor tɩ zu-loe-kaseng wakat bɩ tẽngã tõe n kẽ sull pʋgẽ tɩ ka tũ ne vot ye. Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã, gilg-n-ges yel-soalmã, la kibayã kũuni, la ministɛɛr ning sẽn get arzɛkã la yʋʋmdã moend wilgame tɩ gosneer rɩka noor tɩ AYIBE “AIB” sẽn da get Burkĩna Faso kibayã kũunã na n tolg n lebg gosneer tʋʋm-noore. Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get gosneer nug-tʋmtʋmdbã kõo sor tɩ b rɩk gom-lɛɛbdb 11 tɩ b sõng ministɛɛr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã tɩ bala, Burkĩna Faso tika nug ne tẽns kẽere, tɩ b segd n leebdẽ goamã.

AES miniisr dãmb nins sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã gʋlsa sebr sa-sik kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2024 soabã n kõ Nasẽozini  sull ning sẽn get tẽnsã na gãand bãanã.  Sẽoog kiuugã baosgẽ nin-wẽnsã  tɩ wẽe Mali sodaasã. Wẽedbã pʋgẽ Yɩkrɛnd sodaas la tẽns a taab neb zĩnda sʋka. Wẽebã poore, Yɩkrɛnd no-rɛɛsã sẽn be Senegallã rɩka koɛɛg n wilg tɩ b mii nin-wẽnsã tʋʋmd tiigri. Yaa rẽ tɩ  tẽns a tãabã miniisr dãmb  gʋls sebr n kõ a Mikayɛl Yimrand KANU, Sɩɩraleyond tẽngã no-rɛɛsa, tɩ bala, bãmb tẽngã bee Nasẽozini sullã pʋg n get tẽng na gãand bãanã.

Sebrã pʋgẽ miniisr dãmbã kosa Nasẽozini rãmb tɩ b rɩk na-kẽndr Yɩkrɛnd sẽn yãk yam n yãagd nin-wẽnsã ãnduni wã, sẽn yɩɩd fãa Sayɛllã soolmẽ. Yɩkrɛnd sẽn sõng nin-wẽnsã yɩɩ sabaab tɩ Mali ne Nizɛɛr yals zoodã ne-b sa-sik kiuug rasem a 4 ne a rasma a 6 yʋʋm 2024 soabã.

Sẽoog kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2024 soabã tẽngã taoor soaba Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, rɩka  tɩbsg teed n ning ministɛɛr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã taoor rãmb nugẽ.

Yaa mobills sẽn kẽnd sẽn kell n ya wa logtor-yir b sẽn boond tɩ « kilinik mobillã » bãmb 15, ne mobills 36, pikop 11, taablɛt rãmb 835, la tɩt bĩngr zĩis 1900 n paas teed a taaba, la masĩn dãmb sẽn na n bĩngd tɩtã. Teedã sẽn na n sõnga tɩbsgã wɛɛngẽ n yɩɩd pagbã la kom-bãoonegã.

Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame tɩ bãmb sẽn yãk yam n da teedã yaa sẽn na  yɩl tɩ neb nins sẽn be tẽn-kɩrensã tõog n paamdẽ tɩbsgo. A kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b sagl tɩ yaa weoogã bãag wakato,  la b manes ko-rẽgdã zĩis tɩ rũmsã ra paam n wekdẽ ye. A togsame tɩ logtoɛɛmbã ra tara zu-loees tɩtã bĩngr wɛɛngẽ, la tʋʋmdã teed sẽn paama, zu-loe-kãng kolga weoogo. A wilgame tɩ b na n dɩka teedã n kɩs tẽn-kɩrensẽ logto-yiyã.

Laafɩ wã Miniisr a Robɛɛr Luisẽ Zãn Kolood KARGUUG wilgame tɩ raarã yaa ra-kaseng ne neb nins fãa sẽn tʋmd laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ. A pẽga tẽngã taoor soaba, a sẽn yãk yam n get nin-buuidã laafɩ wã. Miniisrã kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b zã teedã sõma. A  kosa logtoɛɛmbã me tɩ b kẽes b toog tɩ Burkĩna Faso nebã paam tɩbs sõngo. Yaa sẽn tũ ne gosneer ne a tʋmd-n-taas kẽer sõngr la b paam teedã.

Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE pʋʋsa “Yɩɩrã” tẽngã rãmb ne b toogo, b tẽngã taoor soaba a Ebrayɩɩm RAYISI sẽn maan kaalmã. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE togsame tɩ “Yɩɩrã” tẽngã taoor soab ra yaa ned sẽn zabd a tẽngã la a nin-buiidã fãagre, la b soog-m-meng yĩnga. Sẽn sɩng ne Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE sẽn wa naamã zug bõn-bɩʋʋg kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã tɛka, Burkĩna Faso ne “Yɩɩrã” zoodã pãng pasaame. Bala Burkĩna Faso tẽnga,̃ taoor rãmb kẽer kẽngame n tɩ maan nug-tigsa wʋsg ne-a. Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 24 n tãag sig-noy kiuug pipi daare yʋʋm 2024 soabã, Gosneerã taoor soaba a Apolineer KELEM ra bee “Yɩɩra”̃ tʋmd-n-taarã wɛɛngẽ.Kibarã yii Lɩɩbr ẽnfo

Yaa wa moos sẽn maan b kibare : « sã n moe sagb n kõ a kom-n-da-tar-ma, yaa yaas n wʋk teedo ». Sig-noy kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2024 soabã Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naas rog-n-mik la kʋdemdã yel-gɛtb maana kʋdemdã la rog-n-mikã pipi raare. Ra yaa yʋʋm ka tɛka tɩ neb nins sẽn ket n be saamb la yaab sorã zug ra rat n me raar tool zalle, n tẽegd b saam-dãmb la b yaab rãmb yell n kõt-b koom n wilgdẽ tɩ b ka yel-sõm-zɩtb ye. Gosneer sẽn zĩnd b rasem a yopoe-poe sɛkã ; b wilgame tɩ b yãka sig-noy kiuug rasem 15, yʋʋmd fãa tɩ na n lebg kʋdemdã la rog-n-mikã raare. Raarã ka tʋmd ye, la b yaoodame. Raarã sẽn yãke, nin-buiidã wʋsg yĩns ra kɩrdame, tɩ b gũud-a. Sig-noy kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2024 yibeoog wakat a yoobe, Waogdg nin-buiidã ra yõsda taaba, n kẽnd Pãngẽ, n na n tɩ paam n ges Pãngsoab yiisgã. Yibeoog wakat a yoobe, rẽ tɩ d yasa Pãng soab rago-nengã “Rap noore”. Kiba-kɩtbã ned fãa ra kʋmsda masĩn t’a yõg foto rãmb la filme. D sẽn tar kʋmsgo, d wa n wʋmame : « foto ka yõkd ka ye. Filing ka filimd ka ye ».

Wakat a yoobã sẽn wa n ta, sõgen-kamb ra yasa goabg la rɩtgo, n maneg b sẽgene, n da yas wa pagba. Wakat a yoob sẽn wa n loog minit 45 sasa, d wʋmdame:” Pãngsoab yiime! Naab a Bãoog yiime”. D sẽn zẽk d neng n gese, d mikame tɩ b ninga te-peelse, n fũgun b Maanfo, n dɩk b Fublg n palg b bãoko, tɩ d ket n yas n tar gesgo. B sẽn zĩnd n sa, Kamsãoognaab sẽn ya na-pagã bãmb n lʋɩ taoore, tɩ Wiidnaab ne b poor n dãmb yika ne b sʋ-wogdo, tong taaba, n kẽnda. B sẽn wa n kolge, b tek n zĩndame n ning kãn-tɩ-wogdo. «Rog-n-miki, kʋdemde, la burkĩndã tik n me Burkĩna Faso paalle». Gom-zu-kãnga la b tik n maan « SNC » wã naoor 21 soabã. Reem-rɛɛmdbã yɩɩ bãmb 1705. B yii Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã pʋsẽ, n seg taab Bobo n zĩnd rasem a yopoe, tɩ ned fãa wilg a sẽn tar bãngr ning kʋdemd la rog-n-mik reem wɛɛngẽ

« SNC » wã taoor soab a Kiristɛnd SANU wilgame tɩ « GPNAL » wags n bao taoor soabã pʋgẽ, yaa  reem sula 112 n wags taaba. Wasgã b pʋɩ-a-la zĩig  toor toore. Pipi rãmbã yaa kom-bɩɩbã. Zĩ-kãnga, yɩɩ reem-rɛɛmdb sula 15 n wags taab ne rog-n-mik: yɩɩla, saooga, la yʋʋm-teedã wẽebo. Bãmb zĩigẽ wã yɩɩ bãmb 97. Kom-kamsemsã tika rog-n-mik saooga, rog-n-mik yɩɩla la yʋʋm-teed-wẽeb n kẽ wagsgã pʋgẽ.

Rog-n-mik yĩn-wɩsgrã zĩigẽ yɩɩ: maoore. Maoorã zĩigẽ yɩɩ neb 294 n wags-taaba. Lokã yãbg n tão wã zĩigẽ yaa neb 98 n wags taaba.

Sã n ya ne gʋlsgã wags taab pʋgẽ yaa seb-gʋndb 79 n kẽes b mens wags taabã pʋgẽ. Gʋlsgã yɩɩ Roma rãmba, Nuvɛll rãmba la Poeezi rãmba. « SNC » wã pʋgẽ, kʋdemd-teedã me wasg zĩndame. Zĩ-kãng yaa neb 600 n yadg kʋdemd-teed buud toor-toore, tɩ nin-buiidã ra kẽnd n getẽ. Neb 300000 n yi nin-sabls tẽnsẽ n wa gilg n ges kʋdem-teedã.

Miniisr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã la gilg-n-ges yel-soalmã, a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO wilgame tɩ bãmb sẽn da rat bũmb ning tigrã pʋgẽ wã pidame. Miniisrã wilga neb nins sẽn yãagd tɩ « SNC » wã tɩ tigrã lebga gosneer tʋʋm-noore. A kosa zama wã tɩ b yok b tʋb n kelg zu-loees nins sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã n wa n sõng-a t’a kẽn sõma, la a ra leb poorẽ ye.

Miniisrã pẽga neb nins fãa sẽn paam kũunã. Miniisrã wilg-b lame tɩ b sẽn tõog n lʋɩ taoor wagsg buud toor-toor pʋgã, b gʋlsa b yʋʋr kʋdemdã zãadb sʋka.

Sẽn paam-b maoorã la saoogã taoore, Nizɛɛr sẽn ya  tẽng b sẽn yãk t’a ya tigrã waoor tẽngã, kõ-b-la milyõ a yembr-yembre. Nizɛɛr miniisrã a Abdurahamane AMADU pẽga Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã tigr naoor 21 soabã. A wilgame tɩ rasem a yopoe wã pʋg a sẽn zĩnd Bobo wã, a sã n lebg n kusẽ a kuusa ne sũ-noogo. A wilgame tɩ Nizɛɛr rãmb me pʋɩ-b kʋdemd ne Burkĩna Faso. A togsame tɩ wakat sẽn wate Mali me na n naagame tɩ kʋdemdã tõog n paam pãng n paas tẽns a tãabã pʋgẽ.

Tigrã kʋɩlens pagbẽ neb nins fãa sẽn wags n paama reega b kũuni, tɩ gosneerã taoor soaba, a Apolineer KELEM yaool n wẽ Balafõ wã naoor a yoobe, n wilg tɩ » SNC » naoor 21 soabã paga a kʋɩlense.

SNC 2024 : CLAP DE FIN DE LA 21E ÉDITION DE LA SEMAINE NATIONALE DE LA CULTURE

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, na-zakẽ miniisr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã la gilg-n-ges yel-soalmã, a Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOGO, kõo sor tɩ gilg-n-ges kʋdemdã la yel-soalmã zĩis pak a kʋɩlens Bobo Dʋlasoba miisrẽ wã.

Yaa neb 2500 n na n paam n gilg-n-ges Bobo kʋdemdã la yel-soalmã zĩisã, « SNC” » naoor 21 soabã pʋgẽ. Yaa Bukĩna Faso miniisrã, ne a miniirs-taab sẽn yit Nizɛɛr kʋdemdã miniisr a Abdurahamane AMADU, bãmb n  tɩ kõ sor tɩ gilg-n-gesã pak a kʋɩlense. B na n sõs-a-la Radiyo rãmbã pʋse, n wegs-a tɩ neb nins sẽn yãag nebã tɩ b gilgd n get kʋdemdã zĩis paam a bãnre. Karen-biisã, la reem-rɛɛmdbã me na n paamame tɩ b yãag-b tɩ b gilg n gese.

Miniisr Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOG wilgame t’a yam yãk-paall bãmb sẽn kẽes kʋdemdã seg-taab kaseng pʋgẽ. A togsame tɩ « SNC » wã pʋga, nin-buiidã tõe n bẽdame n gilg n ges Bobo Dɩʋlaso yel-soalmã zĩis wala Sogosɩra, Koro (tẽn-bil a ye) a Gimbi WATARA yaoogã, la kʋɩlg ning b sẽn boond tɩ Gẽgɛtã, n paas zĩis a taaba. Miniisrã boonda neb nins sẽn zẽk b naoor n be Bobo dɩʋlaso wã tɩ b yɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã no-rɛɛsdba. Burkĩna Faso kʋdemd la yel-soalmã zĩis yaa 1080, b sʋkã zĩ-bɛdã yaa 399. Yʋʋm 2021 soabã, yɩɩ neb 520 000 n yi kɛɛng n wa Burkĩna Faso n wa gilg n gesã wɛɛngẽ. Gilgrã pʋgẽ, b kẽesa tẽngã milyaar 56.

Nizɛɛr miniisrã wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã sẽn yãk yam ningã yaa sõma. Bala, a na n sõngame tɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã zĩis yʋʋr yi zamaan-zẽnse, tɩ neb wat n getẽ. Nizɛɛr kʋdemdã miniisr wilgame tɩ Dɩʋlasoba miisrã buud a to n be tẽngã Nizɛɛr baobg ning b sẽn boond tɩ Agadɛz. Miis-kãng me meebã taa yʋʋm 1500 baobgo.

Kibarã yii AYIBE

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, tẽngã taoor soaba, kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE kõo sor tɩ kʋdemdã tigs kaseng (SNC ) vuk 21 soabã pak a kʋɩlẽnse, yɩɩ ballã tãoob zak b sẽn boond tɩ « Ɛstaad omnispoor Sãngule Lamizaana » sẽn be Bobo dɩʋlaso wã pʋgẽ.

Wala b sẽn sɩng n maandẽ, neb nins sẽn nong kʋdemdã le sega taab Bobo dɩʋlaso n na n maan « SNC » naoor 21 soabã. Yaa rasma a yopoe la b na n maan-a. Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã la buud toor-toore, ned fãa na n kolg n wilg a kʋdemd sẽn ya a soaba.  A naoor 21 soabã sẽn tõogã yaa bũmb sẽn wilgd tɩ Burkina Faso rãmb sɩd yikame n na n zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã b sẽn vʋɩ a pʋgẽ wã.

Reem-rɛɛmdb buud toor-toor sẽn yi Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã fãa pʋgẽ la tẽn-yags wa n deemame. Tigrã kʋɩlens pakr wakato, tẽngã taoor soab n wẽ gãngaoogã  naoor a tã n wilg tɩ tigrã kʋɩlens pakame.

Nand tɩ tigrã kʋɩlens pake, Bobo Meeri wã delegasõ ɛspesɛll taoor soab a Lorã Kõntogm rɩka koɛɛg n pʋʋs nebã fãa ne-b waoongo, la a wilg b sẽn sogl tigrã toto. A Zonaas YÃMBWEOOGO, sẽn ya “SNC” naoor 21 soabã, ba-yãkdg pẽga tẽngã taoor dãmba, b sẽn dɩk waoor ning n kõ-a wã. A wilgame t’a na n maana a pãng sẽn tõe fãa, tɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã tõog n kẽng taoore..

Na-zakẽ miniisr ning sẽn get kibayã kɩsgo, kʋdemdã la gilg n ges yel-soalmã, a Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOGO tɩ yaa sunoog bal n be ne yẽndã , a wilgame tɩ zama wã sẽn yɩ wʋsg woto wã sɩd wilgdame tɩ Bobo Dɩʋlaso yaa Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã na-tẽnga. A pẽga reem-rɛɛmdbã fãa sẽn deem tigrã kʋɩlens pakr wakatã. Kʋdemdã tig-kaseng naoor 21 soabã gom-zug yaa «Rog-n-miki, kʋdemde, la burkĩndã tik n me Burkĩna Faso paalle». Miniisrã wilgame tɩ gom-zugã yãkr ka yɩ yaar ye.

A tũu ne tõnd tẽngã sẽn vʋɩ zu-loees nins pʋgẽ wã. Rẽnd Burkĩna Faso ned kam fãa segd n tika a buud kʋdem la a rog-n-mik n tʋm t’a burkĩndã paam pãng n paase, tɩ bala, yaa burkĩnd la yaab rãmb tik n zab ne nasaar wẽengã la b lebg n tigim b tẽngã yʋʋm 1947 soabã, b sẽn da pʋɩ-a ne a tẽn-yagsã yʋʋm 1932 soabã. A Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOGO pẽga Nizɛɛr miniisr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã ne a poorẽ dãmba, tɩ bala, yaa Nizɛɛr la b yãk tɩ ya waoor tẽng b sẽn boole.

Nizɛɛr kʋdemdã miniisr a Amadu ABDURAMAAN, waa ne Nizɛɛr neb wʋsgo. Mali rãmb me tʋma ned ning sẽn get kʋdemdã a Ãndogoli GINDO t’a wa zĩnd Mali tẽngã taoor rãmb yʋʋr yĩnga.

Rasem a yopoe wã pʋgẽ yaa reem-rɛɛmdb 1535 n na n deeme. Neb zẽk b naoor n be be Bobo yaa 700 000 « SNC » wã yĩnga. Rasem a yopoe wã pʋgẽ wags-taab buud toor-toor na n maaname tɩ b bãng ned ning n na n dɩk-a kũun-kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ « GPNAL »

Sõasg buud toor-toor na n maana kʋdemdã zugu. B sigla raag tɩ nebã tõe n paam n da kʋdemd-teed buud toor-toore.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, miniisr dãmbã maana b rasem a yopoe-yopoe tigsgã Bobo dɩʋlaso. Yaa  tẽngã taoor soaba  Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE n lʋɩ tigsgã taoore.

Tigsgã sẽn wa n sa, na-zakẽ miniisr a Zã Emanwɛɛl WEDRAOOGO, sẽn ya gosneerã no-rɛɛsã wilgame tɩ b sẽn zĩnd ne taabã b rɩka noy tẽngã na kẽng taoor wɛɛngẽ.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kaorengã la buudã goam taoor kẽnd zĩigẽ miniisr dãmbã rɩka noor n na n yals karen-biisã rɩɩbo, b sẽn da rɩk n ning komindã taoor dãmb nusẽ wã.

Miniisr Zak DINGARA wilgame tɩ noorã b sẽn dɩkã a tũu ne zu-loees buud toor-toor b sẽn segd Lekollsẽ wã. A wilgame tɩ naoor wʋsgo, kaorengã wat n dat n pagame, tɩ rɩɩbã nan ka ta ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ gosneer yãk yam n deeg tʋʋmdã a toore.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get leebgã, la nus tʋʋma zĩigẽ, miniisr dãmbã rɩka tʋʋm-noy sẽn get arzɛkã zãab yell n na n ning tʋʋm-noy sẽn so b mens nusẽ.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get so-togsã zĩigẽ, miniisr Rolã SÕMDA wilgame tɩ reega tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn get karensi wã tɩ b boond tɩ « SONABI » la tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn get Sãnmã vaeesg tʋʋm tɩ b boond tɩ « BIMIZƐB » n paas tʋʋm-noor sẽn get mobilsã vaeesgo, tɩ boond tɩ « SESEVEYA » wã, tɩ lebg gosneer n na n gese.

Miniisr SÕMDA togsame tɩ noorã b sẽn dɩkã na n  sõngame tɩ gosneer lebg n sigl tʋʋma na-kẽnda,  tɩ bũmbã fãa yɩ sõma. Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get arzɛkã la moendã zĩigẽ, gosneer lugla Sãntr t’a na n ges  noos la kĩin gʋʋlgo, tɩ b boond tɩ « KAPAMAP » (CPAMAP). Miniisr ning sẽn get gʋʋlgã, a Amadu DIKO wilgame tɩ yam yãkrã na n sõngame tɩ noosã la kĩinã gʋʋlg paam pãng Burkĩna Faso.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Sull ning sẽn tigimd  Burkĩna Faso sʋn-wʋgdbã tɩ b boond tɩ «FENATI BF» yãka rasem a tã, tɩ ya sʋndã fut buud toor-toor daare. Tʋʋmdã ya a vuk a yiib-n-soabã pak a kʋɩlens tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, SEYAWO wã zakẽ Waogdgo, n na n tɩ pag kiuugã rasem 28.

Sʋn-wʋgdba yii Burkĩna Faso reezõ rãmbã pʋsẽ, n seg taab Waogdgo. Gom-zug b sẽn yãk yaa « Na-kẽnda nins b sẽn tõe n dɩk tɩ sʋndã fuug paam a zĩig Burkĩna Faso yõ-koglg kaalmã pʋgẽ».

Tʋʋmdã ba-yãkd ra segd n yɩɩ depite rãmbã taoor soaba, la a sẽk sẽn ka zĩnd yĩnga, a tʋma a pipi pʋgdgã.

A Wʋsmaan BUGMA sẽn tʋm a soabã pẽga sʋn-wʋgdbã. A wilgame tɩ b yam yãkrã yaa bũmb sẽn wilgd tɩ pagbã kẽesa b mens tẽngã sẽn be zu-loees ninsã pʋgẽ. A togsame tɩ wakat fãa pagbã maanda b sẽn tõe, tɩ sʋndã tʋʋmd kẽnd taoore. Tʋʋm-kãng yaa bũmb sẽn zẽkd Burkĩna Faso zugu, tɩ ãndũni rãmb miẽ, tʋ ba yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn be wã fut ket n yita Bukĩna Faso n kẽnd tẽn-zẽnse. A pʋlame t’a na n yãag-b lame tɩ b tʋʋmdã kẽng taoor n paase.

A Polind BAFEOGO sʋn-wʋgdgbã sull taoor soab wilgame tɩ bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b yãk rasem a tã tɩ ya sʋndã fut daar a vuk a yiib  soabã,  a  pipi soabã b paamame tɩ tẽngã taoor dãmb yãag-ba. B yãagrã yɩɩ sabaab tɩ  sʋn-wʋgdbã sula sẽn be reezõ rãmbã pʋsẽ kolg taaba, la b bãng taaba. Rẽ yaa sabaab kɩtame tɩ kiuug a yiib bɩ a tãab fãa sʋn-wʋgdb segda taaba. Sullã le yɩɩ sabaab tɩ sʋn-wʋgdbã bãng tʋʋma n paase. A kell n bẽda be pʋʋs tẽngã taoor dãmb barka, b sẽn yãag-bã yĩnga. A Polind BAFEOGO wilgame tɩ rasem a tãabã pʋgẽ, ned ning fãa sẽn dat sʋndã fuug kõbg buud toor-toore, bɩ a wa Seyawoẽ wã. A togsame tɩ rasem a tãabã pʋgẽ tʋʋm wʋsg la b na n tʋme.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, b na n talla sõasga. Sõasgã pʋgẽ, b na n togsa soay nins b sẽn tõe n tũ, tɩ ba tẽngã sẽn ka gãe bãanã, bɩ b tõog n naf sʋndã fut tʋʋm pʋge. Sẽn pʋgde, sʋn-wʋgdbã taoor dãmb sẽn be Burkĩna Faso reezõ rãmbã fãa pʋsã na n sega taab n ges b tʋʋma zu-loeese, la b bao a  yidgrã sẽn tõe n tũ sor ninga.

 Baasgã na n yɩɩ tigr b sẽn boond tɩ « dine gala » wã la b na n maane, tɩ boond tɩ Faso dãnfani yʋngo. Badaar na n yɩɩ reem buud toor-toore, la “defile” la b na n maan ne sʋndã futu. Neb me la b na n yãk tɩ b yɩ sʋndã fut wʋgdb no-rɛɛsdba, la b kell n kõ neb kẽer waoor kũuni.

Tʋʋmdã baoosgẽ b kõo sor tɩ raagã pak a kʋɩlense, tɩ ned fãa tõe n kẽng n tɩ ra fut nins sʋn-wʋgdbã nus sẽn tʋme.

A Zɩll KAFAANDO

Jules KAFANDO

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 23 n yʋʋm 2024 soabã Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm sõsa ne Kaskaad Reezõ wã pʋg: kadens tʋmtʋmdba, rog-n-mik yel-gɛtba,  la Wẽn-tũudum taoor rãmba. Reezõ taoor rãmb pẽgame, la b wilg zu-loees nins sẽn be b soolmã pʋga.

Nand tɩ tẽngã taoor soab sɩng sõasga, a  reng n pẽga: sodaasã,  VDP rãmba, la doozo  rãmbã, b sẽn mao maoor ninga,  tɩ laafɩ lebg n kẽed Reezõ wã pʋgẽ wã. B kell n kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b tall tʋmd-n-taar ne sodaasã tɩ bala, bɛɛbã kẽer zoeeme n tɩ be Burkĩna Faso ne a tẽn-yakã toaagẽ. B sẽn be be wã sodaasã la VdP rãmbã segd n bobame n dõbẽ, tɩ ned ka mi bɛ wã sẽn be be n segend bũmb ning ye. Rẽ poore, b kosa guvɛgneerã ne kadensã taoor dãmb tɩ b sagl nin-buiidã tɩ b paam raoodo, tɩ b sã n wa yã tɩ nin-wẽnsã rat n lebg n wa tʋm b tʋʋm-yookã.

Tẽngã taoor soab wilga nin-buiidã tɩ b reng n yãk yam kaoolg yembdã nasaar-wẽnsã sẽn kẽes nin-sablsã zutẽ wã, n tõog tɩ Burkĩna Faso kẽng taoore.

A wilgame tɩ ba b sã n baas zab ne nin-wẽnsã, tãrãzisõ wã tʋmdame n dat tɩ rɩɩbã sek nin-buiidã. La sẽn na  yɩl tɩ rẽ paam pidsgu, segdame tɩ b bãng zu-loees nins sẽn be koobã pʋgẽ, n tõog n dɩk na-kẽnda n tʋm tɩ zu-loɛɛgã welge. A wilgame tɩ bãmb rɩka na-kẽnda n na n zĩnig porze rãmba. Porze ye, n zoe n sɩng tʋʋm 2023 soabã n na n tãag 2025 sẽn watã.

Kapitɛnd TARWORE wilgame tɩ Kaskaad Reezõ wã tẽn-gãong sakda koobo. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ bãmb yãk yam n na n manes koob zĩis Reezõ wã pʋgẽ. Yam yãk-kãng na n sõngame sɩkrã tʋʋm-noor sẽn be soolmã pʋgã paam pãnga. B wilgame tɩ b na n modgame n maneg tʋʋm-no-bɛd nins sẽn get koodã rɩk n tʋm t’a lebg bũmb a to wã yelle.

Kadensã taoor dãmba, la rog-n-mik la a tũudmã taoor dãmb me rɩka b zu-loees n wilg tẽngã taoor soaba. B zu-loeesã yaa : yõ-koglgã, logtor yiya, karen-dotã, soaya, la Bãnfoora logto-yi-kasengã.

Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE wilgame tɩ b wʋma b zu-loeesã la b na n tɩ zĩnda ne b gosneerã n ges b sẽn na n maan toto n paam zu-loe-kãens tɩɩm.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 21 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, a Mark sõng parwaasã sẽn be Nagrẽ Waogdg arõndiisma a 7 sigla porze b sẽn boond tɩ « kominote katolik milyõneer » ( CCM) porze wã yaa sẽn na n sõng parwaasã kiris neb tɩ b tõog n zãms nus-tʋʋma n wa tõog n naf b mense.

A Mark sõng parwaasã Kɩɩre Labe Valeeri SAAGKUGR wilgame tɩ yam-yãkrã tʋlsem pipi ya b sõng kiris nebã ned fãa paam tikr zĩiga, n tõog n tʋm n yidg a menga.

 Yaa zãmsgã yaa ninsaal yidgr sore, leebgo, la a arzɛkã zãab sẽn segd n yɩ toto. Labe Valeeri wilgame tɩ bãmb maana vaeesg parwaasã kiris neb fãa zugu, la vaeesgã poore, b yãame tɩ kiris neb koabg zugu 45 wã yaa lɛɛbdba, 31 wã yaa neb sẽn tar nus-tʋʋma. Piigã  yaa gosneer tʋmtʋmdba. Yopoe wã sẽn kellã yaa karen-biis la karen-bi-bɛda. Kom-bɩɩbã sʋka, neb wʋsg me n be n ka tar nug-tʋʋmd ye. Kiris nebã pʋgẽ me, wʋsg vʋɩɩ « nonloti » rãmb pʋse. Rẽ yaa yell sẽn namsd bãmba. Yaa rẽ fãa n kɩt tɩ b yãk yam n sigl porze wã.

Yʋʋr ning b sẽn pʋd porze wã Labe Valeeri SAAGKUGR wilgame tɩ tũu ne porze wã na-kẽndre, la b paasa milyõneerã sẽn na n yɩl tɩ nebã sã n wʋm ligdã yʋʋre, bɩ b kẽes b mens n tʋme, n wa tõog n naf b mense.

Tʋʋmdã taoor soaba a Etɛnd ZƖƖDA wilgame tɩ ka zãmsga bal la b na n dɩk n taas kiris nebã ye, b na n kell n yãaga ned kam fãa a sẽn yãk tʋʋmd ning n na n tʋm pʋgẽ. Zãms-kãngã poore, b na n tɩ maana zãms-bɩɩsdg tʋʋm-noy kẽer pʋsẽ. B leb n na n maoome tɩ b rɩk tõkr ne tʋʋm-no-bɛd taoor dãmba. A wilgame tɩ bãmb na n modgame tɩ neb nins fãa sẽn na n kẽes b mens tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ  tõog n naag taab n tʋme. A a Etɛnd ZƖƖDA wilgame tɩ ka tũus ned ye. B boonda sẽn dat-a fãa, t’a wa naage.

Parwaasã kiris neb sũur yɩɩ noog ne yam-yãkrã. B wilgame t’a na n sõngame tɩ ned kam fãa tʋm a sẽn dat tʋʋm ninga. A Kiristof SAWADGO, parwaasã kiris ned yeelame t’a pʋʋsda Kɩɩre wã barka, a sẽn yã yam n sigl tʋʋmdã, tɩ bala, a na n sõnga bãmb a lɛɛbdbã. Tɩ bala wakat ninga, b tõe n paama ligdã la b ka mi a sẽn kẽedẽ ye, la rẽ fãa ra yaa bãngrã kaalem yĩnga.

Nand tɩ tʋʋmdã reng n paka a kʋɩlense b reng n sõsa ne taab n gom arzɛkã zãab yelle. Yɩɩ karen-saam-kaseng a Sɩmo WEDRAOOGO n lʋɩ sõasgã taoore.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 20 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, b paama b sodaar teedo, n na n kẽes b mens zãng-zãng n zab n fãag tẽngã. Sodaas nins sẽn yi wã n kẽed sodaas vuk 23 soabã. Sẽn yi-bã zab-yʋʋr yaa « Faso Kanu ». yaa zʋlle, la rat n yeela ne moore, tɩ « tẽng-n-biilim ». Yaa tẽngã taoor soab n pʋd-b yʋ-kãnga. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE wilgame tɩ sodaag yaa ned sẽn segd n kẽes a vʋɩɩm zãnga, a tẽngã yĩnga. Yaa rẽ tɩ yʋʋrã pʋdb wilgdẽ tɩ tẽng-n-biisã zabdame n na n deeg b tẽngã, la b kell n tʋm tɩ buudã goam kẽng taoore. A togsame tɩ sodaasã segd n bãngame tɩ b pipi tʋʋmd ya b modg n zab n deeg tẽngã nin-wẽnsã la nasaar wẽnsã nusẽ, n paam soog-n-meng sɩd-sɩda. Tẽngã taoor soab kos-b lame tɩ b tall vʋɩɩmd-n-ta-sõng ne nebã fãa,  tɩ yaa rẽ la b yet tɩ tẽn-n-bi-tɩrlem. Yaa zʋg-kãng me n na n sõng tɩ burkĩndã paam pãnga. Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame tɩ bãmb ka zoet rabeem ye. Bala, zãmsg ning sodaasã sẽn paam n yitã yaa zãmsg sẽn tar pãnga. B wilgame tɩ zãmsg sẽn ka be sekrã,  b na n kell n ket n paamda zãmsg n paasdẽ sẽn na n yɩl tɩ b n tõog n tũ na-kẽnda nins sẽn gãneg rũnda-rũnda zabrã wɛɛngẽ, n tõog n tall tʋmd-n-ta-sõng ne b taabã.

Sodaas 1000 sʋka Burkĩna Faso kamb yaa bãmb 85, bãmb 15 wã yaa : Gibuti, Senegalle, Sãntrafiriki, Gabõ, Gine, Mali, Kongo, la Nizɛɛr kamba.

Yaa Zenerall Pẽgrnooma ZAGRE la b yãk t’a yɩ «  Faso Kanu » sodaasã ba-yãkdga.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasa fãa moeemb loka b noore. Waogdg tẽngã pʋgẽ, yɩɩ Plaas de la nasẽo la b seg taab n pʋʋse. B sẽn pʋʋs rakaar a yiib loogr poore, Limaam Abdala WEDRAOOGO, rɩka koɛɛg n gom laafɩ wã, la Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã vʋɩɩmd-n-taar yelle. A wilgame tɩ lislaoongã yaa laafɩ, nonglem, la waoor dĩinã. A wilgame tɩ wakat sẽn looge, a boola dĩinã buud toor-toor taoor dãmba, tɩ b kẽes b toogo tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa tẽngã, la a sã n getẽ, a gomdã paama reegre.  Tɩ bala, dĩinã taoor dãmb maoodame, b sagend b poorẽ dãmbã tɩ b rɩk zems-taabã sore.

Museyẽer koeesã loogr poore, Moeembã taoor soaba, Lahagi Muusa KOANDA rɩka koɛɛga. A pʋʋsa Wẽnd barka b sẽn kõ-b daarã, tɩ b lok b noorã. A yeelame tɩ bãmb pʋʋsd-b-la barka, la b kengd b raoodo, n kot Wẽnd tɩ b zĩnd b poorẽ tɩ b tõog n deeg tẽngã nin-wẽnsã nugẽ. Rẽ poore, a pʋʋsa Moognaaba, la Waogdg tigung katolik taoor dãmb sẽn zẽk b naoor n zĩnd sʋka, tɩ ba naag taab saam-biir pʋgẽ n pʋʋsã. Moeembã kosa Wẽnd tɩ b reeg b kosgo, tɩ b sã n na n maan no-lokrã vẽere, bɩ mik tɩ tẽngã gãanda bãane,  tɩ b gãd taab nusi, n get zĩig a ye.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, miniisr dãmbã maana b rasem a yopoe-poe tigsgã. Yaa tẽngã taoor soaba, kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE n lʋɩ seg taabã taoore. Sɛkã loogr poore, gosneem no-rɛɛs wilga noy kẽer b sẽn dɩke.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get Burkĩna Faso ne zamaan-zẽns zoodã zĩigẽ, gosneem rɩka noor tɩ b zĩnig sull t’a tigimd  Burkĩna Faso kamb sẽn be zamaan-zẽnsã. Ka yɩ buudã goam zãsmg bal la kiba-kɩtbã paam rasem a yoobã pʋgẽ ye. B paamame tɩ neb sẽn tʋmd kibayã kũun wɛɛngẽ pɩʋʋg n pʋɩ b bãngr ne-ba.  Sẽn wa n tɩ yɩɩd fãa kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn gomd buudã goam la b gʋlsd-a wã. Zãmsg kãng soabã yɩ a Aminata KABOORE n dɩk-a n taas kiba-kɩtbã. Miniisr Zã-Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO, sẽn get kibayã kũun yellã me rɩka koɛɛg n pʋʋs ministɛɛr ning sẽn get buudã goam na kẽng taoorã, b yãagd tẽngã taoor dãmb sẽn dɩk noor tɩ buudã goam na n lebg tẽngã gill gomdã. Jules KAFANDO

Burkĩna Faso ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kʋʋrã wã ne Risi sull ning sẽn get kʋʋrã wã tɩ b boond tɩ Rosatom dãmb maana nug tikr tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2024 soabã. Nug tikrã yaa sẽn na kõ sor tɩ b paam n sɩng “Sãntrall Nikilɛɛrã “meebo.

Miniisr ning sẽn get kʋʋra wã, la tẽn-gãongã tẽngr arzɛka, a Yakuba Zabre GUBA zĩnda Risi n maan nug-tikr tɩ “Sãntrall nikilɛɛrã” meeb na n  paam pidsgu. Nug tikrã na n yɩɩ vugs a tã. Pipi soabã, yaa zãmsg la b na n dɩk n taas Burkĩna Faso kʋʋra wã bãngdbã” Nikilɛɛrã” zãab wɛɛngẽ. Zãmsgã yaa Risi” Inivɛrsite”rãmb kẽer pʋsẽ, la b na n maane. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ ka ne bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug sẽn watã, pipi sullã na n sɩnga zãmsg Risi Inivɛrsite bɛdã pʋsẽ.

Nug tikrã a yiib soabã yaa kibay kũun bãnr la b na n wilg-b tɩ b rɩkd kibaya n taasd nin-buiidã. Nug tik-kãng soabã yaa sull ning sẽn get” Nikilɛɛrã” zãab b sẽn boond tɩ “AEIA” wã n gãnege. Nug tik kãng pʋga, b na n wilga nin-buiidã “Sãntrall nikilɛɛrã” yõodo, la a zãabã na-kẽndre.

Nug tikr a tãab n soabã, yaa kʋʋrã wã tuʋm-no-kaseng meeb sẽn na n yɩ toto, la a sẽn tõe n sõng tɩ Burkĩna Faso t’a tõog n yidg n kẽng taoore. Miniisrã wilgame, tɩ b ratame tɩ tʋʋmdã kẽn tao-tao.

 Yaa rẽ la bãmb ne “Rosatom” dãmb yã taaba n dat tɩ ka ne sigr kiuugã pʋgẽ, bɩ b tõog n pids nug-tikr a tãabã fãa. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ b yẽsgã na n wa tɩ baasa ne “Sãntrall Nikilɛɛrã” meebo, n paas na-kẽnda nins b sẽn dɩk bãngrã wɛɛngẽ wã. Rẽ fãa yaa sẽn na yɩl n yãag tʋʋmdã. Miniisr GUBA togsame

tɩ b kell n goma Nikilɛɛrã b sẽn tõe n tall-a n kẽes koobã, la laafɩ wã pʋgẽ toto. Miniisrã togsame tɩ nug-tigsa wã fãa sã n tõog maan ka ne sigr kiuug sẽn watã,” Sãntrallã “meeb tõe n sɩnga ka ne yʋʋm 2025 soabã.

 « Rosatoma » taoor soab a Alegsey Likasɛv pẽga tẽns a yiibã zood sẽn kẽnd taoor toto wã, la nug-tigsa nins b sẽn maand ne taabã. A wilgame tɩ yʋʋmd ning sẽn loogã Risi tẽngã taoor soab a Valadimiir PUTIND ne Burkĩna Faso taoor soab a Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, sẽn seg taabã poore, bãmb bee soaglg zugu,  sẽn na yɩl tɩ Burkĩna Faso tõog n paam a Sãntrall Nikilɛɛrã. B leb n sõngda taab laafɩ wã, la koobã wɛɛngẽ.

Nug tikrã maana lekol-kaseng a ye pʋga, seg-taab-kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ « Atomegspo 2024 » loogr poore.

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE reega « Liigdekõnsomatɛɛrã » taoor dãmba. Ya b taoor soabã a Dasmaane TARWORE n lʋɩ taoor tɩ b kẽnge.

A Dasmaane TARWORE togsame, tɩ b kẽngame n tɩ pẽg tẽngã taoor soaba, tʋʋm nins a sẽn tʋmd yõ-koglg na tõog n kẽ tẽngã wɛɛngẽ wã. A wilgame tɩ ka yõ-koglgã goam bal la b gome ye. B kosa tẽngã taoor soaba, t’a sulg n ges arzɛkã zĩigẽ me. Tɩ bala, nin-buiidã namsda wʋsg rɩɩbã paoong wɛɛngẽ, tɩ rẽ fãa tõe n yɩ sabaab tɩ b bas-raoodo. A kell n goma nugẽ bãensã tʋʋm-noy sẽn zãmbd nin-buiidã yelle. A kosa tẽngã taoor soab t’a ges zĩ-kãng tɩ bala, b wẽgbã yaa wʋsgo. A Dasmaane TARWORE ne a poorẽ wilgame tɩ rẽndame tɩ tẽngã taoor soab rɩk na-kẽndre, tɩ nugẽ bãensã tʋʋm-noor a to pak n paase, tɩ sã n ya boto, nin-buiidã wẽgb  kolgda weoogo.

Sullã taoor dãmb wilgame tɩ wakat sẽn loog pʋgẽ,  b paama kibar tɩ neb n dɩkd tõnd mui wã n tekd yond a taab n koosd ligd toogo. La sã n ya ne bãmba,  neb nins sẽn tʋmd-b boto wã ne nin-wẽnsã sẽn be weoogẽ wã n kʋʋd nin-buiidã,  ka tar welgr ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b kot tẽngã taoor soab t’a buud sã n le paase, bɩ a sɩbg-b  sɩbgr ning sẽn segd ne-ba. «Liigdekõnsomatɛɛrã rãmb kell n goma tɩtã ligdi, la neb a taab sẽn paasd Gaasã ligd n koosd ne nebã, n paas yɛl a taaba.

B sõagã baoosgẽ a Dasmaane TARWORE togsame tɩ b sũur yɩɩ noog ne tẽngã taoor soaba, a sẽn sak n deeg bãmbã, la b na n kell n zĩnda a poorẽ n yãag-a t’a tõog n zã tẽngã.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ.

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, gosneer ne Sɩnd tẽng tʋʋm-noor a ye b sẽn boond tɩ « Lehui » maana nug-tikri, tɩ Baarafaso tʋʋm-noorã na n lebg n sɩng a tʋʋma.

Yaa miniisr Sɛrs PODA sẽn get tʋʋm-noyã taoor n kẽnd n maan nug tikrã. Miniisr ning sẽn get arzɛkã yelle, a Abubakar NAKANABO me zĩnda be. Nug tikrã na n sõngame tɩ Baarafaso sẽn get bõn-yũudi wã yelle, tõog n lebg n pak a kʋɩlense.

Tẽegre, Baarafaso yaa Burkĩna Faso tʋʋm-noor sẽn so a menga. B ra me-a-la Komsɩlg soolmẽ wã, la zu-loees n wa n kẽ sʋka,  tɩ b ra pag-a.  Sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm 2015 soabã, gosneer dãmbã sẽn deesd taabã fãa maka b na lebg n pak-a n ka tõog ye.

kibarã yii Lɩɩbr ẽnfo

Sull ning sẽn get sagdã wʋkdb tɩ b boond tɩ FAROMF kẽnga Waogdg meeriẽ wã wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, n tɩ seg delegasẽo ɛspesɛlla taoor soaba. B seg-taabã pʋgẽ b rɩka milyão n ning meeri wã taoor soab nugẽ t’a ra karenzi, sẽn na yɩl tɩ mobilsã tõog n gilgd n wʋkd sagdã.

Sullã taoor soab a Dɛlfind ZÃONG wilgame tɩ kũunã b sẽn kõ wã yaa sẽn na sõng meeri wã taoor dãmba,  tɩ b fãa yaa Burkĩna Faso kamba, b fãa nee tẽngã zu-loɛɛg sẽn ya a soaba.

B  neeme tɩ meeri wã sõngda tẽngã zãadb tɩ b zabd ne nin-wẽnsã. Zabrã yĩnga, meeri wã tõog ka le sekd b na paam gazoal n saagd zĩigã fãa n wʋkd sagdã ye.

FAROMF yaa lagem-n-taar sula 30 sẽn naag taab n lugl sull kasenga. La sẽn na yɩl tɩ bũmbã fãa ket n kẽn wa sẽn segde, b yãa taab n kos tɩ sull fãa kɩsa a sẽn tare. Yaa ligd-kãng la b sẽn dɩk n ning meeri wã taoor dãmb nugẽ wã. Sullã taoor soab saagdame n na n sagl sula a taabã, tɩ bãmb me sõng meeri wã, la ra zĩẽ bala, n gũudẽ tɩ meeri wã sõngdẽ-b ye.

Meeri wã taoor soab a Moris KONATE wilgame t’a  sũur yaa noogo. A pẽga sullã taoor rãmb yam yãkrã, tɩ bala, tẽngã sẽn be nug-gãag ningã, ligdã paoong ka nana ye.

A wilgame tɩ sullã rãmb sẽn tags tɩ b tõe n sõnga meeri wã, a yaa bũmb sẽn noom bãmba.

Bala, meeri wã yiisda  milyaar a 4 la zak yʋʋmd pʋgẽ, Waogdg sagdã wʋkr yĩnga. FAROMF sullã tʋʋmd ya a saag Waogdg n wʋk sagdã nebã zags noy la tẽngã pʋgẽ.

Kibarã yii AYIBE

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, depite rãmbã kõo sor tɩ gosneer dɩk na-kẽnda sẽn kẽed ne zamaan-zẽns nebã sẽn kẽed Burkina Faso la b yitã.

B sẽn wa n na n sɩnge, Depite Oseeni SULAMA reŋg n karma sebr ning gosneer sẽn tall n wa b n wilgi. A wilgame tɩ gosneer rat n paasa vaeesgã na-kẽndre,  ne neb nins sẽn dat n yi Burkĩna Faso n kẽng tẽn-taase, la sãamb sẽn dat n yi b tẽnsẽ n kẽ Burkĩna Faso wã. A wilgame tɩ gosneer togsame tɩ na-kẽnd-kʋdr b sẽn da rɩk yʋʋm 1984 soabã,  a ka tolg n sõngd-b tɩ b tõe n zab ne nin-wẽnsã ye. Na-kẽnd-kãng soabã ra wilgame tɩ sãan tõe n kẽe Burkĩna Faso wa a sẽn date,  la a yi wa a sẽn dat tɩ vaeesg tɩrg ka zĩnd ye. La zamaanã sẽn be nug ningã kɩtame  tɩ gosneer yãk yam n tek na-kẽnd-paalle, n dat tɩ b gʋls-a t’a lebg laloa.

Miniisr ning sẽn sõngd kadensã miniisr la a get yõ-koglgã, a Mahamadu SÃANA wilgame tɩ yʋʋm 1984 n tãag yʋʋm 2024 soabã, yɛl wʋsg teka Burkĩna Faso la ãnduni wã fãa pʋgẽ. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ ya tɩlae tɩ b lebg n ges noy nins b sẽn da rɩk yʋʋm 1984 soabã, n maneg-a t’a zems ne zamaanã nu-gãaga. Bala, wakat kãng tɩ viza ra ka be ye. La zamaanã sẽn ka le ya zaamẽ wã, laloa-kãngã tɛka,  sãan sã n dat n kẽ Burkĩna Faso rẽndame t’a reng n paam viza n yaool n kẽ. Depite rãmbã fãa sakame n kõ sor tɩ b rɩk gosneer raabã t’a lebg laloa.

Kibarã yii Burkina 24

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 21 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, miniisr dãmbã zĩnda b rasem a yopoe-yopoe tigsgã. Tigsgã poore miniisr Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilga noy kẽer b sẽn dɩke.

Miniisr dãmbã wilgame tɩ b zĩniga sull t’a na n ges tẽn-gãongã. Sullã b boond-b lame tɩ AƐNSEF «ANCF», a tʋʋmd yaa tẽn-gãongã gesgo. B rɩka tẽn-gãongã pʋɩɩb n ning nasaarã nus-tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋgẽ b sẽn boond tɩ dizidalisasẽo wã. No-rɩkrã loogr poore miniisr dãmbã tika nug n wilg tɩ ned sã n yã wẽgb buud toor-toor ned sẽn maand tʋʋm-noor pʋgẽ, t’a soab tar kaseto, a tõe n wilgame. Gosneerã no-rɛɛsã wilgame tɩ no-rɩkrã na n sõnga ninb-uiidã tɩ b tõog n gil wẽgbã gosneem tʋʋm-noyã pʋsẽ.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 20 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, miniisr ning sẽn get soayã la meebã, a Adama Liuk SORGO, tɩ gesa sor ning sẽn yit Sakõens n dabd Kʋdgã tʋʋmd sẽn kẽnd toto.

Yaa yʋʋm 2020 soabã la gosneer ne a tʋmd-n-taasã ning sorã kõntaale. Kõntaalã ningr ka yã n zãag raare, t’a wẽneg n sãam ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ gosneer wilg tɩ Sorubat tʋʋm-noorã sẽn ges sorã tʋʋm t’a wẽneg n sãamã, bɩ a maneg-a. Miniisr Adama Liuk SORGO wilgame tɩ so-kãnga wã, a  tʋʋmdã yaa sõma. A pẽga tʋʋm-noorã sẽn sɩd sak n kõ a meng tɩ tʋʋmdã na n tũ sore, la a sa wakat ning b sẽn kõ-a t’a tʋmã.  Sorubat tʋʋm-noorã taoor soabã a Moez BAHRI wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, tɩ bala, gosneerã taoor dãmb sẽn kaag tʋʋmdã, kenga a pɛlga. Kaagrã  na n sõng t’a yĩm kongr ning Sorubat sẽn da maanã. Sorubat tʋʋm-noorã sẽn be soaya tʋʋm pʋgẽ yaa pis-nu rõanda. Sig-noy kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2024 sẽn watã la tʋʋmdã na n sa tɩ b sɩng sorã tũubu. Miniisrã wilga tʋʋm-noy ninsa sẽn deesd tʋʋma n ka tʋmd n wa sẽn segdã tɩ b toeem na-kẽndre. Bala, b tʋʋmdã sã n ka tũud wa sẽn segde, b na n lebgd n manegdame. Sor ning sẽn yit Sakõens n dabd Kʋdgã woglem yaa kɩlo 42. Tʋʋmdã sẽn zoe n tʋma taa koabg zug 66. Sorubat rãmb wilgame tɩ tʋʋmdã na n saa wakat ning b sẽn kõ-bã.

Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE sega Wa-n-yiya rãmba

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, kom-bɩɩbã sull kaseng sẽn be Burkĩna Faso n get Tãrãzisẽo wã koglg sega tẽngã taoor soab Palɛdeɛspoor Waga demill n wilg tɩ b bee ne Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE wĩndg la yʋngo, n na n kell n yãag-a, a yam yãkrã wɛɛngẽ.

Burkĩna Faso reezẽo rãmb 13 wã pʋgẽ kom-bɩɩb sega tẽngã taoor soab Palɛdeɛspoor n dɩk b koees n taas-a. Koeesã rɩgsg sɩngrẽ a Fanta TARWORE, sull ning sẽn sigl seg-taabã no-rɛɛs pẽga tẽngã taoor soaba. A wilgame t’a sẽn dɩk na-kẽndr ningã, yaa Burkĩna Faso na paam soog-m-meng sɩd-sɩda. A kell n togsame tɩ Wa-n-yiya wã rãmb yaa neb sẽn tar bãngre. Yaa rẽ t’a boond-b tɩ b modg n kẽes b mens zãng-zãnga, tẽngã taoor kẽnd yĩnga.

Reezẽo di Sɩɩd wɛsã kom-bɩɩb no-rɛɛs a Bala WATARA me pẽga tẽnga taoor soaba. A wilgame tɩ rũnda-rũnda, yõ-koglg kaalmã lebda poorẽ, la rẽ fãa tũu ne tẽngã taoor soab sẽn dɩk na-kẽndr n lebg n sigl sodaarã tʋʋma, la a ra zab-teedã, n wa ne rẽ. A togsame tɩ ba tẽngã sẽn be zabr zugã, tẽngã taoor soab rɩka na-kẽnda tɩ tẽnga arzɛk kẽnd taoore. A wilgame tɩ tẽngã taoor soab yaa neda, t’a sã n dɩk noor fãa, a pidsda a pʋlengo. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ bãmb na n kell n yãag-a wakat fãa.

Burkĩna Faso sẽn yi SEDEYAWO sullã wɛɛngẽ wã, a Bala WATARA togsame tɩ yaa bũmb sẽn wilgd tɩ soog-m-mengã bee na-kẽnd-sõng zugu.

A HAMA LY Sayɛll reezẽo wã kom-bɩɩb no-rɛɛs yeelame tɩ segdame tɩ b pẽg sodaasã ne VDP rãmbã, tɩ bala b sẽn tʋmd tʋʋmd ningã segda ne pẽgre.

A wilgame tɩ tẽngã taoor soab sẽn dɩkd na-kẽnda ninsã tara yõod wʋsgo. Bala, Sayɛll soolmã pʋga, tʋʋm wʋsg tʋmame. Lekolls kẽer lebg n paka b kʋɩlens Sseba soolmẽ wã. Yaa rẽ fãa, la b yãk yam n na n kell n yãag tẽngã taoor soaba.

Reezẽo rãmb 13 wã fãa no-rɛɛsdb wilgame tɩ yõ-koglg kaalmã lebda poorẽ, neb nins me sẽn da zoe n bas b tẽnsã lebda b tẽnsẽ. B kosa tẽngã taoor soab t’a rɩk na-kẽnda sõma n sẽn na yɩl tɩ ned ning fãa sẽn wa n deeg-a tẽngã  bɩ a ra tõog n toeem na-kẽndrã ye .

Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame tɩ ned ning fãa sẽn ning a yamẽ t’a na n zãmba tẽngã, a na n paama sɩbgr sẽn segd ne-a, bala,  ninbãan-zoeer ka na n zĩnd ye. Musoyẽer Prospɛɛr KÕNTẼEBO sẽn lebg Waogd tigungã roogã ba tɛka, yaa pipi, b sẽn lʋɩ pʋʋs-kaseng taoore. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ b reeg-b sãando Yagem Dĩmpoakã taoore. B sẽn yũ b sãand koom n sa, b rɩka Marwall n bas t’a yɩke, n wilgdẽ tɩ b ratame tɩ Burkĩna Faso lebg n paam laafɩ.

Meesã sɩngrẽ Labe Alferɛɛd WEDRAOOGO, Waogd tigungã roog vikɛɛr zenerall rɩka koɛɛg n pʋʋs  tẽngã taoor dãmba, la neb nins fãa sẽn zẽk b naoor n be tẽeb-so-toakã pʋgẽ.

«Kiris ned fãa tʋm a tʋʋm pakr tigung pʋga,  la zamaanã pʋga». B sẽn tik gom-zu-kãng n maan Yagem tẽeb-so-toakã yaa sẽn tũud ne Layikã rãmb yʋʋmd baaosgo, la koe-noogã sẽn wa Burkĩna Faso yʋʋm 125 kibs pakre. Rõanda Yagem tẽeb-so-toakã, b maand-a-la yʋʋmdã pʋg  dɩmaas a nu soaba. Wẽnd gomdã yɩ a  Mark sõng sebrã pʋga, a gom-dulg ning sẽn togsd t’a Zeezi sãooga a Piyɛɛr reem-pokã. Gomdã wɛgsg wakate, Musoyẽer Porspɛɛr wilgame tɩ Wẽnd gomdã wilgda kiris ned buud fãa  segd n tẽemet’a Zeezi sãooga bãase. La ya a Zeezi n tõe n deeg ninsaalbã zu-loeese n taas Wẽnde.

B wilgame tɩ b sã n tik kaorengã, kiris ned  fãa segd n talla tẽebo. Musoyẽer kosa kiris nebã tɩ b tʋm tẽebã tʋʋma. B kẽes b mens tigungu, la zamaanã tʋʋm pʋgẽ. B modg tɩ zemsgo, la manegr buud fãa zĩnd bãmb ne ninsaalbã sʋka, tɩ boto, d zamaanã na n lebga laafɩ la kõt taab sɩd zamaana.

Musoyẽer togsame tɩ ninsaal tʋʋm pʋgẽ, a segd n yãka wakat n vʋʋs bilfu, tɩ bala yaa  yals n vʋʋs pʋgẽ, la a Zeezi sẽn sãoog a Piyɛɛr reem-pokã. Rẽnd wakat kẽere, ninsaalbã segd n yals bilf n vʋʋs n paam pãn-paalga. Yaa vʋʋsmã pʋg la b tõe n bẽd n sõs ne Wẽnd pʋʋsg pʋgẽ. Musoyẽer Porspɛɛr KÕNTẼEBO togsame tɩ Layikã rãmb yʋʋmd sẽn pag tɩ b rɩk tʋʋmdã n ning pɛrɛtr dãmbã nugẽ wã ka rat n yeel tɩ b leba poorẽ n bas tigungã tʋʋmd ye. B segd n ket n kẽnda taoore, n tʋmd n sõngd pɛrɛtr dambã, tɩ yaa wa moos sẽn wilgi «tʋʋm sayã, tʋʋm keta»

Layikã rãmb taoor soab rɩka koɛɛg n pʋʋs Kiris nebã barka, b sẽn sak n kẽes b mens yʋʋmdã pʋgẽ n tʋm tigungã na kẽng taoor yĩnga. A wilgame tɩ yʋʋmdã pʋgẽ neb wʋsg tunugame n welg b yi-kãadem zu-loees tigungã pʋgẽ. Kẽer yɩɩ soobo, pãn-paosg la sakrma rãmba. Yagem tẽeb-so-toakã pʋgẽ, b rɩka waoor n kũuni n kõ Layikã neb kẽere.

Pʋʋsgã wa n tɩ baasa ne Ekaristi sakrma  yiisgu. B sẽn yiis Ekaristi sakremã n maana pʋʋs-kasengã la b kell n dɩk Burkĩna Faso, sodaasã, VDP rãmbã la neb nins fãa sẽn be namsg pʋgẽ, zabrã sabaab yĩng n ning Wẽnd nugẽ. Yɩɩ Sẽn Sakrmã tall n gilg zama wã sʋka, la  bark ningr n kell tɩ pag Yagem pʋʋs-kasengã, tɩ b kõ taab sɛk sa-sik kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2024 Asomsẽo wã, n na n le seg-taaba.
