Tẽngã taoor soab sẽn tik nug n wilg t’a Idirsa WEDRAOOGO, n lebg SEYƐSE taoor soabã poore, a reega a tʋʋm sɩngr sɛb wao-fugdg kiuug pipi daar yʋʋm 2024 soabã, Metr Apolineer KELEM taoore.

A Idirsa WEDRAOOG yaa kiba-kɩt b sẽn boond tɩ kominikatɛɛrã.  Yẽ la b yãk t’a reeg a Abdulaziz BAMOOGO n na n zã sull ning sẽn get kibayã kũun rot kiblg tɩ boond tɩ SEYƐSE wã yʋʋm a nu.

A Abdulaziz BAMOOG togsame t’a sũur nooma ne b sẽn yãk t’a reeg tʋʋmdã, tɩ bala yaa pãn-paall la bãng paall la b wa ne. Yaa rẽ t’a tagsdẽ tɩ b na tʋm tɩ SEYƐSE tʋʋm-noorã kẽng taoor n paase. A wilgame t’a sẽn zĩnd be wã tɛka, a maana a pãng sẽn tõe n dɩk noy a 4, sẽn na yɩl sõng kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb tɩ b tek kibayã kũun na-kẽndre, n tõog n tũ tẽngã nug-gãaga. A Abdulaziz BAMOOG wilgame t’a me bãnga bũmbli wʋsg tʋʋm-noorã pʋga, la a kota Wẽnd tɩ b yãag ned ning sẽn wa n led yẽ zĩigẽ wã.

A kell n wilgame tɩ rũnda zugã, kibayã kũun tara zu-loees wʋsgo. Bala, neb kẽer kõt kibaya, tɩ b kibayã yaool n ka sɩd ye. Neb me n tʋʋd taaba, la b zangd taab kibayã kũun-rotẽ, la nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã zutu. A kosa taoor soab paallã t’a  ges rẽ fãa n tʋm la a rɩk  bũmb ning sẽn ya tẽnga nafd tõndã n lʋɩɩs taoore. A Idirsa WEDRAOOG toilgsame t’a mii tʋʋm nins sẽn gũud-a, la ne a tʋmd-n-taasã yãagre, b na n tʋʋmame n tõog tɩ kibayã kɩsg kiblg kẽn wa sẽn segde, ka ne b tʋʋmdã saabo. A wilgame tɩ b na n tʋʋmame tɩ bãngrã tõog n paas kibayã kũun wɛɛngẽ, sẽn na  yɩlẽ tɩ kibayã kũun rot  fãa tõog n kõt kibayã ne zemsgo la ne minim.

Tẽegre, yɩɩ tʋʋl-nif kiuug pipi daare yʋʋm 1995 soabã, la b zĩnig SEYƐSE tʋʋm-noorã sẽn na yɩl t’a ges tɩ kibayã kũuni, la longoomp dãmba,  tõog n tũ wa sẽn segd Burkĩna Faso, la a kiba-kɩtbã tʋʋm-sɛb kũuni.

Wao-fugdg kiuug pipi daare, yʋʋm 2024 soabã, Waogdg Imakile kõnsɛpsẽo masɛɛr dãmbã sega kiba-kɩtbã Sãntrkagdinallpollzũngrãana sẽn be Waogdgã, n wilg-b  yʋʋm koabgã kibs sẽn na n yɩ toto. Gom-zug b sẽn tik n maand kibsã yaa « Imakile kõnsɛpsẽo buud masɛɛr dãmba, ne a Maryam sõngo, d pʋʋs Wẽnnaam bark b yʋʋm koabgã kũuni, la d rug n ta ko-sʋka ».

Yɩɩ wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 1924 soabã, la museyẽer Zoaani TEVENU, vigl Imakile kõnsɛpsẽo masɛɛr dãmbã buud Burkĩna Faso. Yɩɩ Masɛɛr Zend SAWADOGO n yɩ Otvolta pipi bi-pugl  sẽn kõ a meng n lebg Imakile kõnsɛpsẽo masɛɛre. A wakatẽ wã masɛɛr dãmbã sõor ra ka waoog ye. Bala, rog-n-mik ra gɩdgame tɩ bi-pugl ka tar sor n soog a meng ye. Yʋʋm koabg loogr poore, masɛɛr dãmbã buud fɩɩgame. B bee Alzeeri, Bene, Burkĩna Faso, Kodenvaare, Mali, Nizɛɛr Togo, Farens la Itali. Rũnda-rũnda masɛɛr dãmbã sõor taa 468.

Imakile Kõnsɛpsẽo masɛɛr dãmbã tʋʋmd yaa: kom-bɩɩbã la kom-kasemsa katesisim kaorengo, kom-pugli la pagbã nug-tʋʋm zãmsgo, Karen-bi-bɛd la karenbi-bãoones kaorengo, logto-yi-bãoones la logto-yi-bɛd pʋs tʋʋma n paas neb nins sẽn tar b zu-loeese, n segd ne sõngre.

Masɛɛr dãmb nins sẽn seg kiba-kɩtbã togsame tɩ yʋʋm koabgã kibs poore, b na n kell n sõnga ninsaalbã tɩ b yĩnsã la b sɩɩsã paam fãagre. B wilgame tɩ yʋʋm koabgã kibs pipi tʋlsem yaa b tʋm tɩ ne Imakile kõnsɛpsẽo masɛɛr dãmbã, la neb wʋsg bãng a Zeezi n paase, tɩ koe-noogã mooneg paam pãng n paase.

Yʋʋm koabgã kibs yĩnga, masɛɛr dãmbã zoe n tʋma tʋʋm wʋsgo. B mee zak Kosoogẽ, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b sã n kẽng vʋʋsem bɩ b tɩ zĩnd be. Yʋʋm koabgã kibs pakr sẽn zĩnd wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, b maana masɛɛr dãmbã gʋʋlg zak kibsa. Rẽ poore, b maana kom-pugli nins sẽn zĩnd masɛɛr dãmbã zagsẽ kibs yʋʋm sar kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2023 soabã. B tɩ gesa neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b zagsã, la b kõ-b rɩɩbo la futu. B tɩ gesa pʋg-yãans nins b sẽn dig sõod poorẽ tɩ b reeg-ba, tɩ b be Sakulã.

B wilgame tɩ b raar fãa pʋʋsgã pʋgẽ, b pʋʋsdame n kot Wẽnd tɩ b gũ Sodaasã ne VDP rãmbã, la b sõng Burkĩna Fas zabrã pʋgẽ.

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, b na n naaga neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnsã, tɩ b maan tigr Kugpɛɛla la Kʋdgo. Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 6 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, b na n yiisa sĩnma sẽn gomd masɛɛr dãmbã vɩɩm Sĩneneerwaya, zabr wakat a yoobe, la yʋng wakat a 8. Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 8 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, b na n talla reem-kaseng Katedrall zakã noore, yʋng wakat a 7. B na n kell n naaga ne foaare. Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 8 yibeoog wakat a 9, b na n kõo neb waoor kũuni.  Badaar zaabre, b na n pʋʋsa bãad rãmbã yĩnga. Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 9 daare, zaabr wakat a yoob sẽn loog minit pistã b na n gilga ne buuzi rãmb Katedrall n wa tɩ baas ne a Maryam sõng pʋʋsgo. Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, b na n maana Wẽnnaam bark pʋʋsg Mees kaseng yibeoog wakat a 9 Katedralle. Sẽn na yɩl tɩ kibsã tall rasãnde, b yiisa kibsã fuugu. Fu-pog zaallã ligd yaa wakɩr 400. Fasodanfãni yaa wakɩr 1600. Imakile kõnsɛpsẽo masɛɛr dãmbã boonda nebã fãa tɩ b wa naag-b n pʋʋs Wẽnnaam bark b yʋʋm 100 kibs yĩnga.

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, AIEA sẽn get kʋʋrã wã tʋʋmd b sẽn boond tɩ nikilyɛɛrã taoor soab pʋgda a Mikɛl CHUDAKOV sega Burkĩna miniisr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã.

Sullã taoor soab pʋgd togsame tɩ bãmb waa Burkĩna Faso, tẽngã taoor soab sẽn yãk yam n dat n me sãntrall nikilɛɛrã yĩnga. Ya arẽ la  b wa n na n wilg bũmb nins tẽngã taoor rãmb sẽn segd n maan tɩ sãntrall niklɛɛrã tõog n lugli. Pipi tʋʋmd ya b reng n zĩnd mag zĩigã meeb sẽn na n yɩ toto, n paam n sɩng tʋʋmdã. Sẽn na  yɩlẽ tɩ tʋʋmdã tõog n yɩ sõma segdame tɩ tẽngã taoor rãmb kẽes b toogo, yaa rẽ  yĩnga, la a sẽn zẽk a naoor n yi Risi n wa seg Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmbã. A Mikɛl CHUDAKOV wilgame tɩ bãmb sẽn dat n zĩniga sãntrall ningã na n paasa Burkĩna Faso kʋʋra wã pãnga, t’a naf nin-buiidã. Zamaan-zẽns miniisr a Karamoko Zãmmari TARWORE pẽga AEIA  taoor soab pʋgdga, tʋmd-n-taar ning sẽn be Burkĩna Faso ne Risi tʋʋm-no-kasengã sʋka. A wilgame tɩ sullã sabaab na n kɩtame tɩ Burkĩna Faso nin-buiisã sẽn da tar naong kʋʋrã wã wɛɛngẽ wã, bɩ b paam zu-noog wa dũni wã tẽn-bɛda. Miniisrã kosa Wẽnd tɩ b sõng tɩ Burkĩna Faso ne AEIA tʋmd-n-taarã paam pãng n paase.

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, AES tẽnsã taoor dãmb yiisa koɛɛg n wilg tɩ sẽn sɩng ne mooneg koɛɛgã kaoreng tɛka, bãmb yii SEDEYAWO sullã pʋga.

Mooneg koeegã pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ yɩɩ sig-noy kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 1975 yʋʋmdã rẽ tɩ Otvolta taoor soab ra yaa Zenerall Abubakar Sãngule Lamizãana, Mali taoor soab ra yaa  Zenerall Musa TARWORE, la Nizɛɛr tẽnga taoor soaba Letena Kolonell Seni KUNTE, ra naag nin-sabls tẽns wĩndg sẽn lʋɩtẽ tẽns 12 taoor dãmb tɩ b tik nug n sigl SEDEYAWO sullã Legoose, Nizɛrya na-tẽngã.

Yʋʋm 49 loogr poore, Burkĩna Faso, Mali, la Nizɛɛr nin-buiidã maanda sũ-sãang ne sullã, tɩ bala, a tʋʋma ka tũud ne yam-yãkr ning b sẽn da tik n lugl-a wã ye.

Sedeyawo sullã sẽn da segd n zab tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsã tõog n kẽng taoorã, b wa n mikame tɩ tẽns a taab n wa kẽes b toog sullã zãab pʋgẽ, t’a ka le get a tẽnsã taoor kẽnd ye. A ka le tũud sor ning b sẽn da rat t’a tũ wã ye. Sedeyawotẽns nins sẽn be yõ-koglg kaalem pʋgã ka tol n paam b sullã sõngre, b na tõog n zab ne b bɛɛbã wɛɛngẽ ye. Tẽns a tãabã sẽn yãk yam n na n gãd taab nus n zab n fãag b mensã, SEDEYAWO sullã rɩka sɩbgr sẽn ka tũud sor n dogl-ba, tɩ ka tũ ne zemsg ning b sẽn da zems taab n tik nug n na n tʋmã sẽn wilgã ye. Na-kẽnd-kãensa fãa wa n namsa nin-buiidã n paas b sẽn da be  yɩɩr pʋgẽ, nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm sẽn wẽnd b paamda teelg yĩnga. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, Kolonell Asimi GOETA, la Zenerall Abduramaan TIYANI wilg tɩ b yii SEDEYAWO sullã pʋgẽ.

Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE kõo sor tɩ b pak sãnem rẽgdã yɩlgr tʋʋm-noore

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, tẽngã taoor soab tɩ kõo sor tɩ b pak sãnem yɩlgre.

 Tʋʋm-noorã yaa gosneer ne tʋmd-m-toor rãmb n naag taab n lugl-a Waogdg sak ning b sẽn boond tɩ Kosoodã.

B rɩka 6000 metr kaare n me n ning: masĩnd dãmba, biiru rãmba, tɩbsg zĩiga, la teed bĩngr roogo.

Yaa tẽngã taoor soab ne a miniisr rãmb kẽer n tɩ pak a kʋɩlense.

Tẽnga taoor soab wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso rɩk a soog-n-meng sore,  a tẽn-gãongã arzɛk wɛɛngẽ.

Tʋʋm-noorã yʋʋr boondame tɩ Goldɛnhãnd « Golden Hand ». Yaa Goldɛnhãnd lugindbã n wa ne yãkrã tɩ gosneerã yãag-ba. Gosneer sõng-b-la koabg zug 40 tɩ b bao 60 n paase.

Golden hand taoor soabã a Emanwɛll TÃPSOAB wilgame tɩ bãmb rɩka bãngrã: Gine, Mali, la Seraleyond rãmb nengẽ, n tõog n lugl-a. Goldɛndhãnd taoor kell n paasma tɩ tẽns wʋsg ra ratame tɩ b wa zĩnig tʋʋm-noorã bãmb tẽnsẽ la bãmb sẽn nong b tẽngã b lugl-a Burkĩna Faso.

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, tʋʋm-noorã maana a pipi nug-tikr ne sãnem tʋʋm-noy a yiibu. Yaa Semafo la Endeyavurmining; la yaa sãnem rẽgd toand 392 la b kɩs bãmb tɩ b yɩlge. Yɩlgrã pʋgẽ b paama sãnem kilo 165.

A wilgame tɩ masĩnd dãmbã yaa Burkĩna Faso ka la b naan-ba.

Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE togsame tɩ b tʋʋm-noorã na n kell n paasa Burkĩna Faso soog-m-mengã pãnga. Bala, a tʋʋma teedo, ba a ye ka yi tẽn-taaga, nin-sablse, tʋʋm-no-kãngã nan yaa Burkĩna Faso ne tẽng a to n tar a buudu. Goldɛnhãnd tʋʋm-noorã pakre, yaa milyaar a yiib la b rɩk n pak-a. B saagdame tɩ ka ne yʋʋm a tãab sẽn wate,  tʋmtʋmdb  124 n na n tʋm a pʋgẽ, pagbã na n  taa 70.

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2022 sẽn loogã, b maana gɛɛla n, mik tɩ yaa sãnem toand sõor na ta 58 la Goldɛnhãnd yiis yã. Yʋʋmd 2021 wã pʋgẽ, b paama milyaar 430 la zaka. Yʋʋm 2022 soabã, b paama Milyaar 540 la zaka.

Logtor-yirã taoor soab a Dogtɛɛr Zili HOKNAE wilgame tɩ tɩbsgã teed wʋsg zoe n beeme. La rẽ na n sõngame tɩ b tõog n tɩbs bãad rãmbã. A wilgame tɩ yaa bãad rãmb gãas 35, la tɩbsg rot katɛk n be a pʋgẽ.

Porfesɛɛr Rolã AKA geta suyã tɩbsgo, la a bee Kodenvoare. Yaa yẽ n yɩ logtor-yirã pakr ba-yãkdga. Mise Rolã wilgame tɩ sũya bãas tɩbsg zĩig sẽn paama, a na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso la tẽn-yagsã.

EBOMAF tʋʋm-noorã taoor soab a Mahamuudu BÕNKŨNG wilgame t’a sẽn gesame tɩ tɩbsgã zĩis ka waoog Burkĩna Faso ye. Yaa rẽ n kɩt t’a yãk yam n me logtor-yirã. A wilgame tɩ Kovɩɩdã wakatẽ, ra yɩl n tall bãad rãmb n tɩ tɩbs zamaan-zẽnsã ra ka nana ye. Tɩ bala, tẽnsã fãa ra paga b toose.

Yaa rẽ fãa n wa ne logtor-yirã pakre. A togsame tɩ logtor-yirã tara tʋmd-n-taar ne Tirki logtor-yir a yembre, yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ Tirki logtoɛɛmb wʋsg na n zĩnd n sõngd ne tɩbsgã.

Dogtɛɛr Robɛɛr Lusẽ KARGUUG wilgame tɩ logto-yirã wa n sõnga Burkĩna Faso ne a tẽn-yagsã nin-buiidã. A wilgame tɩ b Ministɛɛrã pipi zu-loɛɛg yaa nebã na paam tɩbs-sõngo. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ Reezẽodesãntra pʋgẽ, logto-yi sẽn so b mens sõor yaa bãmb 492. B sʋkã logto-yi-bɛd  sẽn so b mens b sẽn boond tɩ Kilinikã yaa bãmb 70, la “Kilinik Pẽrensɛɛs Saara” sẽn wa n  paasã.

Sula nins sẽn sõngd tãrãzisẽo wã sõor tara paoosgo. Sull n doge, tɩ b boond tɩ « Apɛp ». Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, b sega kiba-kɩtbã, n wilg b sullã na-kẽndr sẽn na n  yɩ soaba.

Sullã taoor dãmb wilgame tɩ b sullã tʋlsem, ya b yãag tẽngã taoor soaba Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR ne a gosneerã tɩ b zab n fãag tẽngã. B wilgame tɩ Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR ne a gosneerã sẽn wa wã tɛka, b tʋʋm pakr yaa tẽngã na  lebg n paam laafɩ. Rẽnd yaa tɩlae tɩ bãmb yãag-ba, b yãabã pʋgẽ. Sullã rãmb wilgame tɩ bãmb me na n maana b sẽn tõe n fãa, n sõng tẽngã taoor rãmba tɩ b tõog n lebg n deeg tẽngã. B leb n na n tʋmame tɩ nin-buiidã wʋm taaba, la b gãd taab nus n zab ne wẽgbã la nin-wẽnsã. “Apɛpã” taoor soab a Sõmayɩla TARWAR wilgame tɩ b yãaga tẽngã taoor dãmb ne VDP rãmbã, la sodaasã, la b keng b raood tɩ b tõog n tek tẽn-kugrã. A wilgame tɩ rasem a wãn sẽn watã, bãmb ne nin-buiidã na n pʋɩɩ taab yam, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b tõog n bãng n yãag tẽngã taoor dãmba. Sullã taoor dãmb  kosa b tãb-biisã tɩ b kẽes mens n tʋm tɩ b sullã kẽn wa sẽn segde, la a  tõog n kẽng taoore.

Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR rɩka koɛɛg yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, n pʋʋs Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa ne b taabo. A koeesã pʋgẽ, a goma : tẽngã nug-gãaga, zab ne nasaar wẽnsã, la zab ne wẽgb buud toor-toor sẽn be tẽngã. Tẽnga taoor soab wilgame tɩ b na n maana b pãng sẽn tõe, tɩ tʋʋm-noy katɛk la b tõog n pagse. Yaa koobã tʋʋma, la tʋʋm a taaba, sẽn na yɩlẽ tɩ tẽngã tõog n kẽng taoore. A kosame tɩ yʋʋm 2024 soabã yɩ laafɩ, nonglem, la zu-noog yʋʋmde, Burkĩna Faso nin-buiida fãa yĩnga.

Tẽngã taoor soab koeesã:

Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidu, sẽn zabd-b  soog-m-mengã, laafɩ wã la soog-m-meng sɩd-sɩdã na waw ã rãmba. Yaa sũ-noog ne maam, tɩ m dɩkd koɛɛg yʋʋm-paallã sɩngrẽ, n na n pʋʋs Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã, sẽn be-b yir ka la sẽn be-b zamaan-n-zẽnse. Burkĩna Faso zo-rãmba, la a tʋmd-n-taasã, ne-b yʋʋm paalle, yʋʋm 2024 soabã taabo. D pẽgda Wẽnnaam b sẽn sõng tõnd tɩ d ta ra-kãngã, yʋʋm 2023 soabã yaoolem daarã. D kos Wẽnd tɩ  neb nins sẽn zab tẽngã soog-m-meng yĩng n maan kaalmã, tɩ b sɩɩs gãand laafɩ. D leb  n kota Wẽnd tɩ b kõ neb nins fãa sẽn paam sãmpogr zabrã wɛɛngẽ wã fãa laafɩ. D wilgda d belem ne neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnse, nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm-yood yĩngã.

M saam-biisi, yʋʋm 2023 soabã yɩɩ yʋʋmd tõnd maana vaees-zulung Burkĩna Faso sẽn be nug-gãag ningã zugu. Yɩɩ yʋʋm tõnd sẽn zĩnd n bao zu-loees nins sẽn namsd tõnd tẽngã tɩɩm, yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ d rɩk noy katɛka. Pipi noore, d ratame n yi yembdã nasaar wẽngã sẽn maandã. Yãmb ka tõe n kos ned t’a sõng yãmb tɩ y gẽes bũmb sẽn meneme, tɩ yaool n ya yẽ soabã n fãag yãmb bũmbã ye.

Yʋʋm 2023 soabã, yɛl-kẽer paama tɩʋʋsgo. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, d wilga na-kẽnda nins tõnd sẽn dɩke, laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ, rɩɩbã na sek nin-buiidã, la na-kẽnda wʋsgo, tẽngã taoor kẽnd yĩnga. Yaa rẽ tɩ m pʋʋsd Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa, b kẽes-m-mengã, la b sẽn wʋmd zabr ning tõnd sẽn be a soab pʋgẽ wã võor yĩnga.

Yʋʋm 2024 soabã na n yaa yʋʋmd tõnd sẽn na n kẽng taoor ne zabrã. Tõnd na n kẽnga taoor n zab ne yemd ning b sẽn kẽes tõnd a pʋgẽ wã, la d zab ne nasaar-wẽnsã sẽn dat n gɩdg tõnd yidgrã sorã.

Yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ, tõnd na n kẽnga taoor ne zab n deeg tẽngã. Yaa rẽ tɩ sodaarã wɛɛngẽ, d na n zĩniga sodaas sull b sẽn boond tɩ Birgad ɛspesɛll dẽntɛrvãsẽo rapɩɩdã, yaa sodaas sull sẽn na n tigim sodaasã buud toor-toore. Woto fãa kẽeda ne tõnd sẽn dat n lebg n siglg sodaarã tʋʋma , la d maneg n kʋms-a sẽn na yɩlẽ n paas zabrã pãnga. Yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ, d paama zab-teedo, n tõog n lebg n sigl sodaarã. Tʋʋm-kãens na n kell n kẽnga taoor yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ. Bala, tʋʋm-te-paal  sẽn na kogl sodaasã la a sõng tɩ b pãngã paase, la d na n paame. Sẽn leb n paasde, bãng-y tɩ yʋʋm 2024 soabã na n yɩɩ yʋʋmd d sẽn na pids pʋlems nins d sẽn maana. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa lebg n deeg tẽngã, la neb nins sẽn zoe n bas tẽnsã na tõog n leb b tẽnsẽ wã, la b paam koglgo.

Wa m sẽn da togs yãmba, yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ, na-kẽnda wʋsg d sẽn dɩkã, d sɩnga tʋʋma la yʋʋm 2024 soabã, tʋʋm-kãens segd n kẽnga taoore. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa tẽngã taoor soab sẽn dɩk noor ning sẽn kẽed ne rɩɩbã wɛɛngẽ wã, n paas ministɛɛr ning sẽn get koobã yell sẽn segd n maan tʋʋm nins koobã la gʋʋlgã pʋgẽ. Sapaol-koobã zoe n sɩngame.  Woto wilgdame tɩ na-kẽnda a  yiibã tẽngã taoor soab ne koobã ministɛɛr sẽn dɩkã zoe n bee tʋʋmd zugu. Tʋʋm-kãens na n sõngame tɩ yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ bɩ rɩɩbã tõog n sek nin-buiidã fãa. Ba t’a sã n wa n ka sek zãng me, bɩ rɩɩbã ra paoog wʋsg ye.

Yaa tɩlae ne tõnd tɩ tʋʋm-kãensã fãa tõog n pidi. Yaa rẽ tɩ m boond Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã tɩ b kẽes b mens n tʋm tʋʋma, b sẽn beẽ fãa, sẽn na yɩl tɩ gosneer me tõog n yãag-ba, tɩ b tʋm tɩ b tʋʋmdã tõog n pidi. Sã n ya ne tʋʋm-no-bɛdã zinigr pʋgẽ, la tʋʋm nins fãa sẽn tõe  n sõng sẽn lɛɛbdbã sẽn maood tɩ bũmbã fãa tõogd n sãeeg n kẽ Burkĩna Faso tẽns wʋsg pʋsẽ wã, na-kẽnda wʋsg la d na n dɩk zĩ-kãng me, n tõog n yãag-ba. Apɛkã tʋʋm zoe n sɩngame, a na n sõngame tɩ d paam tʋʋm-no-bɛd kẽere. Yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ na-kẽnda a taab la d na n leb n dɩke.

Yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ tõnd na n kosa Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa tɩ b kẽes b toogo, n tõog n yãag  na-kẽnda nins tẽngã taoor soab sẽn dɩk tẽngã taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ wã. D sẽn maan vaees-zulung laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ, yaa wa d sẽn da yeel yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ wã. Rẽndame tɩ d lebg n ges d tẽnsã siglg yelle, la d kɩt tɩ b lebg yɩlgemde. Rẽndame tɩ nin-buiidã fãa kẽes b toog tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ, n tʋm tɩ yɩlgemdã zĩnd zagsã la tẽngã fãa pʋgẽ. Rẽ na n kɩtame tɩ d tõog n gil bãas nins tõnd sẽn yã yʋʋmd ning sẽn loogã pʋgẽ, tɩ b ra le puk yʋʋm-paallã pʋgẽ ye.

Tõnd sẽn be maoor ning zug rũnda wã, yaa tõnd rog-n-mikã me maoore. Wala yãmb sẽn gũus n gese, vaeesg sẽn maan zu-loeesã pʋgẽ, d bãngame tɩ nasaarã wã wa n yiisa tõnd d rog-n-mikã pʋgẽ. Tõnd rog-n-mikã menemame, tõnd rog-n-mik ning sẽn gãd tõnd laafɩ wã, vɩɩmd-n-taarã, la sõng taabã. Tõnd rog-n-mika menemame. Yaa rẽ la tõnd sẽn zabd n dat tɩ d rog-n-mikã lebg n paam a zĩig tõnd maoorã pʋgẽ wã.

Yaa rẽ fãa n kɩt tɩ tõnd rɩk d buudã goam n ning sʋka, la d le ning sull b sẽn boond tɩ kõnsay nasẽonall de kominote. Yaa laloa depite rãmbã sẽn nan dɩk rasma noore. Woto fãa segd n kɩtyame tɩ tõnd lebg n wa d sɩngrẽ wã, d kʋdemdẽ wã, d rog-n-mikẽ wã, sẽn na yɩl tɩ sõng-taabã la vɩɩmd-n-taarã sẽn paoogd tõndã tõog n lebg n wa tõnd tẽngã pʋgẽ, laafɩ , bas tɩ looge , la sõng-taab rog-n-miki.

Sẽn kẽed ne wẽgbã wɛɛngẽ, yʋʋm 2023 soabã, wẽgbã ra ket n beeme. Yʋʋm 2024 soabã, tõnd datame n sɩd wɩkd mens n zab ne-a. Yaa wakat mam sẽn  na n kos tʋʋm-noy nins sẽn zabd ne wẽgbã tɩ b wɩk b mense, sẽn na yɩl t’a menem tõnd tẽngã pʋgẽ.

M saam-biisi ( kamarad)  ;

Tõnd kõo sɩd ne sor ning tõnd sẽn dɩkã. Sor a to ka be n tõe n kõ tõnd d soog-m-mengã tɩ ka so-kãng ye. Rẽnd yaa tɩlae tɩ d tũ sorã, n tõog n paam d soog-m-mengã tɩ Burkĩna Faso tõog n kẽng taoore. Tõnd kõo sɩd tɩ ne Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã sõngre, maoor ning tõnd sẽn moaadã yaa burkĩnd maoore, Burkĩna Faso ne AYEYƐSÃ tẽns fãa yĩnga, la nin-sabls tẽnsã fãa yĩnga.

M pʋʋsda yãmb ne y taabo, yʋʋm-paallã yĩnga; Wẽnd na kɩt t’a yɩ laafɩ yʋʋmde, maoor yʋʋmde, n yɩ yʋʋmd Burkĩna Faso nebã fãa sẽn na n bao nonglem ne taaba,  n bas welgrã tɩ lʋɩ, la b naag taab n  ges b beoog neerã. A kell n yɩ sũ-noog yʋʋmde, la raab pidsg yʋʋmde. 

M ka tõe n baas m goama, n ka pʋʋs Burkĩna nin-buiidã sẽn wʋm maoorã võore, n sak kẽes b mens wĩndg la yʋng n maood n na n gũ tãrãzisẽo wã ne nao-kẽndr toor-toore. D bãng vẽeneg tɩ bɛ wã nan ka sik a lokã ye, bɩ d gũusi. Nasaar-wẽngã la bɛɛb nins sẽn be Burkĩna Faso ne  kɛɛngã ket n tʋmdame n dat wẽnga.

M pʋʋsda Burkĩna nin-buiidã barka, b maoorã yĩnga. M pʋʋsda neb nins sẽn be yir ka, bɩ kɛɛnga, tɩ yaa  Burkĩna Faso bɩ tẽn-taase, dũni wã fãa pʋgẽ  n sak n teend tõndo, la b sõngd Burkĩna Faso, mao-kãngã pʋgẽ wã.

Le Capitaine Ibrahim TRAORE

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Asosɛsẽo Yisesede rãmb talla sɛk Goobbustɛɛr sẽn be Waogdg sak ning b sẽn boond tɩ Tukẽ wã. Sɛkã võore, ya b sẽn na n zĩnd ne taab n ges yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2020 soabã, b sẽn zĩnd n zĩnig-b sullã tɛka, a sẽn tõog n tʋm tʋʋm ninisi, la b lebg n tek a taoor rãmbã. Sullã seb-gʋn-kaseng a Sõmayɩɩla ROAMBA wilgame tɩ Yisesede yaa sull sẽn get tõnd nin-sabls tẽng rog-n-miki, a kʋdemde, la a nin-buiidã na naag taaba, n wilgd b nin-buiidã zu-loeese, la b rog-n-mik yamã wɛɛngẽ. A leb n yaa sull sẽn takd nin-buiidã n pẽnegd taaba, tɩ b wʋmd taab kibaya, la b tar tõk-n-taar ne taaba, yẽsg la zems taab wɛɛngẽ. Sullã luglame n na n dɩk nin-sabls tẽns kʋdemdã la b rog-n-mik vɩɩmd-n-taarã t’a  yɩ yam wekr bũmbu, tɩ b sã n tar wala zu-loɛɛga, bɩ b kẽ yaab rãmbã yam pʋgẽ, n bao manegre. Sullã na n yãagda reem-rɛɛmdba la neb buud toor-toor sẽn tar minim la bãngr sẽn tõe n kɩt tɩ nin-buiidã naag taab n vɩɩmde. Sullã biiru tõe n ninga zĩig fãa Burkĩna Faso, la b  ratame t’a yadge, n wa tõog n saag nin-sabls tẽnga.

Sɛkã  wa n baasa ne taoor rãmbã toeengo. Nin-paal sẽn  kẽ ya a KAFAANDO Samande, a ZƖDWƐƐMBA Buryaama. Sull sigdgã pʋgẽ, b yãk a Sɩdnooma Yisɛka KABOORE, la neb nins sẽn zã yʋʋm a tãabã, tɩ b leb n zã sullã yʋʋm a tãabo. Sullã paallã sẽn deeg b tʋʋmde, b kosame tɩ b maan Gurp Watzap n paam n taasd taab kibaya. B kell n wilgame tɩ sullã taoor soab fãa modg wa ne a neng sebr Fotokopi Legaliise yʋʋm-vẽkr rasem a yi 2024 sẽn watã, tɩ b paam n lebg n kẽng n tɩ manes sɛbã. Tẽegre, Yisesede sullã b lugl-a-la yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2020 soabã, Yiɛlbe sẽn be Waogdg roogã a ye pʋga.

Pegdouendé Eric Zinaaba

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Waogdg Meeri wã taoor rãmb ne ẽspɛgsẽo de travay rãmb maana nug-tikr ne tʋm-tʋmdb nins sẽn da be sũ-pũur pʋgẽ wã. Nug-tikrã poore, sor kõome tɩ b na n sɩng b yaoobo.

Yaa yʋʋm a tãab tõre, la neb nins sẽm tʋmd  sagdã wʋkre, soayã pɩɩsgo, la zagsã gũub ra tar mo-yõsr ne Meeri wã taoor dãmba. A wakatẽ wã goama yɩɩ wʋsg tɩ tʋm-tʋmdbã ra yi n wilg tɩ b ratame tɩ b yao-b b ligdã, tɩ b ne Meeri wã taoor rãmb ka tol n wʋm taab ye. Yʋʋm a tãab loogr poore, zu-loɛɛgã ka tol n paam welgr n wa ta kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE.

Yaa rẽ t’a Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR  kẽes a toog n kose, tɩ ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kadensã la ministɛɛr ning sẽn get tʋm-tʋmdbã yẽs ne Meeri wã tɩ b mao tɩ zu-loɛɛgã paam welgre. Yẽsgã sɩd woma biisi. Tɩ bala, yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Meeri wã taoor dãmb yãk yam n na n yao-ba. Yaa milyão 300 la b rɩk na n yao  tʋm-tʋmdb 573. La b sʋkã, yaa neb 20 n maan kaalem. Waogdg Meeri wã delegasẽo ɛspesɛll taoor soaba, a Moris KONATE wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo,  wʋm taabã sẽn lebg n kẽ sʋkã. A togsame tɩ sũ-puurã ra waa ne zũndri, tɩ yɩl n wʋm taabã meng  ra lebg toog tʋmtʋmdbã ne Meeri wã taoor rãmb sʋka. La rũndã a pẽgda Wẽnde. Tɩ bala, zu-loɛɛgã paama tɩɩm.

Mise  KONATE wilgame t’a na n yẽsa ne Senesɛs rãmba, tɩ neb nins sẽm tʋmd ne sagdã wʋkre, soayã pɩɩsgã paam b retrɛtã  (vʋʋsma) yaoodo. Neb nins sẽn maan kaalmã, a Moris KONATE kosa Wẽnd tɩ b maneg b reng taoore. A  pʋʋsa neb nins fãa sẽn kẽes b toog tɩ wʋm taab tõog n zĩnd Meeri wã taoor rãmb ne tʋm-tʋmdbã sʋkã. A kosa tʋm-tʋmdbã tɩ b sigs b sũya, la b wa tɩ b gãd taab nusi, n tʋm tɩ Waogdg Meeri wã tõog n yidg kẽng taoore. A togsame tɩ ligdã b sẽn na n yao-bã, sɩngda wakɩr tus a wɛ n talla n kẽng taoore. A Moris KONATE baas a koeesã ne yʋʋm-paallã taab pʋʋsgo.

Tʋmtʋmdbã no-rɛɛs a Edoaar WEDRAOOG pẽga tẽngã taoor soaba, ne Meeri wã taoor soaba, bãmb fãa  sẽn sak n lʋɩsa toog tɩ b zu-loeesã paam welgrã. Mise WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ yʋʋm a tãabã pʋgẽ sɩd yɩɩ zu-loeese, bãmb ne Meeri wã taoor dãmba. La rũndã, b yaa sũur yaa noogo, tɩ bala, b zu-loɛɛgã welgame tɩ b na n yao-ba. A wilgame t’a sũ-noogã, nin-kẽembã, la pʋg-yãansã sẽn be bãmb sʋka, n na n paam b tʋʋlgã biisã. Bãmb sʋkã me, kɩɩbse, la pʋg-kõap bee be. Rẽnd bãmb zu-leesã sẽn paam welgrã, a ya b fãa sũ-noogo. A kosame tɩ Wẽnd sõng-do, tɩ d  tɩ tẽngã gãand bãane. Yaoodã sɩngda ne yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 29 n tãag a rasem 30 daare yʋʋm 2023 soabã.

Arõndisma 10 bee Waogdg sɛgtɛɛr a 5 pʋgẽ. A yaa sɛgtɛɛr 41, 42, 43, 44 , 45, la no-loti rãmb wala: Taabtẽnga, Yẽoko 2, la Gikofe pʋsʋka.

Kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 11 fãa Burkĩna Faso tẽngã rãmb maanda b soog-m-menga tẽegre. Rõanda yʋʋmdã yɩ a naoor 63 soaba. Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ b sigl tigrã reezẽo rãmb wʋsg pʋsẽ. Reezẽo di sãntra rãmb maan-a-la Waogdg palaas de la nasẽo. Neb sẽn paam waoor kũun b sẽn boond tɩ Dekoorasẽo wã yɩɩ neb 101. B wilgame tɩ b rãmbã yaa neb sẽn tʋm tẽngã yĩnga. Gom-zug b sẽn yãk n maan tẽngã soog-m-meng yʋʋm 63 soabã, yaa « kõ-m-mengã la tẽng-n-bi-tɩrlmã yaa bũmb sẽn tõe n wa ne laafɩ tɩ tẽngã paam n me».

Yaa reezẽo di sãntr guvɛrgneere, la reezẽo rãmb a taab taoor rãmb n naag taab n maan tigrã Waogdgo.

Reezẽo di sãntra Guvɛgneer a Abdulae BASẼNGA, wilgame tɩ b sẽn ka maan tɩ tigrã t’a yɩ tig-kasengã tũuda ne tẽngã nug-gãaga. A togsame tɩ ba a sẽn ka yɩ kasenga, a yaa makre, n wilgd tɩ tẽngã yasa a wɩla, la nin-buiidã ket n tara saagre, tɩ sog-m-meng hakɩɩk na zĩndi.

Karen-saamb kaseng a Lorã BADO paama waoor kũun ning b sẽn boond tɩ Komandɛɛr de logdre de letalõ, n paas a sẽn da zoe n paam yʋʋm-sar kiuug yʋʋm 2020 soabã.

A Maru Yãmbweoogo, sẽn ya Arõndiisma 11 soabã taoor soab me paama waoor kũuni b sẽn boond tɩ meday de kolɛktivite lokallã. Neb nins sẽn paam kũunã wilga b sũ-noog ne tẽnga taoor dãmba, tɩ bala,  a yaa bũmb sẽn kengd b raoodo, la kõt-b pãnga.

Reezẽo di sãntr Guvɛgneerã wilgame tɩ tẽngã soog-m-mengã tẽegr ka tigrã bal ye, a yaa ned kam kẽes a toog n ne a nug-bũmbu, la a  tʋm n sõng tɩ b zab ne nin-wẽnsã.

Kibarã yii Lɩɩbr ẽnfo

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 9 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, tẽngã taoor dãmb kõo sor tɩ buudã goam televisẽo Ɛrtebe 3 wã paka a kʋɩlense. Yaa televisẽo sẽn na n tʋm tɩ buudã goam kẽng taoore, la a piuug n paase.

Ɛrtebe taoor soab a Galip SOME togsame t’a na n yaa kibay kũun zĩig yaa sɩda, la a na n yɩɩ tõnd buudã goam yidgr tʋʋm-teoogo. A na n sõngame tɩ ned kam fãa bãng a meng kʋdemde,la a bãng a to me rẽ. Televisẽo wã tʋlsem yaa a pʋɩ kibayã tɩ ta Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa.

Miniisr ning sẽn get kibayã kɩsgo, a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ Ɛrtebe 3 wã kibay kɩsgo, a na n tũu ne zabrã wɛɛngẽ, tɩ bala, kibayã kũun ne buudã goam tata nin-buiidã wʋsgo. Yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn be wã, yaa tɩlae tɩ b kõ kibyã ne buudã goam tɩ nebã fãa tõog n wʋme.

ƐRTEBE 3 na n sõngame tɩ Burkĩna Faso rog-n-mikã la a arzɛkã kẽng taoore. Nan yaa buud goam 12 la a na n sɩng ne. Yaa moore, zʋlle, silmirindi, Gurmdi, ragaabre, bʋsãande, Loobre, bwamu, Gʋrẽnde, Bobo mandaarɛ, sãmogemdo, la Rafĩindi. La a ka na n tek woto bal ye, tɩ bala,  goam a taab n be sorẽ. Ɛrtebe 3 wã be TNT wã zugu. A  gomda daar fãa, a kõta tẽngã kibay la gosneerã kibay.  A leb n na n maoome tɩ vɩɩmd-n-taarã paam pãnga. Ɛrtebe 3 tʋʋm-noor pakr ba-yãkdg yɩɩ Miniisr ning sẽn get kaorengã la buuda goam taoor kẽnde, a Ãdere Zozɛf WEDRAOOGO.  Ba-yãkdgã kosa televisẽo wã taoor rãmb tɩ b tʋm ne bãngre, tɩ tʋʋma tũ wa sẽn segde, t’a na n sõngame tɩ buudã goam t’a kẽng taoore. A wilgame tɩ ministɛɛrã na n sõng-b lame tɩ televisẽo wã tʋʋm kẽng taoore.

Sõasg buud toor-toor na n yita Televisẽo wã zugu. Wala: Magazĩnd dãmba, Kɩɩs-taaba, la Faama. Faama wã na n yɩɩ yibeoog sõasga. Wiri yaa wĩndg sõasga. Dʋrba yaa sibr la hat sõasga. Yaa sõasg ne buudã goamã Faama wã yaa Gurumdi. Wiri wã yaa Loobre, Dʋrba wã yaa gʋrende, Burkĩndlmã yaa moore. Bãntaare wã yaa silmiirindi. Fasodeya baaro wã yaa zʋlle. Televisẽo wã yʋʋr yaa “Tõnd televisẽo, Tõnd buudã yãgre”. A kõbgã yaa Ɛtebe ning sẽn da zoe n be-a wã gõbgo.

Kibarã yii Faso7

Na n maana wakat wook tɩSɩɩd wɛst nin-buiidã ket n tẽegda daarã yell n gomda, tɩ bala, a yɩɩ daar sẽn ka wẽnd a taaba.  Sɩɩd wɛst rãmb paama zu-noogo, tɩ tẽngã taoor rãmb yãk yam n na n me logto-yi kaseng sẽn tõe n sõngba, b laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ. Reezẽo wã guvɛgneer a Buryaama SAVADG wilgame tɩ nin-buiidã fãa sũur nooma ne tẽnga taoor dãmba. Sabaab kãng kɩtame kotẽ tɩ Bafugi. Ya arẽ t’a  kos yaab rãmb kell n zẽk tẽngã taoor soab zugu,  la b sõng-a t’a tʋʋmdã tõog n yɩ sõma.

Tẽnga taoor soab wilgame tɩ ba ne tẽngã sẽn be yõ-koglg kaalmã pʋgẽ wã, ya t ɩlae tɩ nin-buiidã laafɩ paam gesgo, tɩ bala, laafɩ wã n segd n deng taoore, tɩ zab ne nin-wẽnsã yaool n pʋge. Yaa tɩlae tɩ b zab zabrã, la segdame me tɩ b ges tẽnga taoor kẽnde. Y    aa rẽnda fãa n kɩt tɩ b yãk yam n na sõng siid wɛs soolmã rãmb ne logto-yi kaseng sẽn na n ges b laafɩ wã yelle, bala logto-yi kaseng ra ka be rezõ wã pʋgẽ n ye . Tẽnga taoor soab kenga taoor n paas tɩ logto-yir b sẽn dat me wã na nnlogto-yi kasenga, tɩ bala, tɩpsga teed buud toor-toor na n zĩnda a pʋgẽ , tɩ b ra le namsd n kẽnd zĩis a taab n tɩ tɩbsdẽ ye. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR yeel-b lame tɩ porze kãensã buud na n yɩɩ  reezẽo rãmbã pʋsẽ. Na-kẽnd kãng na n sõngame tɩ logtoɛɛmbã paam bãngr kẽng taoore. A wilgame tɩ logtoɛɛmb sẽn tar bãngr ningã yaa tʋʋmã teed ka be ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b saagdẽ tɩ ka la ka reezẽo rãmb a taabã me na n paame.

Sã n yaa ne minisr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã, a Luisẽ Zãnkolood KARGUUG wilgame  tɩ logtor-yir ning tãn-koeemd b sẽn dɩglã, b bool-a lame tɩ opital Inivɛrsitɛɛre. Tɩbsg buud toor-toor  na n zĩnda a pʋgẽ. B na n tɩbsda fulfuudã bãase, suyã bãase, kõambã, gĩinã,  la ɛskaneer rãmbã,  n paas tɩbsg a taaba. Reezẽo wã ne ya yagse, a la tẽns a taab neb na n paamda tɩbsg wakat fãa.

Yaa Milyaar 45 la b rɩk n na n me-a.

 Logtor-yi-kãngã bãad rãmb gãas zĩis bãmb 306  la b na n ning a pʋgẽ. Yaa tʋʋm-noy pisnu la zak n na n zĩnd a pʋgẽ. Zĩigã b sẽn dɩk n na n me-a wã yalem taa Ɛgtaar 27, la yaa tʋʋm-noor b sẽn get meebã tɩ boond tɩ ELIPIS PORZEKTA « ELIPS POJECT » la b kõ meebã. Tʋʋm-noorã taoor soab wilgame t’a na n tʋma ne Burkĩna Faso tʋʋm-noy a taab sẽn get meebã. Boto na n yɩɩ sabaab tɩ b rɩk tẽngã kamb tʋʋma, tɩ sõng-b tɩ tẽngã paam n yidgi. A pẽga tẽngã taoor dãmb b sẽn kõ-a sɩdã.

Sɩɩd wɛst nin-buiidã wilgame tɩ logtor-yirã na n wa sõng-b-la wʋsgo. Bala, ra mi n yaa tɩlae ne-b tɩ kẽng zĩis a taab n tɩ tɩbse, la logtor-yi-kãngã sẽn na n me wã, b ka na n le kẽng Waogdg bɩ Bobo n tɩ paam tɩbsg ye. Bãag sã n yik neda, a tɩbsgã na n yɩɩ zĩig pʋgẽ.

Kibarã yii  faso.net

Sapoalg kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sõsa ne Sɩɩd wɛst reezẽo wã taoor dãmba. B yii Buguriba, Loba, Numbiyɛle, la Poni, n kẽng Gawa n tɩ seg tẽngã taoor soaba. A Bʋryaama SAVADOG sẽn ya  Sɩɩd wɛst reezẽo wã komber wilgame t’a soolmã nin-buiidã sũur yaa noog ne tẽngã taoor soaba, a sẽn yãk yam n wa seg-bã. A kell n wilgame t’a soolmã nin-buiid kɩsa tẽngã taoor soab sɩda.

Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR koɛɛgã pʋgẽ, a wilgame t’a sẽn zẽk a naoor n sig site Bafugi wã, yaa sẽn na yɩl n bãng bũmb nins sẽn maand reezẽo wã pʋgẽ,  reezẽo wã nin-bbuiid sẽn vʋɩ toto. Kapitɛndã pẽga neb nins sẽn be zabrã zĩigẽ wã. A wilgame tɩ zabrã yaa kãnkãe, a na n kaoosa bilf yaa sɩda, la a na n sõnga sodaasã ne teedo,  sẽn na yɩl tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa. A kosa Sɩɩd wɛst nin-buiidã tɩ b yãag tẽngã taoor dãmb ne b nug bũmbu, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b tõog n tʋm tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa Burkĩna Faso.

Sõasga pʋgẽ, Sɩɩd wɛst reezẽo wã taaor dãmb rɩka b soolmã zu-loees kẽer n taas tẽngã taoor soaba. Zu-loeesã yaa: soayã sẽn ka sõma wã, yõ-koglg kaalmã, logtoyiyã sẽn ka waoogã, Gawa Yinivɛrsite wã Karen-dot sẽn ka sekdã, la sãnmã tʋʋma. Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame tɩ zu-loe-kãens na n paama tɩɩm; tɩ bala, b sã n gese, Gawa naaga tẽns nins saaga sẽn niid sõma wã sʋka. A leb n yaa tẽng t’a tẽn-gãongã tar arzɛk wʋsgo. Rẽ zoe n yaa bũmb sẽn tõe n sõng-a t’a kẽng taoore.

A kell n bẽnda be n wilg tɩ masĩn-koods 350 la b na n paam n sõng koaadbã tɩ koobã kẽng taoore. A leb n wilgame tɩ b na n paka SONASP, tʋʋm noor sẽn get tẽn-gãongã arzɛkã tʋntʋmdb biiro rãmb Gawa, tɩ b tõog n deegd sãnem tũudbã sãnem n daadẽ. Rẽ poore, Kapitɛnd  Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sega -n-mikã taoor dãmba. Rog-n-mika taoor dãmb pẽg-a-la na-kẽnda nins a sẽn dɩke, na maoodẽ tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa tẽngã. B no-rɛɛsã sẽn ya Gawanaab a Bifale a yiib-n-soabã wilgame tɩ b sũur yaa nooog  ne-a, a  sẽn yãk yam n wa rɩglg logtoyi-kasengã pipi tãn-koeemd bãmb soolmẽ wã. B kell n wilgame tɩ b ningd-a-la zɩlem-sõngo, sẽn na yɩl t’a tõog a tʋʋmdã.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2023 soabã ADRCN sẽn yãk sull ning t’a get b ra-kasengã yell talla sɛk ne taab Miize zak pʋga, b sõasgã roogẽ. Seg-taabã, yaa sẽn na n leb n ges raarã sẽn kell rũnda ne beoogã seglgã bee nen-bʋgo. Sõasgã sɩngr wakate, b reng n tẽega seg taab ning sẽn zĩnd kiuugã rasem 23 soabã, b sẽn gãd noy ninsi. Rẽ poore, siglgã taoor soaba, Mise Ɛlferɛɛd wilgame tɩ siglgã kẽnda sõma. A Sɩdnooma Yisɛka KABOOR togsame tɩ Savand Medɛ sõasg ning b sẽn boond tɩ Bõnzʋʋr le Faso wã, bool-a t’a kẽng n tɩ sõse, n wilg bũmb ning võor sẽn kɩt b yãk wakatã t’a ya Sãntr noor kambã na seg taab n dɩ rogem noog wakatã. A wilgame tɩ Rtb tel Zinita la Radiyo nasnall yeelame tɩ b tʋm neb tɩ b wa sõse, n wilg rasem a tãabã tʋʋm sẽn na n kẽn toto. Sawand Fm me leb n boolame tɩ b wa sõs Sõorã sõasg pʋgẽ, la Bõnzʋʋr le Faso wã zug n paase. A wilgame tɩ kibaya sãeegr wɛɛngẽ, bɩ b bas rabeem, tɩ b na n paama yãagre. A togsame tɩ b sega kiba-kɩtbã a yibeoogẽ, la rẽ fãa yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ rɩk kibaya n taas nin-buiidã. Tɩ bala, kʋdemdã Miniisr yeelame t’a ka na n zĩnd ye, la a na n tʋma ned tɩ zĩnd a yʋʋr yĩnga. A leb n na n sõng-b-la gosneer kiba-kɩtbã tɩ b wa rɩk koeesã n taas nin-buiidã. Ligdã wɛɛngẽ pʋlem nood ket n kẽnda taoor n paasdẽ, tɩ b saagdẽ ka la ka, b rãmb na pidis b pʋlengo. Mise KABOOR wilgame tɩ b boonda Sãnt noorã kamb gilli, b ka welg tɩ gurma, tɩ silmiiga, tɩ moaaga, bɩ buud a taab sẽn be soolmã pʋg ye. B boonda b fãa, la b ratame tɩ b tall b pagb la b kamb n wa wʋsgo. Rasãndaagã sɩngda lamusa sapaolg kiuuugã rasem 30 n ta hatã yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a tãabo. Zãna ketame, la sẽn dat-a fãa, a ket n tõe n paamame. Reemã zĩigẽ Buls kamb piig la a nu n zoe n segl n sa, n na n deeme n kõ nebã. Ƙoaasdbã na n sega taab yibeoog wakat a nii kiuugã rasem 30. Badaar zaabr wakat a naas la reem-rɛɛmdbã na n sɩnga badaar zaabr wakat a naase. Raar fãa b na n deemame n ta yʋng wakat a nii. Tigrã pakre, la koeesã rɩgsg na n yɩɩ sibrã kiuugã rasem a yi raare, zaabr wakat a naase. Rẽ poore, b na n gilgame n ges zãna.

Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Pengdouendé Eric Zinaaba

Sẽn sɩng ne Sapaolg kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, nasẽo zini sullã tʋma neb tɩ b wa Burkĩna Faso. Yaa ned ning b sẽn yãk t’a get nin-buiidã sõngre, a Zoyse Msuwa, n lʋɩ taoore. Sapaolg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, miniisr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã, ne a miniisr taas kẽer seg-b lame. B sɛg-taabã pʋgẽ,  b togsame tɩ b waoongã võore,  yaa zu-loees nins sẽn be Burkĩna Faso, a nin-buiidã vɩɩm wɛɛngẽ wã, b na tõog n dɩk-a n taas ãnduni wã sull-kaseng taoor dãmba.

Nand tɩ b seg gosneerã, b reng n kaaga sula nins sẽn so b mensã, lagem-n-taar sull b sẽn boond tɩ ƐSPÕNGÃ « SPONG ». B wilgame tɩ b na n kẽnga taoor ne b kaagrã, la yaa nin-buiidã la b na n seg tẽns kẽer pʋgẽ. Seg-kãng me, ya b na tõog n bãng yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn maan bũmb nins pagbã la rapã vɩɩm pʋse. A  Zoyse Msuwa togsame tɩ sõasgã na n sõng-b lame tɩ b tõog n bãng zu-loees nins sẽn be tẽngã, n paam n keng sula nins sẽn get-b nebã sõngr pelse, tɩ b kẽng taoor ne b tʋʋmdã.

 B bẽndame n pʋʋs Burkĩna Faso gosneerã ne nandg pãng ning b sẽn maand nin-buiidã sõngr wɛɛngẽ wã. Sullã sẽn tʋm neb ninsã wilgame tɩ b na n kell n dɩka na-kẽnda n sõng ãnduni sull ning sẽn get rɩɩbã yell b sẽn boond tɩ PAMA t’a paas a tʋʋmdã pãnga. Sullã no-rɛɛs wilgame tɩ b na n pʋgdame n getẽ sõngrã b sẽn kõtã tõog n tat neb nins sẽn a sẽn segd ta wã.

Kibarã yii faso.net

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã ADRCN sẽn ya Sãntr noor kambã lagem-n-taar sull tɩ b boond tɩ Asosɛsẽo Lagemtaabã talla sɛk ne b soolmã kamb kẽere. Seg-taabã võore, yaa ADRCN Lagem-taaba, ne Liniyãopʋʋrledevelopemadelaporvẽesdisãnematẽnga tɩ b kʋʋg koɛɛg n boond tɩ UDPS Natigimzanga, n paas Asosɛsẽo Nayɩneerepʋʋrledevelopemadelaporvẽesdinamentẽnga tɩ b kʋʋg koɛɛg n boond tɩ ANDN, la lagem-n-taar sula a taab sẽn be Bam soolmã, n get Bam porvẽesã yidgri. Sula kãens fãa naaga taab noor a ye, la sũur a ye, n yãk sapaolg kiuug rasem 30 n ta yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a tã yʋʋm 2023, Sãntr noor kambã sẽn be Waogdgã zĩnda ne Miize nasnallã zak pʋga. Ya b soolmã kamb na paas b nonglem ne taaba, la b zĩnd-n-taarã sõmblem pãnga. Yaa rẽ tɩ b yãk tɩ wakatã ya zĩnd n yẽse, n bao yam-dãmba, b soolmã na yidgi, la a nin-buiidã me na zems-taaba, n naag taab n zab ne yõ-kaalmã.

Gom-zug b sẽn tiki, yaa « Sãntr noor kambã tik b kʋdemdã la b rog-n-mikã, n tõog n kɩt tɩ b soolmã yi yõ-koglg kaalmã pʋgẽ».  Bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b na n maan raarã, yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ b tõog n seg taaba, n bãng taab n paase, la b rɩ rogem noogo . La sẽn na yɩl n paas wakatã b sẽn yãk na n seg  taab n sõsã yamleoogo, b maana Rasãndaaga. La b yãka yam tɩ na n yɩ Sãntr noor soolmẽ wã rɩ-rãmbã la bũmb nins fãa b sẽn maand Sãnematẽnga, Namendtẽnga, la Bam soolmã pʋgẽ, la zãna rɩkd-b na n  koose. Rasem a tãabã pʋgẽ, b na n dɩka koees buud toor-toore. Koeesã fãa yaa nin-buiidã na wʋm taab n vʋɩɩmde, la sugr koeese. Koeesã rɩgsg poore, b na n gilgame n ges zãna.

Siglgã taoor rãmb wilgame tɩ b ratame tɩ Sãntr noorã kamb wa ne b pagb la b kamba, la b zo-rãmba. B ratame tɩ tall b kambã tɩ b wa ges tõnd kʋdem-teedã sẽn be zakã pʋgã. Rasãndaagã ka yaood n kẽ ye. La kẽ n ges Miize wã pʋg teedã yaoodame. ADRCN rãmb tʋlsmã ya b mao n paas soolmã kamb zems-taaba, la b wʋmd-n-taarã pãnga, Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩsã pʋgẽ. “Zabr yikd beoog ka kõt weef ki ye”.

Sẽn na yɩl n bãng siglgã kẽnd toto, b sega taab sapolg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Waogdgo, Miize nasnallã zak pʋga. Koeesã rɩkr pʋga, a Sɩdnooma Yisɛka KABOORE, ADRCN taoor soabã wilgame tɩ Busum Dĩma a Sigr sakame n na n sõng-ba. Tigrã ba-yãkd-kaseng yaa Busum Dĩma a Sigri, tɩ Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG ne a Loorã SEDG pʋgda, la Bam soolmẽ wã b ra nan ka paam ned ning b sẽn na n yãk t’a paasã ye. A wilgame tɩ sõandb kẽer n zoe n pʋlmame tɩ b na n kõ-b-la ligdi, tɩ kẽer pʋlem tɩ b na n sõng-b-la ne reem-teedo, mobile, la bũmb buud fãa b me sẽn tõe n paam n kõ-b tɩ b reeg n segl tigrã. Reem-rɛɛmdb na n zĩnda sʋka, la yaood kae ye. Yaa reem-rɛɛmd fãa reem n wilg a bãngre, tɩ zãma wã bãng-a n paase. Lamusã ne arzũma reemã rãmb na n sɩnga zaabr wakat a naas sasa, n tãag yʋng wakat a nii. Sibrã ne hatã, b na n sɩnga zaabr wakat a yoob sasa, n deem n tɩ sik yʋng wakat a nii. Kibayã kɩsg wɛɛngẽ, saagr be, tɩ b na paam yãagre. MISE BAAGMOOG sẽn ya Savand fm kiba-kɩtã pʋlmame t’a na n kẽes a toog n kos Savand fm la Savand Tv tɩ b yãag-ba. Sõasgã yɩɩ gom-n-kõ-taaba, tɩ ned fãa bãng siglgã sẽn be zĩig ninga.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 20 n tãag a rasem 22 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn gʋlsd ne buudã goama sega taab Noomgãana Lʋmbil komindã pʋg n maan zãmsgo. Zãmsgã  gom-zug yɩɩ «Buudã goam  kibay gʋlsdb sẽn segd n maan toto n kẽ nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋgẽ». Tũu ne sull b sẽn boond tɩ AYEPEZIYƐLƐNDÃ paama sull ning sẽn sõngd kibayã kũun rot ne ligdi, b sẽn boond tɩ FAPÃ sõngre, tɩ kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn gʋlsd ne buudã goam lagem-n-taar sull tõog n paam zãmsgã n kõ b kiba-kɩtbã.

Yɩɩ kiba-kɩtb 20 sẽn gʋlsd moore, Silmiirẽndi, Zʋlle, la Gʋrende, n paam zãmsgã. Karen-saamb yɩɩ mise Rasɩɩd TARWAR sẽn tar bãngr nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã wɛɛngẽ n dɩk zãmsgã n taas-ba. Nand tɩ tʋʋmdã sɩnge, Kiba-kɩtbã sull taor soaba a Tasɛɛr Kĩnda pʋʋsa nebã ne b waoongo, la a pẽg

Fap taoor dãmbã, b sẽn sak n yãagd-ba, tɩ b paamd zãmsg buud toor-toor n kõt b kiba-kɩtbã. A wilgame tɩ wakat ning zamaanã sẽn be wã, segdame tɩ ned kam fãa sak n tũ tekrã. A wilgame tɩ zãmsg ning kiba-kɩtbã sẽn paama, a yaa bũmb sẽn tar yõod wʋsgo.

A tõe n sõng-b lame tɩ b kẽ zamaan paalgã tʋʋm-teed pʋgẽ b sẽn boond tɩ Nimerikã. A kell n kosa kiba-kɩtbã tɩ b tũ zãmsgã sõma t’a na n sõng-b lame tɩ b tõog n lebg n vʋʋg b Zʋgnalsã, b sẽn da be kũum sor zugã.

AYEPEZIYƐLƐND yel-gɛta a Evaris ZÃONG wilg tɩ zãmsgã yaa bũmb sẽn tar yõod wʋsg ne kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn gʋlsd ne buudã goama. Tɩ bala, Zʋgnall rãmbã ka le raad ye. Seb-vãt nins b sẽn tar n yiisd sɛbã me ligd lebga toogo, la sã n kẽ nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paala pʋgẽ, nebã fãa tõe n paamda kibaya faag-faaga. A leb n sõngdame me tɩ buudã goam gʋlsdb paamd nafr a pʋgẽ. A Evaris wilgame tɩ b na n dɩka AYEPEZIYƐLƐNDÃ t’a yɩ wa Zʋgnall kasenga, tɩ kiba-kɩtbã gʋlsd a zugu, tɩ b kibaya naagd n piuugd zamaanã pʋ wakat yende. Zãmsgã sɩngrẽ, b reng n wilga kiba-kɩtbã la buudã goam sẽn be zĩig ning Burkĩna Faso tẽn-kugrã pʋgẽ. Wegsgã pʋgẽ, sã n sɩd getẽ, mikdame tɩ Burkĩna Faso zãadb kẽer ra ka rɩk buudã goam n ning sʋk ye. B ra gomd-a-la ne noor bala. Tʋʋma b sẽn tʋmd a pʋgẽ me, ra ka tũud zãng ye. Ba ne nin-buiidã wʋsg sẽn ka wʋmd nasaara wã goam la b mi kaorengã, b baas n ka rɩk buudã goam n da ning taoor ye. Ra yaa Radiyo rãmba, la Televizẽo rãmb nins sẽn gomd buudã goamã n, da sõngd nebã tɩ b paamd kibayã. Zu-bʋkã bãmb me lebda poorẽ tɩ bala, b sẽn ka rɩk buudã goam n tolg n ning sʋkã, b ka paamd teelg ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b saagdẽ tɩ b sã n kõt b kibaya ne zamaanã tʋʋm-te-paala, nin-buiidã na n tõogame n tar zamaanã kibay wakat fãa. Mise Rasɩɩd TARWAR sẽn tar bãngr ẽntɛgnetã wɛɛngẽ wã wilgame tɩ kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn tõog n tũ zãmsgã na-kẽndre, n dɩk b Zʋgnall rãmbã n kẽes ẽntɛdnetã pʋgẽ, b na n paama karemdba. B leb n na n paama ligd n tõog n zã b tʋmtʋmdbã. Zãmsgã baosgẽ b kõo taab sɛk tɩ ka la kiuug a tã pʋgẽ, b na n dɩka Zʋgnal rãmbã n kẽes ẽntɛgnetã pʋgẽ. B kosame tɩ kiba-kɩtb roog fãa modg n wa ne neb sõor sẽn karemd a Zʋgnallã tɩ sullã rãmb tõog n sɩng ẽntɛgnetã tʋʋma.

B wilgame tɩ bũmb ning fãa sẽn tõe n wa ne sãang tẽnga pʋga, b na n yalsa bõn-kãnga.

Kibarã yii Sɩɩge.

Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR tɩ rɩgla Tomatã tʋʋm-noor pipi tãn-koemd Bẽnduguso Bobo dɩʋlaso soolmẽ wã. Tãn-koemdã rɩglg poore, tẽngã taoor soab rɩka koɛɛga. Koɛɛga pʋga, a wilgame tɩ tʋʋmdã sẽn sɩngã yaa bũmb sẽn kengd tãrãzisẽo wã pɛlga, ba-yirã taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ. A kẽnga taoor n paas t’a Toma SÃNKAR ra yeelame tɩ b modg n tʋm sẽn wat beoog yĩnga. Rẽnd tʋʋm-noorã b sẽn kõ sor t’a na n sɩnga, a yaa  Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã tʋʋlg bũmbu. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR kell n paasame tɩ tʋʋm noorã pipi tãn-koemd rɩglg b sẽn tɩʋʋsã, yaa kiis a 3 loogr poore, wilgdame tɩ yam yãkrã yaa bũmb sẽn segd ne Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã  raabo. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ b kõ tʋʋmdã sɩda. A  pʋʋsa Burkĩna Faso kamb sẽn be ka la tẽns a taab barka , la a kell n kos-b tɩ b kẽng taoor n dɩk b arzɛkã n kẽes tẽngã sõngr pʋgẽ.

APƐK sẽn ya sull ning sẽn get tʋʋmdã yell taoor soaba, a Karim TARWAR wilgame tɩ yaa Milyaar a nu n la b na n dɩk n kẽes tʋʋmdã pʋga. Tomatã tʋʋm-noor na n tõog n dɩka 100 tɩ tʋm a  pʋgẽ. Neb 5000 me n tõe n  paam tʋʋm tʋʋm-noorã sabaab yĩnga. Obaasẽ reezẽo wã guvɛgneer a Maryama KONATE wilgame tɩ reezẽo wã nin-buiid sũur yaa noogo, la b pẽgda tẽngã taoor dãmb b sẽn yãk yam n lugl Tomatã tʋʋm-noor bãmb soolmẽ wã.

Yaa rẽ t’a kot nin-buiidã fãa tɩ b kɩs Sãnk mone sɩda t’a na n sõngame tɩ Burkĩna Faso yʋʋrã zẽke.

Kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso depite rãmbã rɩka noor tɩ sodaas na n tɩ sõng Nizɛɛr dãmba.

Rasma noor sẽn loogã Burkĩna Faso taoor rãmbã ra rɩka noor n wilg tɩ b na n tʋma sodaas tɩ b tɩ sõng Nizɛɛr rãmba. Yaa no-kãng la depite rãmbã pids yã. Tɩ bala, b fãa zẽka b nus n wilg tɩ b saka noor ning tẽngã taoor rãmb sẽn dɩkã. Miniisr ning sẽn get sodaasã, Kolonell Mazoor Kaasem KULBALI wilgame tɩ sẽn na yɩlẽ tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa zamaana pʋgẽ, yaa tẽnsã sẽn na n gãd taab nusi. Yaa rẽ tɩ tẽngã taoor rãmb yãk yam n na n sõng yaka, tɩ moos yeelame : tɩ f yak roog sã n yõk bugum bɩ f sõng-a ne koom wal bĩisr ta tõog n kiisi. A togsame tɩ wakat sẽn looge, b sĩndame n ges t’a buud maan Libi la Mali yʋʋm 2012 la yʋʋm 2013 soabã. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ no-rɩkrã sɩnga a tʋʋm depite rãmbã sẽn dag n kõ-b sorã tɛk bala. A wilgame tɩ Sedeyao tẽnsã sẽn yãk yam n dat n zab ne Nizɛɛrã, Burkĩna Faso segd n tʋmame, tɩ Sedeyao no-rɩkr a 2 soabã, b sẽn dat n na zab ne Nizɛɛrã, sã n wa na n tõog bɩ Burkĩna Faso kẽ zabrã pʋg n sõng b yakã. Miniisrã ka togsg sodaas sõor b sẽn na n yãk tɩ b kẽng Nizɛɛrã ye. La a togsame tɩ yaa kiis a tãab la b na n tɩ zĩndi. Kiis a tãaba sãn n sa, b tõe n le paasa kiis a tãabo.

Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã sẽn watã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR na n tɩ rɩgla tʋʋm-noor sẽn na n ges Tomatã rɩk n tʋm t’a lebg Tomat koomã tãn-koeemde, Bẽnduguso Bobo dɩʋlaso.

Yaa sẽn tũ ne sull ning b sẽn zĩnig t’a get nin-buiidã kẽes b toog tẽngã yidgr wɛɛngẽ wã, b sẽn boond tɩ Apɛkã, n zoe n sɩng biis wombo. Yaa sigr kiuug rasem 12 yʋʋm 2023 soabã b sẽn sigl-a wã, n ya sabaab tɩ b na n pak  Tomat rɩk n  tʋm t’a lebg Tomat koomã Lozindi.

B sẽn kõ sor tɩ nin-buiidã sɩng lagd-lobrã tɛka, yaa neb 60 000 n zoe n gʋls b yʋy n kẽes b toog a pʋgẽ. B zoe n loba ligd n paam milyaar a 2 la milyão 500 000. Ligd ning b sẽn dat t’a kẽes yaa milyaar 100. La yaa porze rãmb a naas pʋgẽ la b na n dɩk ligdã n kẽese. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa koobã, la Tomat rɩk n tʋm t’a lebg bũmb a to zĩis a yiibu, Bobo ne Tẽnkʋdgo. B rat n gesa koobã ne tɩɩs biis toor-toor koosg zĩiga, la Sãnem tʋʋm noor zĩiga. Yam yãkrã tũuda ne tãrãzisẽo wã rãmb sẽn dɩk noor n dat tɩ tẽngã kamb kẽes b toog ba-yirã taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ. B wilgame tɩ masã, yaa tẽngã kamb n segd n pags b toorẽ tʋʋm-noya. B ka segd n leb n teeg tẽns a taab tɩ b sõng-b ne ligd ye.

Yɩɩ Wao-fugdg kiuug yʋʋm 2023 soabã, la b zĩnig Apɛkã t’a tʋlsem ya tẽngã kamb kẽes b toog n sõng tɩ b zĩinig tʋʋm-noy katɛk wala koobã, gʋʋlgã, la sãnmã tʋʋma. Yaa Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã fãa pʋg la b segd n tʋm tɩ tẽngã yidgi.

Kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2023 tẽngã taoor soab lʋɩɩ taoor tɩ miniisr dãmbã maan b rasem a yopoe fãa sɛkã. Sɛkã pʋgẽ b rɩka noy ministɛɛr dãmb kẽer pʋsẽ, wala Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get Sãnma tʋʋma, la ministɛɛr ning sẽn get Zagsã la tẽn-gãongã zĩigẽ.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get Kʋʋra wã la Sãnmã tʋʋm zĩigẽ minɩisr dãmbã rɩka noor  n na n tek nug tikr ning sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm 2017 soabã, n gomd yaood nins Sãnmã tʋʋm-noy sẽn segd n yao gosneerã. A wilgame tɩ ka Sãnmã zĩigẽ bal la tags rãmba sẽn paasã ye. Tẽn-gãongã, la arzɛgs a taab wala Maganeesã, zũudã, la Wanzũri wã me bee sʋka.

Nug tikr a yiib n soab b sẽn maan ministɛɛr-kãng pʋgẽ, yaa neb nins sẽn tʋmd Sãnmã tʋʋmd tẽn-kɩrensã pʋgẽ wã, miniisrã wilgame tɩ nug tikr n be bãmb nengẽ wã, n kɩtdẽ tɩ gosneer tõe n kẽes a toog n sõng-b ne Sãnmã tũubu, a yɩlgre la a koosgo. Minisr Sɩmo Pɛɛr BUSIM kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ no-rɩkrã na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso kamb nins sẽn be tẽn-gãongã arzɛk tʋʋm pʋgẽ tɩ b tõog n kẽ tʋʋm-noy nins sẽn get tẽn-gãongã arzɛk yɩlgr pʋgẽ.

Sã n ya Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get tẽn-gãongã la zagsã zĩigẽ, gosneer rɩka noy a tãabo.

Pipi yaa sẽn kẽed ne paam sor n tõog n pak tʋʋm noor sẽn get zagsã la tẽn-gãongã pʋɩɩb b sẽn boond tɩ sosete Yimobɩlyɛɛrã. Zĩ-kãnga, Miniisr Mikayilu SIDBE wilgame tɩ tʋʋm-noy nins fãa sẽn be zagsã meeb pʋgẽ wã, b rãmbã sã n dat tɩ gosneer kõ-b sebr tɩ b tõog n tʋme, rẽndame tɩ sẽn baood-a sebrã fãa yao milyão 250 tɩ b kõ-a sebrã.

A yiib soaba, gosneerã lebg n sulg gesa noy nins sẽn be zagsã meeb la tẽn-gãongã kosg pʋgẽ.

B rɩka noore, n na n kɩt tɩ vaeesg reng n maan zĩig ning zagsã meeb la zĩisã pʋɩɩb tʋʋm-noyẽ sẽn dat n maan b tʋʋmdã yĩnga. Zĩ-kãnga, miniisrã wilgame tɩ noorã rɩkr tʋlsem yaa no-koɛɛm ra le wa zĩndi,  la nin-buiidã me na tõog n paam zĩis bɩ zags tɩ sek-ba.

Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 12 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Miniisr ning sẽn get kadensã la yõ-koglgã a Emil ZƐRBO reega sull ning b sẽn boond tɩ muvma sãasã taoor dãmba. A wilgame tɩ kũunã tũuda ne b sullã neb sẽn kõ b nug bũmb tɩ b reeg n paas n zab zabrã. Metr Gi Erve KAM pasaame tɩ kũunã me leb tũuda ne bãmb sullã yãabo. Kibarã yii kadensã la yõ-koglgã ministɛɛr kiba-kɩtb nengẽ

Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd  Yɩbrayɩm TARWAR reega lɛɛbdbã sẽn be raasẽ wã la yaar dãmbẽ wã no-rɛɛsdb tɩ b zĩnd n sõs ne taaba. Sõasgã pʋgẽ, ned kam fãa wilg a zu-loees sẽn beẽ.

A ROAMBA Kirsi Selind pẽga a tʋmd-n-taasã la tẽngã taoor dãmba. A wilgame tɩ yaa b sẽn na n gãd taab nus la b na n tõog n kẽng taoore, ne kaorengã na yɩ neere.  A kell n kosame tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa Burkĩna Faso.

Karen-saamb dãmb a yiib me n paam waoor kũun b sẽn boond tɩ Sevalyedelogdrdepalemakademikã. Ya a Sɩmond SAWADGO, la a Muusa KABOORE.

Miniisr ning sẽn get kaorengã la buudã goam taoor kẽnde, a Ãndere Zozɛf WEDRAOOG wilga Karen-saamb dãmbã ne karen-biisã tɩ ya b tʋʋm-sõngã yĩng n kɩt tɩ tẽngã taoor dãmb rɩk waoor kũunã n taas-ba. A kell n kos-b lame tɩ b kẽng taoor ne tʋʋmdã,  ba ne tẽngã sẽn be zu-loees pʋgẽ wã. B sõasgã poore, karen-saamb dãmbã ne Karen-biisã tɩ sega tẽngã taoor soaba. B sõasgã pʋgẽ,  Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR pẽga karen-saamb dãmba, b sẽn maooda yĩnga. A wilgame tɩ  ba ne yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn be wã, b sɩd kẽes b toogo, n dɩkd bãngrã n taasd kambã, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b wa yɩ tẽngã beoog zãadba. A kell n kosa karen-biisã tɩ b tall sõng taab yam, la b yɩ Burkin-bi sẽn na n nong b tẽngã, la b mao n waoogdẽ b Karen-saamb dãmbã.

Kibarã yii ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kaorengã yell kiba-kɩtb nengẽ

DCRP / MENAPLN

Sa-sik kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, tẽngã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR lʋɩɩ taoor Miniisr dãmbã sɛk taoore. Sɛkã pʋgẽ noy wʋsg la b rɩk tẽngã zãab wɛɛngẽ.

Pipi, ministɛɛr ning sẽn get sodaasã zĩigẽ, gosneer rɩka noor n na n maan nug tikri. Nug tikrã pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ b na n tʋma Burkĩna Faso sodaas Nizɛɛr soolmẽ wã. Sodaasã Miniisri, Kolonel Kaasem KULBALI wilgame tɩ no-rɩkrã, yaa sẽn na  n sõng n zab ne nin-wẽnsã. Tɩ bala, Nizɛɛr zu-loeesã tõe n wa namsa Burkĩna Faso. Yaa rẽ la b yãk yam n na n tʋʋm sodaas tɩ b tɩ sõng-ba, sẽn na  yɩl tɩ tẽns a yiibã fãa paam yõ-koglgo.

Sẽn pʋgde, yaa Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get gosneer tʋmtʋmbã zĩigẽ. Zĩ-kãnga, miniisr dãmbã rɩka noor n na n lebg n ges neb nins sẽn da tʋmd-b kom-bãoonesã zãab zĩigẽ, b wilgame tɩ b ra rɩka noor yʋʋm 1985 soabã, n yãk neb tɩ kẽ kom-bãoonesã zãab pʋgẽ, la b tʋʋmdã wa n paama zu-loeese, tɩ  b bas tʋʋma la b ka paam tɩ b yao-b ye. Miniisr Basolma BAZIYE wilgame tɩ b sõorã taa bãmb 548 n be zu-loɛɛgã pʋgẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ b rɩk Milyaar  a ye la milyão 660 n na n yao-ba.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get koobã la gʋʋlgã zĩigẽ, miniisr Ismayall SOMBIYE, wilgame tɩ b sigla tʋʋm-noore, koobã la gʋʋlgã yĩng tɩ b boond tɩ Ofãnsif agoropastorall tɩ tʋʋmdã na n dika yʋʋm a yiibu, rat n yeel tɩ yʋʋm 2023 soabã, n tɩ tãag yʋʋm 2025, n na n ko kamaana, mui, pomdetɛɛre, la bɩle. Gʋʋlgã zĩigẽ yaa zĩm,  rũmsi, la noose.

Tʋʋm-noorã na n sõnga neb sõor sẽn ta 100 000 paam nug tʋʋmde. Ligd ning b sẽn segd n dɩk n kẽes tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ yaa milyaar 592. Ligd ninga b sẽn datã pʋgẽ, koabg zugu, 46 n zoe n beẽ, rat n wilg tɩ yaa ligd sõor sẽn ta milyaar 317 la b baood n na n paase. La yaa tʋʋm-noy sẽn so b mense, n na n yãag tʋʋmdã sẽn tũud ne na-kẽndr ning b sẽn boond tɩ PPP wã.

Sẽn na n baase na-zakẽ wã, miniisr dãmbã rɩka noor n na n ges tẽngã yidgr yelle. Goosneer no-rɛɛs a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ yam yãkrã, yaa sẽn na sõng nin-buiidã tɩ b tõog n kẽes b toog n sõng tʋʋm-bɛd a tãabo. Pipi yaa sẽn na n lebg n maneg tʋʋm-noy nins sẽn sãama. Sẽn pʋgde, yaa sẽn na sõng tɩ nin-buiidã tɩ b vɩɩmã zĩis yɩ sõma. Sẽn na n baase, yaa sẽn na  sõng tɩ we-n-vɩʋʋgã paam koglgo. Yaa sull ning sẽn be na-zakẽ wã n get porze rãmbã, n na n ges tʋʋmdã.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ.

Sa-sik kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, miniisr ning sẽn get yĩn-wɩsgrã la kom-bɩɩbã zĩniga sull ning sẽn na n siglg wiidã tabr wags-taab kaseng vuk 34 soabã.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 28 sẽn looge, miniisr dãmba tigs pʋgẽ, b ra rɩka noor n wilg tɩ wiidã tabr wags taab kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ Tʋʋrdifaso wã na n tõog n zĩndame. Sẽn na yɩl tɩ wags-taab kasengã tõog n zĩnd zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 26 n tãag sapaolg kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, wa sẽn segde, Miniisr Bubakar SAWADOGO zĩniga sull ning t’a na n ges tʋʋmdã siglgu. Ya a Yiyas Ameede BEREWUDUGU, sull ning sẽn get wiidã tabr taoor soabã la b yãk t’a lʋɩ siglgã taoore. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ yaa sẽn na yɩl n keng sodaasã la neb nins fãa sẽn be zabrã pʋgẽ pelse, la gosneem yãk yam tɩ wags-taabã vuk 34 soabã na n tõog n zĩndi. Tʋʋm paal la b kẽes wags-taabã pʋga. B wilgame tɩ b na n  lebg n gesa nug tikr limor 2015/857/ sẽoog kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2015 soabã sẽn  gomd Tʋʋrdifaso wã. Sẽn leb n paasde, b gʋlsa sebr sẽn na sõng-btɩ b sigl tʋʋmdã, tɩ samd ra wa kẽ a pʋgẽ ye. Miniisrã kosa sullã rãmb tɩ b ges wed-tabdbã la neb nins sẽn yãagd wed-tabdbã yõ-koglg neere.

Miniisr Bubakar SAWADG kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tẽns a taab wed-tabd sula, la tʋʋm-noy nins sẽn yãagd-b Tʋʋrdifaso wã wilgame tɩ b na n maoome tɩ tʋʋmdã tõog n yɩ sõma. Burkĩna Faso wed-tabdbã sull wilgame tɩ bũmbã fãa segla wa segde, sẽn na yɩl tɩ tʋʋmdã tõog n paam pãnga.

Sẽn na n baase, Miniisrã kosa tʋʋmdã sigind-b tɩ b rɩk ligd ning b sẽn yãk tʋʋmdã yĩng n sɩd kẽes a pʋgẽ, t’a yɩ sõma zãnga, tɩ bala,  yaa tẽngã yʋʋr la a zẽkda.

A Lazaar ZABRE, sull ning sẽn get Tʋʋrdifaso wã siglg no-rɛɛs kosa a tʋmd-n-taasã tɩ b sak n kẽes b mense tɩ wiidã tabr wags-taab  vuk 34 soabã yɩ sõma. A kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ b saagdame tɩ wed-tabd nins sẽn na n wa wã tõe n kɩtame tɩ wags-taabã tall rasãnde.

Kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Sa-sik kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR reega Bãnk rãmba, la ligdã tʋʋm-noy sula b sẽn boond tɩ APEBEFB wã rãmba. Yɩ a Dɛkarya WATTARA n lʋɩ sullã taoore.

Sɛkã pʋgẽ tẽngã taoor soab wilgame t’a na n kosa bãnk rãmbã la ligdã tʋʋm-noy taoor dãmb tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda n sõng kom-bɩɩb, la pagb nins sẽn dat n sigl tʋʋm-no-bãoonesã.

Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame tɩ pagbã la kom-bɩɩbã ratame tɩ b yãag-b ne ligdi, tɩ b tõog n pags b tʋʋm-noyã la zu-loees n be. Bala, b sẽn boond tɩ garãnti wã paoong ka nana ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ tẽngã taoor soab kos sullã rãmb tɩ b ges b sẽn tõe n maan toto tɩ gosneer tõog n sõng tɩ b yãag kom-bɩɩbã la pagbã.

Sullã taoor dãmb pẽga tẽngã taoor soab yam yãkre, la b kell n wilg zu-loees nins sẽn be bãmb tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ. Zu-loeesã yaa sẽn kẽed ne ligdã tʋʋm-noy kẽer sẽn ka tõe n paam ligdã, la zu-loees a taab sẽn tũud ne tẽngã nug-gãaga.

 Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, pʋlm-b lame tɩ b na n baoo rabay sẽn na yɩl tɩ zu-loeesã kolg weoogo. A kell n pẽg-b-la b sẽn tʋmd  n sõngd tɩ tẽngã kẽnd taoorã.

APEBƐFB  sullã taoor dãmb wilgamz tɩ b sũur noogo, b sẽn tõog n paam n seg tẽngã taoor soabã. B togqame tɩ b na n yãaga gosneerã tẽngã taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ, la b tʋm tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa tẽngã.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ

Sa-sik kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso sʋn-wʋgdbã sull b sẽn boond tɩ FENATI-BF sega kiba kɩtbã n wilg b sũ-noog ne tẽnga taoor dãmb sẽn yãk yam tɩ sʋndã fuug na n lebg karen-biisã fut lekolsẽ wã. B wilgame t’a kẽngda ne Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã taoore, la a kɩtdẽ tɩ ned kam fãa tõe n bãng a sẽn ya a soaba.

Tigsgã sɩngrẽ Sʋn-wʋgdbã taoor soaba a Polind BAFEOOG wilgame tɩ gosneerã sẽn dɩk noorã, a na n sõnga bãmb tʋʋmdã. A reng n pẽga tẽnga taoor soab ne a permye miniisrã la miniisr ning sẽn get karen-bi-bãoonesã, la buudã goam kaorengã. Sullã rãmb sokda b mens n getẽ kaorengã yikr sẽn kell kiuug la pʋsʋkã, b na n maana n wãn tɩ ka ne rẽ, bɩ futã beẽ tɩ karen-biisã tõe n paame. Sẽn paasde, b na n maana n wãn n paam sʋn-wʋgd sẽn tõe n wʋg tɩ tũ sore, la yɩ sõma, tɩ b tõog n paam tɩ seke?

B kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ b ka mi bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ gosneer kõ sor tɩ lekol fãa tõe n yãk fuug kõbg ning a sẽn dat n kõ a karen-biisã ye. Zĩ-kãngã, sullã rãmb wilgame tɩ b ra zĩnda ne ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kaorengã yell tɩ b wʋm taab n yãk fuugã kõbgo, la a ligdã sẽn segd n zems toto. B ra wʋma taab tɩ fu-pok fãa na n yɩ wakɩr 900, la gosneer sã n sõng-ba, a ye fãa tõe n yɩɩ wakɩr 800.

La wa n yɩɩ lingr tɩ gosneer yiis koɛɛg b tigsgã loogr poore, n wilg tɩ lekoll fãa tõe n yãka fuug a sẽn date. Yaa rẽ tɩ sʋn-wʋgdbã sull wilg tɩ gosneer yam-yãk kãng ka tũud ne b sẽn da zĩnd n yẽs ne taabã ye. Bala sã n ya ne bãmb raabã komind bɩ reezẽo fãa fuug kõbg segd n wẽnega taab wala kaki wã sẽn da yaa toto wã. La sã n na n yɩ lekoll fãa yãk a fuugu, tʋʋmdã na n namsa bãmba. A ligdã me ka na n yɩ a yembr ye. Bala fuug fãa ne a to, welgr n be b sʋka. Yaa rẽ tɩ sullã taoor soaba a Polind BAFEOOG kos tɩ gosneer lebg n gese.

Sʋn-wʋgdbã sull wilgame tɩ b kẽesa b mense, sẽn na  yɩl tɩ tʋʋmdã tõog n tũ wa sẽn segde, tɩ karen-biisã roagdb sũur yɩ noogo.

Tẽegre, gosneer ra wilgame tɩ b ka na n yiis biig karen-doogẽ a sẽn ka paam ligd n da fuugã yĩng ye.

Zɩll KAFAANDO

Sẽoog kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soaba Kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE zẽk a naoor n kẽng Sẽnpetɛrsburgi, tẽng a ye sẽn be Risi tẽngã wĩndg sẽn lʋɩtẽ nug-goabga. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE na n bẽda tigsgã n sɛg Risi tẽngã taoor dãmb kẽere, tɩ b sõs Burkĩna Faso yõ-koglgã la a taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ.

Kibarã yiii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩbtbã nengẽ

Sẽoog kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2023 soabã ANDN sullã maana tik-kaseng Waogdgo,  Meeri wã kom-bɩɩb zakẽ. B goma Buls ne Pʋytẽng sorã gudrõ, b sẽn dat n viig-a  n tɩ yi Sãagẽ Baraasã Diig zugu, tɩ: Zʋgo, Pĩisi, la Yẽeg rãmb ka rat n sakã, la  nin-wẽnsã tʋʋmd sẽn tar yãngr beoog fãa, tɩ VDP rãmbã ne Buls Zãndarmiiri wã taoor rãmb ka wʋmd taab noor a ye, n tõe n naag taab n zab ne bɛ wã. Koe-baasdgã yɩɩ Sãntr noor nebã na wʋm taaba, la b naag n vʋɩɩmde.

Yaa ANDN taoor soabã a Filibɛɛr BEEMBÃMB n lʋɩ sõasgã taoore. Mise BEEMBÃMB wilgame tɩ gosneem rasem yopopoe seg-taabã pʋgẽ, b goma Buls sorã yelle. B goama pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ b zoe n kʋmsa fãa tɩ sa. B paama sorã maaneg ligdi, tɩ pidi, n kell n yãk raar n sɩnge, la gom-bãoones n ket a pʋgẽ. Tɩ bala, Sãagẽ Baraasã koom sẽn ya wʋsgã, a Kʋlwook sorã ka le tõe n dɩk n kẽng Buls ye.

Bãng-mitbã vaeesame n mik tɩ b sã n dat tɩ Baraasã la gudrõ tõoge, rẽnd tɩ b viig gudrõ wã n kẽng Sãagẽ, n tɩ yi Baraasã Diig zugu, n lebg n tũ Sõorẽ, n tɩ yek so-kʋdrã. Boto me: Zʋg ne Pĩisi, la Yẽeg rãmb ka na n paam t’a yi b tẽngẽ wã ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b yeel tɩ b ka na n sak tɩ b viig-a ye. Sẽn na yɩl n wʋm taaba, sigr kiuug rasem 18 ne a rasem 20 b sega miniisrã, la neb nins sẽn ges sorã tʋʋm vaeesgo, n gom Buls sorã yelle. Seg-taabã pʋgẽ, Pĩis ned n wa n dɩk koɛɛga. A koɛɛgã pʋgẽ, a gomamme n paoog pag ning sẽn maan sorã vaeesgo, n wilg t’a ka tõe n dʋʋg a Kʋlwookã ye. A yeelame  tɩ pagã yagda zigi. A sẽn yeelã, miniisrã ne a poorẽ dãmb yikame n dɩk b sɛb n tar loogre.

Yaa rẽ tɩ ANDN sẽn sullã sẽn tʋmd Namendtẽng na yidgã, sullã taoor rãmb yã taab n yeel tɩ rẽnd tɩ b yãk neb tɩ b kẽng n tɩ kos sugri. Mise BEEMBÃMB wilgame tɩ sẽoog kiuug rasem a 2 L’ looge, b pẽnega Bulsnaab n wilg tɩ b na n tɩ kosa sugri. La Bulsnaab sũur yɩɩ noogo, tɩ b ra yet tɩ b na n zẽka b naoor n zĩnd sʋka, la b wa n tʋma Baannaab t’a kẽng b yʋʋr yĩnga. Bãmb ne Baannaab kẽngame, la pagã sũur yɩɩ noogo. A wilgame tɩ b sẽn bool nebã ANDN tik kasengã pʋgẽ wã, yaa sẽn na n wilg-b tɩ b rɩka na-kẽndre, yellã manger wɛɛngẽ. ANDN taoor soabã sẽn taas moorã,  neb wʋsg sakame tɩ b yi ne sorã Sãagẽ, tɩ fãa yaa Namendtẽng paoongo.

A Zistind KAFAAND sẽn da yɩ sullã taoor soab pẽga Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmba, b sẽn dɩk na-kẽnda, n kɩt tɩ sʋndã tʋʋmd na n kẽng taoorã. A wilgame tɩ sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm 2017 soabã n tãag yʋʋm 2023 soabã gosneerã, la sull bɛda taoor dãmb rɩka noya, sʋndã fut wɛɛngẽ. A kell n pẽga ministɛɛr ning sẽn get nus-tʋʋma la a pʋʋs-b barka. A wilgame tɩ bũmbã fãa ka yɩ naana yʋʋm a nu wã pʋgẽ ye. Bala, b sega zu-loees buud toor-toore,  wala lamdã, la sʋndã fut  neb a taab sẽn yit ne tẽns a taab n wat n sãamd Burkĩna Faso lamdã raagã. A togsame t’a kɩtame tɩ sʋn-wogdb wʋsg ka sak n kẽes b mens sullã pʋgẽ ye. A kell n kosa tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b maan b pãng sẽn tõe, n sõng sʋn-wogdbã ne ligd tɩ b paam zãmsg la bãngre, garã losb la sʋndã wʋgb wɛɛngẽ. A kosame tɩ b sagl reezẽo rãmbã pʋsẽ sʋn-wʋgdba tɩ b kẽes b mens sullã pʋgẽ, la b zãag b mens ne lam-yood nins sẽn yit tẽns a taab n watẽ wã rɩk n wʋg futã. Tikrã baoosgẽ sʋn-wʋgdbã sull kaseng teka b taoor dãmba, yaa neb 21 n be b biiru wã. Ya a BAFEOGO Polind la b yãk t’a lʋɩ sullã taoore n na zã-a yʋʋm a nu.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR reega Etalõ ball tãod bãoonesã. Yɩ b sẽn tɩ tão nin-sabls tẽns kamb nins sẽn ka ta yʋʋm 17 wã ball wags taab loogr poore, n lebg n wa wã, la b kẽng n tɩ seg tẽngã taoor soab n wilg b sẽn paam kũun nins wags-taabã pʋgẽ. Etalõ rãmb pʋga tãab n soab zĩigẽ. B paama Wanzurũ medae rãmba. Yaa rẽ tɩ b karen-saambã, la federasẽo wã taoor dãmb tɩ b yãag-b tẽngã taoor soab nengẽ.

Kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR pẽga kambã n wilg tɩ bũmb ning sẽn maanã. A wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo. Bala b paama soor n na n kẽng n tɩ naag ãndũni wã bal tãob wags-taab-kasengã pʋgẽ. Tẽngã taoor soab yeelame tɩ b maana modgre. A wilgame tɩ b sẽn maana, nooga nebã suyã.

A Saaban WATTARA ball tãodba taoor soab pʋʋsa tẽngã taoor soaba, la a wilg tɩ b rɩka kũun nins fãa b sẽn paama n kõ sodaasã la VDP rãmba, Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa yʋʋr yĩnga. Ball tãodba ne b karen-saamb dãmbã tigsa ligd n paam milyão n dɩk n ning tẽngã taoor soab nugẽ tɩ b reeg n sõng tɩ b zab zabrã.

Baryɩma TARWARE ballã karen-saamb wilgame tɩ b sẽn wa n be Alzeri wã, b ra tagsda tẽnga yelle. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ Burkĩna kambã ra tõe n dɩka kupã. Ball tãod sẽn tʋm n yɩɩg a taab wagsgã pʋg yaa Burkĩna biiga. Ball tãodb wʋsg me le paama kũun dãmb wags-taabã pʋgẽ.

Feredrasẽo wã taoor soab a Lazaar BANSE, pʋʋsa tẽngã taoor dãmb barka b sẽn modg n sõng kambã tɩ b tɩ tõog n kẽes b toog wags taabã pʋgẽ wã. A  kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ b sũur yaa noogo, ba ne tẽngã soab sẽn ka waoogã, a sak n deeg kambã. Rẽ yaa bũmb sẽn wilgd t’a kõo sɩd ne yĩn-wisgrã.

Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame tɩ sẽn kẽed ne ɛstaad di 4 wutã meebo n paas ɛstaad nins b sẽn me tẽngã soog-m-meng tig-tẽegr fãa, a na n paama manesgre. A wilgame t’a na n kõo minisr ning sẽn get yĩn-wɩsgrã naoor t’a modg tɩ ball tãodbã tʋʋm kẽn wa sẽn segde.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2016 soabã, nin-wẽnsã yõka logto-kaseng a ye sẽn da be Gibo ne a paga. A zĩnda Gibo yʋʋm 40 n da get nin-buiidã tɩbsg yelle. Yaa yʋʋm a 7 loogr poore la koees yi Farens kiba-kɩtb roog b sẽn boond tɩ AP news n wilg tɩ Dogtɛɛr Elyot paam n yi nin-wẽnsã nugẽ sig-noy kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2023 soabã. A sẽn paam yi wã, a kell n dɩka sor n kul a ba-yir Ostrali.

Yɩɩ  Wao-fugdg kiuug yʋʋm 2016 soabã,  la nin-wẽnsã ra bas a Zoselind Elyot, t’a ra zẽk koɛɛg n wilg t’a ratame tɩ wakat sẽn wate, bɩ b bas a sɩdã t’a leb Gibo. Sigr kiuug rasem a 7 yʋʋm 2019 soabã, a Zoselind Eliyot le zẽka koɛɛg ne silmirendi, n kos neb nins sẽn yõk dogtɛɛr Elyotã, tɩ b bas a sɩdã t’a paam n vʋɩɩmd ne a zaka rãmba.

La yaa yʋʋm a 7 loogr poore la a kosgã paam pidsgu, tɩ  bala, sig-noy kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Ostrali miniisr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã, a Peni WONG  rɩka koɛɛg n wilg t’a ya sũur yaa noogo, la a rɩkda koɛɛg n na n wilg tɩ Dogtɛɛr Elyot b sẽn da yõk t’a be nin-sabls tẽns wĩndg sẽn lʋɩtẽ wã, a paama sor n kul Ostrali a zakã rãmb nengẽ. A zakã rãmb me rɩka koɛɛg n wilg tɩ b pʋʋsda Wẽnde, Ostrali gosneerã la neb nins fãa sẽn kẽes b toog tɩ dogtɛɛr Elyot paam n yi nin-wẽnsã nusẽ wã barka.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso zãdarem dãmbã taoor soab kõo sor tɩ b pak tʋʋm-no-paalg b sẽn boond tɩ BNVAA. Yaa tʋʋm-noor sẽn na n sõngd nebã tɩ b paamd tõkr ne zãdarem dãmbã nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã zugu. Tʋʋm-noorã pipi tʋlsem ya a reegd nebã, n wilgd-ba, la a kõt-b kibay la sagls yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ. A na n yɩɩ sabaab tɩ nebã tõog n paam n kõt zãdarem dãmbã kibay tɩ ka tũ ne b zẽk naoor n kẽng b tʋʋmã zĩigẽ ye. Tʋʋm-no-paallã sẽn dogã, na n gesa yɛl nins sẽn maand nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋga, yaa vaeesg b sẽn boond tɩ IOSINT la open-source. Yaa Burkĩna Faso tʋʋm noy b sẽn boond tɩ KREEZUS la NAANA TECH n na n ges tʋʋmdã yelle. Zãdarem dãmbã taoor soaba Letena Kolonell Evrad SÕMDA wilgame t’a na n kɩtame tɩ zãdarem dãmbã pẽneg nebã n paase. Yaa rẽ t’a kõt nebã tɩ b kẽes b toog n sõng tɩ kibayã tõog n tat zãdarem dãmbã. Ned ning sẽn dat n paam tʋʋm-te-paalã a nugẽ bãngã zugu, a kẽeda sɩt kãngã www.magendarmeriebf.com ka rẽ bɩ a kẽ pɩlaystoorã zugu n ning apilikasẽo kãngã « Ma gendarmerie BF ». A kell n paasame tɩ tʋʋm-noorã, b sẽn zĩnigã, a ka gɩdg tɩ nebã ra le wa zãdarem dãmbã tʋʋmd zĩisẽ ye.

Depite rãmbã taoor soab wilga tẽngã rãmb tɩ b waoongã, yaa sẽn na n wilg b belem ne neb nins sẽn paam su-sãamsã. A kosa neb nins sẽn maan kaalma roagdb tɩ b sigs b suyã, n sak yẽsgo, la b kõ sari wã roog sɩda, tɩ vẽenem na n puka b roagdbã kʋʋb zugu.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, miniisr ning sẽn get gosneer tʋʋm-noyã, a Basolma BAZIYE reega sodaas nins sẽn beeg sodaasã sẽn wa n yi n wilg b sũ-sãamse, n tʋm tɩ ka zems tɩ b rig n bas yʋʋm 2021 soabã paama b nug bũmb n tʋm b no-rɛɛs a Farma Teba t’a reeg n tɩ kɩs tɩ b sõng n zab  zabrã. Miniisr Basolma BAZIYE pẽg-b lame, la a wilg t’a na rɩk b zu-loɛɛgã n taase.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem 12 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, kibay kũun roog b sẽn boond tɩ «  Envirinfos.net » maana a tʋʋmdã kʋɩlens pakre. Yɩɩ Waogdg Sãntr de pɛrɛs Norbɛɛr ZÃONGO. Yaa miniisr ning sẽn get wen-vɩʋʋgã koglgo yɩlgemdã la koomã Doktɛɛr Ogʋstẽ KABOOR n yɩ tʋʋmdã ba-yãkdga. Miniisr ning sẽn get kibayã kũun a  Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG zẽk a naoor n yɩ kaset tɩ zʋgnallã tʋʋm na n sɩng ẽntɛgknetã zugu.

Yɩɩ yʋʋm 2010 soabã, la « Envirinfos » zʋgnallã pak a kʋɩlense. La yaa sɛb zut la b ra gʋlsd-a t’a yit kiuug a tãab-tãabo. B ra yiisd-a lame b pʋɩt Karen-biisã zaalem karen-dotẽ wã, ne sula nins sẽn so b mensã, la tʋʋm-noy kẽer pʋsẽ.  Sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm 2010 soabã n tãag yʋʋm 2023 yaa zʋgnall rãmb 20 000 la b yiis yã.  A Lazaar DULKUM Zʋgnallã taoor soab wilgame tɩ bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b ning-a ẽntɛgnetã zugã, yaa wakatã sẽn tek tɩ nebã fãa lebg n kẽ nasaarã nug-tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋsã n wa ne rẽ.

Miniisr Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ biig sã n dog zak pʋga, yaa sũ-noog ne zaka rãmba. Yaa rẽ t’a wilg t’a sũur noomame. Bala, a gomda wen-vɩʋʋgã yell nasaara nug-tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋgẽ tɩ neb wʋsg tõe n paam n karem. Miniisrã kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b maan b sẽn tõe fãa n kẽedẽ ẽntɛgnetã pʋg n karemd kibay nins « envirinfos » sẽn yiisdã, t’a na n sõng-b lame tɩ b tõog n kogl wen-vɩʋʋgã.

Tʋʋmdã ba-yãkdg a Ogʋstẽ KABOOR wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso yaa war tẽnga. Rẽ n so tɩ wen-vɩʋʋgã koglg segd n yɩ tɩlae ne nebã fãa. « Envirinfos » sẽn kẽes-a nasaara nug-tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋgã, t’a leb n tar sags buud toor-toor sẽn sagendã, a na n sõnga nebã tɩ b kẽes b toog wen-vɩʋʋgã koglg pʋgẽ. Zʋgnallã b pʋɩ-a-la sags toor-toore yaa: koomã, yɩlgemdã, tɩɩsã zãabo, koobã, la tʋʋm buud toor-toor sẽn tõe n maan t’a kogend wen-vʋɩʋʋgã, la no-rɩkdɩs nins sẽn be wen-vɩʋʋgã koglg pʋgẽ. B tõe n paama bãmb fãa « Envirinfos.net » pʋga.

Kell n yɩɩ wakat Zʋgnallã taoor soab sẽn bẽde, n dɩk kaset sɛb n kõ neb sẽn tʋm Zʋgnallã pʋga, a sɩngrã wakat n tãag rũndã.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, a Nana AKUFO ADDO siga Burkĩna Faso. A sẽn wa n sigda, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR n seg-a-la a sɩlg yiri. B sẽn pʋʋs taabã loogr poore tẽns a yiibã taoor dãmb sõsa ne taaba. Sõasgã pʋgẽ b goma zu-loees nins sẽn be nin-sabls tẽns wĩndg sẽn lʋɩtẽ wã babgã. B sẽn gom n yɩɩd fãa yaa yõ-koglg kaalmã, la b tẽnsã neb vʋɩɩm yelle.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem a 9 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Sɩnd no-rɛɛsã sẽn be Burkĩna Faso wã rɩka vaeesg teed n taas miniisr ning sẽn get kadensã la yõ-koglgã, Kolonell Bukare ZŨNGRÃAN t’a taas tẽngã taoor dãmba. Teedã b sẽn paama, yaa nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paala b sẽn boond tɩ ( BCLCC). B na n dɩk-a lame n ning sull ning sẽn get wẽgbã la zãmb taabã, b sẽn maand masĩn-dãmbã zutu, a taoor soab nugẽ t’a tall n tʋm ne. Teedã lidg taa milyão 84. B leb n drɩka motɛy b sẽn boond tɩ Aloba rãmbã bãmb 28 n kõ ministɛɛrã. Motɛyã me ligd yika milyão 18.

Sɩnd no-rɛɛs a Lu San  wilgame tɩ Sɩnd na n kell n zĩnda Burkĩna Faso taoor rãmbã poorẽ n sõng-b tɩ b tõog n zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã, tɩ b tõog n tʋm tɩ b tẽngã kẽng taoore. A wilgame tɩ kũun ning b sẽn dɩk n kɩs kadensã la yõ-koglgã ministɛɛrã, a na n sõng-b lame tɩ b zab ne bi-beelmã la nin-wẽnsã.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2023 sẽn watã, Burkĩna Faso ne Sɩnd na n maneg n sigla b zoodã, la b maan a yʋʋm a 5 tẽegre. Rẽ tɩ Sɩnd no-rɛɛsã wilg tɩ b na n dɩka na-kẽnd paala. Na-kẽnd-paala pʋga, b na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso a taoor kẽndã wɛɛngẽ. A pasaame tɩ tẽnsa a yiibã nadg pãng na n kɩtame tɩ b zoodã tõog n wom biisi. Kolonell Bukare ZŨNGRÃAN pʋʋsa Sɩnd dãmba, la a wilg tɩ teedã b sẽn paama  na n paasa b pãnga. A nan sõnga neb nins sẽn tʋmd yõ-koglgã wɛɛngẽ tɩ b tõog n tʋme. Yaa rẽ t’a rɩk koɛɛg gosneerã yʋʋr yĩnga  n pʋʋs barka. A kell n wilgame tɩ b na n zãa kũunã neere.

Miniisr Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG kosa neb nins sẽn na n bal  tʋʋmdã tɩ b mao n tʋm sõma, tɩ balbã, tũ wala noor nins b sẽn gãneg kibayã kũun wɛɛngẽ wã. Tẽegre yɩɩ yʋʋm 1997 soabã, la b sigl galyã wã, tɩ kiba-kɩtbã wagsd taaba. Wags-taabã tʋlsem yaa na keng kiba-kɩtb buud toor-toor raoodo tɩ b tõog n kẽng taoor ne b tʋʋmdã, n wa tõog n paam kiba-kɩtb sẽn tar bãng-minim b tʋʋmdã pʋga.

Burkĩna Faso rɩka rasema a yopoe n bool rog-n-mik reem-rɛɛmdba, la kʋdemd-teed buud toor-toor rãmb tɩ b seg taab n maab wags-taaba. Neb nins sẽn zĩnd tigrã pʋg wilgame t’a yɩɩ sõma.

Miniisr ning sẽn get kiba-kɩtbã, kʋdemdã, la gilg-n-ges yel-soalmã a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilgame t’a sẽn yã bũmb nins pʋgẽ wã, a kõo sɩd tɩ kʋdemdã yaa bũmb sẽn tõe n sõng nebã tɩ b bãng b sẽn ya b rãmba.  A na n sõngda nebã tɩ b kell n gãd b burkĩndã. Miniisrã kosame tɩ buud fãa kell n gãd a rog-n-miki, t’a tõe n sõng-b lame tɩ b zab ne nin-wẽnsã.

Sull ning sẽn ges tʋʋmdã siglg seb-gʋnd a Kiristɛnd Maari SÃNU wilgame tɩ ESƐNSE wã naoor 20 soabã, yɩɩ sõma wala, bãmb sẽn da ratã. A kɩtame tɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã leb n kẽng  taoor n paase. A leb n sõngame tɩ nebã na n kẽes a b toogo. A wilgame tɩ wags-taabã pʋgẽ, yɩɩ neb 600 la zak n wa ne b kʋdemdã teed-buud toor toore, la b rog-n-mik n maan wagsgã. Neb sẽn zẽk b naoor n tɩ gilg n ges taa neb 30 000.

Tig a taabã sẽn sigla wagsgã buud toor-toor bãmb b nu. Yɩɩ rog-n-mik yĩn-wɩsgre, rog-n-mik rɩɩb sɛglgo,  reem buud toor-toore, la te-naandse, la sẽn kẽ-b wagsgã tall n wags-taaba.

Eɛnsɛnse wã sẽn pag a kʋɩlens b kõo neb nins sẽn lʋɩ b taabã taoor kũuni. Rog-nik reemã zĩigẽ, yɩɩ reem sull yʋʋr b sẽn boond tɩ turup Kãtigi n lʋɩ taoore. B taoor soabã a Yakuba KULBALI wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, a sẽn paam n lʋɩ a taabã taoorã. A wilgame tɩ yʋʋm 2016 sẽn loogã, a naaga wagsgã pʋgẽ. Yʋʋm-kãnga, a pʋg tãab n soab zĩigẽ. Yʋʋm 2018 soabã, yɩɩ paame. Rõanda soabã me leb n yaa yẽ n paame. Reemã zĩigẽ neb nins sẽn lʋɩ b taabã taoorã rãmb no-rɛɛs wilgame tɩ kũunã b sẽn paama kenga b pelse tɩ b na n kẽng taoor ne tʋʋmdã.

Yaa gossneema taoor soaba, Apolineer KELEM n lʋɩ taoor tɩ b pag tigrã kʋɩlense. A pagbã wakate, gosneemã taoor soab wẽe Balafõ wã naoor a yoobe, n wilgd tɩ ESƐNSE naoor 20 soabã paga a kʋɩlense. B kõo taab sɛk a naoor 21 soabã sẽn watã.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kolonell Mazoor Kaasem KULBALI miniisr ning sẽn get sodaasã n lʋɩ taoore, tɩ b seg nin-zaalsã lagem-n-taar sula, la pa sak kɛgr sula, n paas politikã taoor dãmba. Bb sɛka pʋgẽ, b togsa tẽngã nug-gãag sẽn ya a soaba.

B sẽn dɩk tẽngã nug-gãag n wilg loogr poore, miniisr ning sẽn get sodaasã wilga nin-zaalsã sula la politikã taoor dãmb tɩ ãnduni wã tẽns fãa wẽnega b kãar n tees Burkĩna Faso.

Burkĩna Faso zabda zabrã ne a yãoog pãnga. Sõngrã sẽn yit kɛɛngã ka waoog ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ Burkĩna rãmb kot sõngre,  zab-teed wɛɛngẽ sẽn na yɩl n tõog n zab zabrã. Burkĩna ka rat tɩ sodaas  yi kɛɛng n wa sõng n zab zabrã ye. Kolonell Kaasem KULBALI togsa a sũ-noog ne Burkĩna Faso kambã sẽn sak n kẽes b toog n na n zab n fãag b ba-yirã. A wilgame tɩ tẽŋgã taoor soab ra rata neb 50 000 tɩ b sõng sodaasã n zab n fãag tẽngã. La neb sẽn sak n gʋls yaa 90 000. Winiisrã wilgame tɩ tẽngã sã n dat n yõk bugum, ned kam fãa segd n kẽes a toog tɩ b tõog n kiis bugmã.  Bala, zu-loees nins sẽn be wã, a ka naamã rãmb zu-loeeg ye. A yaa nebã fãa zu-loɛɛga.

Sodaasã miniisr togsame tɩ wakat kẽere,  Sɩls n pɩʋʋgd Burkĩna Faso soolmẽ wã. B pɩʋʋgrã pa tũud sor wal noor sẽn gãneg ye. A wilgame tɩ b yẽsda ne b rãmba. Naoor wʋsgo,  b wilgd-b-la kaset rãmb sẽn ya vẽenega. La b sʋka, kẽer bõosda sugri. Sẽn kẽed ne b sẽn wilg tɩ Risi sodaas sull b sẽn boond tɩ Wagneerã bee Burkĩna Faso wã, ka sɩd ye. Burkĩna Faso tik a nebã sẽn kõt ligd ningã, la lẽmpo rãmbã daad zab -teedã. Miinisrã leb n wilgame tɩ ba Burkĩna Faso rãmb paam zab-teed wʋsgo, rẽndame tɩ b kell n puki b nin ne bɛ wã. Kolonell KULBALI leb n pasaame tɩ wakat sẽn wate, b na n paama zab-teed sẽn tar pãng n paase. Miniisrã kosa nebã tɩ ned kam fãa  modg n kõt kibaya, tɩ rẽ sõngdame tɩ b tõog bɛ wã. A wilgame tɩ nin-wẽnsã toeema b zabrã na-kẽndr a taaba. B rɩkda mobila n ning bõn-pusdum dãmb pʋgẽ. Rẽ fãa yaa bũmb nebã sẽn segd n bãnge, la b puk b nin n vaees mobila wã. Sig-noy kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, SEYƐSE paamame tɩ Kabine « Arno e asosiye » kõ-b tʋʋm-noy zãab na-kẽndre, b sẽn boond tɩ RSE, la Burkĩna Faso sẽn be nu-gãag ning pʋgẽ wã, kiba-kɩtbã sẽn segd n zã b mens toto, zãmsg n kõ kũun rot taoor dãmba.

Sẽn na yɩl n sõng kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb tɩ b tõog n zã b tʋʋm-noyã la b tʋmdtʋmdbã wa sẽn segde, SEYƐSE rãmb paama zãmsg n kõ kiba-kɩtbã. Zãmsgã yaa sẽn na sõng-b tɩ b tõog n paam bãngr la minim sẽn kẽed ne b tʋʋm-noyã zãab wɛɛngẽ.

 SEYƐSE taoor soabã a Abdulaziz BAAMOOG wilgame tɩ yaa zu-loees nins sẽn be Burkĩna Faso wã, la na yã tɩɩm yĩnga, la b sigl zãmsgã, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ kiba-kɩtbã taoor dãmb tõog n zã b tʋʋm-noyã wa sẽn segde. Bala bãmb sã n ka tõog tɩ b tʋʋm-noyã zãab rɩk sore, a na n kɩlla zĩis kẽere. Zãmsgã pʋgẽ kiba-kɩtbã  paama rabay sẽn tõe n sõng-b tɩ b tõog n gãneg b goama la b gʋlsmã t’a tũ sore, wala sẽn segde.

Zãmsgã zu-raoogo, yɩɩ bãng mit-b sull b sẽn boond tɩ « Arno e asosiye » n dɩk bãngrã n taas kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmba. Karen-saam-kasengã wilg-b-la na-kẽnda nins b sẽn tõe n dɩk n tʋm tɩ b tʋmtʋmdbã sũur yɩ  noogo. B leb n wilga kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb b sẽn tõe n maan bũmb nins n sõng neb a taabã.

Zãms-kãng loogr poore,  yaa sẽn yit-b n baood kibayã n wat n yiisdẽ wãn bãmb mensã sẽn segd n zãb b mens toto, Burkĩna Faso sẽn be yõ-koglg kaalmã pʋgẽ wã, a kibay kɩsg sẽn segd n yɩ a soaba. Karen-saambã togsame tɩ kiba-kɩt ka segd n paam kibare, n dɩk-a n yɩ tao-tao pʋɩ ye.

 Kiba-kɩt sã n paam kibare, a segdame n maag a meng n paam vẽenem tɩ seke,  n yaool n yiis-a. Kiba-kɩtbã sã n tõog n tũ rẽ, a na n sõngd-b lame tɩ b ra wa kẽ zu-loees pʋgẽ, la ba kẽes tẽngã zu-loɛɛg pʋg n paas ye. A wilgame tɩ gosneer segd n maana a pãng sẽn tõe n yiisd kibayã tɩ tat nebã, tɩ b fãa paamd tẽngã kibay. Rẽ fãa tõe n sõngame tɩ b zab ne zir-n-be-kibayã sẽn mi n yitã.

Zãmsgã sẽn wa n kolg weoogo, kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn paam-b zãmsgã yãk a Salif SÃAF t’a rɩk koɛɛg b fãa yʋʋr yĩnga. A koeesã pʋgẽ, a pẽga SEYƐSE taoor rãmbã, la kabine “Arno e asosiye” tʋʋm-noorã rãmba. A wilgame tɩ bãngr ning b sẽn kõ-bã yaa bũmb sẽn na n sõng b tʋʋm-noyã taoor dãmb tɩ b sigl sõma,  n tʋm tɩ b tʋʋmdã kẽng taoore. A kosa SEYƐSE rãmb tɩ modg n gom ne tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b ges tɩ kiba-kɩtbã la neb nins fãa sẽn tʋmd kibayã kũun pʋgẽ paam koglgo.

Neb nins fãa sẽn zĩnd zãmsgã pʋg paama kaset sebr sẽn wilgd tɩ b paama zãmsgo. Tʋʋmdã baoosgã SEYƐSE taoor soabã, a Abdulaziz BAAMOOG pʋʋsa neb nins sẽn sak n zĩnd n kelg zãmsgã la a kos tɩ b rɩk bãngr ning b sẽn paama n ning na-kẽndr zugu, t’a yaa bũmb sẽn na n naf-ba. A wilgame tɩ zãmsgã ka sa ye. B leb n sigla zãmsg a to n na n kõ kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb tɩ b bɩɩs b bãngr n paase. Tʋʋmdã baasa ne foto yõkre. Rẽ poore, b kõo taab sɛk rasem 14 sẽn wate.

Pẽngdwẽnde Zinaaba la a Zɩll KAFAANDO

Pengdouendé ZINAABA et Jules KAFANDO

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR tɩ sõsa ne sodaas nins sẽn be b Kã Wenzẽ KULBALI Bobo Dɩʋlaso. Tẽngã taoor soab kell n sega Opeerasẽo Kapidgã taoor dãmbã, la sodaas sull ning sẽn get reezẽo de Wɛstã yõ-koglgo. A kell n kẽngame n tɩ  keng sodaasã sẽn kẽes b toog n zabd n fãagd tẽngã pelse, la a ges b tʋʋma sẽn kẽnd toto. A koeesã pʋgẽ a wilgame tɩ segdame tɩ b tõog n bãng bũmb nins sẽn maand zab-laagã zugu. Rasem sẽn looge tẽnga,̃ taoor dãmb rɩka na-kẽnd-paall sodaar wɛɛngẽ sẽn na paam n tõog n toeem zabrã neng a to.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, kʋdemdã la rog-n-mikã tik-kaseng sẽn na n zĩnd Bobo dɩʋulaso wã tigrã sigindb segã kiba-kɩtbã n wilg tʋʋmdã soglg sẽn be nug ninga.

ESƐNSE wã sigind modga pãng tɛka,  sẽn na  yɩl tɩ bũmb ba a ye ra paoog ye. Tigrã pakr ket a rasem a tãab yĩnga, sullã rãmb sega kiba-kɩtbã n wilg b siglgã sẽn be zĩig ninga. A Fidɛl Aymaar TAMINI togsa kiba-kɩtbã, tɩ siglgã kẽna wa b sẽn da ratã. Bũmba fãa segl n saame, lebga tigrã raar la b gũuda.

Rõanda,  yaa reem-dɛɛdb 1147.  Wandã yaa 600, la  ya b  sẽn boond tɩ paraadã la b maane. Sull ning sẽn get tigrã siglg taoor soab togsame tɩ yaa neb 600 000, n kẽes b toog tigrã pʋgẽ, la rabeem kae ye. Tɩ bala, b soglame tɩ pidi. Sibrã sẽn loogã b sega ne sula bãoones nins sẽn get tigrã siglg yellã. Miniisr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã zĩnda b seg-taabã pʋga. Sull fãa taoor soab wilga a sẽn sigl a tʋʋm toto. A wilgame tɩ siglg buud fãa bũmb tõe n wa keosame, la soaglã sẽn ta zĩig ningã b tar tẽeb tɩ na zemse. A Fidɛl TAMINI vẽegda nebã tɩ  rõanda yaa ESƐNSE wã naoor 20 soabã. Bũmb wʋsg la b paas tigrã pʋga sẽn na yɩl tɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã paam zɩɩr n paase. Burkĩna kamb sẽn be Kodenvoaar na n waame, n wa kẽes b mens wags-taabã pʋgẽ. Sẽn paasde b manega reem-dɛɛmdbã, la neb nins sẽn na bal tʋʋmdã n paasɛ, tɩ b na n ges b sõasgã, la  gãasã zĩis tɩ yɩ sõma. Rõanda, reem-rɛɛm ba a ye ka na n gãand lekoallẽ ye, b manega zĩis n na n deeg-ba. Gĩne la b yãk tɩ b na n lʋɩ ESƐNSE wã naoor 20 soabã taoore. Sull ning sẽn ges tigrã siglg kẽnga Gĩni Konakiri tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 14 sẽn loogã, n tɩ seg tẽngã taoor dãmba. Seg-taabã poore, Gĩne rãmb wilgame tɩ b na n zĩnda tigrã pʋga ne b reem-rɛɛmd sull b sẽn boond tɩ Orkɛstr Bembeya.

Kibarã yii Faso.net

Burkĩna Faso rãmb sigla bogb n na n zab ne weooga bãaga

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Miniisr Robɛɛr KARGUG sẽn get  laafɩ wã yellã, tɩ lʋɩɩ taoor tɩ b maan daar ning b sẽn yãk n zabd ne weoogã bãagã.

Sẽn na n yɩl n zab ne weoogã bãagã, Burkĩna Faso rãmb yãka tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋmd fãa tɩ ya daar b sẽn yãk n zabd ne weoogã bãaga. Gom-zug b sẽn yãk rõanda yʋʋmdã yaa « wakat taame tɩ weoogã bãag ka le segd n zĩnd ye: d kẽes-d toogo, d kẽng taoor ne zabrã, la d rɩk na-kẽndre »

 Miniisr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã wilgame tɩ daarã b sẽn yãkã yaa sẽn na n zĩndɩ n maan, gɛɛla b sẽn zabd ne weoogã bãaga. A leb n yaa wakat b sẽn segd n kẽng taoor ne tʋʋm nins b sẽn tõe n tʋm tɩ weoogã bãag kolg weoogo.

Miniisrã togsame tɩ logtog-yiyã logtoɛɛmbã sẽn segd bãad rãmbã, b koabg pʋga, 38 yaa weoogã bãag bẽedba. Koabg zugu neb 15 n maand kaalem weoogã bãag sabaabo.

Yʋʋm 2021 soabã,  Burkĩna Faso, neb milyão 12 n bẽ weoogã bãaga. B sʋkã neb 4 000 n maan kaalem. La ka segd ye. Woto fãa segd n saame. Yʋʋm 2015 soabã pʋgẽ, neb 1000 sʋka, neb 451 n da bẽed weoogã bãaga. Yʋʋm 2021 soabã, b mikame tɩ neb 1000 sʋka, neb 569  n bẽed bãagã. Rẽ wilgdame t’a ka lebd poorẽ ye.  A sẽn zabd neb rãmb n yɩɩd yaa kamb nins sẽn ka ta yʋʋm a nu wã, la pagb nins sẽn tar pʋsã.

Miniisr Robɛɛr KARGUG kẽnga taoor n togs tɩ weoogã bãag segd n saa zãng ka ne yʋʋm 2030 soabã, la rẽndame tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda wʋsgo. Segdame tɩ nebã kell n gãe fu-rotã b sẽn boond tɩ  MILDA  pʋse, la b kẽng taoor ne vaeesg ning b sẽn maand sẽn na yɩl n paam weoogã bãag bokre.

A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ ka ne ƴʋʋm 2024 soabã, Burkĩna Faso na n sɩnga bogb ning sẽn zabd ne weoogã bãagã. Yaa neb milyão la b na n deng n boke, la  yaa ligd sõor sẽn ta milyaar la gosneerã rɩk n kẽes a pʋgẽ.

Sẽn kẽed ne zab ne weoogã bãag pʋgẽ, Burkĩna Faso rãmb paama yãagr b tʋmd-n-taas kẽer nengẽ. A Sayidu kulbali ãnduni sull ning sẽn get laafɩ wã yell b sẽn boond tɩ OWƐMƐS no-rɛɛs sẽn be Burkĩna Faso, wilgame tɩ tẽngã sẽn vʋɩ yõ-koglgã kaalem pʋgẽ wã,  kɩtame tɩ neb wʋsg yik n bas b zagse, la b na n deng n sɩngã bãmb bogbo. A togame tɩ yaa tʋʋm-te-paal b sẽn boond tɩ ( RTSS la R21) la b na n tall n bog-ba, la b kõ-b-la fu-ro-yũnugdsã.

Yaa Lekoll b sẽn boond tɩ Patris LUMUMBA sẽn be Waogdg Arõdiisma a 6 pʋgẽ la b maan daar ning b sẽn yãk n zabd ne weoogã bãagã. Yɩɩ yʋʋm 2007 soabã, la b rɩk noor n yãk tʋʋl-nigf kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋmd fãa tɩ ya daar b sẽn zabd ne weoogã bãaga.

Kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, a Oliviya ROAMBA Burkĩna Faso ne zamaan-zẽns zoodã Miniisr reega Yinyão Eropeyɛnd no-rɛɛs a Wolfram WETER  tɩ b sõse.
