Sẽn paasde Yinyão Eropeyɛnd rãmb  na n kẽnga taoor ne b tʋmd-n-taar ning sẽn be bãmb ne Burkĩna Faso sʋkã. B na n gãnega porze b sẽn boond tɩ « Burkĩna vɛy». Porze wã na n sõnga nin-zaals lagem-n-taarã sull a politikã gesg pʋgẽ.

Miniisr Oliviya ROAMBA pʋʋs-b-la barka, la a wilg tɩ Burkĩna ne Yinyão Eropɛnd zoodã sɩngr kaoosame.

Miniisrã leoka neb nins sẽn gomd tɩ Burkĩna Faso ka le waoogd ninsaal yalẽ wã wa sẽn segdã, a wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso rɩka ninsaal yalẽ wã waoogr n ning taoore. B tʋmd wakat fãa n dat t’a paam pãng n paase.

Kibarã yii ministɛɛr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã yell kiba-kɩtb nengẽ

Source : MAECR-BE

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR ne a miniisr dãmbã zĩnda ne taab n maan b rasma yopoe-poe sɛkã. Sɛkã poore, a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO, kiba-kɩtbã, la kʋdemdã miniisri, n leb n ya gossneer no-rɛɛsã wilga noy-nins b sẽn dɩk seg-taabã pʋgẽ.

Pipi a wilgame tɩ ministɛɛr ning sẽn get gosneem tʋmtʋmdbã zĩigẽ, b rɩka noor tɩ rõandã wags-taab n bao gosneem tʋʋma pʋgẽ, neb 7218, la b na n dɩke. Neb 5283 na n maana wagsg ning b sẽn boond tɩ kõnkʋʋr dɩrɛktã. Zĩĩs ning b sẽn dat tɩ nebã sak n kẽes b toog wʋsg yaa koobã, nasaarã nus tʋʋm-te-paalã, la laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ. Ligd b sẽn na n dɩk n kẽes wags-taabã pʋga, yaa milyaar 22.

Na-kẽnd-paal n kẽ tʋʋmdã pʋga, tɩ bala, sẽn sɩng ne rõandã, sẽn maan-a wagsgã n paam sor n na n kẽ gosneem tʋʋm-noyã pʋga, a tʋʋmdã zãmsg yaa  kiis a tãabo, la zãmsgã yaa sẽn kẽed ne a na tõog n bãng goosneerã na-kẽnda kẽere. B na n paama sodaar zãmsgo. Na-kẽnd-kãng yaa  tẽngã nug-gãag sẽn ya a soabã, la b paas rẽ.

Sẽn pʋgde, Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get arzɛkã zĩigẽ, b rɩka noor n na n yãkd ligd teed kẽer nebã sẽn daad wʋsgã zugu. Rẽ fãa yaa sẽn na n sõng n zab zabrã. Miniisr Abubakaar NAKANABO, wilgame tɩ no-rɩkrã na n sõngame tɩ nebã bãng ligd ning b sẽn yãkd sɩgaarã, la nag teedã zug võore. Ministɛɛr kãng pʋgẽ me b le rɩka noor n kɩt tɩ Sãntr ning sẽn da get tẽn-kɩrmsã pʋsẽ gʋʋlgã, lebg gosneem tʋʋm-noore. Miniisr ning sẽn get gʋʋlgã wilgame tɩ no-rɩkrã yaa sẽn na sõng tʋʋm-noorã t’a soog a menga, n tʋm t’a tʋʋma kẽng taoore.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kʋʋra wã, la sãnmã tʋʋm zĩigẽ, gosneer na n lebg n sulgame n ges nug-tikr ning sẽn gomd sãnmã tʋʋm Burkĩna Faso wã, n paam n lebg sigl na-kẽnd paala. Minisr Sɩmo Pɛɛr  BUSIM wilgame tɩ tɩ b na n teka nug-tikr no-rɩkdi 26 ne a 30 soabã. Rẽ na n sõngame tɩ b paam yõod ning b sẽn dɩkd n kẽesd tẽn-kɩrensã sõngr pʋgẽ, n tõog n sõng n zab zabrã.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã zĩigẽ , goosneer rɩka noor n na n ges kãnsɛɛrã bãag tɩbsg Burkĩna Faso. Miniisr Robɛɛr Lusẽ Zã Kolood KARGUUG wilgame tɩ neb nins sẽn bẽed kãsɛɛrã, b tõe n pʋɩ-b-la vuk a tã. Pipi, yaa bãad rãmb nins sẽn tar b tõog n maan Asɩrãasã. Bãmb rãmbã yaa Asɩrãasã n tɩbsd-ba. A yiib n soaba, yaa pagbã kãsɛɛr dãmba, la kamb nins sẽn pa ta yʋʋm 15 wã n bẽed kãsɛɛrã. Sẽn paasde, yaa bãad rãmb nins sẽn ka tar b tõogã. Bãmb nengẽ yaa gosneer n gete. Sẽn na n baase, yaa bãad rãmb nins goosneer sẽn yaood b tɩbsgã koabg zug 70 wã.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Moognaab boola kadensã la yõ-koglgã Miniisri, Kolonell Bukare ZŨNGRÃAN Pãngẽ, n kɩs kũun tɩ b reeg n sõng n zab zabrã.

Koeesã rɩkr wakate,  Wiidnaab a Kɩɩb wilgame tɩ yaa tẽngã taoor soab sẽn kos nin-buiidã tɩ b kẽes b toog n sõng tɩ zab zabrã, la Moognaab yãk yam ne b zakã rãmb n kõ milyão a yopoe, mui kɩlo 25 wã yolg 200, kɩlo 50  yolg 22. Kaamaanã kɩlo 50 wã yolg 30.  Kazʋyã ne baningã kɩlo 50 wã yolg pisi-pisi, la sɩkr kartõ 10. B wilgame tɩ yaa Waogdg rĩungã kom-pugli la a kom-dibli n kẽes b toogo, tɩ b sõng tɩ b zab zabrã.

B togsame tɩ Woagdg rĩungã ne Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã sũur yaa noog ne tẽngã taoor dãmba. La b  kotame tɩ b mao n tʋm tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa.Wiidnaab kell n kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b maan b pãng sẽn tõe n sõng tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b zab zabrã.

Miniisr Bukare ZŨNGRÃAN wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo. Bala,  Moognaab kũunã wilgdame tɩ b tẽngã sẽn ka gãe bãanã ya b fãa zu-loɛɛga. Miniisrã kosame tɩ neb a taabã me kẽes b toog n sõng tɩ b tõog zabrã.

Tẽegre, sẽoog kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã sẽn loogã, Moognaab a Bãoog ra zoe n kõo neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnsã kũuni, la b kos yaab rãmba, tɩ b sõng-b tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa Burkĩna Faso.

Kibarã yɩɩ ministɛɛr ning sẽn get yõ-koglgã yell kiba-kɩtbẽ

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR reega Burkĩna politikã sull bɛda a naasã sẽn kẽes b mens tãrãzisẽo wã no-tũds gʋlsg pʋgẽ wã taoor dãmba. Yaa pagtɩ politik nins sẽn da be naamẽ wã, pagtɩ nins sẽn da ya-b naam kɩɩsdbã, la pagtɩ nins sẽn pa be ne naamã la naam kɩɩsdbã. Yaa SEDEPE wã taoor soab a Edi KÕMBEOOGO, n yɩ politikã rãmb no-rɛɛsa. A wilgame t’a wʋmda tẽngã taoor soab sẽn gomd goam nins yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ wã. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ b wa n na n wilg b belem ne-a, tɩ bala b miime tɩ tʋʋmd ning a sẽn tʋmdã ka naana ye. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ politikã rãmb raab ya b lebg n tõog n deeg tẽngã babs nins sẽn be nin-wẽnsã nugẽ wã, tɩ neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnsã tõog n lebe, tɩ tʋʋm-noyã me tõog n lebg n pake, tɩ nebã paam rɩɩbo. Politikã taoor dãmb no-rɛɛs wilgame tɩ tẽngã taoor soab togs-b lame tɩ tẽnga sɩd bee toog pʋgẽ, la sodaasã sẽn tʋmd tʋʋm nins rasma noorã saagr bee tɩ zabrã rabda a saab zĩigẽ. A pasaame tɩ yaa rẽ fãa n kɩt tɩ bãmb wa wilg b sũur belem ne tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soaba.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 4 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Tãrãzisẽo wã depite rãmb maana tigs-kaseng b sẽn boond ne farend tɩ Sẽas pelenyɛɛrã. Yaa depite rãmbã taoor soaba a Wʋsmaan BUGMA la Ggoosneerã miniisr dãmb kẽer n zĩnd tɩ b maan tigsgã.

Sẽn na yɩl n paam zab-teed n zab ne nin-wẽnsã, miniisr dãmbã rɩka noor n na n da zab-teed n paas sodaasã tʋʋmd pãnga. Yaa rẽ tɩ Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmb maan nug tikr ne Tirki tʋʋm-noor b sẽn boond tɩ «  Kõmpãyĩ Raykar Makina Sanayi Ve Anome Sirketi » sẽn maand zab-teedã, t’a n na n maan zab-teed ligd sõor sẽn ta milyaar 253 samde. Tirki tʋʋm-noorã wilgame t’a sakame tɩ b  paam teedã, la b tõe n yaoo  ligdã yʋʋmd a ye, wal b yaood bilf-bilfu. La rẽndame tɩ b rɩk Bãnk ligdã sẽn na n yi wã n gãnege. Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã wilgame tɩ b yẽsa ne YIB bãnk  taoor rãmbã tɩ b sak n na n yãag-ba, la b yeelame tɩ rẽndame tɩ gosneer me maan nug tikr ne Bãnkã. Yaa rẽ tɩ gosneer b rɩk nug tikrã n kẽng ne depite rãmbã taoore tɩ b gese,  b na n sak n nug bɩ b na n basame.

Miniisr ning sẽn get sodaasã, kolonell Mazoor Kaasem KULBALI wilgame tɩ nug tikrã na n sõngame tɩ b paam zab-teed wala dorond dãmba, sɩlse la zab-teed a taaba. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ zab-teed kẽer ra zoe n waame, la yaa Sãnem la goosneer ra rɩk n tek ne. A togsame tɩ zab teed nins sẽn segd n wa wã na n paasa sodaarã tʋʋm pãnga. Te-kãens na n sõngame tɩ b tõog n gũusd Burkĩna Faso toosã yĩngri, tɩ bũmb ra pɩʋʋg tɩ b ka bãng tiir ye.

A sẽn wilg nug tikrã sẽn tar yõod ninsã, depite rãmb 68 wã sẽn da be roogã pʋgã fãa sakame n kõ sor tɩ b ra zab-teedã. Depite rãmbã sẽn wilg tɩ b kõo sorã poore sodaasã miniisr wilgame t’a sũur noomame. Bala sodaarã tʋʋmd pãng na n pasaame, Burkĩna Faso me na n tõog n pidsa sard ning a sẽn dɩk ne Tirki tʋʋm-noorã.

Yaa depite rãmbã sull ning sẽn get arzɛkã yell b sẽn boond tɩ KOMFIB taoor soabã, depite Dirisa SANOG n lʋɩ tʋʋmdã taoore. A Wʋsmaan BUGMA me wilgame tɩ nug-tikrã na n sõngame  tɩ Burkĩna Faso yõ-koglgã paam pãnga, tɩ nebã tõog n lebg n vɩɩmd b tẽnsẽ ne laafɩ.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, moeembã ne kiris nebã tɩ naaga taab Arsevese sẽn be Waogdgã n maan no-kaoore. Yɩɩ dĩin buud toor-toor taoor rãmba : rog-n-mikã zĩigẽ,  moeemba, Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, la kadensã Miniisri.

Yaa yʋʋm 2021 soabã sẽn loogã, la « Liig Islamik pʋʋr la pɛ » ne Tigung Katolik sull ning sẽn get moeebã lane kiris neba wʋm taabã yãk yam sigl naag taab n kao noorã. Moeembã kell n pʋʋsa  no-kaorã poor pʋʋsgo.

Rẽ yaa kaset sẽn wilgd tɩ dĩinã a yiibã gãda taab nusi n dat n mao tɩ laafɩ zĩnd Burkĩna Faso. A togsame tɩ yaa boto me la b sullã rata.

Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG me togsame tɩ no-loeerã a yiibã sẽn seg taab rõanda wã, a yaa makre, sẽn na yɩl tɩ  dĩinã a yiibã sɩd gãda taab nusi, tɩ b fãa yaa Wẽnd kamba. Kagdinall kosame tɩ b pʋʋs n kõ tãrãzisẽo wã taoor dãmba, sodaasã, la neb nins fãa sẽn kẽes b toog n zabd n tẽngã yĩng tɩ b tõog n tʋm tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa a zĩigẽ. Kagdinall Filip kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ Tigung Katolik na n kell n zĩnda moeembã poorẽ wakat fãa. B togsame tɩ yaa rẽ n so tɩ wakat fãa no-lokre, bɩ kibsa, bãmb zẽkda b naoor n tɩ zĩnda moeembã pʋʋsgẽ.

Miniisr Kolonell Bukare ZŨNGRÃNA wilgame  tɩ nand tɩ ned tuub n yɩ more, bɩ kiris neda, maan-kʋʋda, wall tũudum a to neda, a soab reng n yaa Burkĩna Faso biiga. Rẽnd naag taab n vɩɩmdã yaa tɩlae. Liig islamikã ne Tigung Katolik sull ning ning sẽn get dĩin dãmb na wʋm taabã taoor dãmb kõo taab sɛk yʋʋmd sẽn wate.

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR reega liise teknik Abubakaar Sãngule LAMIZÃANA karen-biisã no-rɛɛsdba.

Yaa tẽngã taoor soab sẽn da zẽk koɛɛg n kos nin-buiidã sõngre,  sẽn na yɩl tɩ b paam n sõng sodaasã la neb nins sẽn be zu-loees pʋgẽ, sẽn tũ ne nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm-yoodã yĩnga, la karen-biisã maan lagd lobre, n paam tus-koabg la piig la a naase, la wakɩr kobs nii la pisi ( W 114820) n dɩk n ning tẽngã taoor soab nugẽ.

Karen-biisã no-rɛɛs a Abdul Hãmmiid NIKƐƐM wilgame tɩ b me yaa Burkĩna Faso kamba, zab ne nin-wẽnsã yaa tẽng-n-biig fãa zu-loɛɛga.

Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ b yãk yam, n kẽgs burã ligd paam n na n kẽes b toog n sõng tẽngã taoor dãmba. A kell n boola karen-biis a taabã tɩ b rɩk bãmb naoore, tɩ bala tẽngã zoe n dɩka a soog a meng sore.

Kibarã yii naa-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Burkĩna Faso gosneerã yiisa mooneg koɛɛg tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, n wilg tɩ b yalsa Fãrens tẽng televisẽo a ye b sẽn boond tɩ Farens 24 tʋʋm Burkĩna Faso. Bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b rɩk noorã, yaa tɩ Farens 24 rãmb kõ sor tɩ AKMI wã sẽn ya nin-wẽnsã taoor soab a ye rɩk koɛɛg televisẽo wã zugu.

Burkĩna goosneerã wilgame tɩ televisẽo wã sẽn sak n kõ nin-wẽnsã sull taoor soab sor t’a rɩk koɛɛgã yaa bũmb sẽn ka sakde. Bala, b sõngda nin-wẽnsã tɩ b tõe n tʋm b tʋʋm-yoodã.

Rẽ kɩt tɩ tẽngã taoor rãmb rɩk noor n yals televisẽo kãnga Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã fãa pʋgẽ. Goosneer no-rɛɛs togsame tɩ tẽngã taoor rãmb sẽn dɩk na-kẽndr ning n na n zab ne nin-wẽnsã, b ka na n sak tɩ kibay kɩtbã yɩ sabaab n sõngd tɩ nin-wẽnsã tɩ b paamd pãng n tʋmdẽ ye. B leb n ka na n sak tɩ b rɩk koees sẽn tõe n sãam sodaasã tʋʋm n yiisdẽ ye. Wakat sẽn looge Tãrãzisẽo wã taoor dãmb ra zoe n dẽega Fãrens 24 televisẽo wã nugu, a sẽn da yiis kibar pagb pis-nu la zaka, b sẽn da yõk reezẽo di noorã pʋga. Wakat sẽn loog me, tẽngã taoor dãmb ra yalsa ƐRƐFI Fãrens radyo wã.

Kibarã yii AYIBE

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso sodaasã taoor dãmb wilgame tɩ b paama zab-teed sẽn tõe n sõng-b yõ-koglg keelmã wɛɛngẽ. Yaa Baaz Ayerɛnd 511 pʋg la b tɩ yals n wilg zab-teedã.

Yaa Miniisr ning sẽn get sodaasã, a Kaasem  KULBALI la sodaasã taoor soaba a Davɩɩd KABRE  n lʋɩ taoore, tɩ b wilg zab-teed nins b sẽn paamã.

Kolonell Davɩɩd KABR wilgame tɩ Sɩlsã, la zab-teedã taabã b sẽn ne wã, ya a wãn bal yãk n na n wilg nebã. Yaa zabr Sɩlse, Sɩls sẽn tõen wʋkd rɩɩbo, la Sɩls sẽn na n getẽ tɩ bũmb ra wa ling ye. B wilgame tɩ yaa tẽngã ligdẽ la b yãk n da zab-teedã. Sodaasã taoor soab wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo,  b sẽn paam zab-teedã yĩnga.

Miniisrã togsame tɩ zab-teedã sẽn wa wã na n paasa Burkĩna Faso sodaasã pãnga, la a sõng nebã rɩɩbã tall n tɩ kõ wã, la b laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ. Yaa milyaar 250 la tẽngã taoor dãmb dɩk n kẽes zab-teedã raab pʋgẽ.

Kibarã yii Lɩɩbr ẽnfo

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sõsa ne Burkĩna Faso ball tãoodbã.  Yɩɩ ne nasaara nug-tʋʋm-teoog b sẽn boond tɩ viziyokõnferãasã.

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso ball tãoodbã, na n sɛga Togo ball tãoodbã sẽn na  yɩl n paam sor n tɩ lagem nin-sabls tẽns ballã wags-taab  sẽn segd n zĩnd Kodenvoaar soolmẽ wã.

Tẽngã taoor soab wilga Etalõ rãmba tɩ Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa be b poorẽ. A kos-b lame tɩ b kẽes b toogo, sẽn na yɩl tɩ nebã sũur yɩ noogo. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa neb nins sẽn zãadb bug-raadã, tɩ bala b sẽn be zĩig ning fãa b ratame n paam sũ-noogo, kibay n keng b raoodo.

Etalõ ball Karen-saamba a Yibɛɛr VELUUD pẽnga tẽngã taoor soaba, a sẽn keng b pelsã. A wilgame tɩ b me na n maana b pãng sẽn tõe n noog nin-buiidã sũya. Bala tẽngã taoor soab goma kẽes m toog yelle. Rẽnd ball tãoodbã na n sɩd kẽesa b toogo.

A Bertrã TARWARE, ball tãoodbã taoor soab me kell n pẽga KApitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR a sẽn maan bũmb ning fãa Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã yĩnga. A wilgame tɩ ball a yiibã b sẽn na n tão wã, b na n kẽesa b toog sõma, sẽn na yɩl n noog Burkĩna nin-buiidã sũuri.

Tẽegre yaa rũnda zaabrã wakat a 7 la Burkĩna Faso na n seg Togo rãmb Marok soolmẽ wã. Tão n lɛbgsgã na n yɩɩ Togo tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 28.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbẽ wã

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sega  Sãtrnoor  taoor dãmba, la kom-bɩɩbã.  A sõasgã pʋga a goma zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã yelle.

Yɩɩ Kaya sɛkã ro-kaseng pʋg la a seg Sãntrnoorã taoor dãmb n wilg a sẽn kẽes a meng toto n na n sɩd zab n fãag tẽngã, la a tʋm tɩ laafɩ la yõ-koglg hakɩk tõog n lebg n wa, tɩ tẽngã kẽng taoore.

A koeesã pʋga, a wilgame t’a ka na n tol n bas tẽngã tɩ lʋɩ ye. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR bẽda be n bool kom-bɩɩba fãa tɩ b sak n kẽes b toog n sõng zab n fãag tẽngã. A pẽga nebã sẽn sak n sɩd kẽes b toog n na n zab n fãag tẽngã. A wilgame t’a bee tʋʋm zugu, sẽn na yɩl n tõog n sõng neb nins sẽn vʋɩ Sãntrnoor soolmã pʋgẽ, la neb nins fãa sẽn namsd yõ-koglg kaalmã yĩngã.  A wilgame t’a na n tʋmame tɩ b tõog n paam ko-yɩlgemde, tɩ kambã me tõog n paam kaorengo.

Tẽngã taoor soab kell n wilga nebã tɩ zab-teedã pãng pasaame, la a na n sõnga sodaasã tɩ b tʋʋmdã pãng paas wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ.

Kapitɛnd TARWAR leb n kosa nebã la kom-bɩɩbã, tɩ b maan gũusg ne kibayã kũun ẽntɛgnetã zugu, bala a tõe n yɩ sabaab n koms sodaasã tʋʋmde.

Sãntr noor soolmã taoor rãmb pẽga nadg pãng ning tẽngã taoor soab sẽn tarã, sẽn yɩɩd fãa Burkĩna Faso na lebg n paam laafɩ wã. B wilgame tɩ b bee tẽngã taoor soab poorẽ wakat fãa. B kell n dɩka zu-loees sẽn be yõ-koglgã wɛɛngẽ, la reezẽo wã taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ n taas tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soaba.

Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame t’a tʋmda sẽn na yɩl n paam a tɩɩm, la rẽnd tɩ ned kam fãa kẽes a toogo.

Sẽn na yɩl tɩ Burkĩna Faso ne Mali tʋʋmd-n-taarã kẽng taoore, neb 19 n yi Bamaok Mali soolmẽ wã n kẽn nao n wa Waogdgo. B kẽe tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 21 yʋʋm 2023 soabã la b ta Waogdgo, rẽ tɩ b yi Mali a rasem 22 yĩnga.

Yɩɩ Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, la neb yãk yam n yi Bamaoko, Mali soolmẽ wã n kẽn n wa Burkĩna Faso na-tẽngã pʋga. Kẽndbã ra zãada Burkĩna Faso ne Mali tãb-kaorã. Yaa Mali, Burkĩna Faso,  Gine, la Kõngo kom-bɩɩb sẽn zabd nin-sabls tẽnsã na paam a soog n meng hakɩɩka, bãmb n naag taab n sigl kẽndã. B kẽndã tʋlsem yaa sẽn na n wilg Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b ratame tɩ b tʋm tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsã gãd taaba nusi.

A Sãngare,  kẽndbã sʋk ned a ye, sẽn ta yʋʋm pisoob rɩka koɛɛg n wilg tɩ rũnda-rũndã, nin-sabls tẽnsã segd n tik n yikame. La bũmb ning sẽn kõt bãmb raoodã, ya a Asimi GOETA, ne a Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, la a Mamadi DUMBIYA sẽn dɩk nin-sabls tẽng yikrã sorã. Yaa rẽ tɩ b me yik n na n yãag-ba, tɩ b tʋm tɩ tẽns a taabã me rɩk b na-kẽndrã. A kẽnga taoor n paas t’a Asami GOETA ne Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sã n gãd taab nusi, n dat tɩ b tẽns a yiibã naag taab n zabe, yaa tɩlae tɩ b yãag-ba. Bala yaa bãmb sẽn zabd n dat bũmb ningã la b sẽn maandã.

A Yusuf BOARI kẽndã siglg taoor soab wilgame tɩ yaa kɩlo 862 la b sẽn kẽna. A togsame tɩ b raabã yaa tɩ toaag ra le zĩnd Burkĩna ne Mali sʋk ye. Yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ tẽns a yiibã lebg bũmb a ye. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ wakat sẽn looge, tẽns a  yiibã  ra yaa wa tẽn-yende, la rũnda , b sã n gomd naag taabã yelle neb wʋsg sãbdame tɩ yaa naab a yembr n na n zã tẽns a yiibã.  Naag taabã, yaa  nin-buiidã sẽn na n paam sor n kẽnd tẽns a yiibã pʋgẽ wa b sẽn date, tɩ nasaar wẽnga sẽn da maan toos ninsã ka le naag sʋk ye. Sã n  yɩ  boto tẽns a yiibã na n kẽnga taoore, b soog-b-mensã paamda pãng n paase.

Yaa nin-buiid katɛk n yi n deeg kẽndbã. B yɩɩla Burkĩna Faso ne Mali tẽngã soog-b-mens yɩɩla. Yɩɩ Memoryall Toma Sãnkarã la b seg-ba.

ESƐNSE wã yaa kʋdemdã, la reem buud toor-toor tig-kaseng b sẽn maand Bobo soolmẽ. Rõandã soabã ya a naoor 20 soaba. A na n sɩnga tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 29 n tãag sig-noy kiuug rasem a 6 yʋʋm 2023 soabã. Sẽn na yɩl tɩ tigrã soglg tõog n kẽn wala sẽn segde, miniisr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã, a Rĩmtallba Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG zĩniga sula Bobodɩʋla tɩ b na n ges tʋʋmdã siglgu.

Gom-zug b sẽn tiki, n na n maan a naoor 20 soabã tig-tẽegre, yaa « Rog-n-mikã reemã buud toor toor sõngda naag taab n vɩɩmdã wɛɛngẽ ». B yãka neb 20 tɩ b ges tʋʋmdã siglgu.  Ya a Fidɛll TAMINI ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã seb-gʋnd-kaseng la b yãk t’a lʋɩ sulã taoore. Sulã taoor soab pʋgd a yiib n soab a Kiristɛnd Sano KULBALI wilgame, tɩ lebga vẽeneg tɩ ESƐNSE wã na n tõogame.

 A togsame tɩ ka ne kiis a yiib pʋgẽ bala, Bobo soolmã na n vɩɩmda rog-n-mik buud toor-toor tig-kaseng pʋgẽ. Tigrã sɩnga yʋʋm 1983 soabã, a tʋlsem ya a sõng tɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã la a rog-n-mikã buud toor-toor tõog n kẽng taoore, la a sõng tɩ neb nins sẽn be kʋdemdã tʋʋm pʋgẽ wã tõogd n paam n segd taab zĩig a ye, n pʋɩt taab yam-dãmba. Yɩɩ wao-fugd kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, la gosneer wilg tɩ ba tẽngã sẽn be zu-loees nins pʋgẽ wã, b n na n maan-a lame.

Kʋdemdã miniisr a Rĩmtallba Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO sẽn zĩnig tʋʋmdã sigindb sul loogr poore, a rɩka wilgame tɩ ESƐNSE wã maanda wakat ning tẽngã sẽn ka gãe bãane, la ba ne rẽ fãa tẽngã taoor soab sak n kõo sor tɩ tigrã na n tõog n zĩndi. A pasaame tɩ ka sorã kũun bal ye. Tẽngã taoor soab kẽes a toogo n na ges tɩ tigrã tõog n kẽn wa sẽn segde. Yaa rẽ tɩ miniisrã kɩt neb nins sẽn na n ges tʋʋmdã siglg tɩ b kẽes b toog tɩ tʋʋmdã tõog n yɩ wa tẽngã taoor soab raabã. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tig-kãngã segd n yɩɩ pʋɩ taab la wʋm taab pʋgẽ. Bala tẽngã bee zu-loees pʋgẽ. Tigrã maaneg wilgdame tɩ Burkĩna Faso ka kɩll ye. A na n kõo neb nins sẽn get kʋdemdã reezẽo wã pʋgẽ sor tɩ b lʋɩ taoor n tõog n yãag tʋʋmdã. Boto na n sõngame tɩ b bãng bãmb me tʋʋm sẽn ya a soaba. ESƐNSE wã seb-gʋnd-kaseng pʋʋsa tẽngã taoor soab barka a sẽn sak n kõ sor tɩ tigrã 20 soabã na n tõogã, t’a noogda Bobo rãmb sũuri.

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, a Maari Zistind Filip Wedraoogo, pag ning sẽn maood a pãng tɛka, tɩ Burkĩna Faso rog-n-mikã la tẽn-peelmã na paam a zĩigã, sega Zɩnyãr soolmẽ tẽng soben-dãmbã. Sɛg-taabã tʋlsem, yaa tẽng-n-biisã b sẽn boond b rãmb tɩ tẽngsoben-dãmbã, na lebg n paam b zĩiga, tẽngã zãab pʋgẽ Burkĩna Faso. Yaa Geoogẽnaab ne b zãma wã na kẽes b toogo, t’a Bilɛɛs lebg n kẽ ba-yirã, la a ra pa weoog ye.Sõasgã sɩngrẽ, yaa Geoogẽnaab n deng n dɩk n koɛɛga, n pʋʋs zama wã. Rẽ poore, b yeelame:” mam yaa Geoogẽnaaba. Mam sẽn wa n deeg naamã, m mikame tɩ m ya m ye. Katoliki, Moeemdo, la Merka, reega kamba. Tɩ mam na n kẽn n bao m saam-biisi. M kẽna tẽns ka tɛka, n seg tẽngsoben-dãmbã. Rũnda, d lebga wʋsgo. La Giulung tẽngsob kae ye. Bãmb sẽn kae wã, roogã nan yaa vɩʋʋgo. Sãambã sẽn wa wã, b waa ne b sũur koeese. Yaa rẽ la m bool-y-yã tɩ wa tɩ d kelg-ba. Sãambã sẽn tar koees ninsi, b na togs tɩ d kelge”.

Geoogẽnaab sẽn kõ noor poore, yaa Kaya Gawa tẽngsoab a Ãdem Sawadg n dɩk koɛɛga. A wilgame:”yaa yʋʋm ka tɛk la pagã sẽn zĩ wã, a Maari Zistind Filip Wedraoog ne a tũud-n-taas a yiib wa n yã Gawa rãmba, tɩ b yita Tẽnkʋdg Rĩmtẽnga, la b ratame n bãng tẽn-peelmã pãnga sẽn taẽ, la a tʋʋma. B reng n watame tɩ d lebsd-ba, tɩ b leb tɩ Rĩmtẽngnaab kõ-b sore. B kẽngame n tɩ paam b naabã noore, n wa tɩ d lebs-ba. Tãab-n-soabã, b waa ne sebre, tɩ tõnd tik rẽ n tall-b n kẽng Gawa, la Loaaga.Yʋʋm ka tɛkã d sẽn be ne taabã, m ka tõe n yeel tɩ m ka mi-b ye. D tʋma ne taaba, m mi-b lame. Yaa minim-kãng n kɩt tɩ m tall-b tɩ b wa yãmb nengẽ, tɩ d yaa tẽngsoben-dãmb buudu. B ratame tɩ rog-n-mikã la tẽn-peelmã paam pãnga, tõnd me bee rẽ yĩnga. Mam yaa Tɩɩbsoab biiga, m le yaa tẽng soab biiga. M dogame, n mik Tɩɩbsoaba. M dogem yʋʋm piig yĩng la b maan kaalem. M buga tẽngsoab korgã yʋʋm pissi la zaka, n da tʋkd koom yãagd-b tɩ b kẽnd n kʋʋda. La Moeemdo, Katolik la Merka wa n deega zĩig n yãmbe. Tẽngsobendã yaa rẽgd ne neb kẽere. A yaa rẽgd sẽ, la a tar yõ-wooko. Tẽngsoab wa n kaeeme tɩ nebã ket n watẽ tɩ b rata sõngre, yagens beeme, la yengs sẽn ka rẽgd ka be ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ m yeele, tɩ tẽn-peelem yaa buudu. M sẽn yasã, m dat n yɩ poɛɛga, ka tõe ye. M ka na n yɩ sãy la. La yaa sãy n kõt maam m kukurã. M dat n yɩ buud a to me, ka tõe ye. Tẽngsobendã ya m buudu. Yaa rẽ tɩ m lebg n gãd rẽ, tɩ rẽ la m yãgre. M yasa, m ka yũud tẽn-taag koom ye. Ya m rog-n-mikã yĩnga. La m bõos-y lame, tɩ tõnd sẽn wa ne bũmb ningã, bɩ y reeg-a. Tõnd sẽn togs yãmb koees ninsã, tɩ bal-y-a, n tũus sẽn sakdã”.Gawa tẽngsoab koeesã poore, b kõ a Maari Zistind Filip Wedraoog sore, t’a togs bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a s’gd Geoogẽnaab ne b poorẽ dãmbã. A yeelame : « m kabsda tẽngsoben-dãmbã fãa. M kabsda naab a Zɩɩdwẽnd ne a pag a tẽnga. M yaa biiga, m sẽn wa n gom n yõsgẽ, bɩ y maan m sugri. Mam sã n wa be y taoor rũnda, yaa raab b sẽn dat tɩ m yals y taoore. Sã n ka rẽ Tiugungkatolik karen-saamb biiga, pastɛɛr paga, kõn wa n yas yãmb taoor ye. Mam wa n karma Bɩɩblã, n yã tẽn-peelmã goam a pʋgẽ wã. M karma Gɛɛla 16 soabã pʋgẽ, n yã t’a Moyiis goma ne tẽn-peelmã Yɩsralyall kambã yĩnga. Tɩ mam sʋk m menga : rẽ yĩngã tẽn-peelmã yell sẽn gomd Bɩɩblã pʋgã, a yɩɩda tõnd yaab rãmbã tẽn-peelem la? Tɩ m na n bao neb n sʋgs tɩ b wa tees maam Gawa tẽngsoaba, tɩ m sʋk bãmb tɩ m na paam vẽenem. Tɩ mam na n yõgen kẽna.

La vẽneg-kãng poore, a wa n yii be, tɩ lebg tẽngã yelle. B wilgda maam naamã zãabã, sẽn ka tũud sorã. B reng n wilga maam Dĩinã zĩigẽ wã. B togsa maam tɩ m wilg Dĩinã taoor rãmb tɩ b sẽbga nebã. B weooga tẽedbã, n tudg-ba, tɩ b bas b rog-n-miki, n bas b yaab rãmba, la b bas-b tɩ b rɩk b yaab rãmbã sore. La b sã n ka yols nin-buiidã n bas-b tɩ b leb b yaab rãmbã sorẽ, yell n na n wa. Yellã pãng na n yɩɩga bãmb sẽn gãd yell n ning n tarẽ wã, la b pĩnd n bas-b tɩ lebg n dɩk b yaab rãmbã sore. Tɩ mam tol n gʋls sebre, n kõ Pastɛɛr a ye: Wẽnnaam yeelame tɩ y yols nin-buiidã, n wilg-b b yaab rãmbã sore. Yaa Bɩɩblã pʋg la mam tɩ yã yel-kãngã. Y sã n ka maan rẽ me, yellã sã n wa, y na n wa ratame t’a leb poorẽ la y ka na n tõog ye.Rẽ poore, mam le gãandame tɩ koɛɛg a to wa, tɩ m yeel perzidã Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoore. B wa n ka reeg me, b sẽn ya tẽngã naabã, bãmb n segd n yik n yalse, n gom ne nin-buiidã tɩ b bao b yaab rãmbã sore. La b sã n kell n ka reeg gomdã, b yãka raar sõor n kõ-ba. Raarã sõor sã n ta, b ka na n le rɩ naam ye. Seb-kãng yii Zʋgnallẽ wã yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2014 soabã. Zĩ-likr yʋʋm 2014 soabã, b naam Bilɛɛs lʋɩɩme. La yaa gomdã la b ka paame. Tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn be na-zakã pʋg n get rẽ wã, reega sebrã, la b ka sõd-a wa gom-zug ye. B ka rɩk-a n taas-b ye. La sẽn da yeel tɩ b sã n ka yik n gese, bãmb mengã naamã na n lʋɩɩme wã, sɩd yɩɩ woto.Rẽ loogr poore, yaa Tãrãzisẽo. T’a Yakuba Yizak Zɩɩda wa. La bãmb ra wẽnegame n dat n leb Dĩm dãmbã nugẽ, tɩ mam yet tɩ woto, a ka zems zãng ye. La bãmb sã n ka rɩk a sorã, b na n wa zoeeme tɩ b ka rig-b ye. Bãmb me naamã ne a wa yet t’a na n saame, b zoeem tɩ b rig-b ye. Tɩ bãmb loog tɩ perzidã Rok Kaboor wa. Tɩ tõnd yeel tɩ biig ka rigd a ba n deeg naam ye. A Bilɛɛs yaa yãmb ba politikã pʋgẽ. Bãmb n zãms yãmb plitikã, bãmb n wilg-a yãmba, tɩ y ning-b yãnde, n dig-ba, tɩ b yi n tɩ be kɛɛnga. Tẽeg-y tɩ Moog ka, a buud zĩndame. Naab a Zombre, b rig-b lame tɩ b kẽng Bigtoogo, n tɩ zĩnd yʋʋm a tã, tɩ b na n yõg sees tɩ b lebg n deeg b naam.Yãmb me segd n yõga sees n lebs y ba wã a zĩigẽ wã. B sã n wa n ka rɩ naam me, ka sãam ye, la y segdame n maoome tɩ b lebg n wa, la b ra pa weoog ye. Koe-kãng la tõnd taas perzidã Kaboore. D wilg-b lame tɩ b modg tɩ ka ne yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2021 t’a Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoor sã n ka wa, b naamã na n lʋɩɩme. Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, a naamã lʋɩɩme. Tɩ bãmb loog t’a Damib wa. Tɩ d yẽrg n kolg-ba, n yeele: yaa sɩda. B yãka raar toor n yeel t’a Bilɛɛs segd n lebg n waame. La raarã loog t’a ka wa ye. Tõnd na n bõosa yãmb kiuug a yoobã pʋga, yãmb naamã zãabã pʋga, tɩ y modge, n wa ne perzidã Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoore. Ka yet tɩ y wa kõ-b naamã ye, yãmb we n wa ne-b tɩ b wa zĩnd ba-yirã la b ra be moog ye. Yaa Wẽnnaam meng n tik n da kõ-b yʋʋm 27 wã, tɩ bũmb kõn tol n maan tẽngã ye. Bee Alkʋrãanã la Bɩɩblã pʋga, tɩ b tõe n karem tɩ ya vẽenega. Tõnd togsda yãmba, d ka maand politik ye.Naab ning sẽn wa-a fãa tõnd togsd-a-la vẽenega. Y sã n ka modg tɩ b wa, yãmb me naamã na n saame. A Damib rãmb sẽn kelg tõndo, tɩ tõnd lebg n kuli, b ka le bool tõnd ye. Tɩ tõnd me zĩ n getẽ. B sẽn wa n mik tɩ wakatã sẽn da kõ wã, kẽeme n bõoge, b yika yãg-yãge. B ka wilg tõnd ye. B ka segl baafɩ ye. B yikame n tɩ tall a Bilɛɛs n wa, tɩ nebã ka sak ye, tɩ b le lebs-ba. Rẽnd b waoongã ka pid ye.La a Yɩbrayɩɩm Tarwar sẽn deegã. Ket n yaa koe-yende. Rẽnd tɩ perzidã Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoor wa, tɩ d lebg n yɩ sugr dãmba, n bas tɩ looge, la b tik d yaab rãmb n bõos sugri, tɩ tõnd rag n basa yaab rãmbã sore. D menemame n da tɩ be tẽn-taas sorẽ, la masa wã, d segdame n bãng d yaabã sore, tɩ d na n tõoga nin-wẽnsã. Bugraadã tʋʋmd bee be, la ka bugraadã bal tʋʋmd ye. Rẽnd tɩ rog-n-mikã paam pãnga, tɩ tẽn-peelmã lebg n paam tũubu. Sã n da ya bugraad pãng bala, woto tɩ yellã kolgẽ la weoogo.La yãmb a tẽngsoben-dãmbã me tara y tʋʋmd a pʋgẽ. Bala, b sã n yeel tɩ b yolsa nin-buiidã Dĩin dãmbã la tũudum dãmbã zĩigẽ, b na n lebg n waa yae? Yaa yãmb nengẽ la b na n wa. Yaa rẽ tɩ d rat n bõos-y tɩ b sã n wa wa, bɩ y reeg-ba. La y sã n ka bãng b waoongã tiiri, y na n deeg-b-la wãn-wãna?Rẽ la tõnd me yet tɩ d na n kolga yãmba. Nasaar wẽngã la sẽn be d sʋkã. Nasaar wẽngã me yellã, mam le wa n gãandame tɩ b yet tɩ m kolg tẽngsoab n bõos tẽn-peelmã tɩ nasaar wẽngã tõog n loog la a bas tẽngã. Tɩ sã n ka yẽ n yi, d ka na n soog d tẽngã zãng ye. Tɩ tõnd na n bõos tẽngsoaba, tɩ b sɩd tʋm tʋʋmdã, n yet tɩ d reeg gomdã n tɩ togs-a. D reega gomdã, la d ka tõe n togs-a-la. Yãmb la sẽn mi la. Nasaar wẽngã, d zoet-a lame. Sã n yet t’a menem tẽngã, la d yaool n ka tẽng taoor dãmba. D reega yellã, la d ka tõe n ta n togs ye. Yaool n yaa tɩlae tɩ d ta n togs-a. Sẽn wa n zems kiuugu, d tagsame tɩ tõnd tʋʋmdã ka zems zãng ye. A tõe n lebg n paa ne tõndo. Tɩ tõnd kell n gʋls sebrã n tool Ãmbasaadã, n togs Fãrensnaabã yʋʋre. D yeelame tɩ ka la kiuug a tã, rẽnd tɩ b sã n ka yi la b bas tẽngã, n lebg n zems ne tõnd nanambsã la b bas b zãmbã tʋʋma. Kiuugã a tãabã sã n loog tɩ b ka maan rẽ, sẽn pʋgdã yaa Burkĩna tẽn-peelmã n na n zab n sõng tẽngã.

Tɩ kiba-kɩt a ye reeg maam a sõasg pʋg Radiyoburkĩna, n sʋk maam tɩ m tẽedame tɩ tẽn-peelmã ket n tũuda sɩda ! Tɩ m yet t’a keta a zĩigẽ. Tẽn-peelem na n tʋma a tʋʋma. Tõnd kõta Fãrens bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug pipi raare. A sã n wa yeel t’a na n taame yãmb na n wʋma nasaar tẽngã rãamde. Nasaar wẽngã, na n loog ka. Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug la tõnd sẽn kõ wã, wakat kãng sẽn wa n ta, la a Yibe nebã sẽn wa n ta n yeel tɩ b loogã. Rũnda-rũnda, b saga b teedo. Rat n yeel tɩ tekr ning sẽn tekd tɩ ya perzidã Yibe n be taoorã, ad yaa tẽn-peelem n tʋmd a tʋʋma. Tõnd yẽ tʋma tʋʋmdã, la yaa yãmb n be taoore. Sã n da ka yɩẽ woto, ka yɩt naana ye. ,Tõnd baoome n na n kolg sẽn be-b tẽngã taoor n togs-ba tɩ b bãng tɩ tʋʋmd n deng n tʋme, la b ka reeg tõnd ye. D ra ratame n togs-b tɩ b bãnge, la b me naag b toogo, la b kẽes tẽn-peelem sʋka, la b ka kelg tõnd ye. Hal n tãag woto, tõnd ka paam n gom ne-b ye. B ka kelgd tõnd ye. Bãmb sã n ka lebg n wa yellã sor zugu, ka na n zems ye. Rũnda tõnd sẽn yas yãmb taoorã, yaa sẽn na n togs-y tɩ y bãng nind sẽn be. D ratame tɩ y togs-ba, tɩ b lebg n vʋʋg tẽn-peelem ne a pãngã fãa, ne a tõogã fãa, tɩ d tẽngã paam n gãand bãane. Yãmb a tẽng-n-biisã segd n yik n deega y tʋʋma. D ka yet tɩ y sik naabã ye. La y segd n deega y tẽn-peelem tʋʋma, tɩ naamã yaa tẽn-peelmã naam. Yãmb a tẽngsoben-dãmbã n deng n beẽ tɩ nasaar naamã yaool n wa. Na n yɩɩ saglse, na n yɩɩ kosg tɩ y kos-ba, mam yẽ ka tõe n tags yãmb zĩigẽ ye. M kot-y lame tɩ y sagl naabã t’a lebg n tik yaab rãmbã zĩigẽ, tɩ nin-buiidã paam fãagre. La yaa wa m sẽn yetã. Tõnd ka maand politik ye. Yaa yaab rãmbã zug zẽkre, yaa nin-buiidã laafɩ la b zems taab n vʋɩɩmd n pak tõndo. A Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoor sẽn be weoogã ka sõma ne tẽngã ye. A ka sõma ne-do, a ka sõma ne tẽngã laafɩ. B we n wa ne-b tɩ b wa beẽ b zakẽ wã bala. Ba b na yãk sodaas tɩ b gũudẽ-ba. A Bilɛɛs sẽn wa wã, yãmb yãame tɩ b tõe n lebg n maana bõe? B we n wa beẽ b zakẽ bala, tɩ b yʋʋrã na n gũu tẽngã. Alkʋrãanã pʋga, b yeelame tɩ b yaa zag-gũuda, la yãmb sã n dig y baag t’a wesda wʋsgo, y yak bʋʋg n dũmd-y-yã”.Koeesã poorẽ, Geoogẽnaab ne b poorẽ dãmbã pẽgame. B yeelame tɩ b na n sega miniisr ning sẽn get kibaya, kʋdemdã, rog-n-mikã, la gilg-n-ges yel-soalmã yell lamusa tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2023, la b gʋls sebr n ning b sũurã koees tɩ b reeg n taas-a, t’a taas a Yibe. La a Maari Zistind Filip Wedraoog wilgame tɩ sebrã zoe n beeme, la a na rɩk n yek-b n kɩse. Seg-taabã sɩnga reem, n baas ne reem. Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, depite rãmbã talla seg taab kasenga, n zĩnd n gom sodaas nins sẽn get soayã manegr la meebã sẽn na n kẽes b mens toto n sõng n maneg soayã yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn beẽ wã. Seg-taabã pʋgẽ, b goma sãnem bogd kẽer sẽn pagd yõ-koglg kaalmã sabaabã yelle. Yaa Miniisr ning sẽn get sãnmã tʋʋm la tẽn-gãongã arzɛk yelle, bãmb n yals depite rãmbã taoor n kõ-b vẽenmã.Wao-fugdg kiuug yʋʋm 2023 soabã, yaa sãnem tʋʋm zĩis 43 n page. Bukldimuhun soolmã pʋga. Sigr kiuug yʋʋm 2021 soabã me, guvɛgneerã ra yiisa mooneg koɛɛg n wilg tɩ b pag sãnmã tʋʋm zĩis sẽn be Bukldimuhun reezẽo wã pʋga. Miniisr Sɩmo Pɛɛr BUSIM wilgame tɩ yaa yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn be wã, n kɩt tɩ b rɩk noy n pag sãnmã tʋʋm zĩisi. Tʋʋm-noya pagb waa ne zuloeese. Bala, a kɩtame tɩ Burkĩna Faso sẽn da yiisd sãnmã yʋʋmd fãa wã leb poorẽ. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2022 soabã yaa sãnem toand 58 la b yiis sãnem bogdã pʋs Burkĩna Faso. Yʋʋm 2021 soabã, sẽn loogã, yɩɩ sãnem toand 67 la b ra yiisda. Rẽnd sẽn lebg woto wã, wilgdame tɩ yaa toand 14 n booge. Sẽn paase, neb nins sẽn da be tʋʋm no-kãens pʋsã tʋʋm sãamame. Rẽ fãa tõe n yɩɩ sabaab tɩ kẽer lebg bi-beese, ka rẽ bɩ b tɩ kẽes b mens nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm yood pʋga.Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n wilg t’a Ministɛɛrã bee tʋʋm zugu, sẽn na yɩl n paam a tɩɩm. B na n gesa b sẽn tõe n zĩnig yõ-koagendbã toto sãnmã tʋʋm zĩisẽ, la b zĩnig sodaas sull tɩ b tʋʋmdã ya sãnmã zĩis koglgo. Goosneem rɩka sãnmã tʋʋm zĩis koglg t’a na n yɩ tʋʋm-kasenga. Yaa na-kẽndr segd tɩ b tũ tɩ tẽngã tõog n paam n nafe.kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

B sʋkã, yaa neb 843 sẽn zoe n bas b tẽns n be soayã zut n bõosdẽ. Bãmb rãmbã sʋka yaa pagb 316, kamb 507, la rap 20. Wao-fugdg kiuugã pʋga, yaa neb 1342 n be soayã zutu. Pagbã 157, rap 31, kamb 265. Yaa woto la miniisrã wilg yã. Gosneem taoor dãmbã wilgame tɩ b rɩka na-kẽnda buud toor-toor n nan yiis-b soayã zut ka ne yʋʋmdã baasgẽ.kibarã yii Lɩɩbrẽnfo

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 9 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, sull ning sẽn vaeesd tʋʋm noya, la a zabd ne wẽgbã tɩ b boond tɩ ASCE-LC wã taoor dãmb sega kiba-kɩtbã. Sɛkã pʋga, b wilgame tɩ b vaeesa tẽngã taoor soab zĩigẽ, n paas depite rãmbã tʋʋm zĩigẽ, la gosneerã taoor soab tʋʋm zĩigẽ.A koeesã pʋga a Filip NIYÕ wilgame tɩ yaa tẽngã taoor soaba Kapitɛnd Yɩbryɩɩm TARWAR n kõ sor tɩ b maan vaeesgã. Yaa rẽ kɩt tɩ b yãk tʋʋm no-bɛd a tãabã.B sẽn vaees na-zakẽ wã, b mikame tɩ yaa milyão 695 n ka be yʋʋm 2020 n tãag yʋʋm 2021 wã pʋga.Gosneerã taoor soab zĩigẽ, yaa milyaar a ye la zak n ka be. La yaa sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm 2018 n tãag yʋʋm 2021 soabã. Asãmblnasnalẽ wãz, yaa milyaar 13 la b gõdg yã. Be me sɩnga ne yʋʋm 2018 n tãag yʋʋm 2021 soabã.

Tʋʋm noy a tãabã pʋga, yaa milyaar 15 la milyão 648 n ka be. Yaa ligdã sẽn yi tɩ ka tũ sor ye. Bala, b ka wilg ligdã b sẽn dɩk n tʋm tʋʋm nins ye. B leb n yiisa karenzi tɩ ka tũ soay ye. Tʋʋm b sẽn gãneg n wilg tɩ b tʋmame wã me ka tũ sor ye.Bũmb sẽn paas ligd gõdgrã, ASCE-LC taoor soabã wilgame tɩ gosneerã taoor soab tʋʋm noorẽ, b ka tũ nug tikr limoro 2019-06- b sẽn tik nug zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2019 soabã, n wilg tɩ b segd n booga gosneerã taoor dãmb ligdã yisg ye. B sẽn ka tũ noorã, yaa milyão 116 la tus pisoob la zak la b rɩk n sãame. A Filip NIYÕ wilga kiba-kɩtbã tɩ b rɩka vaeesgã sẽn wilg a soabã n ning tẽngã taoor soab nugẽ. A le pasaame tɩ b rɩka na-kẽnda sebrã pʋga, sẽn na yɩl n sõng n zab ne wẽgbã la ligdã gõdgre.kibarã yii awaga.kom

Pagbã soog-b-meng tigr naoor 166 sẽn maan tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 8 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, pagb nins sẽn be ka sak kɛgr sull wala UAS, Asosɛsẽo Kebayina, la MBDHB wã pʋgẽ tigma taab n maan b soog-b mengã daare. B tigsgã pʋgẽ b goma pagbã sẽn segd zu-loees nins yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ b tik gom-zu-kãngã n maan b tigsgã: ” Raba-bʋs la b tõe n tik n sõng pagb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽns yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ”. A Aminata KABOORE, sull ning b sẽn boond tɩ Kebayina wã taoor soab wilgame tɩ yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn namsd b rãmb yaa pagbã ne kambã. Bala b zoeesã pʋgẽ b konga fãa.Yaa rẽ tɩ sulã tigs taaba, n wilg b belem ne pagb nins sẽn be zu-loeesã pʋsẽ wã. B zĩnda ne taab n ges b sẽn tõe n tũ soay nins n sõng tɩ tẽngã gãand bãane. A Aminata KABOOR kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ b zoe n sõnga pagb kẽere, la b saagdame n na gãneg na-kẽnda a taaba, n paam n sõng pagb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnsã tɩ b tõog n ges b mense, la b kambã tɩ b tõog n vʋɩɩmd b burkĩndã pʋgẽ.kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 7 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Zapõ no-rɛɛsã sẽn be Burkĩna Faso wã rɩka bõn-zombds n taas Burkĩna Faso polɩɩs rãmbã. Yaa miniisr ning sẽn get yõ-koglgã n zĩnd tɩ b rɩk kũunã taase, tɩ b reeg n sõng Burkĩna Fason zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã. Yaa mobila b sẽn boond tɩ Pikopã bãmb 40 n paas motɛ-bɛd b sẽn boond tɩ BMW rãmbã a 8. Fãa sẽn naag taab yaa milyaar a ye la milyão 500. Zapõ no-rɛɛsã togsame tɩ kũunã bãmb sẽn kõ wã yaa sẽn na n sõnge, tɩ b tõog n zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã.Kibarã yii Minit.bf

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, FESPAKO naoor 28 paga a kʋlens Palɛdɛspoor sẽn be Waga demillã. Yaa Burkĩna Faso taoor soabã Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR n lʋɩ a pagbã taoore.Sĩnim dãmbã yɩɩ bãmb ka tɛk n da kẽ wagsgã pʋga. La wagsgã sẽn wa n sa, bʋ-kaoodbã zĩndame n bale n wa wilg tɩ yaa Tinizi tẽngã sĩnim manada a Yusɛf SEBI n lʋɩ taoore ne a sinma yʋʋr b sẽn boond tɩ Askal. Askalã yaa sĩnim naandem b sẽn boond tɩ figsẽo wã. A sĩnmã wã gomda vaeesg b sẽn maan zag-gũud a ye b sẽn maan kaalem zag-vɩʋʋg pʋga. Yaa Tinizi tẽngã taoor soab kʋdg a Bɛn Ali kaalem loogr poore, la polɩɩs rãmbã pak vaeesgo, tɩ vaeesgã wa ne neb a taab kũum b sẽn da ka tar kibare.Yaa rẽ tɩ sẽn zĩnd n ges-b tʋʋmdã balb wilg t’a n segd n paam kũun ning b sẽn boond tɩ Etalõ doorã, sãnem wed-moaaga, la milyão 20. Sĩnim kãng poore, yaa Burkĩna Faso sĩnim maanda a Apolind TARWAR sĩnmã ning b sẽn boond tɩ SƖRA wã n pʋge. La yẽ paama milyão10 n paas zũud wed-moaaga, b sẽn boond tɩ Etalõ darzã wã. Burkĩna Faso sĩnim maandba wilga b sũ-noog ne b tʋmd-n-taagã, a sẽn tõog n paam n ta yiib-n-soab zĩigẽ wã. A Taleb Kant sẽn ya Burkĩna Faso sĩnim maandaa ye wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, Burkĩna Faso sẽn ta yiib-n-soab zĩigẽ wã. A pasaame tɩ nin-buiida fãa ra be a Apolind TARWAR poorẽ, la bʋ-kaoodbã me tʋma b tʋʋmde.

A Bintu Gɛllo, wilgame t’a sũur ka sãam wʋsg ne Burkĩna Faso sẽn ka paam pipi zĩiga a ye. Bala sĩnim ning a Apolind TARWAR sẽn yiisã kɩtame tɩ nin-buiida fãa naag n taab n zĩnd a poorẽ. A wilgame tɩ wʋm taab sɩd tõe n zĩnda Burkĩna Faso. Tẽns sẽn wa n zĩnd FESPAKO naoor 28 soabã yɩɩ Kodenvoaare, Kɛɛde, Senegalle, Gine la Mali. FESPAKO wã taoor soab a Muusa Alegs SAWADG wilgame tɩ sĩnma wã tigr naoor 29 soabã na n sɩnga wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 22 n tãag tʋʋlg kiuug pipi daare yʋʋm 2025 soabã.kibara yii librẽfo

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, kibayã kũun rot sull kaseng b sẽn boon tɩ Sɛpã, yaa kibay kũun rot nins sẽn so b mense. B sullã taoor dãmb seg a Wʋsmaan BUGMA depite rãmbã taoor soabã. B sɛkã pʋgẽ, b goma tigs-kaseng ning sẽn na n zĩnd tɩ b gom kibayã kũun rot tʋʋma yelle.Yaa SƐP taoor soab a Yinuusa WEDRAOOGO, n lʋɩ taoore tɩ b seg Tãrãzisẽo wã depite rãmb taoor soaba. A togsame tɩ b sega depite rãmbã taoor soab n wilg b sullã taoor dãmb b sẽn nan yãke. B kell n togs-a-la zu-loees nins sẽn be kibayã kũun rotẽ.Sullã taoor soab wilgame tɩ bãmb reega sullã taoore, Burkĩna Faso sẽn be zu-loees pʋg wakate.La sẽn wa n tɩ yɩɩd fãa, yaa kibayã kũun pʋsẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ b wilgd depite rãmbã taoor soab tɩ b na n sigla seg-kaseng wakat sẽn wate n gom kibayã kũun rot la b arzɛkã paoong sẽn ka na n wã yelle. A Yinuus WEDRAOOG kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ ba ne Burkĩna Faso kibayã kũun rot yʋy sẽn yi ãnduni wã pʋgẽ wã, b ket n tara zu-loeese. Ligdã kaalem wɛɛngẽ, kɩtame tɩ yɩl n tõog n vɩɩmdã ya toogo. A Yinuusa WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ tigsgã sẽn watã, a na n sõngame tɩ kiba-kɩtbã, la neb nins sẽn ka kiba-kɩtbã zĩnd ne taab n pʋɩ taab yam, n paam rabay n tõog sõng kibayã kũun roto. Bala kibay kũun roog sã n page, yaa wa bas-yardo, la soog-m-meng n kõ m me tagsgã sẽn leb poorẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ b kẽng n na n tɩ kos depite rãmbã tɩ b yãag-ba. Tigsgã pʋga b na n kell n dɩka waoor buud toor-toor n taas kiba-kɩtb sẽn tʋm wakat sẽn looge, n sõng kiba-kɩtbã na soog-b-mense. SƐP taoor soabã wilga zĩ-kãng tɩ segdame tɩ b tẽeg b yell tɩ b nan ket n vʋɩ.

Depite rãmba taoor soab pẽga b yam-yakrã, la a wilg t’a na n yãag b lame. A kell n pasaame tɩ wakat kẽere, ka wʋm taab n sɩd mi n be taoor dãmbã ne kiba-kɩtbã sʋka. La bũmb sẽn be tẽngã taoor dãmb ka tõe n zãag b mens ne kibayã kũun rot ye. Ya a rẽ t’a kos tɩ b yẽs ne taaba, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b tʋmd-n- taarã yɩ naana. A Wʋsmaan BUGMA kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ Burkĩna Faso yaa tẽng sẽn so a meng kibayã kũun wɛɛngẽ. Rẽ kɩtame t’a tar pãnga. Yaa rẽ tɩ b segd n tʋmd tɩ b soog-b-mensa ra leb poorẽ ye.SƐP sullã taoor soab lebg n tẽega b sẽn da tall sɛk ne gosneerã taoor soab wakat sẽn looge. Sɛkã poore, sull ning sẽn get ministɛɛrã kibay kũun yiisa kibar tɩ bãmb sullã rãmb wilg tɩ b ka gom ligd goam ne gosneerã taoor soab ye. La hal tãag ne rũndã b ket n ka toeem kibarã ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b kot kibayã kũun sull sẽn be be wã tɩ b modg n toeem kibarã n ning-a a zĩigẽ.Kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Miniisr dãmbã seg taab sẽn zĩnd tʋʋlg kiuug pipi daar yʋʋm 2023 soabã, gosneerã rɩka noor n kõ Tirki tʋʋm noor a ye b sẽn boond tɩ Aforo Tirk sor t’a tʋm Tãmbao, la Yinata sãnmã. Tũu ne wʋm taab sẽn zĩnd tẽngã taoor dãmb ne tʋʋm noorã sʋka, tɩ b rɩk noor n kõ-a t’a tilg Tãmbao la Yinata. No-rɩkrã na n yɩɩ sabaab n sõng tɩ so-togsã lebg naana Burkĩna Faso, Mali, la Nizɛɛr sʋka. Tʋʋm noorã na n dɩka neb 1000 tʋʋma. Neb 3000 me n segd n naf a pʋgẽ. Tɩ bala b tõe n kẽng n tɩ tʋmame la b pak b koosem zĩisi. Tãmbao sãnmã tʋʋm noor bee Markoy komindã. La Yinata sãnmã tʋʋm noor bee Sũm porvẽsa pʋga. A yiibã fãa bee Sayɛllã reezẽo wã soolmẽ. Tẽegre yɩɩ yʋʋm 2018 soabã, la gosneer ra reeg Tãmbao zĩigã. B reega Yinata la Belawuru sãnem bogdã tʋʋm noorã rũmb nugẽ wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2023 soabã.kibarã yii AYIBE

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, a Galip SOME sẽn ya ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kiba-kɩtbã, kʋdemdã la gilg-n-ges yel-soalmã no-rɛɛsa, yaa yẽ n tɩ lʋɩ taoore, tɩ b Fespako naoor 28 soabã, seg-kaseng b sẽn boond ne farend tɩ kolokã pag a kʋɩlense.A Galip SOME rɩka koɛɛg Miniisr Emanwlɛl WEDRAOOG yʋʋr yĩnga n pʋʋs zama wã, ne bãng-mitbã, la sinim maandb nins fãa sẽn zẽk b naoor n wa zĩnd tigsgã pʋgẽ. A wilgame tɩ bãngr ning b sẽn pʋɩ taabã sõngame tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsã na n tõog n kẽng taoore. A wilgdame tɩ sinma wã yaa na-kẽndr b sẽn tõe n tik t’a yɩ sabaab n wa ne tekr buud toor-toore , sã n mik tɩ nin-buiidã sɩd wʋmd a võore.Seg-kasengã sõngame tɩ b rɩk noya, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n sõng tẽnsã. Neb nins sẽn zĩnd tigsgã pʋg kosame tɩ b lebg n dɩk sĩnma wã kaoreng n kẽes Yinivɛrsite Zozɛɛf Ki Zerb kaorengã pʋgẽ. B leb n kosame tɩ b kẽes buudã goam me sĩnma wã pʋgẽ, la b rɩk-a t’a yɩ kaorengo, tɩ sã n yɩ boto, a tõe n sõngame tɩ tẽngã lebg n paam a laafɩ wã. B leb n kosa karen-bi-bɛdã ne bãngdbã la sĩnm maandbã fãa tɩ b tik nin-sabls tẽnsã rãmb rog-n-mik n maandẽ b sĩnma wã.Yaa Mali, Gine Konakiri, Benẽ, Kodenvaare, Nizɛɛre, Afirikdisɛd, Almae, Fãrense, Bolivi, Etazini, la Burkĩna Faso sĩnm maandb la bãngdb buud toor-toor n naag taab n maan tĩgsgã.Kibarã yii kʋdemdã ministɛɛr kiba-kɩtbẽ

Yampaalg yaa lagem-n-taar sull sẽn dog n na n sõng nebã b tʋʋma pʋgẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ sullã taoor dãmb yãk yam n bool kiba-kɩtbã n wilg b na-kẽndrã sẽn ya a soaba, tɩ b rɩk n taas Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã.

Sullã taoor soab a Deni ZŨNGRÃAN wilgame tɩ Yampaalg sullã pipi tʋʋmd ya a sõng kom-bɩɩb la pagb sẽn tar nus tʋʋma, n yaool n ka tar sõngre, tɩ bala, b sẽn be Noloti rãmbã pʋsã b yãt-b lame tɩ b be zu-loees wʋsg pʋga. B wilgame tɩ b sẽn paam b rogmã sebrã, b na n sõng-b lame tɩ b tõog n pẽneg tẽngã taoor dãmbã la sull bɛd sẽn tõe n sõng-ba.Sullã pagb taoor soab wilgame tɩ sullã sẽn paam a rogem sebrã a na n yãag-b lame tɩ b paam teoolg tẽngã taoor dãmb nugẽ. Yaa pagb koabg n be sullã pʋgẽ.Sullã taoor dãmb leb n wilgame tɩ tẽngã sẽn be zu-loees pʋgẽ wã yaa nebã fãa zu-loɛɛga. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ b rɩk yam n na n kos Moognaab la tẽnga taoor dãmb tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda tɩ tẽngã kamb sẽn zoe n be zamaan-zẽnsã yĩng tɩ b lebg n wa b tẽnsẽ wã, n wa tõog n sigl b tʋʋma. Tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ, b maana lagd lobr n na n dɩk n taas tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b sõng VDP rãmbã n sodaasã pʋg-kõapa ne b kɩɩbsã.Zɩll KAFAANDO

FESPAKO naoor 28 soabã pak a kʋɩlenseWao-fugdg kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, nin-sabls tẽns sĩnma wã tigr b sẽn boond tɩ FESPAKO wã pak a kʋɩlens Waogdgo. Yaa neb sẽn be nin-sabls tẽns la nasaar tẽns n zẽk naoor n zĩnd sĩnma wã tigr pʋgẽ. Tʋʋmdã kʋɩlens pakre, yɩɩ Wagademill Palɛdɛspoorã pʋga.Sẽn n wa zems zaabr wakat a tãabo, nin-buiida ra pida zĩigẽ wã, tɩ Burkĩna Faso la Mali reem-rɛɛmd reemdẽ. Mali reem-rɛɛmd a ye yʋʋr sẽn boond t’a Sidiki DƐBATE, rɩka tẽnsa a yiibã tãb-kaoor n yɩɩl ne a kʋndã, tɩ zama wã sũur yɩ noogo. Ya a Apolineer KELEM, la a Sogɛl MAEGA n lʋɩ taoore, tɩ pak a kʋɩlensã. B fãa koeesã pʋgẽ, b goma nin-sabls tẽnsã soog-b-mens yelle, la b kos tɩ b yɩ burkĩmba, la b gãd taab nus n fãag b mense. Yaa rasem a yopoe la b na n dɩk n maan tigrã, tɩ sĩnm maandb nins sẽn naag wags-taabã tõog n wa paam bãng b tʋʋmdã sẽn na n kõ-b bũmb ninga. Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Mali gosneerã taoor soab a Sogɛl Kokala MAEGA siga Waogdgo. Yɩɩ Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soab a Apolineer KELEM, la depite rãmbã taoor soab a Wʋsmaan BUGMA, la miniisr dãmb kẽer n tɩ sega a sɩlg-yiri. Mali gosneerã taoor soab waame n na n sõs ne Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã, la a kell n pʋʋs-b ne b zaamẽ ko-yũudu, sodaas 51 wã sẽn maan kaalmã. Miniisr Sogɛl MAEGA na n zĩnda rasem a tãabo, n gom tẽns a yiibã yõ-koglgo, la b zoodã yelle.Miniisr Sogɛl MAEGA wilgame tɩ tẽns a yiibã zood zoe n kẽnga taoore, la segdame tɩ taoor dãmbã kelg b nin-buiidã sẽn dat bũmb ningã. A togsame tɩ b sẽn wa n dɩk sɩbgr n kõ Mali sẽn wa n be sɩbgr wã, tẽnsã fãa pag b yĩngr toose, tɩ Mali nebã maana b pãng sẽn tõe n pak b tẽngr toosã.

Yaa neb pis-nu n yãag-a. Neb pis-nu wã sʋka, miniisr dãmbã yaa bãmb piiga. A Sogɛl MAEGA wilga Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã tɩ b tall raoodo. Bala, sodaas 51 b sẽn kʋ wã, yaa sẽn na yɩl n kɩt tɩ nebã bas-m-yam ne sodaasã leb poorẽ, tɩ bɛ wã paam n maan a sẽn date, la b tall raoodo. A kell n wilgame tɩ sodaas ka tõe n yi tẽn-taag n wa zab n sõng tẽngã ye. Segdame tɩ tẽngã kamb yiki. Bala, na-kẽndr ning tẽngã taoor dãmb sẽn dɩk n dat n fãag tẽngã, a zabda neb kẽere. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ b maand tʋʋm-yood buud toor-toore, sẽn na yɩl n paam n koms tẽngã yõ-koglgo. A wilgame tɩ yellã tɩɩm yaa nebã yik n yalse, tɩ b ra tõog ye.A rɩka makre, b sẽn wa n dɩk na-kẽndre, tɩ daar fãa nebã kʋʋb paasdẽ wã, tɩ nin-wẽnsã reegd tẽnsã, tɩ sodaasã kiidẽ, la b ra mi bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ ya boto wã, yaa wakat kãng la Mali nebã tik n yiki, tɩ yellã kolg weoogo. Rẽnd Burkĩna Faso me sã n maana rẽ, b zu-loeesã na n kolga weeogo. A wilgame tɩ wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm na n sa Sayɛllã soolmẽ. Bala, tẽnsã sẽn zabd bũmb ning yĩngã yaa vẽenega. A Sogɛl Kokala MAEGA, wilga a sũ-noog ne Burkĩna ne Mali gosneerã, la b depite rãmbã sull sẽn tar yãab a yembrã.FESPAKO wã sẽn ya nin-sabls tẽnsẽ sĩnm maandbã seg taab kasengã sẽn na n pak a kʋɩlens wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2023 Palɛdɛsporwagademiilã, yaa Mali la b yãk t’a ya tigrã ba-yãkdga.Kibarã yii Faso.net

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, b lebg n muma a Toma SÃNKAR ne neb 12 b sẽn naag n kʋ zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 1987 yʋʋmdã. Mumba yɩɩ Kõnsayedelãntãnte, zĩig ning b sẽn kʋ-bã. Yaa gosneerã taoor soaba, depite rãmbã taoor soaba, n paas miniisr dãmb kẽere, la kiidbã buudu, la b roagdba, rog-n-mik yel-gɛtb la dĩin taoor dãmb pʋʋsa b yĩnga la b rɩk koeese. B koeesã pʋga, b kosa kiidbã roagdb tɩ b kõ b mens sugri. Yɩɩ wakat me b sẽn kell n kos Burkĩna Faso kom-pugli la a kom-dibli tɩ b kõ taab sugri tɩ tẽngã gãad bãane. Wakat sẽn looge a Toma SÃNKAR buuda,̃ ra wilgame tɩ b ka sake, b sẽn lebg n mum b biigã zĩ-kãngã ye. La tẽngã taoor dãmb sã n ka kelg b kosgã, bãmb pa na n zĩnd a mumbẽ wã ye. B sẽn kelg-ba, yɩ a SÃNKAR yao a Valentẽ SÃNKARA, la a Musbila SÃNKARA la buudã neb kẽer bal n zĩndi.Yɩɩ tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2015 soabã, la b lebg n buk a Toma SÃNKAR ne neb 12 nins b sẽn kʋ wã n maan vaeesgo, n pidis sari wã roog rãmb sẽn da kose.Kibarã yii BF1

Yel-beed ning sẽn zĩnd Dewu tɩ sodaas 51 maan kaalmã, kibay la neb yiis ẽntɛgnetã pʋg n wilg tɩ sodaas taoor soab a ye, n ning neb nins sẽn be zabrã zĩigẽ taale. Yaa rẽ tɩ Eta mazoorã yiis mooneg koɛɛg wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2023 soabã n wilg tɩ kibarã ka sɩd ye. A wilgame tɩ yellã loogre, sodaas taoor soab ba a ye nan ka gom ne kiba-kɩtb sẽn kẽed ne yel-wẽndã zug ye. A togsame tɩ b na n kẽnga ne gomdã bʋ-kaoodb taoore, tɩ neb nins sẽn yiis zir-n-be kibarã togs b sẽn paam-a zĩig ninga.Kibarã yii Lɩɩbr ẽnfo

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, miniisr ning sẽn get karen-bi-bãoonesã la buudã goam na kẽng taoorã, tɩ yalsa Toees Komindã Bazɛɛg porvẽesã pʋga, n kõ sor tɩ b sɩng buudã goam koarengo, a yʋʋm 2023 soabã.Yaa buudã goam buudã karen-saamb dãmb ne b karen-biisi, la reezẽo wã, taoor dãmb n wa zĩndi, tɩ b kõ tɩ b sorã, tɩ b na n sɩng tʋʋmdã.Buudã goam koareng sõngda neb nins yʋʋm sẽn loog lekollã, tɩ b tõe n tũnug be n paam bãngre, nn paas b nus tʋʋm pãnga. Yaa rẽ tɩ yʋʋmd fãa ministɛɛr kõt sor tɩ b pakd karen-dotã kʋlense. Yʋʋm 2023 soabã, gom-zug b sẽn tik yaa” Buudã goam kaoreng sõngdame n zabd ne naongã, yo-koglg kaalmã sẽn be tẽns ninsã pʋse”Yaa Miniisr Zozɛɛf Ãndere WEDRAOOGO, n lʋɩ sorã kũun taoore. A koeesã pʋgẽ a wilgame tɩ ned ka tõe n tik a to buud gomd tɩlg ye. A sã n dat n tɩlge, rẽnd t’a tik a buudã gomd n tõog n gãneg a sẽn tar yam nins n dat n tʋma. Yaa rẽ tɩ ministɛɛrã ne a tʋmd-n-taas maood yʋʋmd fãa, n pakd buudã goam karen-doto, sẽn na yɩl n sõng kom-bɩɩb la kom-kasems sẽn ka paam n kẽ-b nasaara wã lekolle, tɩ b karem n tõog n paam bãngr n zã b zagse, la b tʋʋm-noyã.

Miniisrã wilgame tɩ yʋʋm 2023 soabã, b sõnga Fonayɛf tɩ b na n pak kren-dot 3150. Karen-dot 797 yaa kom-bãoones la b na n karme. Karen-dot 2363 yaa kom-bɩɩb la kom-kasems na n karem zĩ-kãense. Yaa karen-biis 94500 n segd n paam kaorengã. Kom-bãoonegã yaa bãmb 23610. Kom-bɩɩbã la kom-kasemsã zĩigẽ, yaa neb 70890 n segd n karem. Yʋʋm 2022 soabã karen-dotã sõor paasame, tɩ bala, yõ-koglg kaalmã kɩtame tɩ lekolls wʋsg page. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ b yãk yam n na n sõng-b tɩ b paam buudã goam kaorengo.Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ karen-dotã sõor ta woto. Ba gosneer sẽn maod tɩ nebã fãa na paam kaorengã, zu-loees ket n be a pʋgẽ. Operatɛɛr rãmbã no-rɛɛs a Sidooni SAWADG rɩka koɛɛg n pẽg gosneere, b sẽn modgde, tɩ buudã goam koareng na kẽng taoorã. A wilgame tɩ Operatɛɛr rãmbã, ne b karen-saamb dãmbã tara zu-loees b tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ.B zu-loeesã pipi yaa tɩ koarengã teed pa sekdã. Yiibu, yaa karen-saamb dãmbã ligd sẽn ka waoogã. Bala, sã n ges karen-saambã sẽn dɩk raarã sõor ning n karemd karen-biisã, ne a ligdã, mikdame tɩ yaa toog ne-a.Tãab soaba, Sãntr dãmbã sõor ka sekd Operatɛɛr dãmbã ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b kot miniisrã t’a ges tɩ b zu-loeesã paam welgre. Miniisrã pʋlm-b lame t’a na yã a tʋmd-n-taasã tɩ b ges b sẽn tõe n maan a soab yãag-b tɩ b paam tɩɩm. Tʋʋmdã baoosge miniisr Zozɛɛf Ãndere WEDRAOOGO tɩ kaaga Sãntr a ye sẽn be Dagum tẽngã pʋgẽ. Zĩ-kãnga, b ges karen-biisã sẽn tar bãngr ninga, la tʋʋma b sẽn paam n bãngrã n tʋmdẽ.Dagum tẽngã bee Toees Komindã pʋga, Bazɛɛg porvẽesẽ wã, Sãntrsɩɩd reezẽo wã soolmẽ.Zɩll KAFAANDO

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso miniisr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã kẽnga Adiisabeb tigsga. Tigsgã pʋga a kosame tɩ b yãk sɩbgr ning Yinyão Afirikɛndã sẽn dɩk n taas Burkĩna Faso ne Mali la Gine wã.Mali miniisr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodo, a Abdulae DIOP, Gine no-rɛɛsa n paas a Olviya ROAMBA sega Komoor miniisr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã, a Doahir DULKAMALE.Seg-taabã pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ YINYÃO Afirikɛnd sẽn sɩbg bãmb tẽnsã, a waa ne zul-oeese, b tʋmd-n-taarã wɛɛngẽ. Bala, sõngr nins b sẽn da segd n paam n tõog n zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã la b sõng nin-buiidã ka paoogdame tɩ b ka tõe n tʋm b sẽn dat ye.A Oliviya ROAMBA kosame tɩ b naag-b sullã tigs-bɛdã pʋse, tɩ b paam n togs zu-loees nins sẽn be.Bala zu,-loɛɛg ning sẽn be wã yaa zu-loe-kasenga. Yaa rẽ tɩ nin-sabls tẽns lagem-n-taarã sula segd n zĩnd b poorẽ n sõng-b tɩ b zab ne bɛɛbã.Burkĩna Faso miniisrã kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tẽns a tãaba sẽn be Tãrãzisẽo wã pʋgẽ wã tara b raabo. B raabã sã n pidi b na n siglga vot tɩ nin-buiidã tõe n yãka b yam naab tɩ bas-yardã kẽng taoore. A kosame tɩ b rɩk b raabã n ning sʋka. Bala, sɩbgrã namsda bãmb n yɩɩd zabrã ne bɛɛbã. Zu-loɛɛgã yaa nin-sabls tẽng zu-loɛɛga, segdame tɩ b tʋm n paam a tɩɩm.A Doahir DULKAMAL yeelame t’a wʋmame, la a na rɩk n taas Komoor tẽngã taoor soaba. A wilgame tɩ wakat sẽn wate, tõeeme tɩ Komoor tẽngã taoor soab sẽn na n deeg nin-sabls tẽnsã sull kaseng taoorã bɩ a kẽng Burkĩna Faso ne Gine, la Mali.Kibarã yii Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã kiba-kɩtb nengẽ

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kadensã yiisa sebr wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, n tẽegd ƐMPESƐR dãmb sẽn da yiis moonegã koɛɛg b naamã rɩkr wakat n wilg tɩ pagtɩ politiki, la nin-zaals lagem-n-taar sula tʋʋm buud toor-toor yalsame. Yaa rẽnda  tɩ YIPESE rãmb wilg tɩ b no-rɩkrã gɩdga bãmb seg-taab kasenga sẽn da segd n zĩnd wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2023 soabã. Rẽ soa, tɩ b yãk yam n na n kẽng bʋ-kaoodb taoore, tɩ b yãk yellã nenga.Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kadensã ra gɩdga SEDEPE pagtɩ wã rãmb me tɩ b kõ maan b seg-taab kaseng naoor 73 soabã, sẽn da segd zĩnd yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2023 soabã ye. La SEDEPE rãmb kɩɩsa noorã n baas n maan b tigsgã. Zĩ-kãng me, ministɛɛr yiisa mooneg koɛɛg wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, n dẽeg b pagtɩ wã nugu. B bẽda rẽ n tẽeg pagti politikã taoor dãmb tɩ noor ning sẽn da rɩk bõn-bɩʋʋg kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, n wilg tɩ pagtɩ rãmbã tʋʋm yalsame wã, a ket n be a zĩigẽ.Tẽegre yaa Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE sẽn wa n deeg naamã bõn-bɩʋʋg kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã la b rɩk noorã.Kibarã yii Lɩɩbrẽfo

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, a Eliize WEDRAOOGO, sull ning sẽn get votã siglg ( SENI) taoor soab kẽnga Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR nengẽ. Seg-taabã poore, a wilgame tɩ SENI wã tʋʋmd ka a wilg votã daar bal ye. A tʋʋmdã yãgr ya a tʋm tɩ b sã n wa wilg tɩ vot n be, bɩ sullã tõog n tʋm tɩ votã tũ sore.SENI wã taoor soab kell n dɩka yʋʋm 2020 la yʋʋm 2021 soabã, tʋʋm kʋmsg sebr n taas Kapitɛnd TARWARE. Tẽngã taoor soab pʋlma tɩ SENI wã taoor dãmb t’a na n tʋmame tɩ yõ-koglgã lebg n wa a zĩigẽ tɩ b tõog n sigl vote. Tẽegre, Burkĩna Faso ra kosa SEDEYAO sullã sõngre, sẽn na n yɩl n tõog n zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã, b sẽn be a pʋgẽ yʋʋm a 7 wã tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa, tɩ b tõog n maan votã sẽoog kiuug yʋʋm 2024 soabã.Kibarã yii AYIBE

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 13 fãa ãndũni wã rãmb maanda Radiyo wã daare. Yɩɩ yʋʋm 2012 soabã, la nasẽo zĩni sullã yãk daar tɩ ya Radiyo rãmbã daare. Rõanda ya a naoor 12 soaba. Gom-zug b sẽn tik n maand-a yaa ” Radiyo, la laafɩ”Sã n ya ne nasẽo zĩni sull ning sẽn get bãngrã baoob la kʋdemdã b sẽn boond tɩ YINESKO wã, radiyo rãmbã, sõngdame tɩ nebã paamd kibaya. A leb n sõngda ne noyã rɩkr ãndũni wã pʋgẽ.YINESKO rãmb wilgame tɩ radiyo wã tõe n yɩɩ sabaab n wa ne zaba, minim sã n ka zĩnd a tall n tʋma pʋgẽ. A tõe n kɩtame tɩ zabã kolg weoogo, a leb n tõe n yɩɩ sabaab tɩ yẽsg sor pake, tɩ wʋm taab tõog n zĩndi.Burkĩna Faso ka yaa Radiyo rãmb sõor taa 150. Yaa lagem-n-taar sula radiyo rãmba, tũudum radiyo rãmba, koosem la gosneem radiyo rãmba. Sula nins sẽn get tẽngã taoor kẽnd tũnugda radyo rãmbã n yiisd koees n sagend nebã, la b sagend-ba.kibarã yii Sɩdwaya

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Miniisr ning sẽn get zagsã meeb la tẽn-gãongã pʋɩɩbo a Mikayilu SIDBE lʋɩɩ taoor n pak tigsga b sẽn zĩnɗ n na n gom no-paal nins b sẽn dɩk n dat kẽes tẽn-gãongã la zagsã meebã zugu. Sɛkã pʋgẽ, b wilga b sẽn na n lebg n sigl tẽn-gãongã la zagsã meeb toto. No-rɩk paallã pʋgẽ, yaa gosneema tʋʋm-noy sẽn get zagsã meebo, n paas neb a taab b sẽn kõ sor tɩ b tõe n pʋɩ tẽn-gãongã b sẽn boond tɩ lotiisma wã. Koeesã sɩngrẽ miniisrã pʋʋsa neb nins fãa sẽn zek b naoor n zĩnd tigsgã pʋga, n na n kelgã, t, bala, yaa tigsg gosneem sẽn sigl n dat tɩ neb nins sẽn be tẽn-gãongã la zagsã meeb pʋg tõog n bãng bũmb ninsg sẽn be a pʋgẽ.Miniisr Mikayilu SIDBE tẽega bũmb nins sẽn kɩt tɩ b bool neb nins sẽn tʋmd meebã la tẽn-gãongã pʋgẽ. A wilgame tɩ yaa yʋʋma noore, tẽn-gãongã la zagsã meeb tʋʋmd sẽn tar zuloeesã n kɩte. A togsame tɩ neb sẽn maan sula tɩ b boond tɩ sosete Yimobilyɛɛr rãmb fãada nebã zĩisi. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tẽn-gãongã koosg sẽn lebg wʋsg kɩtame tɩ sula rãmb ka le tar gũusg-m-meng ye.

No-rɩkr lomoro 057-2008/ AN sapaolg kiuug rasem 20 yʋʋm 2008 soabã, sẽn gomd tẽn-gãongã pʋɩɩb b sẽn na n lebg n sulg n gesã, a kɩtame tɩ sull fãa sẽn tõe n paam tẽn-gãong yalem sẽn ta Ɛgtaar 25. B lebg n gesa sebr nins b sẽn na n dɩke, tɩ noorã sã n wa ka tũud wa sẽn segde, bɩ b remse. No-rɩkrã na n leb n kɩtame tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda zagsã koosg wɛɛngẽ.Miniisr SIDBE wilgame tɩ tʋʋmd ning b sẽn zoe n tɩʋʋs n dat n ges nor-rɩkrã, yaa sẽn na paam yam dãmb sẽn tõe n sõng tɩ zu-loees nins sẽn be tʋʋmdã pʋg kolg weoogo. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n paase, tɩ noy nins b sẽn na n dɩkã tõe n sõnga Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã, tɩ b tõog n kõ sɩd tɩ yʋʋmd sẽn wate zu,-loees ka na n le zĩnd ye. A wilgame tɩ yaa tẽngã taoor soab n wa ne yãabã, la rẽnd tɩ b seg neb nins fãa sẽn be tʋʋmdã pʋga, tɩ b kõ b tagsgo. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tẽn-gãongã segd n yɩɩ sabaab n sõng tɩ tẽngã kẽng taoore, la a tõog n naf a kambã. Tẽegre, depite rãmbã ra rɩka noor b sẽn boond tɩ loa limoro 003-2020/AN yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2020 soabã, n zĩnig depite rãmb sull tɩ b ra get tẽn-gãongã pʋɩɩb la zagsã meeb tʋʋmde. Rẽ fãa yaa sẽn da rat n sõng tɩ wẽg-taabã booge. Depite rãmbã sẽn pa sak n yiis vaeesgã biis tɩ nebã fãa bãngã, yaa noy la gosneem ra rɩk yã n kɩt tɩ minɩisr dãmb nins sẽn get tẽn-gãongã, la zagsã tũ n tũus neb nins sẽn segd n tʋm tẽn-gãongã pʋɩɩb tʋʋma. No-rɩkrã pʋga, no-rɩkr ning b sẽn gomd a saobã ra naagame .Kibarã yii Faso.net

Sẽn na yɩl n gãneg zood la tʋmd-n-taar Burkĩna Faso ne Gine, la Mali sʋka, b tẽnsã taoor dãmb tʋma b minisr dãmb nins sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã tɩ b seg taaba, wao -fugdg kiuug rasem a 8 ne a rasem a 9, n zĩnd n na n segle.Burkĩna Faso a Olviya Rayãgnewẽnd ROAMBA, sẽn get zamaan zẽns zoodã. Gine, ya a Morisanda KƲYATE, la Mali a Abdulae DIOPE. Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR reega ned kam fãa t’a togs a tẽng taoor soab sẽn kõ-a koees ninsi. Sõasgã poore, Kapitɛnd TARWAR wilg-b-la na-kẽnda b sẽn tõe n dɩke, tɩ tẽns a tãabã rãmb sẽn tar saagr ningã tõog n pidi.Miniisr dãmba yã taab pʋgẽ, b tika gom zut sẽn tõe n sõng tɩ tẽns a tãabã sẽn be tãrãzisẽo wã pʋg tõog n zã b tẽnsã, la b tʋm tɩ bas-yard zĩndi. B goma yõ-koglgã, la b tẽnsã taoor kẽnde, la na-kẽnda b nins b sẽn na n dɩk tɩ so-togsã yɩ naana Bamaoko, Gine Konakiri la Waogdgo. B leb n goma b tẽnsã ne ãnduni wã lagem-n-taar sula tʋmd-n-taare.Tẽnsã taoor dãmb pẽgame, tɩ bala, a yaa burkĩndã sor dɩkre. Yaa bũmb sẽn na n sõng nin-buiidã tɩ b tõog n vʋɩɩmd ne laafɩ la wʋm taaba, wa b yaab rãmb sẽn da vʋɩ toto.Seg-taabã baoosgẽ, miniisr dãmbã rɩka noya:Pipi, b na n talla seg-taab n tik nug n wilg tɩ b na n tʋmame tɩ Bamaoko, Gine Konakiri la Waogdg yɩ so-yende, tɩ b nebã vʋɩɩm sõmblem paaseB leb n dɩka na-kẽnda, n na n paas taab pãnga n tõog n zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã. B kell n goma SEDEYAWO , ne Yinyão Afirikɛnd sullã sẽn dɩk sɩbgr nins n taas tẽns a tãabã tɩ b ka tõe n kẽes b toog sullã seg-taab pʋgẽ, la b yaool n gomd yõ-koglg kaalmã, la tẽnsã taoor kẽnde, la nebã vʋɩɩm manegre, b segsã pʋsẽ wã. Zĩ-kãngã tẽns a tãaba miniisr dãmb wilgame tɩ sula wã welgr namsda nin-buiidã, n paas b sẽn da zoe n namsd yõ-koglg kaalem pʋgẽ wã. B na-kẽndrã leb n yaa bũmb sẽn gɩdg tɩ tẽnsã rãmb ka tõe n gãd taab zab n tõog n deeg b tẽnsã ye. B boonda Yinyão Afirikɛend , ne SEDEYAO rãmb tɩ b sõng tẽns nins sẽn be namsg pʋgẽ wã, tɩ b tõog n zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã. B sõng-b tɩ b tõog n tʋm tɩ bas-yard naamã tõog n lebg n sigli. Tẽns a tãaba miniisr dãmb wilga vẽeneg tɩ b rɩka na-kẽndr n na n tʋm ne taab n tõog n yãk sɩbgr nins sẽn be b zugã.Kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 9 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR tɩ lʋɩ Komisɛɛr de Polɩɩs rãmbã seg-kaseng taoore.Sekã pʋgẽ, kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR togsame t’a waame n na n taas Polɩɩs rãmba, la sodaasã fãa koeese. A wilgame tɩ wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ b na n yãka ned kam fãa sẽn segd n zĩnd zĩig ninga. Sẽn paas neba, la zab-teed sõor b sẽn na n yiis n tõog n zab n fãag tẽngã. A kell n boola Sodaasã ne neb nins sẽn kẽes b toog n zabd tẽngã yĩngã ( VDP rãmbã), tɩ b zãag b mens ne welgr buud fãa la b naag taab noor a ye maoorã pʋga.

A leb n wilgame tɩ rẽndame tɩ b toeem na-kẽndrã. Bala, zabr ning pʋg Burkĩna Faso sẽn be wã, yaa bãngr zabre. Segdame tɩ wakat fãa bɩ toeemd na-kẽndre, tɩ bɛ wã me toeemda na-kẽnda. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR paasame tɩ zabrã pʋga, neb ning sẽn ya b sodaag bɩ Polɩɩse, a segd n yãka kʋɩɩm la yaams n yamẽ. Yaa rẽ t’a kot komsɛɛr dãmbã sẽn yaa Polɩɩs rãmbã taoor dãmba, tɩ b yɩ gãn-daado, la b ra yɩ taoor dãmb bal ye. Bala, zabrã, sẽn ya a soabã, b segd n naaga taab n zaba. A kell n kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ ned kam fãa zãag a meng ne ninsaal yam daabã, la ligd gõdgrã, tɩ bala zabrã segd n sɩnga ne Polɩɩs rãmbã la sodaasã buud toor-toore. Yaa rẽ t’a rat tɩ Polɩɩs rãmbã puk b ninnni. Gom-zug b sẽn tik n maan tigsgã yaa “Polɩɩs rãmbã tʋʋmde, sẽn tũud ne nasaara nug tʋʋm te-paalã la yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn kẽnd taoorã” Yaa komsɛɛr dãmb 300 n seg taab tigsgã pʋgẽ. Tigsgã paka a kʋɩlens wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 9 n na n tãag a rasem 10 daare.kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 7 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, a Yinuusa SÃAF sẽn ya nasaara nug tʋʋm-tet-paalã bãng-mit yiisa sɛba. A pipi sebrã boondame tɩ ” nugẽ bãngã fo yaa ãnda?”. Sebr a yiib soabã yaa” nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã sẽn tõe n yɩ sabaab n zãmb kambã ne b roagdbã “. Yaa seb-bãoones sẽn tõe n zãad n kẽnd zĩig fãa. Pipi sebrã yaa vã-nens 30. A kaorengã yaa naana. Bala rũnda-rũnda nebã ka le rat n karem sɛbã wʋsg ye. B rɩka bũmbã fãa n ning nugẽ bãensã pʋse. A Yinuusa SÃAFO. Seb-gʋndã wilgame, tɩ nug n bãngã lebga tɩlae nebã vʋɩɩm pʋgẽ. La segdame tɩ b gũus ne-a zãabo, wall b booge. Wakat ninga, b rɩkda b vɩʋʋgã fãa tɩ ya nugẽ bãngã la b geta.Sebr a yiib soabã, a wilga kambã ne b roagdbã nugẽ bãngã la nasaara nus-tʋʋm-te-paalã, b sẽn tõe n tall n zãmb taabã pʋgẽ. Seb-gʋndã wilg a sebrã pʋg na-nakẽndr ning ned sẽn tõe n tũnug ne nasaara wã nus-tʋʋm-te-paala. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa Ẽntɛgnetã pʋg b sẽn kẽed n zãmb neda, ka rẽ bɩ belg-a n deeg a ligdi. Seb-kãng sagenda nebã tɩ b ra wa rɩk b vɩɩm, bɩ b zak rãmb kibay n ning ẽntɛgnetã zug ye.A Yinuusa SÃAF wilgame t’a sɛbã sõngdame nebã tɩ b tõe n n kogl b mens ne fãadba, neb kẽer sẽn tʋmd ẽntɛgnetã zugu. A yeelame tɩ nebã maan modgr n paam sɛbã. Sɛbã ligd yaa wakir 600. B bee sɛbã kosg zĩisẽ, la neb nins sẽn saad n koosd sɛbã nengẽ. Yɩɩ Doktɛɛr Rasablga WEDRAOOG n yɩ tʋʋmdã ba-yãkdga. Neb nins sẽn yi perfaas maandb yaa Waogdg bʋ-kaood ro-kasengã taoor soab a Arʋʋna YODA, ne a Kiristẽ Napõ.kibarã yii Burkina 24

A Ãdere Zozɛf WEDRAOOGO, minisr ning sẽn get kaorengã la buudã goam na kẽng taoorã paka seg- kaseng kʋɩlens wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 6 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kʋdg soolmẽ wã, tɩ b na n zĩnd n tagse, n dɩk na-kẽndr n kɩt tɩ sʋndã fuug lebg karen-biisã Lekoll futu.Yaa gosneerã taoor soaba, Apolineer KELEM n da yals depite rãmbã taoor sapaolg kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2022 soabã n wilgã, la b yãk yam n na n sɩng a pidisgu. A wakatẽ wã, gosneema taoor soab ra wilgame tɩ karen-biisã sã n yelg b ba-yirã fuugu, a na n sõng-b lame tɩ b bãng b sẽn yitẽ. B rɩka gomdã n kẽes seg-kaseng ning b sẽn boond tɩ Asɩɩs nasnallã pʋga. La b yãabã, yaa wa a Toma SÃNKAR sẽn da wilgi” D rɩ tõnd sẽn kood bũmb ninsã”Yaa neb sẽn tʋmd kaorengã pʋgẽ, ministɛɛr dãmb toor-toor no-rɛsdba, Burkĩna Faso sʋ-wʋgdbã sull neba, nus tʋʋma rãmba, la neb nins sẽn sẽt futã n naag taab tigsgã pʋga.B na n zĩndame n kɩɩs taaba, la b pʋɩ taab yam sẽn na sõng-b tɩ b yãk fuug kõbg ning b sẽn na n dɩk kẽes Lekolsẽ wã, la b kell n ges b sẽn na n yãag neb nins sẽn tʋmd sʋndã wʋgb toto tɩ b tõog n tʋm-a. A Terees KULBALI sẽn be sʋn-wʋgdbã sull pʋg wilgame tɩ b sã n yãk sʋ-wʋgdb 2300 n kõ b zãmsgo, b na n tõogame tɩ goosneer sẽn dat bũmb ningã pidi.Minisr Ãndere Zozɛf WEDRAOOG togsame tɩ yaa neb nins fãa sẽn naag tigsgã pʋg sẽn na n kẽes b toogo, la b tõe n gãneg b sẽn dat bũmb ningã. A kosame tɩ ned kam fãa t’a kõ a tagsgo sẽn na yɩl tɩ b tõog n dɩk yam yãkrã n ning na-kẽnd-sõng zugu.kibarã yii

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, kiris nebã yii Burkĩna Faso wen-n-vɩɩsa a naasã n seg taaba, n maan b tẽeb so-toak Yagm tãngã zugu. Yɩɩ Musoyẽer Gabrɛll SAYAOOGO, Kugpɛɛl tigung roogã ba n lʋɩ pʋs-kasengã taoore. Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, Musoyẽer Mikayɛll KOROTI sẽn ya Pap no-rɛɛs n be Burkĩna Faso ne Evɛk rãmba, la pɛrɛtr dãmb katɛk n paas gosneerã neb kẽer zĩnda be.Yʋʋm 2023 soabã, b tika gom-zu-kãngã n maan Yagem tẽeb so-toakã ” Ne d ma a Maryam sõngo, d yalg koe-noogã moonego”. Pʋʋsgã sɩngrẽ, Labe Zɩll Paskall ZABR sẽn ya Yagem tãnga yel-gɛt rɩka koɛɛg n pʋʋs nin-buiidã ne b waoongo. Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, Waogdg tigung roogã ba me rɩka koɛɛg n pʋs nebã. B wilgame tɩ rõanda Yagem tẽeb so-toakã gom-zug tũuda ne Burkĩna Faso tigung roogã sẽn tẽegd koe-noogã waoong yʋʋm 125.Kagdinall kosa kiris nebã tɩ b pʋʋs n kõ Kagdinall Risaar Wat sẽn ya Gana tẽng a ye Evɛke, n da le ya nin-sabls tẽns Evɛk rãmbã fãa taoor soaba. Tɩ bala, a ra pʋlmame t’a na n lʋɩɩ Yagem tẽeb so-toakã mees-kaseng taoore, la a maana kaalem sapaolg kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã. B le kosame tɩ b tẽeg Pap Farensoa yelle. Bala sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuugã kũum b maana tẽeb so-toak Kõngo la Suudãdiɩɩd soolmã.

Wẽnd gomdã wɛgs pʋgẽ Musoyẽer GabrɛLl SAYAOOG kosa kiris nebã tɩ b tʋm n yɩ vẽevem la yamsem b taabã la tẽngã yĩnga, wala wẽnd gomdã sẽn wilgã. B rɩka makr ne tẽng-bi-tɩrlem kaalmã tʋʋm kom-bɩɩbã sẽn maandã. Makre wala soayã sãongo, kẽnd n pa yals bug-miidẽ wã, la yɛll a taaba. Musoyẽer wilgame tɩ ka rẽ bal la tẽng-n-bi-tɩrlem kaalem ye. B rɩka makr ne manesem kẽer neb wʋsg sẽn maand tʋʋma zĩisẽ. B pa kẽnd tʋʋm pĩnda, b sã n kẽng me b pa tʋʋmd wa sẽn segde. B rata wakat fãa tɩ b kõ-b bũmb tɩ b tʋme. B yaool n yaood-b-la rẽ yĩnga. Musoyẽer SAYAOOG wilgame tɩ tʋʋm-kãense ıa kom-bɩɩbã sẽn tar manesem ningã fãa ka zãr taab ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b kot kiris nebã tɩ b zãag b mens ne rẽ. Bala kiris ned sẽn deeg soob pa segd n kẽes a meng rẽ pʋg ye.Pap no-rɛsã sẽn be Burkĩna Faso wã, Musoyẽer Mikayɛl KOROTI rɩka koɛɛg n wilg a sũ-noog ne kiris nebã sẽn yi wʋsg n wa naag taab sũur a ye wã. A wilgame tɩ yaa sũ-noog ne-a a sẽn naag Burkĩna Faso tigung roogã neb n maan b tẽeb so-toakã.Meesã pʋgẽ b rɩka Burkĩna Faso n gũnug a Maryam sõngo Yagem dĩm-poakã tɩ b gom ne b biig a Zeezi tɩ laafɩ lebg n zĩnd tẽngã. Yɩɩ Ekarsti sakrma waoogre la gilg n ning nebã bark n wa tɩ baas yʋʋm 2023 soabã Yagem tẽeb so-toak kasenga.Zɩll KAFAANDO

Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Miniisr ning sẽn get kibayã kũuni, kʋdemdã; la gilg n ges yel-soalmã, a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG zĩniga sull ning b sẽn yãk t’a na n ges FESPAKO naoor pisi la 28 soabã. Yaa neb pisoob n be-a pʋgẽ.Miniisrã wilgame, tɩ Burkĩna Faso rãmb segd n tʋmame tɩ FESPAKO wã tõog n yɩ sõma wa sẽn segde. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ b yãk yam n zĩnig sullã t’a na n ges tigrã silgu. Miniisrã yeelame t’a kõ-b-la sɩda, yaa rẽ yĩng la b sẽn yãk-bã. A kosa sullã taoor dãmb tɩ b keng b mens n tʋm tɩ Burkĩna Sĩnma wã n kẽng taoore.A wilgame tɩ b segd n tʋmame tɩ dũni wã rãmb bãng tɩ Burkĩna Faso yaa tẽng b sẽn ket n tõe n kẽnd n kaagdẽ. Yaa Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 25 n ta tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 4 la FESPAKO naoor 28 soabã pakd a kʋɩlense. Gom-zug b sẽn yãke, yaa “Nin-sabls tẽns sĩnma wã la b kʋdemdã tʋʋmd laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ”. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tãrãzisẽo wã taoor dãmb rɩka na-kẽnda n na n ges yõ-koglgã la laafɩ wã.Na-kẽndrã rɩkr yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ neb nins sẽn na n wa wã tõog n leb b tẽnsẽ wã ne laafɩ. Yaa ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã seb-gʋnd-kasenga a Fidɛll Aymaar TAMINI la b yãk t’a lʋɩ Fespako wã siglg taoore. Miniisr Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilgame t’a bas-m-yam bee ne neb nins b sẽn yãkã. A kos-b lame tɩ b naag taab n tʋm t’a ministɛɛrã tõog n pids a tʋlsmã.Kibarã yii AYIBE

Wao-fugdg kiuug pipi daare, yʋʋm 2023 soabã, SƖYAO taoor soabã wilgame tɩ b rɩka na-kẽndre, tɩ ned ning sẽn lʋɩ a taabã taoore, sẽn kẽed ne nus-tʋʋma wagsg pʋgẽ, a soab na n paama milyão a yiib la waas koabga, Torfe la bãngr kaset sebre. Ned ning pʋg-a yiib n soabã, yaa milyão la waag koabg la b na n ko-a. Tãab n soabã na n paam milyão la bãngr kaset sebre. Taoor soabã wilgame tɩ zu-loees kẽer la b seg tʋʋmdã siglg pʋgẽ. Bala, neb kẽer ka wa ne teed nins b sẽn segd n naag wagsgã pʋg pĩnd ye. Rẽ yaool n yaa bũmb sẽn tiisd sull ning sẽn get bʋ-kaoorã tʋʋma. A Darmaan TU sẽn ya SƖYAO wã taoor soab wilgame tɩ bũmb nins b sẽn na n tik wagsgã pʋgẽ, yaa teoogã soab sẽn tall bũmb ning n naan-a wã. Yaa teoogã rɩkr sã n ya naana, la a yaa tẽnga taoor soab sẽn na n kõ kũun ningã la rẽ. Yaa Depite rãmbã taoor soab kũuni, la reezẽo rãmbã kũuni, n paas kũun a taab SƖYAO wã yãagdb sẽn na n kõ. Wagsgã yaa wao-fugdgkiuug rasem a 2 soabã la b na n kʋms-a. Tẽns nins sẽn kẽ wagsgã pʋg yaa, Senegalle, Kɛɛde, Nizɛɛre, la Mali.kibarã yii AYIBE

Pap Farensoa zẽka b naoor yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, n sig Repiblik demokaratik di Kongo. Pap sigbã poore, b reng n sõsa ne Kongo gosneerã taoor soaba, n yaool n kẽng tẽngã taoor soab nengẽ. Yɩɩ ne waoore, la tẽns a yiibã tãb-kaoor yɩll la b reeg Pap Farensoa Kongo na-zakẽ wã. A Feligs TISEKEDI zĩnda ne Pap tɩ b sõse. B sõasga pʋga, Kongo tẽngã taoor soab wilga tigung katolik taoor soabã zu-loees nins sẽn be a tẽngã pʋgẽ. Yaa wala Rwanda tẽngã sẽn namsd bãmbã, n paas M23 wã toãtb sẽn namsd a soolmã nebã.Tẽngã taoor soab segb poore, yaa pagtɩ politikã, sula la sula nins sẽn so b mensã, la tẽns a taabã no-rɛɛsdb sẽn be be Kongo, la Pap seg yã. Sõs-kãng pʋga Pap kosa nasaar tẽnsã taoor dãmba, tɩ b bas nin-sabls tẽnsã arzɛk fãabo. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa Kongo. Bala, ka sãnem bok b sẽn segd n wat n yãkd b sãnem ye. Kongo, leb n ka tẽng b sẽn segd n kẽnd n sãamdẽ ye. Pap Farensoa kosa tẽngã neb tɩ b zems taaba. Bala, b so-taokã yaa sẽn na n kos nin-sabls tẽns neb tɩ b modg n wʋm-taaba. Pap wilgame tɩ b kẽnda b so-toakã a Zeezi yʋʋr yĩnga. B kẽngame n na kos tɩ wʋm-taab tɩ laafɩ zĩnd tẽnsã pʋse. B wilgame tɩ Kongo yaa bark tẽnga, la a na yɩɩ zĩig nin-sabls tẽnsã rãmb sẽn na n tik n kẽng taoore.Wao-fugdg kiuug pipi daarã Pap Farensao na n talla mens-kasenga, tɩ neb milyõ katɛk zĩnd n kelg Wẽnd gomdã. Rẽ poore pPap na n sõsa ne kom-bɩɩbã.kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soab a Apolineer KELEM rɩka sɩlga n kẽng Bamako. A sẽn ta, yaa Mali sɩlg yirã, yaa gosneerã taoor soaba a Sogɛll MAEGA n seg-a. Mali kẽndã ya b sẽn na n zĩnd ne taab n tʋm tɩ Burkĩna Faso ne Mali zoodã taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ, la b tʋm tɩ yõ-koglgã paam pãng n paase. Ka pipi, Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soab sẽn sig Mali soolmẽ wã ye. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã, a kẽnga Mali n tɩ sãag Risi. Burkĩna Faso ne Mali tʋmd-n-taarã tara taoor kẽnde. Sẽn sɩng ne bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2022 soabã Mpsr 1 na-kʋdg a Poll Ãari Sãndaogo DAMIB ra kẽngame tɩ b sõs tẽns a yiibã yõ-koglg yelle. Mpsr sullã seen lub a Poll Ãari Sãandaoog DAMIB tɩ Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, reeg n wa ne Mpsr 2 bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, a pipi so-taok yɩɩ Mali sapaolg kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 2022 soabã. Rẽ loogr poore, tãrazisẽo wã Depite rãmb taoor soab a Wʋsmaan BUGMA me kẽnga Mali yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2022 soabã. Gosneerã taoor soab kẽnd wilgdame tɩ tẽns a yiibã tʋmd-n-taar paamda pãng n paasdẽ. Sẽn kẽed ne b tʋmd-n-taarã wɛɛngẽ,yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 12 ne a 13 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Mali rãmb sõnga Burkĩna Faso sodaar wɛɛngẽ tɩ b tõog n paam pagb 66 b sẽn da yõk Arbĩnda wã kibare. Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soab kẽnd zemsa ne wakat ning tẽngã taoor dãmb sẽn kõ Fãrens sodaasã kiuug tɩ b yi la b bas b tẽngã. Sã n ya ne Mali rãmbã, yɩɩ yʋʋm 2022 soabã pʋgẽ la bãmb ra kɩt tɩ Fãrens sodaasã loog la b bas b tẽngã.Kibarã yii Libr ẽfo

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2023 soabã. Yaa nus-tʋʋm buud toor-toor taoor sẽn be b tẽnsã pʋsẽ n seg taaba, n na n zĩnig sull kaseng t’a tigim b soolmã pʋgẽ nus-tʋʋm rãmb b sẽn boond tɩ reezo wã. Tẽns wʋsg nus-tʋʋm sula taoor rãmb zẽka b naoore, n wa tɩ b na n bale, n bao yam la bãngr n paas taaba. Yaa Burkĩna Faso rãmba, miniisr ning sẽn get nus-tʋʋma la leebgã, a Sɛrz Poda n lʋɩ taoore,tɩ seg taabã pak a kʋɩlense.

Miniisrã koees pʋgẽ, a pẽga neb sãambã sẽn zẽk b naoor n wa Burkĩna Faso n wa tigsgã. A wilgame tɩ b yam yãkr yaa bũmb sẽn segde. Bala, a na n sõng-b lame tɩ b pʋɩ taab bãngr buud toor-toore, sẽn kẽed ne nusã tʋʋm yidgr wɛɛngẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ miniisr Sɛrz Poda kot neb nins sẽn na n zĩnd tigsgã pʋg tɩ b pelg n pʋs n dɩk na-kẽnda sẽn tõe n sõng tɩ sull ning b sẽn dat n zĩnigã tõog n naf b tẽnsã rãmba. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ sul-kãngã ka sull sẽn wa n paas sula sõor ye. A yaa sull sẽn na n sõng tɩ nusã tʋmtʋmdbã sẽn be IYEMOA tẽnsã pʋs tõog n paam tags-yende, la b tʋm tɩ nusã tʋʋm kẽng taoore.Ned ning sẽn be IYEMOA sulã pʋg n get tʋʋma la tʋmd-n-toorã rãmba, a Poll KOFI pẽga yam-yãkrã. A kosmae tɩ b sẽn na n yãk neb nins tɩ b lʋɩ taoorã sak n tʋm ne pʋ-peelem tɩ sullã tõog n naf tẽnsã. A kell n pʋlmame tɩ IYEMOA rãmb na n yãaga nus-tʋʋmã rãmba, b yam-yãkra pʋgẽ.Burkĩna Faso nus-tʋʋmã taoor soab a Zɛrmɛnd KÕMPAOR pʋʋsa neb nins fãa sẽn zẽk b naoor n wa zĩnd tigsgã pʋgẽ wã barka. A wilgame tɩ yaa kõ sɩd tʋʋm la b sẽn tʋma. Bala, Burkĩna Faso sẽn be nug ningã, b na-kẽndrã wilgame tɩ ya b sẽn na n gãd taab nus la b na n tõog n kẽng taoore. A wilgame tɩ yaa IYEMOA tẽnsã nus tʋʋm rãmb sẽn na n tʋm ne taab la b tẽnsã na n paam yidgri. A pʋʋsa IYEMOA tẽns a nii yã nus-tʋʋm taoor dãmba, tɩ bala, tũu ne b fãa yãabo, la sullã sẽn tõog n na n zĩindã. A pʋʋsa IYEMOA komisẽo wã rãmb barka, b yãagrã yĩnga. A wilgame tɩ sullã pipi tʋʋmde yaa tẽns a nii wã nus-tʋm-ɖmdb na tõog n gãd taaba, tɩ zĩig ning pãngã sẽn be wã tõog n yãag zĩig ninga pãngã sẽn ka waoogã.

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, neb ka tɛk ra pida Sãnkaryaare, tɩ bug-zõ-sablg zẽkdẽ. Ba f sã n da be zĩ-zãagẽ, f nee bug-zõosã. Yɩɩ sũ-sãang ne lɛɛbdbã. Zĩiga pʋgẽ , ned kam fãa ra yasame t’a neng gãnem. Lɛɛbdb kẽer paama raoodo, n da kẽed ne mobil la tagsi moto rãmb n wʋkd b teed n yita. Lɛɛbdb kẽer sẽn da zoet n yuugd n wʋkd b teedã, a ra tiisda Sapɛɛr põmpiye wã tʋʋmde. Bala, b ra ka tõe n paam weer n kẽ n kiis bugmã ye.Zĩig pʋgẽ lɛɛbdb kẽer ra bee sũ-sãang pʋgẽ. Bi-bɩɩg a ye meng n da tʋlg t’a na n kẽ bugmã pʋg ne pãng n wʋk a teedo. La nebã ne polɩɩs rãmbã sẽn da be zĩigẽ wã tõogame t’a ka kẽ ye. Zĩigã ra wulumsa ne yãbre. Sãangã talla pãnga. Su-sãams ne sũ-puurã ra naaga taaba. Lɛɛbdb kẽer sẽn da be zĩigã pʋgẽ getame tɩ bugum sodaas ka tʋʋl ne bugmã kisg ye. Kẽer me ra pẽgd-b lame la b kengd b pelse. Sẽn lebg nebã fãa zu-loɛɛgã, kom-bɩɩb kẽer yãka yam n sõngd nebã n kiisd bugmã. Polɩɩs rãmbã n da bee zĩig pʋgẽ wã gɩdgd nebã tɩ b ra kolg ye . Koees vẽeneg nan ka yi n wilg bũmb ning sẽn wa ne bugmã tɩ sãangã zĩndã ye. La vũn-vũnã rãmb wilgame tɩ yaa bõn-pusdum b sẽn tar n tʋmd ne sãnmã zĩigẽ, la b ra bĩng roog a yembr pʋga. Ya ayẽ n pusi, n yɩ sabaab n wa ne yel-beedã. a bũmb ning b sẽn tõe n gãde, yaa Poɩɩs rãmb nins sẽn get vaeesgã sẽn na n wa yiis koɛɛg n wilg la b tõe n gãde. Gosneem yiisa koɛɛg n wilg tɩ yõor ka yi ye, la sãangã yɩɩ wʋsgo.Bala,yaa butigs 700 bɩ 800 la bugmã sãam yã.Kibarã yii Faso.net
