Sẽn tũ ne a Yɩbrayɩɩma MAEGA sẽn gʋls Fesbukã zug n wilg t’a Zefɩɩrẽ GƐBRE ne Fãrens no-rɛɛs a Liuk Halaad rɩka sɩlg n kẽng Paari, rẽ me wakat ning Kodenvaar tẽngã taoor saob sẽn wa n be Fãrens soolmẽ wã, neb wʋsg rɩk kibarã n pʋɩ. YIPESE pagtɩ wã sull ning sẽn get kibayã kũun yiisa mooneg koɛɛg n wilg tɩ b pagtɩ wã taoor soab sõangdb rɩgla beegr sebr sari taoore. B wilgame t’a Yɩbrayɩɩm MAEGA, Faesall NINKƐƐMA, a Sansã KÃMBU, la a Salf NINKƐƐM rẽgma a Zefɩɩrẽ GƐBRE yʋʋre.Beegrt sebrã pʋga b kosa bʋ-kaood roogã tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda n ges neb nins sẽn be tẽns a taab la b maand tʋʋmd sẽn pa sakdã yelle.Sẽn pʋgde b kosame tɩ b rɩk na-kẽndr ne Fesbuk rãmba tɩ neb nins sẽn pʋɩt zir-n-be kibay la sulunsugd buud toor-toore, sẽn ka wat ne manegrã, b rãmbã kolg n leok bʋ-kaoodbã taoore.IPESE rãmb wilgame tɩ b kõo Burkĩna Faso bʋ-kaood roogã sɩda, yaa rẽ tɩ b kot tɩ sari tõog n tʋm tɩ neb nins sẽn sãamd b taabã yʋyã paam sɩbgre.Kibarã yii Faso.net

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soaba, kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sega Burkĩna Faso bʋ-kaood sõangdbã lagem-n-taar sull kasenga. Yaa Metr Sɛka NEAMBA n lʋɩ b taoore, tɩ b kẽng n tɩ wilg tɩ b bee tẽngã taoor soab poorẽ. Bala, a rɩk a pãngã fãa n zabd ne yõ-koglg kaalmã, la b na n kell n sõng-a lame t’a tõog n zã tãrãzisẽo wã wa sẽn segde.Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Fãrens rãmb boola b no-rɛɛsã sẽn be Burkĩna Faso wã. Yɩɩ mooneg koɛɛg sẽn yi Fãrens kibay kũun roog b sẽn boond tɩ AFP pʋga la AYIBE rãmb paam kibarã.Moonegã koɛɛg pʋga Fãrens wilgame tɩ b yãka yam n na bool a Lik Halaad Paari, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n kelg bũmb ning sẽn be Burkĩna Faso ne Fãrens zoodã pʋgẽ. Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 23 sẽn loogã Burkĩna Faso gosneem no-rɛɛsã yii ƐRTEBE televisẽo wã zug n gom yel-kãng zugu. A ra wilgame tɩ rasem a yopoe kãngã pʋgẽ, Fãrens no-rɛɛs a Liuk Halaad na n loogame. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 20 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso rãmb ra gʋlsa sebr n kos Fãrens ministɛɛr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽnsã zood yell n kos tɩ b tek a Liuk Halaade, tɩ bala, b pa tar bas-m-yam ne-a ye.Kibarã yii lɩɩbr ẽnfo

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, sull ning sẽn get kibayã kũun na tũ sor wala sẽn segdã, rãmb zẽk b naoor n tɩ sega Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE. Sullã taoor dãmb tɩ wilgamz tɩ ya b sẽn dat n tʋm tʋʋm nins kibayã kɩsg na kẽng Burkĩna Faso wã, la b kos tẽngã taoor soab t’a yãag-ba.SEYƐSE wã taoor soab a Abdulaziz BAMOOG togsame tɩ b sõasgã ne taabã, yaa sẽn na wilg b tʋʋm-noorã taoor dãmba, la b pʋʋs Kapitɛndã barka a sẽn kẽes a toog tɩ zu-loees nins sẽn da be SEYƐSE wã paam welgrã. A wilgaame tɩ zu-loɛɛgã sẽn welg tɛka, b maanda b pãng sẽn tõe, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ tʋʋmdã tõog n kẽng taoor wala sẽn segde.A Abdulaziz BAMOOG kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ b tʋʋmdã ne kibayã kũun rot sɩgame. Yaa rẽ tɩ b kell n kos tẽngã taoor soab t’a sõng kibayã kũun ro-bɛdã tɩ b tõog n zab ne zir-n-be kibayã. La b ra wa yiis koees sẽn n tõe n wa ne welgr ye. Sẽn pʋgde, SEYƐSE taoor soabã goma ẽntɛgnetã yelle. A wilgame tɩ b na n dɩka na-kẽnda tɩ ned sã n na n zẽk a koeese, bɩ a tũ soaya, la a ra wa ne welgre, bɩ paoor ye.SEYƐSE taoor soabã togsame tɩ tʋʋm nins b sẽn tɩʋʋsã pʋgẽ,b ratame tɩ tẽngã taoor soab yãag-ba, tɩ b tʋʋmdã wom biisi. Tẽngã taoor soab kelg-a-la sõma. A kelga b sẽn dat n tʋm tʋʋm nins n yãag kiba-kɩtbã. Kelgrã poore, a kõ-b-la saglse. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa, yaa zab ne nin-wẽnsã wɛɛngẽ.kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 18 sẽn loogã, gosneem rasem a yopoe-poe seg-taabã pʋgẽ, la b yãk a ABasage Abraham t’a reeg yɩɩn-yɩɩnd a Sayidu ZÃONGO, tɩ b boond t’a ZEDƐS zĩiga, n na n kẽng ne Senaza wã tʋʋm taoore. Yaa rẽ tɩ yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuugã rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã miniisr ning sẽn get kibaya la kʋdemdã n paas gilg-n-ges yel-soalmã tʋm a derktɛɛr de kabĩne wã, a Galip SOME t’a tɩ zĩnig-a.Sig-n-kɩs-taoor soab paallã, maana Senaza zakã pʋga. Reem-rɛɛmdb ka tɛk zẽka b naoor n zĩnd zĩigẽ wã. Miniisr Rĩmtallba Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG ka tõog n zẽk a naoor ye. A tʋm a Galip SOME t’a kẽng n zĩndi, tɩ taoor soab sigdã rɩk sɛbã n ning taoor soab paalgã, a ABASAGE Abraham nugẽ. A Galip SOME wilgame tɩ yaa yʋʋm a yoobe, la kiis sẽn ta a tã n digd a pʋgẽ, la a ZEDƐS zĩnd Senaza tʋʋm-noorã taoore. A tʋma tʋʋm wʋsgo, hal tɩ b pẽgda, la nasaar tʋʋmd yaa woto. Yaa rẽ, t’a pʋʋsd-a ne neb nins fãa sẽn naag taab n tʋm yʋʋm a yoobã pʋgẽ barka. A ZEDƐS koees pʋgẽ, a wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, la a na n kulame n tɩ vʋʋse, la a ka rat n yeel t’a na n basa yɩɩlã ye. A wilgame tɩ sẽn wa n ya wakat ning fãa, sã n mik tɩ Senaza taoor soabã rata sõngre, a segl n saame, n na n sõng-a.Taoor soab paallã, koees pʋgẽ, a wilgame t’a me na n kell kosa a ZEDƐS t’a yãag-a, tɩ bala, b sẽn yãk-a t’a na n lʋɩ tʋʋm-noorã taoorã, yaa bãmb a reem-rɛɛmdbã fãa paoongo.

A wilgame miniisrã bool-a lame n togs t’a gãnega tʋʋma sõor sẽn ta bãmb pis-tã n dat t’a tʋm Senaza, la reemã pʋgẽ zĩis a taabã paam taoor kẽnde. La miniisrã kotame t’a ra gũs ye, tɩ ka le ya gõeem wakat ye. Abraham yeelame : «  yõk-m n lub raagẽ wã, ya m ka pãnga, la vuud-m n yuugd raagã, yẽ ya m ka ned manesem ». Rẽ wã, a kotame tɩ reem-rɛɛmdbã kẽes b toog n sõng-a. Sẽn kẽed ne tẽngã zãadb sẽn kos tɩ tʋm-tʋmdbã kẽes b toog n sõng-b ne wakɩ-bell koabg zug tɩ b yao VEDPE rãmbã, Senaza taoor soab paalgã wilgame t’a na n yãka a kiuugã ligd pʋgẽ kiuug fãa wakɩre, kiuug piig la a yiib pʋgẽ, n kõ tɩ b sõng n zab ne bɛɛbã. Tʋʋmdã maane ne sũ-noogo, la yamleoog ne a ZEDƐS la a ABasage Abraham sʋka.Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Wakat sẽn looge, kiba-kɩtb roog b sẽn boond tɩ AYIBE rãmb yiisa kibar n wilg tɩ gosneer kõo Fãrens sodaasã sẽn be Kambõesẽ wã kiuug a ye tɩ b loog la b bas Burkĩna Faso. Sẽn na yɩl n dɩk vẽenem n taas nin-buiidã, Gosneer no-rɛɛsã sẽn ya miniisr Emanwɛll Rĩmtalba WEDRAOOGO kẽnga ƐRTEBE televisẽoẽ wã yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 23 wĩntoog wakat a yembrã kibay kũun pʋgẽ n tɩ gome.A Koeesã pʋgẽ, a wilgame tɩ gosneer sẽn yãk yam n yals Burkĩna Faso ne Farẽns sodaasã tʋʋmd-n-taarã yaa sẽn na tik b Burkĩndã n tõog n zab n fãag tẽngã. A togsame tɩ yaa nug tikr n da be Burkĩna Faso ne Farẽns sʋk sodaarã wɛɛngẽ, nug tikrã no-rɩkr 16 soabã ra wilgame tɩ nug tikrã sã n wa segd n lebg n maange, tɩ mikame tɩ tẽngã taoor dãmb pa na n kẽng taoore, b kõta sodaasã kiuug tɩ b segl n loog la b bas tẽngã. Rẽnd yaa nug-tikrã no-rɩkr 16 soabã la b tik yã.A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ vɩʋʋg pa ka n zĩndi, sẽn tũ ne Fãrens sodaasã loogr ye. Vɩʋʋg sẽn tõe n zĩndi, sẽn kẽed ne zab ne nin-wẽnsã wɛɛngẽ, yaa Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã sẽn na n bas b tẽngã. Miniisr Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ Fãrens rãmbã gomda wakat fãa n wilgd b tẽngã sẽn kẽesda a meng toto Sayɛllã fãagr la Burkĩna Faso tẽngã fãagre. Yaa rẽ tɩ tãr̃zisẽo wã taoor dãmb yãk yam n na n kɩt tɩ burkĩn-bi wã kõ b mens n tõog n deeg tẽngã. Kõ m mengã yaa nin-buiidã sẽn na n pa sodaasã ne VDP rãmbã poorẽ. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ b tara tẽeb tɩ Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã sɩd kõ b mens n na zab n fãag b tẽngã. Goosneem taoor soabã wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso ket n teega a tʋmd-n-taasã, la b zo-rãmbã sõngre, zab-teed wɛɛngẽ, sẽn na yɩl n tõog n kõ sodaasã ne VDP rãmbã.Kibarã yii Faso.net

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 20 yʋʋm 2023 soabã lagem-n-taar sula buud toor-toor sẽn zabd n dat tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsã tõog n yi Fãrens yembdã pʋg sega taab Waogdg Palaasdelanasẽo n na n gom tẽngã laafɩ goama, la nin-buiidã na zems-taaba, la b wilg tɩ b bee tẽngã taoor soaba Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR poorẽ. Rẽ poore, yaa Fãrens Ãmbasaadã, a Liuk ALAADE, Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmb sẽn wilg tɩ b ka le rat-a,  la b tek ned a to, tɩ Fãrens yeel t’a sẽn be ka n tʋmdẽ wã nafda bãmbã, yaa rẽ n zab sula buud toor-toore, tɩ b yeel tɩ Fãrens rat n modga Burkĩna Faso n maan a sẽn date, la bãmb ka sak ye. B ratame tɩ Fãrens loog ne a sodaasã sẽn be Kãmbõensẽ wã. Fãrens loogrã me ka yãk raar ye. B yeelame tɩ sẽn sɩng ne rũndã tɛka, b na n maoome n tãag  Fãrens ne  a sodaasã loogre. Wakat sẽn wate, d na kõ-y vẽenem tɩ yɩɩg woto.

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Tãrãzisẽo wã depite rãmb taoor saob sega Burkĩna Faso neb nins fãa sẽn deng-a n zĩnd Asãmble wã taoore. Depite kʋd nins sẽn zẽk b naoor n kẽng n zĩnd tɩ b yã taabã, yɩ a Rok Mark Kiristẽ KABOORE, a Muusa SANOOGO, Abdul Kadɛɛr SISE, Abubakar TUGUYENI, Alasãn Bala SAKÃNDE, a Sugalo Apolineer WATARA, a Melge TARWARE, la a Arsɛnd YE. Rẽnd ra segdame t’a seg-ba, n paam yam la bãngr bilf n tõog n zã Asãmble wã. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ b sẽn zĩnig ƐMPEYƐSƐR a yiib n soabã depite rãmb sẽn be be tɛka, seg-kãngã nan ka zĩnd ye. A Melge TARWARE, depite kʋda no-rɛɛs rɩka koɛɛg n pẽg tãrãzisẽo depite rãmb taoor soaba, a yam yãkrã yĩnga. A wilgame tɩ depite kʋdã na n kell n yãag-a-la tʋʋma pʋga t’a tõog n tʋm tɩ zems wala sẽn segde.kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Dogtɛɛr Lasina SẼEMPOOR sẽn ya kʋdemde, la vaees-n-bao n bãng soab b sẽn boond tɩ Arkeoloogã maana a sɛb a yiib zulukri. Pipi sebrã gomda Laglg naab a Ãbg vʋɩɩmã sẽn yɩ a soaba.Seb-gʋndã wilgame tɩ Laglnaab rɩɩ naamã yʋʋm pis-nu. A tʋma Meeriẽ wã, n da sõngd neb tɩ b gʋlsd b kãadem sɛba, la b gʋlsd b kamb rogem sɛba. A yɩɩ rog-n-mik nab sẽn da tar reem-rɛɛmdba, la a meng ra reemdẽ. Na-kẽnd ning a sẽn da rɩkã, yaa bũmb sẽn ka waoog tõnd rog-n-mik naamã pʋgẽ. A yɩɩ ned sẽn tall sɛb wʋsgo, la a mengã ka raem ye. A ra togsdame tɩ b kelgd n gʋlsdẽ. Nasaara wã zʋg-wẽng sẽn wa n deegd zĩigã, Laglnaab a Ãbg yeelame:” zĩm-bedr suta bẽgdẽ tɩ koom ka sa ye”. Seb-kãng pʋga, a togs Laglaan ne b rãmb sẽn tʋm n yãag tõnd rog-n-mikã, wala a Kistokõebre, a Hado Gorgo Leoontindi, la a Zugnanzagemda… A vẽnegame tɩ ya a na-kẽndrã sẽn yɩ sõma wã, n kɩt t’a gʋls sebrã n na n pẽg-a.

Seb-gʋndã wilgame tɩ tẽng-n-biig sã n be a tẽngẽ n ka kẽes a meng a tẽngã vʋɩɩm manegr wɛɛngẽ, tẽng-n-bi-kãng yõoda pa waoog ye. Rẽ so t’a pɩɩs roog n na n mong nang bʋʋm. A kẽnga taoor n wilg t’a sẽn ka rat n yɩ ned sẽn ka tar yõod ne a ba-yirã n kɩt t’a kẽes a toog n gʋls sebã. Ya a sebr a yoob ne a yopoe n soab la a sẽn nan yiisã. A ra zoe n gʋlsa sebr n gom naab a Wubr yelle. N lebg n gʋls a to n gom naab a Wubr biig a Bɩlg yelle. Sebrã a yoob soabã wilgame tɩ Laglg naaba a Ãbg sẽn yɩɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã wilgda. Sebrã tara seb-vã-nens 166. Seb-gʋndã gomda a sẽn yã Laglg naab a Ãbg ne yãad nini. Bala a yii Kodenvoaar n wa zĩnd Laglẽ sakã. A zĩnda Laglgẽ yʋʋm 1974, n ta yʋʋm 1980. Sebr a yiib soabã, yʋʋm 1928 ne yʋʋm 1982, a wilgda Laglg naaba a Ãbg sẽn da maand rog-n-mik soalma, la b ra ya reem-rɛɛma. sebrã pʋga a wilgamre tɩ Laglg naab yɩɩ rog-n-mikã pʋgẽ bʋ-kaooda. Bala, b sõngame tɩ zu-loees wʋsg paam tɩɩm. A Lasina Sẽmpoor wilgame tɩ Laglg naab a Ãbg yɩɩ seb-gʋnda, ba b sã n da kɩtdame tɩ neb gʋsld n kõt-ba. B sɛb kẽer yi b kaalmã poore. Rẽ n so t’a wilg tɩ b yaa kʋdemdã wilgda. A seb-gʋnda kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ n waoog Laglgnaab sẽn tʋm tʋʋm nins kʋdemdã wɛɛngẽ wã, la a gʋls sebrã b yʋʋr yĩnga. Sebr a yiib n soabã yaa Waogdg rĩungã yell la a gomda. A pʋd seb-kãng tɩ “Waogdgo Rĩungã na-tẽnga”. Sebr a yopoe n soaba, Gomda waogd rĩunga na-tẽnga, seb-gãng soabã, a pʋɩ-a-la saks a tãabo. Pipi sakã wilgda neb nins sẽn da zĩnd Waogdg hal yʋʋm sẽn kaoose, la sẽn ket n vʋɩ-b Waogdg rũnda. Sak a yiib soabã gomda naab a Wubr sẽn ya a soaba, la b sẽn zĩnig Waogd rĩungã yelle. La a wilgd Waogdgã sẽn dat n yeel t’a soaba. Sak a tãab soabã, wilgda Waogdg sagsã sẽn sɩng toto, la sak sɩngdb sẽn yitẽ, la b sẽn da maand a soab b rog-n-mik wɛɛngẽ.Doktɛɛr Lasina SẼEMPOOR wilgame tɩ yaa yʋʋm pisi la zak la a rɩk n maan vaeesg Waodg rĩungã zugi. Yaa rẽ tɩ seb-kãng pʋgã a wilgd neb buud toor-toor sẽn kẽ Waogdgo, la b waoongã sẽn yɩ a soaba. A wilgame tɩ b sã n tũ sebrã sõma, b na n yãame tɩ zamaan dãmbã buud toor-toor bee a pʋgẽ, wala kugã peesg zamaanẽ b sẽn boond tɩ pɛɛr taye wã, n tɩ tãag tõnd sẽn be zamaan ning pʋg rũnda wã.

A Mumina Serif SY sẽn ya kiba-kɩt n le yaa seb-gʋnda, n paas a Ãndere Ezɛnd YILBƲƲD, sẽn ya Akademi de waga taoor soaba la Radɩyo dɛ Ekoll taoor soabã , sẽn maan sebrã perfaasã pẽga a Lasina SẼEMPOOR a tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ seb-kãensã buudã sõngda kom-yaoobã wʋsgo. B kell n kosa seb-gʋndã t’a kẽng taoor ne a tʋʋmdã sẽn na yɩl tɩ Burkĩna Faso tẽns a taabã me tõog n bãng b sɩngre. INSS taoor soabã la solem-tãood b sẽn boond t’a KPG me zĩnda tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ. Kell n yɩɩ wakat b sẽn dɩk Dogtɛɛr Lasina SẼEMPOOR sẽn gʋls sɛb n taas INSS taoor soabã, a Mutafa GOMYĨMBU. Seb-gʋndã wilgame t’a kʋmsa a sẽn gʋls sɛb nins tɩ loogã vuks a tã n na n dɩk n kõ tɩ ning Biblotɛk rãmb pig pʋgẽ, tɩ karen-biig ning sẽn wa n dat n bao bãngr bɩ a tõe n paam n karme.Sebr ning sẽn gomd Laglnaab a Ãbg yellã la sɛb nu wã sẽn lebg n sigã bãmb ligdã yaa wakɩr 1000. La sebr ning sẽn gomd Waogdg rĩungã yaa wakɩr 2000, la sã n yaa seb-gʋndã nug la b na n da-a, yaa wakɩr 1500. Karen-biig Karen-saamb sã n deeg n koose, yaa 1500 la sebrã soab reegda, tɩ sẽn koos-a wã soog 500.

Sebr ning sẽn gomd Laglnaab a Ãbg yellã ya a Pɛɛr BALIMA Pormolãng tʋʋm-noor soaba, sẽn get buudã goam seb-gʋndbã sɛb yiisgu, n yiis-a. Yaa rẽ t’a Lasina SẼEMPOOR bool-a t’a zẽk naoor n zĩnd sʋka.Koeesã rɩkr pʋgẽ, b kõ-a-la sore, t’a rɩk koɛɛga, n togs tɩ neb nins sẽn gʋlsd sɛb tɩ buudã goam be b pʋsẽ wã, b rãmbã sã n mi n na n gʋls bɩ b pẽneg buudã seb-gʋndb tɩ b sõng-b gʋlsgã no-tũuri.A Pɛɛr BALIMA wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, ne ned sẽn ya karen-saam-kasenga, n wa yãk yam n dat n dɩk buudã n kẽes sʋka. Yaa rẽ t’a kotẽ, tɩ ned buud fãa sẽn na n gʋls ne moorã, bɩ a kos tɩ b sõng-a ne gʋlsg moorã gʋlsg no-tũuri, t’a sõngdame tɩ buudã goam kẽnd taoore. Yɩɩ zama ka tɛk n zẽk b naoor n zĩnd zĩigẽ. Wẽnd na kõ seb-gʋndã raood la tõog t’a kẽng taoor ne a yam-yãkrã.

Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Etamazoora yiisa mooneg koɛɛg n kos Burkĩna Faso neb nins sẽn tar mobill bɛdã, tɩ b kẽes b toog n sõng-b tɩ b tõog n tall koodã n tɩ kõ tẽns nins pʋs sẽn rɩɩbã sẽn ka be wã. Etamazoorã mooneg koɛɛg pʋgẽ b kosa tɩ neb nins sẽn tõe n kõ zaalem bɩ b kõ-ba, sẽn pa tõe n kõ-b zaalmã me, bɩ b ges n boog ligdã, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b paam n tɩ fãag b saam-biisã sẽn be rɩɩbã raab pʋgẽ wã. Sodaasã taoor dãmb wilgame tɩ b kɩsa sɩd ne nebã, la b kotẽ tɩ b kell n tall ninbãan-zoeer ne b saambiisã sẽn be namsg pʋgẽ wã.Tẽegre, tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soab sẽn seg politikã taoor dãmb wakat sẽn loogã, a ra wilgame tɩ lɛɛdb kẽer ka tar ninbãan-zoeer ne neb nins sẽn be namsg pʋgẽ wã ye. A koeesã loogr poore , neb wʋsg yãka yam n sɩd kẽes b mens n sõngdẽ. Tẽnga taoor soab pẽga sõangdbã, a sẽn n wa n dɩkd tẽnga soog-m-meng tig tẽegr koeesã pʋgẽ.Etamazoor rãmb wilga b mooneg koɛɛg pʋg tɩ b teega nin-buiidã sõngre, n na n paam tɩ rɩɩbã ta tẽns nins sẽn be raabã pʋgẽ wã.kibarã yii libr ẽfo

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sega karen-bi-bɛdã, Yinivɛrsite Zozɛɛf Ki Zerbo sẽn be Waogdgã.Yaa sẽn wa n zems zaabr wakat a tãab sẽn loog minit 30 la tẽngã taoor soab kẽ ro-kaseng ning a sẽn zĩnd n sõs ne karen-biisã. Yɩɩ ne waoor la kilsg la karen-bi-bɛdã reeg-a. Gosneem miniisr dãmb kẽer wala miniisr ning sẽn get karen-bi-bɛdã, ne miniisr ning sẽn get nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã, n paas minisr ning sẽn get kibayã kũuni.Nand tɩ tigsgã sɩnge, Kapitɛnd TARWAR kosame tɩ b yik n yals bilf n tẽeg neb nins sẽn maan kaalem sẽn tũ ne yõ-koglg kaalmã.Rẽ poore a rɩka koɛɛg n pʋʋs karen-bi-bɛdã la a wilg tɩ yaa tɩlae t’a wa sõs ne-ba sẽn na yɩl tɩ b pʋɩ taab yam tãrãzisẽo wã zã wɛɛngẽ. A koeesã poore, karen-bi-bɛdã paama sor n sʋgs sʋgs nins b sẽn tare, tɩ tẽngã taoor soab leok-ba.Sogsgã leoob pʋgẽ, pipi yaa zu-loees nins sẽn be Burkĩna Faso Yinivɛrsite rãmbã pʋsẽ wã. Zĩ-kãnga, a wilgame tɩ na-kẽnda la b na n dɩk n lebg n sigl kaorengã. Na-kẽnd kãng tõe n sõngame tɩ b lebg n ges kaoreng ning b sẽn na n dɩk n taas karen-biisã, la na-kẽnda a taab me n be tɩ b tõe n maan t’a sõng n zab ne kom-bɩɩbã tʋʋm kaolgo. Na-kẽnd kãng sã n tõog n sigli, karen-biis nins sẽn paam bakã bãngr kaset sebr tõe n paam tʋmame tɩ Yinivɛrsite wã kẽnd yɩ yam-yãkre, la ra le yɩ pakr bũmb ye. Rẽ na n sõngame tɩ karen-biisã sõor boog Yinivɛrsite rãmba pʋse. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR tosame tɩ tãrãzisẽo wã ka tõe n yidg zu-loeesã zãng ye, la tʋʋm kẽer la b na n tɩʋʋse, tɩ neb nins sẽn na n wa reeg tẽngã n zã wã tõog n kẽng taoor ne tãrãzisẽo wã sẽn tɩʋʋs a soabã, sẽn na yɩl tɩ Burkĩna Faso Yinivɛrsite rãmbã paam n kẽnd wa sẽn segde.

Sẽn kẽed ne yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ, Kapitɛnd TARWAR wilgame tɩ zabrã pipi tʋlsem pa sẽn na n kʋ ye. Neb nins sẽn na n sak n dʋʋg b zab-teed la b naag n me tẽngã bãmb rãmbã zãab na n yɩ toore, la neb nins sẽn pa na n sakã, yaa tɩlae tɩ b tɩ b maan bũmb ning sẽn segd ne-ba. Tẽngã taoor soab togsame tɩ yõ-koglg kaalmã namsda tẽngã rũnda-rũnda, la yaa naamã sẽn pa paam zã-sõngã. Bala b welga neb kẽer n bas tɩ yaa wa gosneem pa mi-b tiir ye. A wilga a sũ-sãang ne neb nins sẽn yik n dɩk bug-raad rũnda-rũndã n na n wẽneg n zab ne b saam-biisã. Kapitɛnd TARWAR boola karen-bi-bɛdã sẽn ya kom-bɩɩb n leb n ya beoog tẽngã zãadb tɩ b zãag b mens ne belsg buud toor-toor b sẽn na n wa belg-ba. A kos-b lame tɩ b ra wa yik n zab ne buud a to ye. B gãd taab nusi la b tall bas-tɩ-looge. Sẽn tũune karen-bi-bedr a ye sẽn sʋk tẽnga taoor soab n na n bãng bũmb ning sẽn wat ne rabeemã, a wilgame tɩ bũmb ning sẽn kõt-a raabem, yaa sã n wa mik t’a zãmba tẽngã. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ bũmb ning sẽn tõe n wa ne zãmb taab vʋɩɩmã pʋgẽ, yaa ligdã. A wilgame t’a raar fãa pʋʋsg pʋgẽ a kota Wẽnd tɩ b sõng-a t’a ra wa lʋɩ yel-kãng pʋg ye. Kapitend TARWAR kosa kom-bɩɩbã tɩ tɩ b rɩk tẽngã zu-loɛɛg tɩ yɩ b pipi zu-loɛɛga, la b ra wa pʋg neb nins sẽn baood welgrã ye. A rɩka makr n wilg tɩ rasma noore, neb kẽer sẽn mik tɩ sodaasã ne VDP rãmbã rat n tõoga zabrã, b rɩka bu-welgr goam n kẽesd sʋka. Tẽngã taoor soab kosa karen-bi-bɛdã tɩ b ra sak n lʋɩ b rãmbã bẽdg pʋg ye.

Sẽn kẽed ne pagtɩ politik rãmbã sõor sẽn tar paasgã, a wilgame tɩ na-kẽnda la b na n dɩk n kɩt tɩ pagtɩ rãmbã sõor wooge. A togsame tɩ tãrãzisẽo wã bee Burkĩna Faso politikã na-kẽndr lebg n maneg n sigl zugu. Bala, b sã n pa maan tʋʋm-kãnga, ned ba a ye pa na n tol n maan-a ye. Kapitɛnd TARWAR wilgame tɩ soay nins politikã rãmb sẽn dɩk n na n tʋm tɩ Burkĩna Faso kẽng taoorã ka waoog ye. Pagtɩ rãmbã wʋsg na-kẽndr kẽeda taaba. Yaa rẽ t’a kot pagtɩ rãmbã taoor rãmb tɩ b naag taab n zĩngig tẽngã taoor-kẽnd na-kẽndr a yembre, n sõng tɩ Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã naag taab la b wʋm taabã tõog n kẽng taoore. A paasame tɩ gosneem taoor soab na n sigla tigsg-kaseng wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ n gom Burkĩna Faso politikã rãmb tɩ b lebg n sigl politikã na-kẽndre.Yɩɩ wakat a yiib tõr la tẽngã taoor soab rɩk n sõs ne karen-bi-bɛdã. B wilga b sũ-noog ne tẽngã taoor soaba. Nand t’a sõs ne karen-bi-bɛdã tẽngã taoor soab reng talla sõasg ne Yinivɛrsite wã taoor dãmba, la Karen-saamb dãmba. Sõs-kãng yɩɩ yã taab b sẽn boond tɩ sulg-m-zug tɩ d lɩk taab tʋbrẽ wã “wɩkolo”.kibarã yii Faso.net

Tẽngã taoor dãmb wilgame tɩ wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ, b na n tʋma ne Gine Konakiri sẽn kẽed ne karenzi wã rɩkr wɛɛngẽ. Yaa miniisr ning sẽn get Burkĩna ne zamaan-zẽns zoodã sẽn zĩnd Gine rasem a tãabã pʋgẽ, rat n yeel tɩ yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuugã rasem 10 ne a 13 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, la kiba-kãng yi yã.Karenzi wã tall n kẽ Burkĩna Faso wã mi n tara zu-loe-bãoones n namsd tẽngã taoor dãmbã. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ gosneer yãk yam n na n bao tʋʋmd-n-taar ne tẽns a taab wala Gine Konakiri. Yaa rẽ yĩnga, la b tʋm miniisr Olviya ROAMBA t’a tɩ yẽs ne Gine tẽngã taoor rãmba, tɩ tẽns a yiibã zood na n kell n kẽng taoor n paase. B yẽsgã pʋgẽ, Burkĩna Faso rãmb kosame tɩ b sõng-ba, tɩ b zɩɩbã buud toor-toor tũudẽ Gĩne tẽngã Poaarẽ wã. B sõng-b tɩ teed nins sẽn yit tẽns a taabã tõe n pɩʋʋgd bãmb tẽngã faag-faag n kẽed Burkĩna Faso. B kell n kosa zĩig sẽn na n bĩngd b teedã, la Karenzi wã. La Gine taoor dãmbã wilgame tɩ b sakame. Yẽsgã sẽn bɩ wã Karenzi wã na n tũud Gine ne Mali n wat Burkĩna Faso. Zems-taab nug-tikr̃ na n paasa Karenzi wã waoong pãnga. Bala wakat sẽn looge ra yaa Lome, ne Kotonu la karenzi wã ra tũud kẽedẽ. La yʋʋm-sar kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso paama zu-loees sẽn kẽed ne Karenzi wã wɛɛngẽ, hal tɩ Waogdg neb kẽer meng ra paas a ligdã n koosdẽ. Gosneem tigsg sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, b wilgame tɩ Milyaar 489 la zak la gosneem segd n yao SONABI. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, samdã yika Milyaar 149 la zaka.kibarã yii Lɩɩbr ẽnfo

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Tãrãsizẽo wã depite rãmb sega taab n gom gosneer tʋm-tʋmd nins sẽn bas b tʋʋm zĩis sẽn tũ ne yõ-koglg kaalmã sabaabã. B sɛkã pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ yaa tʋmtʋmd tus 4773 ln be zu-loɛɛgã pʋgẽ.Gosneem miniisr dãmb a yiib la b bool tɩ b kẽng n tɩ kõ vẽenem, la b kell n leok sogsg kẽer depite rãmbã sẽn da tare. Yaa minisr ning sẽn get tʋm-tʋmdbã Basolma BAAZYE, n paas kibayã kũuni, kʋdemdã, la gilg-n-ges yel-soalmã miniisri, a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO.Yaa Depite rãmbã taoor soaba a Wʋsmaan BUGMA n lʋɩ sõasgã taoore. Depite rãmb 58 n tall sʋgsgo n sʋk miniisr dãmbã.A Basolma BAAZYE ne a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG leok-b lame, sẽn yɩɩd fãa Ẽntɛrnetã kibay kũun zugu. Sẽn leb n paasdẽ Zu-loɛɛg ning sẽn be Telemob sẽn lebg Moov Afirka tʋʋm-noorã pʋgẽ.

B kosa sor tɩ b na n wa goma yel-kãng tigsg sẽn wat pʋgẽ.Pipi Minisr ning sẽn get tʋm-tʋmdbã wilga depite rãmbã tɩ yaa tʋm-tʋmdb tus 4773 n zoe n bas b tʋʋma zĩisi. A kell n togsame tɩ gosneem tʋʋm-noy kẽer me n pag b kʋɩlense nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm yood sabaabo, la b rɩka na-kẽnda tɩ tʋm-tʋmdb nins sẽn ka le tar tʋʋm-zĩisã na n kẽng zĩis a taab n tɩ tʋme. Tʋmtʋmdb tus 33 239 la b zoe n dɩk n kẽes tʋʋm-noy a taab pʋsẽ. Sã n na n tik ne sõadg sẽn maan yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso gosneem tʋm-tʋmd tus kobsi la pis la a tãabo, la neb kobs nii pis-nu la a tã 223853, b sʋka, koabg zug yaa neb 27 la bal n be Reezẽodisãntrã pʋgẽ. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ yaa Burkĩna Faso tʋʋm-noyã wʋsg sẽn be Sãntrã pʋgẽ wã n kɩt tɩ tʋmtʋmdbã sõor waoog be.Sẽn kẽed ne Ẽtnɛknetã wɛɛngẽ, kibayã kũun miniisr wilga nebã sẽn tar nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã n tʋmd toto, la na-kẽnda b sẽn dɩke, n na n tõog t’a tũ soaya. Yɩɩ wakat depite rãmbã sẽn wilg b sũur ka noog ne koees wʋsg sẽn zẽkd Ẽntɛrnetã zugu, n tõe n wa ne zaba, la kibay sẽn pa sɩd tɩ b rɩk-b n yiisdẽ. Depite rãmbã togsame tɩ yel-kãens tõe n yɩɩ sabaab n sãam nebã ne taab zĩnd-n-taare, tẽngã sẽn be nugã pʋgẽ. Yaa rẽ tɩ b kot gosneem t’a puk a nin n dɩk na-kẽnda sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ yaarã kolg weoogo.Miniisr Zã Emanwɛll me wilgame t’a sũur ka noom ne zir-n-be kibayã sẽn yitã ye. La a togsame tɩ na-kẽndr la b segd n dɩk n gɩdg kibay kẽere. A wilgame tɩ noor nan ka be n gomd Ẽntɛrnetã yell ye, sã n ka noor ning sẽn be sari wã zĩigẽ n gɩdg goam kẽer wala yõ-koglgã tʋʋm kibaya, la sodaasã tʋʋm wilgri. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ yɩl n tõog n gũus kibayã yaa toogo. Bala nebã sẽn tar b Watzap rãmb bɩ b paas Fasebuk rãmb n gom ne taaba. Gosneem ka tar na-kẽndr n sẽn tõe n dɩk n bãng b fãa ye. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ ba ne zu-loe-kãens fãa sẽn be wã, na-kẽndr na n dɩkame n tõog n demse. Sẽn paasd kibayã kũun ministɛɛr ne sari wã ministɛɛr Gosneem tara sul a taab sẽn zabd ne-a. Sulã yaa SEYƐSE, SIL, la ARSƐP. Sull ning sẽn zabd ne ninsaal yam daabã Ẽntɛrnetã zugã (BCLCC) n le paas sull ning sẽn get vaeesgã la sull b sẽn boond tɩ ANR.Kibarã yii Faso.net

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, tẽngã taoor soab reega Burkĩna Faso la Nizɛɛr Evɛk rãmbã. Yaa Musoyẽer Gabrɛll SAYAOOG n lʋɩ Evɛk rãmbã taoore. Seg-taabã loogr poore Musoyẽer Gabrɛll wilgame tɩ b kẽng n tɩ sõsa ne Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, sẽn kẽed ne tẽngã nug-gãaga. Tẽngã taoor soab rɩka zu-loeesã buud toor-toor sẽn be n wilg tigung katolik taoor dãmba. Evɛk rãmbã wilgame tɩ b bee tẽngã taoor dãmb poore. B pʋlmAME tɩ b na n yãag-b-la tʋʋmã pʋsẽ. B kell n kosa Wẽnd sõngre, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b sõng nebã tɩ b gãd taab nus n tʋm tɩ zĩnd-n-taarã sõmbblem paase, tɩ waoog taab la sak taab zĩndi. Musoyẽer SAYAOOG wilgame tɩ yɩɩ wakat Evɛk rãmbã sẽn dɩk tigung katolikã yʋʋm 2023 soabã taab pʋsg n taas tẽngã taoor soaba.Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 12 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, sull ning sẽn zabd ne wẽgbã la ligd gõdgrã b sẽn boond tɩ AESEƐLSE wã taoor dãmb yiisa mooneg koɛɛg n wilg tɩ bãmb sullã sẽn yiis koɛɛgã n wilg tɩ depite rãmbã reesa mobila sam n ka yao wã loogr poore, neb n dɩk na-kẽnda n dat n sãam bãmb sullã neb kẽer tʋʋma. Rẽ n so tɩ sullã taoor dãmb wilg tɩ b kell n na n tʋmame tɩ wẽgbã la ligd gõdgrã tõog n kolg weoogo, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ gosneem tʋʋm-noy kẽn wa sẽn segde. AESEƐLSE sullã boonda neb nins sẽn dɩk na-kẽndr n dat n sãam bãmb tʋʋmdã, tɩ b tek na-kẽndre, pa rẽ b na n kẽnga ne yellã sari taoore. B kell n bẽda mooneg koɛɛgã pʋg n bool nin-buiidã tɩ b kõ-b sɩda, tɩ b na n tʋmame tɩ bas-yard meng-meng tõog n zĩnd Burkĩna Faso tẽngã zãab pʋgẽ.Kibarã yii Faso.net

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 12 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Risi no-rɛɛs a Alegsi SALTIKOV sega gosneema taoor soab a Apolineer KELEM . Seg-taabã pʋga Risi no-rɛɛsã wilgame tɩ b rɩka na-kẽndr n na n sõng Burkĩna Faso rãmb tɩ b zab ne nin-wẽnsã.A wilgame tɩ yʋʋm 2015 soabã, Risi taoor soab a Valadimiir Putind ra rɩka na-kẽndr n kos ãndũni wã tẽn-bɛd tɩ b gãd taab nus n zab ne nin-wẽnsã b tʋmd tʋʋm-yood ninsã pʋgẽ wã. La bʋkã, na-kẽndrã ka paam pidsg ye.Sẽn leb n paasdẽ yõ-koglgã wɛɛngẽ, a Alegsi SALTIKOV wilgame tɩ bãmb ne Burkĩna Faso tʋmd-n-taarã ka na n tek yõ-koglgã bal ye, b na n tʋma zĩis a taab me n paase. Risi no-rɛɛsã togsame tɩ ba nasaar tẽns a taabã, sẽn dɩk sɩbgr ning n taas Risi wã, b tẽngã arzɛk ket n kẽnda taoore. Yaa rẽ t’a saagdẽ tɩ bãmb ne Buekĩna Faso tʋmd-n- taarã tõe n nafa tẽns a yiibã.Wakat sẽn looge, sula wʋsg ra zẽgsa koees n boond Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmb tɩ b bas Fãrens la b pẽneg Risi tɩ b sõng-b tɩ b zab ne nin-wẽnsã sẽn namsd nin-buiidã hal yʋʋm a yopoe rõanda wã.Tẽegre, Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soab ra zĩnda Risi wakat sẽn loge, n wilg tɩ Burkĩna na n bao tʋmd-n-taar ne tẽnsã wʋsg o, tɩ b sõng-a t’a zab ne nin-wẽnsã tɩ yõ-koglg kaalmã tõog n sa.Kibara yii AYIBE

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 12 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, sull kaseng ning sẽn tigsd Burkĩna Faso nus-tʋmtʋmdbã buud toor-toor b sẽn boond tɩ Sãmbr de metiye e de lartizana wã maanda b seg taab kasengã, a vuk a yiib soaba. Tigs-kaseng a yiib soabã pʋgẽ, yaa nus-tʋmtʋmdbã taoor dãmb n yi Burkĩna Faso reezẽo rãmbã pʋsẽ n wa Waogdgo, Burkĩna Faso na-tẽngã pʋga, tɩ b naag taab n na n ges b sẽn tõe n sigl b tʋʋma, toto tɩ b sullã tõog n kẽng taoore. Tigsgã sɩngrẽ, b boola sullã neb yʋya, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n bãng neb nins sẽn zẽk b naoore n wa tigs-kasengã. Yʋyã boolg loogr poore, sullã taoor soaba a Zermend KÕMPAOOR rɩka koɛɛg n pʋʋs nebã fãa ne-b waoongo. Rẽ poore, a pʋʋsa sullã ne b yʋʋm-paall taabo. A sẽn wa n na n sɩng sõasgã, a kosa nebã fãa tɩ b yik n yals bilfu, tɩ b tags sullã pʋgẽ, tʋmtʋmdb kẽer sẽn maan kaalem nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm-yood sabaabo.

A koeesã pʋgẽ, a pʋʋsa neb nins fãa sẽn zĩnd sullã taoore. A pẽga sull ning sẽn tʋme, tɩ yʋʋm 2023 soabã tigsg na n tõog n maanã. Kell n yɩɩ wakat b sẽn dɩk b waoor kũun sɛb n taas neb a nu sẽn zĩnd n zã sullã wakat sẽn loog pʋgẽ. Sullã taoor soab wilga a sũ-noog ne tigsgã sẽn tõog n zĩndã, la a wilg tɩ tigs-kãngã pʋgẽ, b na n lebg n gesa tʋʋm nins b sẽn tʋm tɩ loogã , la b tags na-kẽnda a taab zugu, n tõog n sigl tɩ sẽn watã yɩ neere.Sẽn yɩɩd fãa tʋʋm, nins b sẽn da wilg tɩ b na n tʋma yʋʋm 2022 soabã pʋgẽ wã, la b na n gese, bʋg n pidi, la bʋg n ka pidi. B leb n na n gesa arzɛk ning b sẽn da wilg tɩ b na n dɩk n tʋmame wã sã n sɩd tõog n sekame.Rẽ poore, b na n ges bũmb nins sẽn paoog yʋʋmd ning sẽn loogã tʋʋm pʋgẽ. A Zermend KÕMPAOOR kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tigs-kãngã pʋga, b na n gesa b sẽn tõe n sigl tʋʋm nins yʋʋm 2023 wã pʋgẽ, tɩ Sãmbr de metiye wã tʋʋm kẽng taoore. B na n kell gesa ligd sõor b sẽn na n dɩk n kẽes yʋʋm 2023 tʋʋm pʋgẽ.Sullã taoor soab kẽnga taoor n leb n paas tɩ yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ, b ratame n paas b sullã neb fãa bãngre. Bala, b bãngrã sã n paase, a na n yɩɩ sabaab tɩ b tõog n paas b tʋʋma sõmblem. Rẽ sã n tõog n yɩ, b tõe n tʋmame tɩ neb nins fãa sẽn tar nus-tʋʋmã tõog n gʋls b yʋy n kẽ sullã pʋgẽ. A wilgame tɩ rẽ sã n yɩ, a yaa kaset sõng b sẽn tõe n tik n wilg tɩ b sɩd tara nus-tʋmtʋmdba. A leb tõe n sõng-b lame tɩ b tõog n sɩd gãd taab nus n tʋme. Sẽn kẽed ne sʋndã fut sẽn yit zamaan-zẽns n wat n sãamd Burkĩna Faso sʋn-wogdbã raagã, sullã taoor soab wilgame tɩ yaa bũmb sẽn sɩd komsd b tʋʋmdã, la b na n dɩka na-kẽndre tɩ reezẽo rãmb nins sẽn ya sabaab n kɩtdẽ tɩ fu-yoodã kẽed Burkĩna Faso wã bɩ b lebs b tʋʋmdã poorẽ tɩ rẽ n na n sõng tɩ fu-yoodã waoong kolg weoogo.Yaa tʋʋm buud toor-toor la b na n tʋme, la b pʋɩ taab yam, la b yaool n kõ taab sɛk tigs-kaseng a to sẽn wate.A Pẽgwẽnde Erik Zinaaba la a Zɩll Kafaando

Yʋʋm vẽkr kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Gine Biso tẽnga taoor soab sẽn le yaa SEDEYAO wã sull taoor soabã, a Umaro Sisoko EMBALO wa Burkĩna Faso n wa ges tãrãsizẽo wã na-kẽndr yelle. Yɩɩ tẽnga taoor soaba, kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAREn seg nin-kãnga a silg yiri, tɩ b yaool n zĩnd ne taab n sõse. soãsga pʋgẽ SEDEYAO taoor soabã wilgame tɩ sullã na n yãaga Burkĩna Faso n zab ne yõ-koglg kaalema, a wilgame tɩ bãmb sek ning sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm sar kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, SEDEYAO tẽnsa taoor dãmba fãa yãka yam n na n sõng Burkĩna Faso rãmba sẽn tũ ne tẽnga taoor soab sẽn kos sullã sõngrã. Gɩne tẽnga taoor soab kell n kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ yẽnda wʋmda bũmb wʋsg sẽn maand Burkĩna Faso wã võore, yaa rẽ ta wilg tɩ sullã tigsg kaseng sẽn watã, a na n wilga a sekã ne Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmba sẽn yɩ toto, sẽn na n yɩl tɩ b tõog n dɩk na-kẽnda n yãag Burkĩna Faso.Sullã taoor soab kell n wilgame t’a na n kẽnga taoor n yẽs ne SEDEYAO tẽnsa taoor dãmb fãa, la a pak n taasã, tɩ b tõog n sõng Burkĩna Faso ta zab n koglg a tẽngã. A EMBALO UMARO SISOKO wilgame tɩ bũmb ning sẽn be SEDEYAO wã zugẽ, pa rɩk sɩbgr n taas Burkĩna Faso rãmb ye, sullã rat n sõnga tẽns nins fãa sẽn be tãrãzisẽo wã pʋgẽ wã.Kibarã yii Na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Fãrens gosneerã seb-gʋnd a Kirsula Zakaropulu sega Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE. Sɛkã yɩɩ wakat ning Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã sẽn wilg tɩ b pa le rat Fãrens no-rɛɛs a Liuk Halaad t’a zĩnd tẽngã ye. B sõasgã loogr poore Fãrens gosneerã seb-gʋnd sega kiba-kɩtbã. A wilgame t’a wa n taasa Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmb a koeese. Koeesã yaa sẽn na n wilg tɩ Fãrens ket n bee Burkĩna Faso poorẽ. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa a sẽn be zu-loees nins pʋgã. Sẽn kẽed ne Fãrens sodaasã sẽn be Burkĩna Faso wã, a wilgame tɩ b na n kell n paa Burkĩna Faso n tãag wakat ning tẽngã taoor dãmb sẽn dat ket n be b tẽngã pʋga. A kell nkẽnga taoor n paas tɩ yaa sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm 2013 soabã, la Fãrens sodaasã be Sayɛllã soolmẽ. La yaa tẽnsã taoor dãmb n da kos-ba.Kirsula Zakaropulu wilgame tɩ Fãrens taoor soabã wilgame tɩ b pa wa n na n deeg Sayɛllã tẽns taoor dãmb zĩig n zab ne nin-wẽnsã ye. B waame n na n sõng-b n zabe. Sõngrã yaa ne sodaase, la zab-teedo. Kiba-kɩtbã bẽda be n gom Risi sodaas sull b sẽn boond tɩ Wagneerã yelle. Zĩ-kãnga, Fãrens gosneema seb-gʋnd wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso yaa tẽng sẽn so a menga, la a tara sor n tõe n yãk tẽns nins a sẽn na n tʋm ne. A wilgame t’a ka wa n na n gom Burkĩna Faso tẽngã rãmb yʋʋr yĩng ye, la a sẽn mi bala, yam-yãkr fãa tara a sẽn tõe n wa ne zu-loees ninsi. Fãrens gosneerã seb-gʋnd wilgame tɩ bãmb tẽngã rãmb ka pẽdg Burkĩna rãmb tɩ b kẽng taoor ne zoodã ye. A sẽn mi bala, Fãrens rãmb na n kell n yãaga Burkĩna Faso, a sẽn wat n tar bãmb raab sasa. Wakat sẽn looge, Burkĩna Faso rãmb ra wilgame tɩ b ratame tɩ Fãrens rãmb bool b no-rɛɛs a Liuk Halaade. Zĩ-kãnga, Fãrens gosneerã seb- gʋnd wilgame tɩ b na n welga yel-kãng wala tẽns a yiibã zood na-kẽndr sẽn gãneg toto wã. Tẽegre, Burkĩna Faso sula sẽn so b mens ra yii bãmb ka tɛk n wilg tɩ rẽndame tɩ Fãrens loog la abas Burkĩna Faso.kibarã yii lɩɩbr ẽnfo.

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR teka gosneerã bilfu. Yaa gosneer seb-gʋnd a Zak Sostɛnd DẼNGARA n karem moonegã koɛɛg Televisẽo nasnallã zugu, n wilgi. A wilgame tɩ b kẽesa miniisr dãmb a yiib gosneerã pʋga. Pipi ya a Bubakar SAVADOGO. Yẽ n deeg a Yisuf SIRIMA zĩiga n lebg yĩn-wɩsgrã, la kom-bɩɩbã miniisri. Yiib soaba, ya a Amadu DIKO, sẽn ya rũms logtor b sẽn boond tɩ Veterineerã, la a ra get laboratoaar nasnallã tʋʋma. B yãka yẽ t’a sõng koobã la gʋʋlgã miniisri.

Kiba-kɩtb roog b sẽn boond tɩ 18 Voasmedɛ rãmb sega reem-rɛɛmd a Zugnanzagemdkõntʋktãng t’a kõ a tasg sẽn kẽed ne yõ-koglg kaalmã zugu. A Zugnanzagemd yeelame :”nin-wẽnsa tʋʋmd sẽn paam pãng tẽngã pʋgẽ wã yaa tõnd sẽn bas d rog-n-mikã yɛl kẽer tɩ lʋɩ wã. Pĩndã, ned a ye ra tõe n kɩtame tɩ b pag raaga. La tũudmã sẽn wa wã tɛka tõnd basa rẽ fãa. Fo sã n dat n kẽe dĩinã pʋgẽ, b yetame tɩ f yõog bũmb nins fãa sẽn tar wala tɩɩm wɛɛngẽ. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ rapã fãa lebg wa pagba. B basa fãa, tɩ lʋɩ la woto yaa bʋko. Yaa sẽn dat n wilg yãmb tɩ kʋdemdã ra sõngda tõnd wʋsgo. Makre, rog-n-mik nanambsã ra tara rog-n-mik n maand koodã rɩkr wakat tɩ b boond tɩ Nabasga, la rũnda-rũnda nanambs nins sẽn ket n maand rẽ wã sõor ka le waoog ye. Yel-kãens fãa yaool n yaa bũmb sẽn da kogend nin-buiidã ne vʋɩɩmã pʋg zu-loees kẽere. B basa fãa, yaa rẽ tɩ zu-loɛɛgã sẽn wa marsã, tɩ b kot dĩinã taoor dãmb tɩ b pʋʋse, la b kot rog-n-mikã rãmb tɩ b gese. Rog-n-mikã rãmb na n tika bõe n gese?”Yaa 18 voas medya rãmb n sõs ne rem-rɛmda zugnazagemda

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem a 7 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Nagrẽ kom-bɩɩbã ne sodaag a ye n tall mo-yõsre, tɩ sodaagã pogle. Yaa rẽ tɩ kiuugã rasem a 8 raare, sodaas kẽer yik n kẽng Arõndiisma a 7 soabã, rat n yeel tɩ Nagrẽ sakã, n tɩ maan n dok b sũuri. B taame n kẽ sakã pʋga, n pãb nebã, tɩ kẽer paam sãmpogre. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ sodaasã taoor dãmb yiis mooneg koɛɛg n wilg tɩ sodaasã sẽn maanã pa tũ sari ye. A leb ka bũmb sẽn pa sõngd nebã ne sodaasã tʋmd-n-taar ye. Tɩ bala, wakat kãngã, yaa yõ-koglg kaalem sasa, sodaasã ne nebã segd n gãda taab nus n zab ne nin-wẽnsã. Sodaasã taoor dãmb kẽnga taoore, b mooneg koɛɛgã pʋg n wilg tɩ na-kẽndr la b zoe n dɩke, la b na n dɩke, n sɩbg sodaas nins sẽn tʋm tʋʋm-yookã. Ka pipi, sodaasã sẽn tʋm tʋʋm-kãngã buud ye. Tẽegre, bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, sodaas n tɩ pãb ne Dapoaya Waogdg sak a ye pʋga. Yẽ soabã tũu ne b sẽn kõs b tũud-n-taag t’a maan kaalem. Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 11 ne a rasem 12 yʋʋm 2021 soabã me, Po sodaasã yiime n kẽ tẽngã pʋg n pãb nebã hal tɩ neb wʋsg paam sãmpogle.Kibarã yii Libr ẽnfo

Yõ-koglg kaalem bãng-mit a Loorã KIBORA wilgame tɩ VEDEPE rãmbã yãkr yaa bũmb sẽn na n sɩd sõng nebã tɩ b zab ne nin-wẽnsã. La a kota tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b rɩk nebã wɩdg n ning sʋka, tɩ VEDEPE rãmbã ra wa lebg n zab ne nebã ye.Yaa Sɩdway kiba-kɩtbã n sõs ne a Lorã KIBORA sẽn kẽed ne zab ne nin-wẽnsã pʋgẽ, la a wilg a sũur tagsgo, gosneer sẽn yãk yam n bool nebã tɩ b gʋls b yʋy n sõng tɩ b zab n fãag tẽngã. Tɩ bala, VEDEPE rãmbã sull yaa sabaab n kɩtdẽ tɩ b ka le tõe n tʋm b tʋʋm-wẽnsã ye. A Wilgame tɩ VEDEPE rãmb sã n zoe n be tẽng pʋge,̃ nin-wẽnsa pa tõe n kẽng be n tɩ tʋm b sẽn dat ye. Tẽegre, yaa zĩ-likr kiuugã baoosgẽ la gosneem yãk yam n wilg tɩ b rata neb 50 000 sẽn na n kẽes b mens n sõng sodaasã tɩ b zab n fãag tẽngã. VEDEPE rãmbã tʋʋmd sã n noom neb kẽere, kẽer me wilgame tɩ tʋm-n-dok sũur n be a pʋgẽ. Tɩ bala, tʋʋlg kiuug sẽn loogã pʋgẽ, a ra paoogame Burkĩna Faso tẽns wʋsg pʋgẽ. Zĩ-likr kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã pʋg me, a leb n yɩɩ boto, tɩ gosneerã taoor soab ra yi n wilg t’a na n paoogame.Kibarã yii Lɩɩbre ẽnfo

Le yaa wa b sẽn sɩng n maandẽ. Yʋʋmd fãa, Nowɛllã kibs sãn wa pẽnege, Waogdg tigung rooga ba, Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG boonda kiba-kɩtbã, n dɩk Nowɛll kibsã, la yʋʋm-paallã pʋʋsem n taas-ba, tɩ b  pʋɩ ne Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã la Kiris nebã.Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG koeesã la woto:” M saam-biisi m neb sõm yã, Waogdg tigung roogã yʋʋr yĩnga, m dat n pʋʋsa y zãng fãa ne y taabo, Nowɛllã la yʋʋm-paallã kibs yĩnga. Wẽnd na pids ned kam fãa sũur raabo, la a sik laafɩ, la sũ-noogo, nin-buiidã fãa yĩnga. Yaa sɩda, sẽn zems yʋʋm a 8 woto, Burkĩna Faso zamaanã tara zu-loeese, bɩ Wẽnd kelg-do, la b kell n yols n kõ-do. Nowɛll kibsã gomd la woto: “Wẽnnaam paam pẽgr yĩngri, la ninsaalbã kamba, bãmb sẽn nongã, paam laafɩ tẽng zugu”. D kotame tɩ Wẽnd meng tek d suyã, tɩ d mao tɩ laafɩ zĩndi, tɩ ninsaalbã fãa vʋɩɩmd laafɩ pʋgẽ, tɩ ninsaal buud fãa paam waoogre. Yaa bõe n wat ne nin-kʋʋrã? Yaa ninsaal vʋɩm waoogr kaalem. Sɩda, la zemsg kaalem. Yaa rẽ fãa, n wat ne zu-loeese, n wat ne namsgo. La tõnd tara zu-noogo, tɩ Wẽnnaam naana tõnd fãa, pagb la rapa, tɩ d fãa ya bãmb meng wẽnego, tɩ d fãa ya Wẽnnaam kamba. Ba-biisi, la ma-biisi. Woto ya d sẽn na n bas bug-raadã sɩɩ, la d bao yẽsgo, la zood ne taaba, tɩ rẽ bal n kengd d saambiirã pãnga. Rẽ bal n wat ne laafɩ.D sẽn tog n gãd n paase, yaa tɩ d fãa yaa ba-yir a yembr kambã, Burkĩna Faso tẽng-n-biisi. Bɩ d rɩ rogem ne taaba, la d sak n kos Wẽnnaam sugri n tõog n kõ taab sugri, tɩ saam-biir la zems-taab bui d zamaanã. Bɩ d siig beem lalsã, sũ-kĩir lalsã, la d me radse (põ) rãmba, sẽn ya wʋm taaba, kõ taab sugri, saam-biir la ma-biiri, nong taab ne sɩda. Yaa sɩda, Burkĩna Faso zãadbã wilga d fãa zu-loees nins pʋg d sẽn be wã. Yaa zu-loees meng-menga, la b ratame, tɩ d tik n yik n naag taaba, rapa, pagba,kasemba, la kom-bɩɩba, tɩ d zab ne d bɛɛbã, la d tʋm ninbãan-zoeer la nonglem tʋʋmde, ne neb nins fãa sẽn be-b namsg pʋgẽ wã. Sẽn le paasde, d fãa miime tɩ d tara zu-loees wʋsgo. Bɩ ned kam fãa mao t’a manesem ra paasdẽ d zu-loeesã ye. Bɩ ned kam fãa mao tɩ d ba-yirã leng-lengã sa , tɩ nin-kʋʋrã sa. Bɩ d kɩs taab sɩda, la d maan pʋ-pelem ne taaba. D rɩk y d teegre, n teeg soaala Wẽnde, ne b bi-nongrã , tõnd soaal a Zeezi kiristã sẽn wat ne saagre, la fãagre dũni wã tõr yĩnga. Tõnd ba sõngo, Pap Farensoa, kõo tõnd sagl-sõngo n yetẽ: ” Zamaan pʋgẽ, kom-bɩɩbã tara b zĩiga, la b tʋʋmde, bãmb n kõt zamaana pãnga, t’a tõe n kẽng taoore, la nin-kẽemba me, bãmb n paasd b pãnga ne b sagl-sõmse”. Ya d zãag fãa naag taab n tʋme, tɩ laafɩ tõog n zĩndi. Bɩ d mao n kelg kom-bɩɩbã , la d sõng-ba, b zu-loeesã fãa pʋgẽ.M neb sõma , tõnd soaala Zeezi kirista waame, n na maan b meng yamba, sõgne, n kõ-b vʋɩɩmã kʋʋngã yĩnga, dũni tõr yĩnga, woto yaa kaseto, tɩ taoor soab fãa yaa yamba, la sõgne, yaa kõ-m-meng vʋɩɩm zãnga, nin-buiidã na yɩ neer yĩnga. Bãngda Yizae ra pĩnd n wilgame: ” sẽn da kẽnd-b likẽ wã, b yãa vẽenem-kasenga” woto, Nowɛll wata ne saag-kasenga, fãagr saag-kasenga, bɩ d pak d suyã, n tõog n lebg Wẽnnaam kom-nongdse, n me laafɩ zamaan-paalga. Yaa pʋʋsgo, n paas yẽs ne-m to la nonglem. Laafɩ yaa Wẽnd kũuni, d sẽn tog n kose. Laafɩ me leb n yaa ninsaalb tʋʋmde. M neb sõmse, m saam-biisi, Wẽnd na sõng-do, tɩ d maan kibs rãmbã sẽn watã, ne tẽebo, la zɩɩri. D mao n maan bũmb fãa ne zemsgo, la d tẽeg d saam-biis nins fãa sẽn be-b namsg pʋgẽ wã yelle. D tõe n maana bõe bãmb yĩnga? Nowɛll la yʋʋm-paalgã mees rãmb pʋgẽ, Parwaas fãa mao n sak n yãk ligd lobr a yembre, tɩ d sõng sẽn be-b namsg fãa pʋgẽ. Neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnse, la b paoongo, kɩɩb-bi wã, pʋg-kõapã, la naong rãmba. Bɩ d kos laafɩ naabã, tɩ b ning Burkĩna zamaanã bark n kõ-do, b ning nin-sabls tẽnsã, la ãndũni wã tõr bark n kõ-do. Y zãag fãa ne y taabo, Wẽnd na taas-d vẽer ne laafɩ la sõmblem”.Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, Waogdg tigung roogã ba.

Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soab sẽn lebg Risi n wa wã, a talla sõsa ne kiba-kɩtb tʋʋm noor b sẽn boond tɩ RT Fãrãns yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2022 soabã. A sõasgã pʋga, metr Apolineer KELEM wilgame t’a wa n sega Risi tẽngã taoor dãmb kẽere.Gosneerã taoor soab wilga woto: “tõnd sega Risi tẽngã taoor dãmb kẽere, la b tʋʋm-noy taoor dãmba. B sakame n deeg-do. Tõnd sẽn dat yaa Burkĩna Faso ne Risi zoodã kell n paam pãng n paase”.A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tẽngã nin-buiid yõ-koglgã, yaa yẽ n yɩ pipi gom-zug b sẽn tik n gome. Rẽ n kɩt t’a kotẽ tɩ Risi sak n sõng Burkĩna Faso n zab ne nin-wẽnsã, wala tẽns a taab sẽn zoe n paam tɩ b sak n sõngd-bã. Gosneerã taoor soab pasaame tɩ Risi yaa tẽng sẽn tar pãnga, la a sã n data, a tõe n sõnga Burkĩna Faso.Sẽn paasd yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn yãk a toogo, gosneerã taoor soab wilgame t’a goma goam a taab sẽn tõe n naf Burkĩna Faso wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ. Metr Apolineer KELEM kell n wilga sõasgã pʋgẽ tɩ Risi tẽngã taoor soab kõ-a-la booll sebr sẽn wilgd tɩ b boonda Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor soaba Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR t’a zẽk a karg n wa naag tigs-kaseng ning Risi la nin-sabls tẽnsã sẽn segd taabã pʋgẽ.Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soab wilgame t’a pa paam n gilg ges zĩis kẽer a Toma SÃNKAR sẽn tɩ kaag Risi soolmẽ wã b sẽn boond tɩ Sɩte Etoallã ye. A kẽnga taoor n kos Risi tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b kẽes b teed kẽer wala Bɩle wã koosg Burkĩna Faso. B sã n ka na n kẽes a koosgã, Burkĩna, bɩ b tʋm neb tɩ b wa zãms Burkĩna Faso koaadbã a koobo, la b sõng-b ne birga.Metr Apolineer KELEM de Taambɛɛl wilga a sũ-ka-noog ne Risi Ãmbasaadã a sẽn bas Sãntr Kiltirɛllã tɩ lʋɩ wã, n paas Risi sɩlsã sẽn da wat Waogdgã, n ka le watẽ wã. A kosa Risi rãmb tɩ b lebg n wa rɩk b zĩigã t’a ket n be b nugẽ.Kibarã yii Librẽfo

Gana tẽngã taoor soab sẽn gom Etaziini tigsgã pʋg tɩ Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmb rɩka Sãnem bok n kõ Wagneerã sodaasã tɩ na n yɩ b keoorã, minisr ning sẽn get Sãnmã kɩɩsa gomdã. Ya a sẽn tall sek ne nin-zaalsã lagem-n-taar sula yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 20 yʋʋm 2022 soabã pʋga, la a wilg yã. Minisr Sɩmo Pɛɛr BUSIM wilgame tɩ Sãnmã tʋʋm nug tikr sebr pʋgẽ, sor beeme tɩ b tõe n dɩk Sãnem bok n gãneg ne tẽng a to n deeg zab teedo, bɩ bũmblɩ a taaba, la rẽ ka tõe n zĩnd tɩ ka tũ ne nug-tikr ye. Yaa rẽ n so tɩ miniisrã wilg tɩ Burkĩna Faso ka kõ Wagneer dãmb Sãnem bok ye. A wilgame tɩ Gana tẽngã taoor soab sẽn togs bũmb ningã ka sɩd ye. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n tɩ paas tɩ yaa sẽn tũ ne gosneer rasem yopoe-poe tikr sẽn sẽn looge, la b rɩk noor n kõ Sãnem tʋʋm-noor b sẽn boond tɩ Yimiugu Noorgold sor t’a na n tilg Sãntr noor soolmẽ wã. Bab-kãng me pa pẽ ne Gana toaagã ye. Rẽnd woto fãa wilgdame tɩ Gana tẽngã taoor soab pa togsd sɩd ye. Sɛkã baoosgẽ sula wã taoor dãmb wilga b sũ-noog ne miniisrã sẽn kõ vẽenem ningã.Kibarã yii Faso.net

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Waogdg komindã delegasẽo ɛspesɛll taoor soab a Moriis KONATE ne a poorẽ dãmbã tɩ kaaga sapɛɛr põmpiye rãmbã. kaagrã võore, yaa sẽn kẽed ne tʋʋma b sẽn gãneg n na n tʋ yʋʋmdã saab pʋgẽ.B sẽn tɩ kaag polɩɩs minisipallã poore, yaa sodaas nins sẽn zabd ne bugmã la koomã, n paas sor zug poagã tʋʋm-noor b sẽn boond tɩ Sapɛɛr põmpiye wã nengẽ la b kẽng yã, n tɩ keng b pelse, b sẽn tʋmd nin-buiidã yõya la b laog koglg yĩngã. A Moriis KONATE wilgame tɩ yaa bũmb b sẽn minim n maand wakat fãa, yʋʋmdã basgẽ. Yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ n pẽg neb nins sẽn kẽesdb toog nin-buiidã laogo, la b yõyã koglg wɛɛngẽ . Komindã taoor dãmb ka kẽng ne nug zaal ye. B tɩ kõ-b-la ligdi, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n keng b pelse. B taoor soabã, a Nawo Daba sẽn deeg ligdã, a wilgame t’ a sũur yaa noog ne Meeri wã taoor dãmba. Bũmb zãnga, b sẽn n tags bãmb a sodaas nins sẽn tʋmd bugmã la sor zug sãmpoagã zĩigẽ wã. A bẽda be n bool nin-buiidã, tɩ b tall b mens neer sor-zug kẽna wɛɛngẽ, sẽn yɩɩd fãa tigã pʋgẽ. A boola so-tũudbã tɩ b waoog noy nins b sẽn gãneg sorã tũub wɛɛngẽ wã. B maan gũus ne b sẽn mi n yũ rãamã n dat n dɩk sorã n maan b reem zĩigã, tɩ yõor sã n kaoose, a soab n bãng a zãabo.kibarã yii Burkĩna 24

Sɛkã võore yaa gosneerã taoor soab a Polineer KELEM sẽn yals depite rãmbã taoore, n wilg tʋʋma a gosneema wã, sẽn gãneg n na n tʋma pʋgẽ, la a ra wilg yã, t’a na n maoome tɩ fu-moaasã b sẽn boond tɩ Fasodãnfani wã b rɩk-ba, tɩ b lebg Lekoll karen-biisã la sodaasã futu. Yaa rẽ la b bool kiba-kɩtbã n dat tɩ b sõng-ba, tɩ tʋʋmdã tõog n puk zĩig zãnga, tɩ nin-buiidã bãng-a. La mikame tɩ neb a taab n wat ne fut sẽn wẽnd Fasosdãnfani wã, tɩ fu-kãens sãamd Burkĩna Faso sʋ-wʋgdbã fut raaga. Rẽ fãa n kɩte, tɩ b seg kiba-kɩtbã, yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, n na n taas-ba, b sũur koeese.Burkĩna Faso, pagb wʋsg rɩka sʋndã wʋgb n maan b nug tʋʋmde. A tʋʋmdã sõngd-b lame tɩ b zabd ne tʋʋm-koaalgã. A leb n zẽkda tẽngã yʋʋr ãndũni wen-vɩɩs a naasã pʋgẽ.

Vaeesdbã wilgame tɩ Burkĩna sʋndã futu, a tẽngã nin-buiid sã n ninga, a sõmblamã ka tar mak-n-taag ye. Ba zĩigã sã n wɩngd bɩ a maagdame, a ket n sakda ne Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã vɩɩm. Rẽ n so tɩ ministɛɛr ning sẽn get leebgã yell ra rɩk na-kẽndr n maan tɩ fuugã sẽn wa n tɩ beẽ fãa bɩ b tõe n bãng t’a yii Burkĩna Faso. B boonda rẽ ne Farende, tɩ labeliize wã.La b wa n tɩ mikame tɩ fut sẽn pa wʋg ne Burkĩna Faso lamdã, n wa kẽ raagã pʋgẽ, tɩ ya sabaab n komsd tẽngã sʋ-wʋgdb tʋʋmde. Yaa rẽ t’a Zistind KAFAANDO, sẽn ya Burkĩna Faso sʋ-wʋgdbã sull taoor soab pẽg Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmba, ne-b dɩk na-kẽndr ning n na n kɩt tɩ sʋndã fuug lebg Lekoll karen-biisã la sodaasã fut ã. La tʋʋmdã sẽn wẽnd a kẽnda taoorã , sʋn-wʋgdb kẽer yãka yam, n tʋmd tʋʋm sẽn ka kẽesd tẽngã yõodo.B togsdame n wʋgd fut sẽn pa wʋg ne tõnd Burkĩna Fasom lamdã, n be raagã pʋgẽ, n sãamd Fasodãni wa raaga.Yaa rẽ tɩ b kot nin-buiidã tɩ b maan gũusg wʋsgo, ne fu-kãens buudã. Bala yaa fut sẽn ka kẽesd Burkĩna Faso yõod ye. A nafda neb ka yɩɩd a wãn bala. La sã n ya fut nins sẽn wʋgd ne Burkĩna Faso gĩsã, a sõngda sʋ-wʋgdbã, la a le sõngd tẽngã t’a arzɛk kẽnd taoore. Sʋ-wʋgdbã taoor soab kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ fut nins sẽn yi zamaan-zẽnsã, b bãngrã yaa naana. Bala, b sã n get-ba, b be neer nifẽ. B leb n yaa zɩsgo. B gisã sã n yõog-b bugum b yẽnegdame, bala, b yaa sũudu. Rẽnd nebã maan gũusgu, ne b sẽn daad fut ninsã.

Sullã seb-gʋnd a Zermend KÕNPAOOR me kell n zẽka koɛɛg n kos kiba-kɩtbã tɩ b rɩk b sũurã koees n taas nin-buiidã tɩ b tõog n bãng gĩs a yiibã n welge. A pẽga gosneema, a sẽn dɩk na-kẽndrã pʋgẽ.Sẽn kẽed ne fuug ning sẽn wa n na sãamd raagã, a kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b sã n sɩd nong b tẽngã, bɩ b bas fu-kãens raabo. Bala, a sãamda bãmb tʋʋma, a leb n pa nafd tõnd tẽngã me. A kosa neb nins sẽn wat ne fu-kãensã, la sʋ-wogdb nins sẽn dat zamaan-zẽns gĩsã tɩ b bas b tʋʋmdã la b ra tõnd me rẽ wã, t’a yaa bũmb sẽn lebsd tõnd tẽngã arzɛk poorẽ.Pẽgdwẽnde ZINAABA la a Zɩll

Burkĩna Faso ministɛɛr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã boola Gana tẽngã no-rɛɛs a Bonifaas Gambila ADAGBILA, yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2022 soabã n na n kelg Gana tẽngã taoor soaba a Nana Akufo ADDO sẽn kẽng Etazini n tɩ wilg tɩ Risi sodaas sull b sẽn boond tɩ Vagneerã bee Burkĩna Faso wã. Rẽ poore, b boola b no-rɛɛs Zenerall Pẽgrnooma ZAGR sẽn be Gana soolmẽ wã t’a wa yiri . Yaa Afirik tẽnsã taoor dãmb sẽn segd taab ne a Merka tẽng naabã Etazini soolmã, la Gana tẽngã taoor soab wilg vẽeneg tɩ Risi sodaasã b sẽn boond tɩ Vagneerã bee Burkĩna Faso ne bãmb toaagẽ wã. A leb n wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso rãmb rɩka Sãnem tʋʋm-noor a ye, n kõ Risi sodaasã, tɩ na n yɩ b tʋʋmdã yaoodo. Yaa yʋʋm a yopoe la woto b sẽn gomd vagneerã yelle, tɩ nasaar tẽns kẽer wilg tɩ b pa rat tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsã taoor dãmb sak n maan nug-tikr ne-b ye. Ba tɩ rasma noorã, miniisr Apolineer KELEM sã n zẽka a naoor n kẽng Risi soolmẽ wã, hal n tãag rũndã, koɛɛg nan pa yi vẽenega, n wilg tɩ Vagneer sodaasã sɩd bee Burkĩna Faso ye.Kibarã yii AYIBE

Nus tʋʋmã rãmb tigs-kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ Sɩyao wã, a naoor 16 soabã na n paka a kʋɩlens yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2023 soabã. Gom-zug b sẽn yãk n na n maan tigrã yaa ” nin-sabls tẽnsẽ, a nus-tʋʋma, sõngd a tẽnsã la a nafd a ninb-uiidã”B ra yãk-a-la zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 28 n tãag sapaolg kiuug rasem a 6 sẽn loogã, n da na n maan-a, la b ka tõog wakat-kãng ye. Bala, kell n sega naaw wẽ-n-dɩkã sasa.Sɩyao wã raab yaa tigs nin-sabls tẽns neb nins sẽn dɩk teedã naaneg tɩ ya b tʋʋmdã, sẽn na n yɩlẽ, tɩ b tõog n pʋɩ taab bãngre, la b koos b teedo. Rõandã soabã, yaa nug-tʋm-tʋmdb sõor sẽn ta bãmb 4000 n na n zĩnd tigs-kãngã pʋgẽ. Sẽn leb n paasdẽ neb 350 000 n segd n yi tẽns 25 pʋgẽ, n wa gilg n ges teedã.kibarã yii Faso.net

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, A Salifu Rigobɛɛr KONGO maan a pipi sebr zulukri, Kombisr soolmẽ wã. Sebrã yʋʋr yaa: Maam ne m ba” yaa sebr sẽn wilgd yẽ  ne a ba vʋɩɩm sẽn yɩ a soaba”.Yɩ a zak rãmba, a zo-rãmba, a tʋmd-n-taase, la kiba-kɩtb taoore, la a Salifu Rigobɛɛr KONGO  sẽn yaa dipolmat sẽn dɩk a vʋʋsem, gʋlsa sebre, n wilgd n gomd yẽ ne a ba wã sẽn yɩ Rulgnaab a Tugr vʋɩɩm sẽn yɩ a soaba. Yaa sebr sẽn tar seb-vãt 192. Sẽn be sebrã pʋgã, wilgri, yaa Yinivɛrsite karen-saam-kasenga, Porfesɛɛr Sɩse, la b yãk t’a karem sebrã, n wɛgs kibay nins fãa sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã, n wilg zãma wã sẽn zĩnd zĩigẽ wã. A wilgame tɩ sebrã pʋgẽ, a Salifu Rigobɛɛr KONG sebrã pʋga, a gomda yẽ ne a ba wã Rulgnaab a Tugr sẽn tʋm tʋʋma ninsi. Porfɛɛser Sɩse pẽga seb-gʋndã, a sẽn lebg n dɩk bũmb nins fãa, a ba wã sẽn maane, tɩ b tẽngã neb fãa na n dɩ a yõod yʋʋm katɛk sẽn wat pʋgẽ wã. Rulgnaab a Tugr sẽn wa n kẽed Zãongẽ rẽ t’a Rigobɛɛr KONG tara yʋʋm 19.A Salif Rigobɛɛr KONG roga yʋʋm 1948 soabã. 

Rulg sak a yembre, b sẽn boond tɩ Gana, Bazɛɛg porvẽesã pʋgẽ. A yɩɩ Burkĩna Faso no-rɛɛs n zĩnd tẽns wʋsgo, a leb n tʋma Burkĩna Faso yʋʋr yĩng tʋʋm-noy wʋsg pʋgẽ. Yɩɩ yʋʋm 2006 soabã, la a rɩk a vʋʋsem. Kell n ya a vʋʋsmã pʋgẽ, la a paam weere, n gʋls a sebrã.Seb-gʋndã wilgame tɩ sebrã tara sags a yiibu. Pipi sakã wilgda a Mumuni Etɛnd KONGO, Rulnaab a Tugr vʋɩɩmã sẽn yɩ toto. Sak-kãng pʋgẽ a wilgame tɩ Rulgnaab Tugr yɩɩ ned sẽn tall yam yãk-sõngo. Yaa ned sẽn dɩk nebã sõngr n lʋɩɩs taoore. Seb-gʋndã kell n dɩka Rulgnaab goam kẽere, la b sẽn da maan bũmb ninsi, n ning pipi sakã pʋgẽ.Sak a yiib n soabã, wilga tʋʋm-bɛd nins Rulgnaab a Tugr sẽn tʋm b naamã zãab pʋgẽ. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa kaorengã la pagbã yel-segdɩ wɛɛngẽ.A Salifu Rigobɛɛr KONG boonda nin-buiidã sẽn yɩɩd fãa Baazɛɛg soolmẽ kom-bɩɩbã tɩ b modg n paam sebrã n karem t’a na n sõng-b-la b vʋɩɩmã siglg wɛɛngẽ, la a kɩt tɩ b bãng b sɩngrã sẽn ya a soaba. Nand t’a gʋls sebrã, a Salifu Rigobɛɛr KONGO ra gʋlsda Zʋgnall rãmb kẽer pʋse, tɩ b ra boonda koe-zugã t’a Sɩdkɛta. Sebrã yiib poore a Salifu Rigobɛɛr kell n kosa kiba kɩtbã tɩ b taas nin-buiidã tɩ wakat sẽn wate, a na maana Dogtora, bãngr kaset sebr ning b sẽn boond ne farend tɩ tɛɛsã. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 11 fãa Burkĩna Faso rãmb tẽegda b tẽngã soog-m-meng yelle. Rõandã yʋʋm 2022 soabã, ya a yʋʋm 62, la tẽngã nug-gãng sẽn ya a soabã kɩtame tɩ b pa maan tigr ye. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 10 soabã, tẽngã taoor soab rɩka koɛɛn gom ne Burkĩna Faso nin-uiidã. A kell n kosame tɩ b kẽes b mense, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ tẽngã sɩd paam soog-m-meng sɩdsɩda.Tẽngã naab koees pʋga, a wilgame tɩ wakatã ka tigr maaneg wakat ye. Tɩ bala, tẽngã ka so a meng ye. Bɛɛbã bee tẽngã babs wʋsg pʋse, n kɩt tɩ arzɛkã pa le kẽnd wa sẽn segd ye. Yaa rẽ n so t’a ka na n gom gom-wogd ye.A kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ rasem sẽn looge, rat n yeel tɩ bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, teoong n zĩnd tẽngã taoore, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ tẽngã tõog n paam a soog-m-menga, la rasma noorã, maoor ning sẽn na n kɩt tɩ tẽnga paam a soog-m-mengã sɩgame, la mao-kãng ya ne za- teedo, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n dig bɛɛbã sẽn dat n soog tẽngã. Tẽnga taoor soab bẽdame n pẽg sodaas buud toor-toore, sẽn sak n sɩd kẽes b toog tẽngã fãagr yĩngã. Bala, yaa kiis katɛk la b be zabrã pʋga, n koosd b yõy tẽngã fãagr yĩnga. A pʋʋsa nin-buiidã sẽn sak n kẽes b toog Vedepe rãmbã gʋls wɛɛngẽ n na n sõng n zabã. Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame tɩ koodã b sẽn tall rasma noor n tɩ kõ nin-buiidã, yaa tẽngã kamb n sak n dɩk b mobila n sõng tɩ b tõog n kẽng ne koodã. A pẽgame la a wilg tɩwoto wilgdame tɩ sõng-taabã paamda pãng n paasdẽ. Yaa woto wilgdame tɩ Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã lebgame n na n vʋɩɩmd sõng taabã pʋgẽ.Sẽn kẽed ne VEDEPE rãmba zãmsg wɛɛngẽ, tẽngã taoor soab wimgame tɩ b paama sõngre. Yaa rẽ tɩ b pʋʋsd neb nins sẽn maan sõngrã barka, la a wilgdẽ, tɩ b ket n data sõngre.Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR pʋʋsa Burkĩna Faso kamb nins sẽn be we-loorã barka, b sẽn kẽes b meng n sõngd tẽngã. A wilgame tɩ b sega b tʋmd-n-taas kẽere, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n le kos b tɩ b sõng nin-buiidã sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ yɩ burkĩnmba, n tõog n zab n deeg b tẽngã. Tẽngã taoor soab leb n tẽegame tɩ b pa na n maan tigr ye. Bala, tẽngã pa soa a meng zãng ye.A kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b toeem na-kẽndre, la b lebg n sulg n ges b sɩngrẽ wã, bala zab n fãag-m-mengã yaa bũmb sẽn segd n zab ne zab-teedo, la arzɛka.Rẽ n so tɩ b segd n deng n zab ne wẽgbã, la ninsaal yam daabã. Tẽngã taoor soab pasaame tɩ zabrã pa na n sa tɩ Burkĩna Faso kambã sã n pa tõe n paam rɩɩb tɩ sek-ba la b tõe n gãand n gũs ne bãane b tẽnsã pʋsẽ ye. La a kõo sɩd tɩ b na n tõoga zabrã.Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR kosa nin-buiidã fãa tɩ b kell n gãd taaba, la b yals sodaasã la neb nins sẽn kẽes b toog n zabd n fãagd tẽngã poorẽ, tɩ b tõog n naag taab n zab tɩ tẽngã paam a soog-m-meng sɩd-sɩda. A koeesã baosgẽ, a kosa Wẽnd tɩ b kõ neb nins sẽn paam sãmpoagã laafɩ, la Wẽnd na maag tẽng neb nins yõy sẽn pa zabrã pʋga.

Gosneem no-rɛɛs a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ b rɩgsa noy ministɛɛr dãmb kẽer pʋsẽ, sẽn na yɩl n sõng tẽngã t’a kẽng taoore, la yõ-koglgã me tõog n zĩndi.Sã n ya ne ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kadensã, la yõ-koglgã zĩigẽ, miniisr dãmbã rɩka noor n na n ges neb nins sẽn kẽes b toog ne yamleoog n na n zab n fãag tẽngã tɩ b boond tɩ VDP rãmbã. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ b na n lebg n demsa nug tikr ning b sẽn da maan yʋʋm 2020 soabã, n n paam n sigl VDP rãmbã tʋʋmd sẽn segd n yɩ a soab tẽngã pʋgẽ. Sẽn paasde, b na n lebg n gesa na-kẽnda nins sẽn tõe n sõng BVDP wã . Yẽ soabã yaa sodaas sull ning sẽn get VDP rãmbã, tɩ b tõog n paam bũmb ning fãa sẽn segd neb zabrã zĩigẽ.Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get arzɛkã la moeendã zĩigẽ, miniisr dãmbã lebg n gesa gosneem sẽn yis ligd ning yʋʋm 2022 soabã pʋgẽ. Miniisr NAKANABO wilga zĩ-kãng tɩ sẽn sɩng ne bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 sẽn loogã, ligd sõor sẽn da segd n kẽ koglgã pʋgã, koabg zugu yaa 79 n kẽ, la boto wilgdame tɩ tʋʋmdã yɩɩ sõma. Bala, gɛɛlã pʋga, bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 wã tɛka ligdãsõor sẽn da segd n kẽ yaa koabg zug 75. Miniisrã pẽga tʋʋm-noy nins fãa sẽn kẽes b toog tɩ ligdã tõog n kẽ wã. Sãn ya ne ligdã sõor sẽn yi wã, gosneem wilgame t’a yiisgã tũu wa sẽn segde.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get Sãnmã la kʋʋra wã zĩigẽ, gosneem maana nug tikri, sẽn na n yɩl n kõ Sãnem tʋʋm-noor a ye b sẽn boond tɩ Yimiuugunorgold t’a na n sɩng a tʋʋma Yimiuug Sãnmã tʋʋm zĩigẽ. Miniisr Sɩmo Pɛɛr BUSIM wilgame tɩ b sẽn kõ tʋʋm-noorã sor t’a na n sɩng Sãnmã yãkrã, a tõe n yɩɩ sabaab tɩ b paam Sãnem toand a 2 la pʋsʋka, yʋʋm a 4 pʋgẽ. A na n le sõngame tɩ Bisagold tʋm-tʋmdbã kell n paam be n tʋme. Miniisr dãmbã kell n pʋɩɩ taab yam buud toor-toore, sẽn kẽed ne tʋʋm kẽer sẽn na sõng Burkĩna Faso t’a tõog n paam yõod Sãnmã wɛɛngẽ. B wilgame tɩ b segd n lebg n gesa nug-tigsa b sẽn da gãneg Sãnmã tʋʋm pʋgẽ, tɩ b boond tɩ Koodmindye wã. B leb n wilgame tɩ b na n sigla tʋʋm-noor tɩ band Sãnmã Burkĩna Faso ka, n paam n tõog n bãng Sãnem toand sõor sẽn yit tõnd tẽn-gãongã pʋgẽ.Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 6 yʋʋm 2022 soaabã, a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO, miniisr ning sẽn get kibayã kũun la kʋdemdã yell n le ya gosneem no-rɛɛsã sega kiba-kɩtbã taoor dãmba.Sɛkã pʋgẽ, b goma zu-loees nins sẽn be kiba-kɩtbã soog-m-meng wɛɛngẽ, sẽn yɩɩd fãa kibay nins sẽn yit ẽntɛgnetã zugu, n le paas gosneem kibay kũun pʋgẽ.Miniisr Zã Emanwɛll rɩka koɛɛg n pẽg Burkĩna Faso kiba-kitbã taoor dãmba, b sẽn maood tɩ kibayã tat nin-buiidã. Minisrã kẽnga taoor n wilg kiba-kɩtbã taoor dãmb tɩ tẽnga sẽn be zu-loɛɛg ning pʋg rũnda-rũnda wã, segdame tɩ kiba-kɩtbã maneg n ges b tʋʋmdã na-kẽndre. Sẽn kẽed ne Fãrens kiba-kɩtbã sẽn maa a soab tɩ b yals b tʋʋmdã, a yeelame tɩ Burkĩna Faso kibayã kũun rot sẽn ka maand a soabã, b ka na sak tɩ tẽng a to kibay kũun roog wa maan rẽ tõnd tẽngã ye.

Sẽn kẽed ne soog-m-meng n kõt kibayã ẽntɛgnetã zugã, sẽn yɩɩd fãa tʋʋbã, bu-welsgã, la bool neb tɩ b yãk ned yõorã, a wilgame tɩ gosneem na n tʋmame tɩ kiba-kɩtbã soog-m-meng kẽng taoore, la b ka na n sak tɩ ned wa sãam-a ye.Kiba-kɩtbã taoor dãmb pẽga miniisrã yam yãkre, la b kell n kos gosneem t’a kẽng taoor ne kibay nins a sẽn da kõt miniisr dãmbã tigsg poorã, la kibay sẽn kẽed ne bũmb nins fãa sẽn pɩʋʋgd zabrã pʋgẽ wã. B kell n kosame tɩ b sulg n ges zu-loɛɛg ning sẽn be sull ning sẽn get kibayã remsg zĩigẽ, b sẽn boond tɩ SEYƐSSE wã pʋgẽ.Miniisr Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG pʋlmame tɩ b na maan b pãng sẽn tõe, tɩ b sẽn kos bũmb ninsã paam pidsgu. A kell n wilgame tɩ b sẽn ka kõt kibay ning sẽn pɩʋʋgd zabrã zĩigẽ wã, yaa na-kẽndr sẽn na n yɩl n sõng tʋʋmdã. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ wakat sẽn wate, b na n yãka ned t’a yɩ sodaasã no-rɛɛsa. Yẽ soabã na n yitame, n kõt nin-buiidã sodaarã tʋʋm pʋgẽ kibaya.Kibarã yii ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kibayã kũun yell nenegẽ

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 6 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR tika nug n wilg t’a Abdulaziz BAMOOG lebga sull ning sẽn get kibayã kũun remsg taoor soaba. Nug tikrã wa n kɩtame tɩ tʋʋm-noorã na n tõog n sɩng a tʋʋma masã wala sẽn segde.Tẽegre, yɩɩ tʋʋlg kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã, la neb a nu bãmb b wɛ wã sʋk ra yãk a Abdulaziiz BAAGMOOGO, t’a lʋɩ SEYƐSSE wã taoore, la a wakatã  pag a ye, b sẽn boond t’a Danyɛll BUGAYIRI me ra baoodame n na n lʋɩ sullã taoore. Yaa rẽ, t’a wilg t’a pa sak ye. Yaa rẽ, tɩ b ra kẽng ne gomdã bʋ-kaodb taoore. Bʋʋdã sẽn bʋ wã, a Abdulaziiz BAAGMOOG paama bʋʋm. La ba ne a sẽn paam bʋʋmã, a Poll Ãari Sãndaoogo DAMIB sẽn da ya tẽngã taoor soab a wakatẽ wã ka tol n sak n tik  nug n kõ-a sor t’a sɩng a tʋʋma ye. Hal a Matiyaas TÃNKOANO sẽn dɩgl a sigb sebr bõobɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2021 soabã, n bas tʋʋm-noorã tɛka, ra ya Abdulaziz BAAGMOOG n da get sullã tʋʋma.Kibarã yii AYIBE

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, gosneema no-rɛɛs a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOG yiisa koɛɛg sẽn tũ ne neb sẽn dɩkd koees n bugsd kiba-kɩtbã b tʋʋma wɛɛngẽ.Koeesã pʋga, a wilgame tɩ rasem a noore neb wʋsg n zẽk koees ẽntɛgnetã pʋga , n tʋʋd la b bugsd kiba-kɩtbã sẽn tũud ne b kibayã kɩsg wɛɛngẽ.Gosneem wilga b su-pa-noang ne b sẽn boond nebã tɩ b tɩ sãam kiba-kɩtb kẽer teedo, ka rẽ bɩ b kʋ-bã. Wakat sẽn loog pʋgẽ, yaa kiba-kɩt a lamin TARWARE, la a Newtoand Ameed BAARI, la neb rɩk koees n bugsi. Yaa rẽ tɩ gosneem wilg t’a buudã wata ne welgre. Rẽ so tɩ b boond nebã tɩ b tall maag-m-menga, la b tʋm tɩ zems taab n vɩɩmdã kell n paam pãng Burkĩna Faso, tɩ bala, sasa-kãngã nebã fãa segd n gãda taab nusi. Gosneema wilgame tɩ na-kẽndr rɩkame sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ kba-kɩtbã soog-m-mengã, la nebã mens la b arzekã koglg kẽng taoore. Tẽngã taoor dãmb le kosame n yɩlem tɩ Burkĩna Faso nebã tall wʋmd-n-taar yam, la b mao n tũ sari sẽn gãnege.

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Tãrazisẽo wã depite taoor soab ne a poor n dãmbã tɩ sega Moognaab a Bãong ne Merka rãmbã sull taoor soaba.Yaa Sapaolg kiug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2022 soabã la b zĩnig depite rãmbã sulli. Rẽ loogr poore, tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soab a Wʋsmaan BUGMA ne a poorẽ dãmbã, wilgame tɩ yaa bũmbli a tãab yĩng la b yãk yam n na n wa seg Moog Naab nengẽ. Pipi yaa sẽn na yɩl n paam saglse. Sẽn paasde, yaa zɩlem-sõng la b wa n bao. Sẽn na n baase, yaa kosg la b kos pãng soab tɩ b sõng Burkĩna Faso t’a tõog n yi zu-loɛɛg ning pʋg a sẽn be wã.

Moognaab pẽga b yam yãkrã la b kos tɩ b sak n kẽes b toog n tʋm tẽngã na kẽng toaar wɛɛngẽ. B kell n kos-b lame tɩ b sulg n ges tẽn-gãongã zãab yelle, bala, a zul-oe-kasengã b sẽn tar goam wakat fãa wã yaa kibayã kũun rot pʋse. Depite rãmbã taoor soab wilgame tɩ zĩ-kãnga, b na n dɩka na-kẽndre, n bool tẽngã ninbuiidu, lagem-n-taar sula fãa tɩ b zĩnd n bao yellã tɩɩm. A Wʋsmaan BUGMA kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ sẽn kẽed ne Burkĩndã wɛɛngẽ, pãng soab kõo bãmb sagls b sẽn tõe n dɩk n tʋm tɩ nebã naag taab vɩɩmdã paam pãng n paase.B sẽn yi Moognaab nengẽ, Depite rãmbã taoor soab ne a poorẽ dãmbã kẽnga Merka rãmbã sull-kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ FEME wã taoor soab nengẽ. Sullã taoor soaba, Pastɛɛr Ãari YE, pẽga b yam yãkrã. A wilgame tɩ yaa su-noog ne-ba, tẽngã taoor dãmb sẽn sak n yãk yam n na n seg Wẽnd-tũudbã. Pastɛɛr YE paasame tɩ b pʋʋsda wakat bũud fãa. Bala tẽngã tara pʋʋsg raabo. B pʋʋsdame sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ Wẽnd leok Burkĩna Faso kosgã. Tãrãzisẽo wã depite rãmb taoor soab le paama sagls zĩ-kãnga, sẽn na yɩl sõng-a t’a tõog n tʋm a tʋʋmdã sõma.kibarã yii Faso.net

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã yell sega kiba-kɩtbã yʋʋm-sar kiuug pipi daare yʋʋm 2022 soabã. Sɛkã pʋgẽ, b wilga kiba-kɩtbã tɩ Sĩnma wã tigr b sẽn boond tɩ FESPAKO a naoor 28 soabã, na n zĩnda Waogdgo, ao-fugdg kiuug rasem 25 n ta tʋʋlg kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ. Gom-zug b sẽn yãk n na maan tigrã, yaa “Nin-sabls tẽnsẽ Sĩnma wã, tʋʋmd kʋdemdã la laafɩ wã pʋgẽ”. Kell n yɩɩ wakat b sẽn le wilg naand b sẽn tik n na n maan tigrã.Tigs-bɛd wʋsg viiga Burkĩna Faso sẽn tũ ne tẽngã nug-gãag sẽn ya a soabã, rẽ n kɩt tɩ neb wʋsg ra sãmbd tɩ Fespako wã me na n viigame. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug pipi daare yʋʋm 2022 soabã, a Galip SOME sẽn ya derktɛɛr de kabĩne n be Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã, ne Fespako wã taoor soab sega kiba-kɩtbã miniisr Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG yʋʋr yĩnga, n wilg tɩ Sĩnma wã tigs kaseng na n tõogame. Kell n yɩɩ wakat b sẽn wilg tɩ b sũur ka noom ne SIYAO wã, la SNC wã b sẽn viig-ba ye. Rẽ n so tɩ b wilg tɩ ba ne tõnd tẽngã sẽn vʋɩ yõ-koglg kaalem pʋgẽ wã, rẽndame tɩ b maan modgr n tõog tɩ tig kẽer sẽn sõngd tẽngã arzɛkã kẽesg wɛɛngẽ wã mi n tõog n zĩndi. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ tẽngã taoor dãmb yãk yam n na n maan modgre, tɩ tig-kãngã tõoge, t’a sõngda nin-sabls tẽnsẽ Sĩnim maandbã tɩ b paamd n segd taab n pʋɩ taab yam dãmb sẽn tõe n sõng-b tɩ b tʋʋmdã kẽng taoore.A Galip SOME wilgame tɩ yaa tẽngã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR n dɩk na-kẽnd kãngã t’a na n tõog n zĩndi. A kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b sak n tũ na-kẽn- paal nins Fespako wã taoor dãmb sẽn na n dɩkã.Sã n ya sẽn gom-zugã b sẽn yãkã, kʋdemdã ministɛɛr taoor dãmb wilgame t’a tara pãng wʋsgo. Tɩ d sã n mi tɩ Sĩnma wã sẽn sõngd toto wubrã wɛɛngẽ. Sẽn tũud ne sulunsugdã ne goam nins sẽn yit a pʋgẽ wã. Miniisrã goam pʋgẽ, a kosa Sĩnim maandbã tɩ b modg tɩ b Sĩnim dãmba gom vʋɩɩmd-n- taarã la wʋm taabã wɛɛngẽ. Sẽn na yɩle, tɩ nin-sbls tẽnsã tõog n naag taab n kẽng taoore, b tẽnsã yidgr pʋgẽ.Seg-taabã pʋg me, b kell n wilga naandã b sẽn tik n na n maan Sĩnma wã naoor 28 soabã võore. Yaa pag sẽn bob pɛɛmã, n mubl a rɩtg nugã, la a zãad rasaar ne a goabgã. A Gerigoaar DABILG tɩ b boond t’a ELMarto, ned ning sẽn naan-a naandã wilgame tɩ pagã makda wa a Sarunya sẽn yɩ Nizɛɛr pʋg-gãn-daoog a ye. A kell n paasame, t’a naana naandã n na n waoog nin-sabls tẽns pagb nins sẽn zabd b tẽnsã fãagr yĩngã.Kibarã yii Faso.net

da rat n maan naam wẽ-n-dɩkã, miniisr ning sẽn get kibayã kũun yelle, n la yaa gosneema no-rɛɛs wilgame tɩ tẽnga taoor soab pa tol n gom naam wẽ-n-dɩk yell ye. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ tẽngã taoor soab sẽn seg nin-zals lagem-n-taar sula yʋʋm-sar kiuug pipi daarã , a togsame tɩ neb n be tẽngr n dat n sãam gosneem tʋʋma, yaa rẽ n kɩt t’a wilg tɩ b na n kẽe yẽsgo, ne neb nins sẽn dat n maan rẽ wã. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ wakat kãngã, ka zoe n dɩk neb kẽer tɩ ya bɛɛb wakat ye. B miime tɩ bũmb ning sẽn maan Bõnbɩʋʋg kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, ka noom neb kẽer ye. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ tẽngã sẽn vʋɩ zu-loɛɛg ning pʋg rũnda wã, segdame tɩ kiba-kɩtbã tʋm ne bãngre, n tõog n da wa kɩsd kibay sẽn ka sɩd zãng ye.Kibarã yii Burkina 24

Arb daar fãa, gosneem miniisdãmbã segda taaba. Yʋʋm 2022 soabã, b sega taab sapaolg kiuug rasem 30, wa b sẽn minim n maandẽ, la yɩɩ Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR taoore. Gosneem no-rɛɛs a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ b rɩka noy wʋsgo b seg-taabã pʋgẽ.Sã n ya ne ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kadengã tʋmtʋmdb zĩigẽ, b rɩka noor n na n gɩdg tɩ b ra le rɩk politik tʋʋmd n kẽes gosneer tʋʋm noyã pʋs ye. Sẽn get-a nug-tik kãngã, yaa miniisr Basolma BAAZIE. A wilgame tɩ na-kẽndrã ra zoe n bee Burkĩna Faso tẽn-kugr ning b sẽn gʋls sigr kiuug rasem 2 yʋʋm 1991 soabã, a no-rikr 12 soabã zĩigẽ. B zĩniga nin-kẽem-sõms sull yʋʋm 2006 soabã, tɩ b sulg n ges no-rɩkrã a Noorbɛɛr ZÃONG kʋʋbã loogr poore. Nug-tik- kãng na n sõngame tɩ gosneem tʋm-noyã fãa ra kẽ tʋʋm-sõms pʋgẽ, tɩ neb nins fãa sẽn kõt b mens tʋʋmdã pʋgã ra tõog n paamd keoor ning sẽn segd ne-ba. Woto na n kɩtame tɩ pʋpeelem zĩnd tʋʋma pʋga, tɩ tẽngã tõog n kẽng taoore.

Miniisr ning sẽn get tʋmtʋmdbã kell n wilgame tɩ b sã n tik no-rɩkrã, b tõe n gesa ned fãa tʋʋmd na-kẽndrẽ n yaool n dɩk a soabã, n lʋɩɩs tʋʋm-noor taoore. A pa na n le tũ ne a sẽn be pagtɩ politik ning pʋgẽ ye. Woto me, rɩkd gosneem mobilã n tar n maand naamã baoob nogooma me na n tũu be n kolg weoogo.Sẽn kẽed ne ministɛɛr ning sẽn get tẽngã arzɛk zãab zĩigẽ, miniisr dãmbã tika nug n wilg ligd sõor b sẽn na n dɩk n tʋm yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ. Miniisr Abubakar NAKANABO wilgame tɩ yaa zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã zĩigẽ̃, la b na n kẽes ligdã n wa tɩ yɩɩge. Yaa ligd sõor sẽn na n ta milyaar 2600 la b tõe n kẽes yʋʋm 2023 pʋge.̃ La ligd sẽn na n yi yaa milyaar 3200. Gosneerã b segd n baoo ligd sõor sẽn ta milyaar 600 n paase, tɩ b tõog n tʋm tʋʋma. Sẽn na yɩlẽ n paam ligdã, gosneem yãka yam n na baoo tʋmd-n-taas sẽn na n sak n sõng ne milyaar 600.Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get sari wã la ninsaal yalẽ wã zĩigẽ, gosneem rɩka noore, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n koglg nin-buiidã wala, nin-wẽnse, bɩ tʋʋm-yoodã rãmb sẽn mi n yõk ned menesã wɛɛngẽ. Zĩ-kãnga, miniisr Bibata NEBIYE wilgame tɩ tʋʋlg kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã, b wilga tʋʋmdã na-kẽndr sebre. Seb-kãng rɩglgã na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso tɩ b tõog n tũ na-kẽnda nins b sẽn gãneg ãndũni ninsaal yalẽ wã wɛɛngẽ, la ãnduni wã pʋgẽ.Na-kẽnd-kãng na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã tɩ b wilg tʋʋm nins b sẽn maan yʋʋm 2016 , la yʋʋm 2021 soabã ninsaal yalẽ wã waoogr yĩnga.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso gosneema taoor soaba, Metr Apolineer KELEM reega Farens no-rɛɛsa a Lik HALADE. B seg taabã poore a Lik HALAD wilgame t’a yẽesa ne Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soaba, sẽn kẽed ne tẽns a yiibã ne taab zoodo, la sodaarã tʋʋmd pʋgẽ. A kell n togsame tɩ Farens rãmb na n yãaga Burkĩna Faso tɩ taoor dãmbã sã n wa mik tɩ raab ket n beeme. A pasaame tɩ Fãrens sodaasã taoor soab na n sega Burkĩna Faso miniisr ning sẽn get sodaasã tɩ b zĩnd n ges b sẽn na n lebg n sigl sodaarã tʋʋmd toto. 

A Lik HALAD wilgame tɩ bãmb tẽngã yaa Burkĩna Faso pipi pak-n-taaga, yaa rẽ ta wilg tɩ sodaasã tʋʋmd sẽn pa kẽnd wa sẽn segdã, b na n paasa tʋʋmdã pãnga, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n sõng n zab ne nin-wẽnsã. A wilgame t’a tara saagr tɩ Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã na n kẽnga taoor ne yẽsgã sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ tʋmd-n-taarã kẽng taoore.Sẽn kẽed ne arzɛkã wɛɛngẽ, Fãrens tẽngã no-rɛɛs wilgame tɩ bãmb tara ligd sẽn ta Ero wã milyão 100 n na n sõng Burkĩna Faso. Rẽ n so tɩ b pa na n bas sõngrã ba tɩ ninbuiid kẽer sã n zabd ne bãmba; sẽn kẽed ne nin-buiidã sẽn yit n sãamd Fãrens Ãmbasaadã la b tʋʋm-noy a taabã, a wilgame tɩ b teega Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã tɩ b kogl-ba.A Lik HALAD kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ bãmb tẽngã na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso sẽn yɩɩd fãa zu-loɛɛg ning a sẽn vʋɩ a soab pʋgẽ wã. A kell n kosa nebã tɩ b ra kelg neb nins sẽn wat ne kibay sẽn pa sɩd n dat n sãam tẽns a yiibã zoodã ye.kibarã yii Faso.net
