Sapaolg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, gosneem yiisa mooneg koɛɛga. Mooneg koɛɛgã pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ tʋmtʋmd nins sẽn da gẽ tɩ b gɩdg b kiuug yaoodã, b na n yaoo-b lame. Gosneem wilgame tɩ yaa tʋmtʋmdb nins b sẽns da sɩbg 2016 la 2021 soabã, yaa bãmb dãmbã la b na n lebs-b kiuugã yaoodo.Tẽegre, yɩɩ wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2016 soabã, la Burkĩna Faso bʋ-kaoodbã pa sak kɛgr sull kẽ gẽeb pʋgẽ, n wilg tɩ b ratame tɩ bʋ-kaood roogã soog a menga. Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ b ra sɩbg b tʋmtʋmdb kẽere. Wakat kãng me, Yinivɛrsite wã karen-saamb dãmb me ra kẽe gẽeb pʋgẽ, n da rat tɩ b ges b kiuugã ligd yelle, la b tʋʋma siglgu.Yaa sɩbg-kãens fãa la gosneer rɩk yam tɩ sapaolg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, b na n yãka noor ning sẽn gɩdg-bã, tɩ b lebg n paam b kiisã yaoodo.kibarã yii Faso.net

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Polɩɩs Minisipallã paga baar dãmb a 5 Arõndiisma a 3 ne a 4 pʋgẽ. Bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b pag-bã, yaa bʋʋr la b maand wʋsgo, tɩ sãamd neb nins zags pẽ baar dãmbã gõeem. Sẽn leb paasdẽ, b pa tar sor kũun sɛb wala sari sẽn wilg ye.Polɩɩs Minisipalã wilgame tɩ b yagsã togsa bãmb naoor katɛka, tɩ b tiisda b gõem la b rɩk na-kẽndre. Yaa rẽ, tɩ bãmb tik sari wã no-rɩkdg n°97-031/MATDS/PKA/CO laloa wã sẽn wilg tɩ b pag baar dãmb nins sẽn wat n ka tũud noorã. Polɩɩs rãmbã kell n kosa baar dãmbã taoor dãmb tɩ b maan modgr n tũ noor ning b sẽn gãnegã.kibarã yii Polɩɩs Minisipallã nengẽ

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, polɩɩs rãmbã taoor dãmb talla sɛk ne kiba kɩtbã n na n kõ-b vẽenem, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ b bãng b tʋʋmdã sẽn ya a soaba, la b sẽn segd n kogl nebã ne b arzɛkã toto. Komisɛɛr Apolineer KAFAAND sẽn ya polɩɩs rãmbã kiba-kɩt togsame, tɩ f sã n dat n kõ ned sɩda, rẽnd f reng n bãng a sẽn ya a soaba. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ b bool kiba-kɩtbã n na n wilgb polɩɩs tʋʋm na-kẽndr sẽn segd n yɩ a soaba. Polɩɩs rãmbã taoor soab a Rooze WEDRAOOGO, sõasgã ne kiba-kɩtbã sõngame tɩ b paamd vẽenem wʋsgo, polɩɩs rãmbã sẽn be tẽngã pʋg n tʋmdẽ võore. Polɩɩs pipi tʋʋm pakre, yaa nebã ne b arzɛkã koglgo. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ b rɩk na-kẽndr n wilg-b polɩɩs rãmbã tʋʋmde, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ b tõog n tʋm b tʋʋmdã kibayã kũun wɛɛngẽ t’a tẽeg tɩrga. Polɩɩs rãmbã taoor soab pẽga kiba-kɩtbã tʋʋmde, b kibaya kũun sẽn ya toto wã.

Kell n yɩɩ wakat polɩɩs rãmbã taoor soab sẽn wilg bãmb tʋʋma na-kẽndre, la neb sõor sẽn be a pʋgẽ, la btʋʋma zãmsg na-kẽndr sẽn ya a toto. Veẽnmã kũun poore, kiba-kɩtbã tall sogsg buud toor-toore, la b kõ b me tasgo, sẽn na n sõng tɩ b ne polɩɩs rãmbã tʋmd-n-taar tõog n paam pãnga. Kiba-kɩtbã sẽn gom a soab n yɩɩda, yaa ninsaal yam daabã , sull ning sẽn zabd ne rẽ wã rãmb sẽn wilg tɩ polɩɩs rãmbã n be taoorã.Zĩ-kãnga, a Rooze WEDRAOOG kos-b lame tɩ b sã n wa yã tɩ polɩɩs tʋmd ninsaal yam daab tʋʋmd bɩ b ning pãng tɩ ta b taoor dãmbã. A kell n kosa nebã fãa tɩ b sã n yã polɩɩs t’a yals sor zug n yeel t’a yao la a looge, a soabã ka segd n kõ-a ligd ye. B sẽn yet t’a soab yao wã tog n talla gomdã n kẽng Komsɛɛrya sẽn pẽ n tɩ wilg sebr ning b sẽn kõ-a wã, la a yao yaood ning b sẽn yeel t’a yao wã. Polɩɩs rãmbã taoor soab wilgame tɩ wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ, b na n le sigla tʋʋm a taaba, sẽn na n kɩt tɩ kiba-kɩtbã ne polɩɩs rãmbã tʋmd-n-taar paam pãnga.kibarã yii Faso.net

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR reega Nizɛɛr na-kʋdr a Mahamadu YISUFU, SEDEYAO sullã sẽn yãk t’a get Burkĩna Faso ne bãmb yẽsd-n-taarã yelle. B sõasgã baoosgẽ, a togsame t’a waoogã yaa sẽn na n ges Burkĩna Faso tãrãzisẽo wã zãab sẽn kẽnd toto, n paam tɩ SEDEYAO sullã rãmb seg-taab-kasengã sẽn na n zĩnd yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 4 Abuuza Nizɛɛrya na-tẽngã, bɩ b ges b sẽn tõe n dɩk noor ninga.Sõasgã sẽn wa n sa, t’a seg kiba-kɩtbã a wilgame tɩ tẽngã taoor soab na-kẽndr a sẽn gãnegã na n tõog n pidisa tãrãzisẽo wã tʋlsem.A kell n wilga Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR tɩ Nasẽozini, Yinão Afirkɛnd, SEDEYAWO, la Ze 5 Sayɛllã sẽn dat n dɩk na-kẽnda nins Sayɛllã koglg wɛɛngẽ. Zĩ kãnga Burkĩna Faso taor soabã wilgame t’a na n maan a sẽn tõe tɩ b sõng taaba.Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, tẽngã taoor soab tʋma miniisr ning sẽn get kadensã tʋʋma, a Basolma BAAZIE t’a tɩ kõ sore, tɩ b sɩng yʋʋm 2022 la yʋʋm 2023 soabã sapaol-koobo, la b kell n bog rũmsã sẽn na yɩlẽ n zab ne rũm-bãasã. Sorã kũun yɩɩ Tãngẽwoodo Sabu komindã Reezẽo de Sãntr wɛstã pʋgẽ. Yaa gosneema miniisr dãmb kẽere, la tẽngã rãmb zĩnda sʋka.Gom-zug b sẽn tik yʋʋm 2022 la yʋʋm 2023 soabã, yaa ka-koaadb la gʋʋndb paam bãngr n paas sapaol-koobã na tõog n kẽng taoore, la b rũmsã na paam laafɩ la koglgo. A Basolma BAAZIE sẽn pak tʋʋmdã tẽngã taoor soab yʋʋr yĩnga, a wilgame tɩ zu-loees nins sẽn be Burkĩna Faso wã kɩtame tɩ koobã la gʋʋlgã leb poorẽ. 

A yɩɩ sabaab n paas zu-loees a taab wala sa-paowã, la birgã kaalem n kɩt t’a ligdã lebg toogo. Koaadbã sẽn pa tar bãngr sõma koobã la gʋʋlgã wɛɛngẽ wã, kɩtame tɩ rũm-bãasã kʋʋd b rũmsã. Miniisr ning sẽn get koobã, a Deni WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ nasaar birgã ligd sẽn ya toogã, yaa ãndũni wã fãa pʋgẽ. Bala, tẽns koabg zugu, 80 bɩ 90 fãa birg yita tẽns nins be zab pʋgẽ wã. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa Risi. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ gosneer kot koaadbã, tɩ b tʋm ne bir-moaagã, t’a tõe n sõng-b lame. A yeel-b lame tɩ b maoome, tɩ birgã maaneg zĩig sẽn be Kugpɛɛlã na n tõog n sɩng tʋʋm yʋʋm 2023 pʋgẽ.Miniisr Basolma BAAZIE wilgame tɩ sapaol-koobã, la gʋʋlgã wɛɛngẽ zu-loees ka be ye. Bala, zĩ-koods ketame. Koom zĩis beeme, tɩ b tõe n tall n ko hɛgtaar 200 000. Gʋʋlgã me zĩis beeme , tɩ b tõe n tik n tʋme, tɩ nebã paam rɩɩb sõma. Miniisrã paasame tɩ b sã n tõog n kõ zĩis nins a sẽn wilgã, a na n sõngame tɩ neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnsã tõog n paam tʋʋma. Yʋʋm 2022 la yʋʋm 2023 soabã, b saagdame tɩ sapaol-koobã na n tõogame tɩ b paam kood biis sẽn ta toand 65000, la zẽ-biis sẽn tat toand 109000. Sẽn na n yɩlẽ, tɩ b raabã paam pidsgu, gosneem rɩka koob la gʋʋlg teedo, la teed a taab n kõ-ba. B na n manega baraas rãmb a 4 Sãntrsɩɩde, Palatosãntralle, la Noor reezẽo pʋgẽ. Ligd sõor b sẽn dɩk n kẽes taa milyaar 10, tɩ b na n ko yʋʋm 2022 la yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ. Tʋʋmdã tɩ baasa ne rũm-bɛda, la rũm-bãoones bogbo, la gilg n ges kood biis buud toor-toore.Kibarã yii Faso.net

Sapoalg kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, buudã goam kiba-kɩtb lagem-n-taar b sẽn boond tɩ AEPZILƐND (AEPJLN) boola b tʋmtʋmdbã Nongaana, Lumbil Komindã pʋg n kõ-b Zãmsgo, sẽn kẽed ne yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ, kibaya kũun sẽn togd n kẽn toto.B gom-zug b sẽn tiki, yɩɩ kibay kũun ne vɩɩmd-n-taare: kiba-kɩt tʋʋmd yõ-koglg kaalem wakate, la nin-buiidã sẽn vɩ zu-loeesã pʋgẽ wã. Karen-saamb kasengã yɩɩ mise Ãdma BAARO, kiba-kɩt sẽn dɩk b vʋʋsem, n be Lekoll kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ YISTIKÃ ( ISTIC) n ket n karmd kibaya kɩsg karen-biisi. Yaa sull ning sẽn teend kibay kũun nins sẽn so b mense, tɩ boond tɩ FAPEPE ( FAPP) wã n kõ-b sõngre, tɩ b reeg n zãms b tʋmtʋmdbã yõ-kaalem sasa kibaya tʋʋm sẽn segd n yɩ a soaba.Tʋʋmdã sɩngrẽ AEJPLN taoor soabã, Evariis ZÃONGO, ne a pʋgdgã a Taasre KĨNDA, bãmb n dɩk koeesã, n pʋʋs kiba-kɩtbã ne b waoongo, la b wilg tɩ zãmsgã yaa bũmb b sẽn saagd t’a na n sɩd sõnga b tʋmtʋmdbã, tɩ bala, Burkĩna Faso , neb koabg pʋgẽ, pis-wɛ la zakã fãa pa wʋmd nasaara wã goam ye. Nin-buiidã wʋsg wʋmda buudã goama, b leb n vʋɩɩ tẽngã babs nins zu-loees sẽn waoogẽ wã. Yaa rẽ tɩ buudã goam kiba-kɩtb segd n kẽes b toogo, ne rabay buud toor-toore, n sõng-b tɩ b tõog n mogb taab n vʋɩɩmde, la b ra welg taab tɩ rẽ me le wa wa ne zu-loees a taab ye.Zãmsgã sɩnga kiuugã rasem 22 n ta a rasem 24 raare.

Yaa sẽn kẽed ne kiba-kɩt sẽn segd n zã a meng toto, a tʋʋmdã wɛɛngẽ, n da wa ne welgre, la zũnglg tẽng pʋgẽ ye. Rat n yeel tɩ kiba-kɩt sẽn segd n tall a meng toto, n tõog n pidis noy nins tõnd tẽngã tẽn-kugr sẽn dɩke, b tʋʋmdã na-kẽndr wɛɛngẽ.B leb n paamame tɩ b sull ning sẽn banda kibaya rat yeel tɩ SEYƐSE wã, no-gãnegdɩ tɩ sebr b sẽn boond tɩ Sartã n wegs-a n kõ-b vẽenem. Karen-saamb kasengã mise Adma BAARO wilgame tɩ kiba-kɩt segd n talla maag-m-meng wakat buud fãa a tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ. A ka segd n yiis kibare, sẽn ka vẽeneg a, bɩ a sẽn ka tar kibar ning vẽenem ye. A modg t’a sã n na n n yiis kibare, bɩ a reng n paam yellã kaseto, n yaool n dɩk-a n taas nin-buiidã. B wilgame tɩ kiba-kɩt ka segd n yɩ sõng-yook soaba, a tʋʋmdã pʋg ye. Zãmsg-kãngã pʋgẽ, AEPEZILƐND kiba-kɩtbã paama bãngre, sẽn kẽed ne kibaya kũun na-kẽnda buud toor-toor zugu. Karen-saamb kasengã pʋɩ-b-la sula a nu, tɩ sull fãa maan tʋʋmdã makre, n wa tɩ b zĩnd n bale. Balbã, poore, yɩɩ wɩdga, sẽn na yɩl tɩ ned kam fãa bãng a sẽn tõe zĩig ninga, la a sẽn ka tõeẽ. Zĩnd n bala, poore, sẽn paam-b zãmsgã sũur yɩɩ noogo, hal tɩ b pẽge, la b bõos tɩ b leb n sõng-b ne zãmgsg a taaba. Zãmsgã wa n tɩ paga a kʋlens ne Fot rãmb yõgbo la b pʋʋs taaba, tɩ ned kam fãa rɩk a yir sore.Pẽngdwẽnde Erik Zinaaba, la a Zɩll Kafaando

Yɩɩ seg-taab ning sẽn zĩnd Ãkara Gãna na-tẽngã Sapaolg kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, n tigim nin-sabls tẽns wĩndg sẽn lʋɩtẽ tẽnsã taoor dãmb la b gosneem taoor dãmbã, la b yãk yam n na n zĩnig sodaas sulli, tɩ b sõng n zab ne nin-wẽnsã.Tigsgsã pʋgẽ b wilgame tɩ tẽns a 7 wa fãa sẽn be sullã pʋg na n yãka sodaas tɩ b kẽ sullã pʋgẽ, la yaa ligd sẽn ta milyaar 328 la b na n dɩk n sɩng tʋʋmdã. Sula a taab wala, Yiniyão Eropeyɛnd, SEDEYAWO, Yiniyão Afirikɛnd, la Gãrãs Bertae rãmb wilgame tɩ b na n yãag-b-la b yam yãkrã wɛɛngẽ.Tẽnsã, la b gosneema taoor dãmb wilgame tɩ yaa yam yãk-sõngo, la b sã n tõog n zĩinig sodaasã sull kãngã ka ne kiuugu, Ãkara tigsgã poore, n ya sõma n yɩɩda.Burkĩna Faso tẽngã gosneem taoor soaba Apolineer KELEM zĩnda tigsgã pʋgẽ. A koeesã pʋgẽ, a wilgame tɩ rẽndame tɩ nin-sablsã mens yik n zab n fãag b mense la b ra gũ tɩ sõngr yi zĩig a to n wa ye. Bala, nin-sabls tẽnsã rãmb sã n data b tõe n tigsa ligd b tʋʋma pʋsẽ n sõng b mense. A kẽnga taoor n paas t’a ka na n dɩk vɩʋʋg tɩ ya tigsg katɛk maaneg ye.Sodaasã sull b sẽn zĩnigã, a na n zĩnda Tamale Gãna tẽng a ye pʋga, la kibayã baoob sull na n n zĩnda Waogdgo, Burkĩna Faso na-tẽngã . Nizerya tẽngã b sẽn yãk t’a na n ges tʋʋmdã kẽndã, wilgame t’a na n sõnga sodaasã ne Sɩlse, la zab-teedo.Mali tẽngã taoor dãmb pa wa naag tigsgã sẽn zĩnd Ãkara soolmẽ wã Sapaolg kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2022 soabã ye. Yaa sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm 2017 soabã, la tẽnsã taoor dãmb ra zĩnd n tags sullã yelle. A sɩngrẽ wã b ra wilgame tɩ yaa kibay la b na n pʋɩt taaba, la b rɩkd zãmsg n taas sodaasã, la b tʋmd-b tɩ b tɩg n zĩndid tẽnsã ne taab toosẽ, la yaa yʋʋm a 5 loogr poore, la tʋʋmdã yaool n tõoge, n na n sigli. Sull-kãngã zĩniga wakat ninga, sull b sẽn da reng n zĩnig tɩ b boond tɩ Ze5 sayɛllã sẽn tar pã-komslem.Kibarã yii Lɩɩbre Ẽnfo.net

Tãrãzisẽo wã Depite rãmb sull b sẽn boond tɩ ALT wã yiisa koɛɛg n wilg tɩ sapaolg kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso gosneema taoor soaba, Metr Apolineer KELEM de Taanbɛɛl na n yalsa Asãmble wã depite rãmb taoor yibeoog wakat 10 sasa n wilg soay nins a sẽn gãneg n na n zã gosneemã. A yaa bũmb sẽn be Burkĩna Faso tẽn-kugrã no-rɩkr 63 soabã, pʋgẽ. No-rɩkã wilgdame tɩ yaa tɩlae ne gosneem taoor soab fãa, t’a yals depite rãmbã taoore, n wilg tʋʋm nins a sẽn gãneg n na n tʋm tẽnga taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ. Tẽegre, yaa zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 21 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, la tẽngã taoor soab yãk Metr Apolineer KELEM t’a zĩnd gosneemã taoore.Kibarã yii Faso.net

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 17 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Metr Benewẽnd SÃNKAR sẽn ya bʋ-kaod-soãngdã, n leb n ya pagtɩ Politik taoor soabã, zẽk a naoor n kẽng reezẽo di Sãntr Guvɛgnoora, n tɩ gʋls a yʋʋr n na n sõng sodaasã n zab n fãag tẽngã. Metr Benewẽnd SÃNKAR wilgame t’a yam yãkrã pa sẽn nan maan n bao yʋʋr ye, yaa tẽngã taoor soab sẽn dɩk noy nins rasma noorã n kõ-a raoodo. Kiba-kɩtbã sẽn sok-a bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a ning sodaasã fuugu, n wa na n gʋls a yʋʋrã. Sapaolg kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, miniisr dãmbã leb talla b seg-taab ning b sẽn maand Arb raar fãa ne tẽngã taoor soabã. B sõasgã poore, a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO, miniisr ning sẽn get kibayã kũun la kʋdemdã, n leb n ya gosneem no-rɛɛsã wilga noy nins b sẽn dɩk tigsgã pʋgẽ. A togsame, tɩ b rɩka noore, tẽngã taoor soaba, ne a gosneemã taoor soaba, la tʋʋm-no-bɛdã taoor dãmb kiuugã yaood zugu. A togsame tɩ b kiisa noor ning b sẽn da rɩk tʋʋl-nif kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã, n paas gosneerã miniisr dãmb ligdã, la b rɩk nug tikr ning b sẽn da gãneg yʋʋm 2008 soabã kiuugã yaood wɛɛngẽ. Nug tik-kãng pʋgẽ, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR wilgame t’a pa na n dɩk kiuug yaood ninga, b sẽn da gãneg n yaood tẽngã taoor soab rẽnda ye, a na n kel n dɩkda yaood ning sẽn yaa Kapitɛnd yaoodo. Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame tɩ ned kam fãa tog n kẽes a toog tẽngã fãagr pʋgẽ.Miniisr dãmbã me wilgame tɩ b na n yãka b sapaoolg kiuugã yaood pʋsʋk n kõ tɩ b sõng neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnsã, n be zu-loees pʋgẽ wã. B leb n dɩka noor n paas Laboratoaar nasnallã tʋʋm a taaba, t’a na n get rɩɩbã, wen-vɩʋʋgã, la tʋʋma yelle. Gosneem wilgame tɩ b na n mee logto-yi reezõ de Wobasẽ wã soolmẽ.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, tẽngã taoor sega neb nins sẽn kẽes b toog n zabd tẽngã fãagr yĩngã. Seg taabã pʋgẽ b goma tẽngã koglg yelle.B sõasgã sɩngrẽ, tẽngã taoor soab reng n pẽga VEDEPE rãmbã sẽn sak n kẽes b toog Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã pʋgẽ n zabd n na n fãag tẽngã. Rẽ poore, a kos-b lame tɩ b kell n gãd taab nus la b sak n tʋm ne sodaasã, la b sak n pʋɩt b bãngrã ne neb nins b sẽn nan na n yãk tɩ b wa naag tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ wã̃. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR wilga VEDEPE rãmbã, tɩ na-kẽnda la b na n dɩk wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ, n sõng-b b tʋʋmdã wɛɛngẽ. A kell n yeel-b lame tɩ wakat fãa bɩ b tʋm ne gũusgu, la b sak n tʋm ne taab ne pʋ-peelem.VEDEPE rãmbã me rɩka koɛɛg n pʋʋs tẽngã taoor soab la b kos tɩ b sõng-b ne tʋʋm-teedo. Sẽn leb n paasdẽ me, rẽndame tɩ b tʋm sodaas wʋsg zĩis nins nin-wẽnsa sẽn be wã sẽn na n yɩlẽ n sõng-b tɩ b tõog n paam n tʋm wa sẽn segde. Kell n kosame tɩ nebã me sak n kẽes b toogo, tɩ zabrã yaa sẽn na n fãag tẽngã. Sapaolg kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR tika a nug sebr zug n wilg tɩ sodaarã tʋʋmde, a lebg n sigl-a Burkĩna Faso, la a le yãka kom-bɩɩb tɩ b na n lʋɩ sodaasã sula taoore.Nug tikrã pʋga, yaa sodaasã reezẽo rãmb sẽn da pʋɩ tɩ ya tẽng fãa pʋgẽ, bãmb b tãab n be wã, sigl-paallã pʋgẽ, lebga reezẽo rãmb a yoobe. Zãndarem dãmbã sẽn da tar reezẽo bɛd a tãabã, bãmb me lebga a yoobe. Sã n ya ne yĩngr sodaasã sẽn da ya reezẽo a yembrã, b lebga a yiibu.Sodaasã pipi reezẽo ket n yaa Kaya. Yaa sodaas nins sẽn be-b Sãntrnoorã n get Noorã babg me.Reezẽo a yiib n soabã ket n yaa Bobo Dɩulaso. Bãmb n get reezẽo de Wobaasẽ, Sɩɩd wɛse, la Kaskaadã soolem.Reezẽo a tãab n soabã yaa Waogdgo. Waogdg soabã geta Sãntre, Sãntr sɩɩde, Palatosãntralle, la Sãntr wɛse.Reezẽo paal nins tẽnga taoor soab sẽn yãkã, yaa Sayɛll reezẽo wã, yaa Doori sodaasã, sull n get be soolmã.Reezẽo di Bukl di Muhundã sull bee Dedugu. Yaa bãmb n get Bukl di Muhundã soolem. Sẽn na n baase, b wilgame tɩ yaa reezẽo de Lɛɛs sodaasã sull ning sẽn be Fada wã. Bãmb n get reezẽo de Lɛɛs la Sãntr wɛs soolmã.

Yĩngr sodaasã zĩigẽ, bãmb pipi sullã bee Waogdgo. Yaa bãmb n get reezẽo Sãntrã, Palatosãntralel, Lɛse, Sãntr wɛse Sãntrsɩɩde, Sãntr wɛse, Sãntr noore, la Sayɛllã soolem.Sull a yiib soabã bee Bobo. Bobo soabã geta Sɩɩd wɛse, Kaskaade, Obaasẽ, la Bukl di Muhund soolmã.Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, leb n sigla, sodaas sula a yoobe. Sull-kãens tʋʋmde, yaa bũmb sã n yɩ pẽrɩ bɩ b kẽng tʋʋlle.B boond-b lame tɩ BIR, Bɩɩrã bee Waogdgo, la raab sẽn wa be tẽngã baobg ning fãa, b kẽndame.B na n pʋɩ-b-la tẽngã we-n-vɩɩs a naasã pʋgẽ. B tʋʋma zĩisi, yaa sodaasã sull taoor soab n yãk-b n tʋmẽ la b kẽnda. Nin-wẽnsã sã n wa rat n deeg tẽngã, bãmb n na n ges rɩɩbã, tɩtã, la teed a taabã koglg tɩ b tõog n ta zĩis nins b sẽn dat n tɩ kõ nin-buiidã. B leb n na n zaba ne bi-beesã, la b get tẽngã pʋgẽ yõ-koglgo. Yaa Kapitɛnd dãmb la tẽngã taoor soab yãk tɩ b lʋɩ sullã taoore.Sodaasã reezẽo rãmb a yoobã fãa paama taoor dãmba. Sabaab kãng kɩtame t’a seg kiba-kɩtbã Sapaolg kiuug rasem a 8 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, n wilg t’a sigame la a bas ministɛɛrã, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ gosneem ra paam zu-loeese, a tʋʋma pʋg ye. A wilgame tɩ sã n wa mik tɩ sõngr raab bee yẽ gosneer sʋka, a na sõng-b tɩ b tʋʋmdã kẽng taoore.Ssã n ya ne neb nins sẽn da yti n wilgdẽ t’a pa segd n lʋɩ ministɛɛrã taoorã, a Donasẽ Nagalo pʋʋs-b-la barka, ne rõadg ning b sẽn dɩk n dogl-a wã. A kos-b lame tɩ b rɩk na-kẽndr sari wɛɛngẽ tɩ b tõog n paam n welg yellã. Yaa rasem 14 poore, b sẽnda yãk-a, t’a lʋɩ leebgã ministɛɛr taoore, la a sẽn lebg sigã. Wakat sẽn da looge, gosneerã taoor soab tall sõasg Televisẽo wã pʋg ne kiba-kɩtba. Sõs-kãng pʋga, a ra wilgame t’a pẽnega tʋʋm noor ning sẽn zabd ne ninsaal yam daabã la wẽgbã tɩ b maan vaeesg a Rok Donasẽ Nagalo, la a Yakuba Diye zugu, la bũmb pa be sẽn wilgd tɩ b kẽesa b mens ninsaal yam daab la wẽgb pʋgẽ ye.kibarã yii libreinfo

Sapaolg kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR zẽk a naoor n kẽng Gibo sodaasã zakẽ. A kẽndã võore, yaa sẽn na n keng b raoodo, b sẽn sak n kẽes b mens n zabd tẽngã yĩnga. A pẽg-b lame, la a kos-b tɩ kell n paas raoodo. Kapitɛnd TARWAR bẽda be n wilg tɩ tʋʋm kẽer n pa tũud wa sẽn segde, la a na n gesame tɩ b rems-rems ne tʋʋlem, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ bũmbã fãa tõog n zemse.

Yaa sẽn ta yʋʋm a 2 woto, la b tʋm sodaas kẽer Gibo. A wilgame tɩ sẽn ta yʋʋm a yiibã, sodaasã yãa namsg wʋsg buud toor-toore, la a na n gesame, tɩ wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ, bɩ b paam sor n tɩ vʋʋs bilfu, la b yaool n lebg n kẽ zabrã pʋgẽ. A kell n wilg-b lame, t’a na n maoome, n paas kibayã baoob tʋʋmd b sẽn boond tɩ Rãnsayema wã pãng Gibo soolmã pʋgẽ.Sodaas nins sẽn nan kẽed zabrã pʋgẽ pipi wã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR kosame tɩ b tall su-keelem la raoodo, la b rɩk zãmsg ning b sẽn paamã n ning-a na-kẽndr pʋgẽ, tɩ boto, b tõogdame. A wilgame tɩ tẽng ning fãa sẽn segd ne kolgo, la zĩis nins fãa nin-buiida sẽn tar yõ-koagendbã raabo, b na kẽngame. Sẽn na n baase, a yeelame tɩ b na n maoome n deeg tẽngã, n lebs a toosã zugu.kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Kapitɛnd Sɩdsore Abdul kadɛɛr WEDRAOOG ne a poorẽ dãmb a yiibu. Yaa Kapitɛnd Salɛm GƐLLO, la Kapitɛnd Didaas Sagl WEDRAOOGO. B ra zoeeme n pʋg a Poll Ãari Sãandaoogo DAMIBA, n da tɩ be Togo. La yaa Togo sodaasã n yõk-b n kɩs Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmba. Sã n ya ne kibay sẽn yit b yõkrã pʋgẽ, wilgame tɩ b fãa yaa Sɩlg yir sodaas b sẽn boond tɩ Larmedelɛɛrã sodaase. La b ningd-b-la taal tɩ b zuk sodaasã Sɩlga, n da tɩ be Togo, n segend n dat n lub Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR naamã.Tẽegre naam wẽ-n-dɩkã sẽn zĩnd Bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 wã, yaa soda-kãens b tãabã n dɩk Letena Kolonell Poll Ãari Sãandaoogo DAMIB ne Burkĩna Faso sodaasã sɩlga a ye n kẽng Togo. B sẽn kẽngã b tɩ basa Sɩlgã be la b bao zĩig n da tɩ be be, n ka lebgdẽ ye. Letena kolonɛɛl Poll Ãari Sãndaoogo DAMIB sẽn maan naam wẽ-n-dɩk ning yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, yɩɩ Kapitɛnd Sɩdsore WEDRAOOG n karem moonegã koees televisẽo wã pʋga.kibarã yii AYIBE

Sapaolg kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Miniisr ning sẽn get kadengã, la yõ-koglgã, Kolonell Bukare ZŨNGRÃAN ne a sõangda kẽngame n tɩ kaag Komisɛɛr Mahmuud SÃANA, la zãndarem dãmbã la polɩɩs rãmbã taoor dãmbã.Miniisr dãmb a yiibã wilgame tɩ kaagrã võore, yaa sẽn na yɩl n bãng zu-loees nins sẽn be b tʋʋma pʋse, n paam n bao rabay sẽn na n sõng-ba, tɩ b tõog n zab ne nin-wẽnsã.

B renga polɩɩs rãmbã zĩigẽ, n tɩ kelg b taoor dãmbã koeese. Sõasgã pʋgẽ, b pẽga tʋʋm nins b sẽn tʋmd nin-buiidã koglg wɛɛngẽ wã, la b wilg-ba, tɩ tʋʋmdã nan ka sa zãng ye, tɩ bala, tʋʋma a taab n ket be taoore. A togsame tɩ b pipi tʋʋmde, ya b tõog tɩ yõ-koglgã lebg n zĩnd tẽnsã pʋsẽ. Rẽ n soa, t’a kot-b tɩ b kell n kẽng taoor ne b tʋʋmã. Polɩɩs rãmbã taoor soab a Rooze WEDRAOOG wilga miniisrã tɩ bãmb me na n maana b pãng sẽn tõe fãa, tɩ ne sodaasã taabã sõngre, bɩ b tõog n tʋm tɩ yõ-koglg meng-meng zĩnd tɩ nin-buiidã vɩɩmd ne bãane.B sẽn sõs ne bãmb n sa, miniisr dãmbã, kẽnga Zãndarem dãmbã taoor dãmb nengẽ. Be me, b koeesã le yaa wa a sẽn loogã. A pʋlm-b lame tɩ gosneer na n maana a pãng sẽn tõe, n tõog tɩ zu-loees nins sẽn be b tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ wã paam tɩɩm. A kosa zãndarm dãmbã tɩ b bas welg taabã, la b naag taab n zabe, tɩ yaa rẽ bal la b tõe n tik n tõog bɛɛbã.Letena Kolonell Evraad SÕMDA, Zãndarem dãmbã taoor soab wilgame tɩ b na n kell n kẽnga taoore, ne b tʋʋmdã tɩ wʋm taab yɩ vẽenega, n tõog n kolg nin-buiidã ne b arzɛka.Tʋʋm-noy a yiibã taoor dãmb pẽga miniisr Bukare ZŨNGRÃANA, b yam yãkrã yĩnga. B wilgame tɩ bãmb me na n kell n maana n pãng sẽn tõe, tɩ bũmb nins miniisrã sẽn kosã paam pidisgu.kibarã yii kadenga, la yõ-koglgã ministɛɛr kiba-kɩtb nengẽ

Sapaolg kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso gosneerã ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kibayã kũun yiisa mooneg koɛɛg n wilg b sũ-pa-noaang ne ƐREFI la Zend afirik rãmb sẽn togs kibay ninsã ka tũ sor ye. Yaa tẽngã zãadb sẽn dɩk noor n na n dɩk kom-bɩɩb tɩ b sõng n zab ne nin-wẽnsã, wɛɛngẽ, la b gom sapaolg kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, nin-sabls tẽns kibayã kũun pʋgẽ. ƐREFI kiba-kɩtbã lebg n dɩka Zend afirik rãmb sẽn gʋls kibar n gomd Burkĩna faso gosneem sẽn wilg tɩ b na n dɩka kom-bɩɩb 350 tɩ b sõng sodaasã n zab ne nin-wẽnsã. B goama pʋgẽ ƐREFI kiba-kɩtbã wilgame tɩ neb nins b sẽn na n dɩk tɩ b sõng sodaasã n zabã pʋgẽ, yaa moosã la b yãkda, tɩ bala, nin-wẽnsã, yaa silmiisã la b rɩkd tɩ sõngd-b zabdẽ.Yaa rẽ gosneerã, wilg t’a sũur ka yɩ noog ne kibarã ye. Tɩ bala, kibarã yaa rõandga. B leb n kẽnga taoor n wilg b su-pa-noaang ne ƐRƐFI kiba-kɩtã sẽn wilg a sõasgã baoosgẽ tɩ yaa bu-welsg la Burkĩna Faso rãmb sẽn maandã, la a na n waa ne zabr sẽn pa na n tol n sa.Burkĩna Faso gosneerã wilga a sũ-sãang ne kibarã ka sɩd ye. La a sũur sãamda ne kibay kũun ro-kãensã b yiibã sẽn naan kibar sẽn ka tar tikr zĩig n yiisi, t’a tõe n wa ne zu-loees buud toor-toor n kẽes tẽngã neb ne taab sʋkã.Gosneem bẽda be n tẽegd ƐREFI, ne Zend afirik kiba-kɩtbã tɩ b mi n bao vẽenem wʋsg kibayã kũun wɛɛngẽ, la b yaool n dɩk-a n gome. B wilgame tɩ b sẽn kõ sor tɩ nin-buiidã tõe n gʋls a meng ne yamleoog sõng sodaasã ne zabrã, yaa sẽn na kɩt tɩ ned kam fãa tõog n kẽes a toogo, a tẽngã fãagr pʋgẽ. Gosneem ka tũus buud n wilg tɩ yaa bu-kãngã la bu-kãngã la b segd n dɩk ye.Gosneem paasame tɩ b sũur pa noom ne kibay nins sẽn wat ne welgre, b leb n pa gɩdg kiba-kɩtbã, tɩ b ra soog-b-mens n kõ b tagsg ye, la rẽndame tɩ b waoog na-kẽnda nins sẽn gãneg kibayã kũun wɛɛngẽ wã. Yaa gosneerã no-rɛɛs a Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOG n tik a nug mooneg koɛɛgã zugu.

Sapoalg kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR kẽnga Mali tẽngã taoor soaba a Asimi GOETA nengẽ, tɩ b zĩnd ne taaba, n gom tẽns a yiibã yõ-koglgã yelle.yɩɩ Zaabr wakat a 3 sẽn wa n loog bilfu, la Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sig Bamaoko Mali na-tẽnga. A sẽn ta wã, yɩɩ Mali tẽngã taoor soab a Asimi GOETA n seg-a a sɩlg yiri, tɩ b tũ taaba, n kẽng b sõasgã zĩigẽ. Nanambs a yiibã sõasg ne taab loogr poore, b tẽnsã taoor dãmb me zĩnda ne taab n sõse. B sẽn wa n sa, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR togsa kiba-kɩtbã, tɩ yaa zood kaagre, Burkĩna Fao ne Mali sʋka, tɩ bala, tẽns a yiibã yaa saam-biidu, b zu-loɛɛgã ya a yembre. Yaa rẽ n so t’a wa sõs ne Mali tẽngã taoor dãmba, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ b tʋm ne taab sodaar wɛɛngẽ, tɩ b nin-buiidã yõy paam koglgo.

Burkĩna Faso ne Mali taoor dãmbã yãka yam n na n paas b zoodã pãnga, la sẽn yɩɩd fãa, yaa yõ-koglgã wɛɛngẽ. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR boola Burkĩna Faso, Mali, la Sayɛllã fãa neb tɩ b gãd taab nusi, tɩ rẽ bal n tõe n sõng tɩ b tõog zabrã. Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor soab le kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ bũmb ning sẽn leb n kɩt t’a yãk yam n wa Mali wã. A yeelame tɩ Burkĩna ne Mali toaagã zãrem zems kɩlo 1200, la b nebã vɩɩ ne taaba, b kẽeda taaba.Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtbã nengẽ

Sapoalg kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor soab maana a pipi tʋʋmd ne a miniisr dãmbã. Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, b sẽn da maan seg taab tɩ ned fãa bãng loogr poore, la b sẽn leb n seg taaba, n zĩndi, n tɩʋʋs tʋʋma b sẽn gãneg n na n tʋme. Yaa seg taab n bao rabaya, la b ges b sẽn na n sõng taab toto n tõog n sigli, tɩ b tʋʋmdã yɩ neere. Zĩnd-kãng pʋgẽ, b kell n gesa gosneem sẽn tʋm tɩ loogã, n na n paam n bãng bũmb nins sẽn be, sẽn kẽed ne arzɛkã zãab wɛɛngẽ. Tẽngã taoor soab tũnuga be n wilg miniisr dãmbã tɩ bũmb ning sẽn ya zu-loɛɛg tɩ b segd n deng n gese, yaa yõ-koglgã.kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ

Wa yʋʋmd fãa sapaolg kiuug pipi daare, Bukĩna Faso Sodaasã tẽegda b tʋʋmdã siglgu. Rõandã yʋʋmdã, ya a naoor 62 tig-tẽegre. Gom-zug b sẽn tiki, yaa : Sodaasã ne nin-buiidã na naag taab n tʋme, n tõog n deeg tẽngã nin-wẽnsã nusẽ. Yaa Kolonell mazoor Kaasem KULBALI, miniisr ning sẽn get Sodaasã, n wa zĩnd tẽngã taoor soab yʋʋr yĩnga. Yaa Sodaasã taoor soaba Eta mazoor Zeenerall David KABRE, n paas rog-n-mik yel-gɛtba, la dĩin taoor dãmb n wa n zĩndi, tɩ tigrã tẽegr tʋʋm tʋme.Tig-tẽegrã pʋgẽ, Sodaas 46, n paam waoor kũuni, b sẽn sak n kẽes b mens n tʋm ne sũuri, tãngã koglg yĩnga. Miniisr Kaasem KULIBALI pẽga Sodaasã, la a kos tɩ nin-buiidã sugri, tɩ bala, wakat kẽere, pa wʋm taab n mi n be Sodaasã ne nin-zaalsã sʋka. A tẽega zu-loees nins fãa sẽn pɩʋʋg tõnd tẽngã pʋga. La wa n tɩ yɩɩd fãa yʋʋm 2022 soabã pʋgẽ. Rẽ n so, t’a kot nin-buiidã tɩ b sak n yãag-b ne pʋ-pelem, tɩ b tõog nin-wẽnsã. Miniisrã togsame tɩ ned kam fãa segd n basa be yɩɩg n gomdã, la a kẽes a toog n zab tẽngã yĩnga. Tẽngã biig fãa segd n ning a yamẽ tɩ zabrã yaa nebã fãa zabre. Yaa rẽ tɩ ned kam fãa segd n kẽng zabrã zĩigẽ tɩ d paam n tõog nin-wẽnsã. B kẽes b mens tɩ b wa n ka tõog-b fasɩ me, bɩ b koms b raoodã. Miniisr wilga sodaasã, tɩ b tẽeg nug tikr ning b sẽn tik b tʋʋmdã pʋg kẽeb wakatã. B tẽege, tɩ yaa tẽngã la b tik nug n na n kogle. Bala zabr ning zug b sẽn be rũnda wã, pa zabr sẽn yɩɩd b pãng ye. A boola Burkĩna Faso yagsã tɩ b gãd taab nus n tʋm ne taaba, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n tʋm tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa nin-sabls tẽns nins sẽn be zu-loees pʋgã. Kolonell Mazoor Kaasem KULIBALI kosa sodaasã taoor dãmb tɩ b tall mak-sõngo, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ sẽn get b bãmbã tõog n dɩk b na-kẽndrã n tʋm ne pʋ-pelem.

Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Metr Apolineer de Taanbɛɛla KELEM lʋɩɩ taoor tɩ b tẽeg neb nins sẽn maan kaalem, sẽn tũ ne nin-buiidã sẽn yi n wilg b sũ-pũu zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 30 la a 31 yʋʋm 2014 soabã, la naam wẽ-n-dɩk vaall ning sẽn zĩnd bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug yʋʋm 2015 soabã. Tẽegrã yɩɩ Monima de Ero nasẽono wã sẽn be Wagadeemillã la b maan-a.Kell n yɩɩ wakat Sodaasã sẽn dɩk tẽngã soog-m-meng yɩɩlle. Yɩɩlgã poore, b boola neb 37 wã nins sẽn maan kaalmã yʋya. Yʋyã boolg poore, gosneerã taoor soab rɩka tɩ-puud n tɩ rɩlg Monima wã taoore, la a ka rɩk koɛɛg ye. Koeesã, rɩkdb yɩɩ neb nins sẽn maan kaalmã roagdba, n paas neb nins sẽn paam-b sãpogrã sull taoor dãmb n gome.

Neb nins sẽn paam sãpogr nebã sẽn wa n yi n wilg b sũ-pũur yʋʋm 2014 yʋʋmdã sull taoor soab a Darmaan WEDRAOOG togsame tɩ b sẽn da wilg tɩ b na n gesa b yellã, gesgã pa tolg n ya sõma zãng ye. Yʋʋm a 8 loogr poore, neb n ket nan ka paam tɩbsg ye. Sã n mikame tɩ b rɩka noor n wilg tɩ b na n sõng neb nins sẽn paam zu-loeesã, rẽndame tɩ b mao tɩ noorã paam pidsgu. Bala, neb nins sẽn paam zu-loees tɩ b segd n ges b yellã sõor taa neb 600. A Siya ZUDAADA paama sãpogr wakatẽ wã. Yẽ wilgame tɩ rẽnda tɩ tẽngã taoor dãmb sɩd rɩk na-kẽnda, tɩ bãmb zu-loeesã paam welgre. Bala tẽngã taoor soab meng wilgame tɩ bũmbã fãa segd n yɩɩ yãgbo.A Kiristof LÕMPO neb nins sẽn paam sãmpogr naam wẽ-n-dɩk vaallã pʋgẽ sull taoor soab me goam a yɩɩ wa a taabã sẽn wilgã. B fãa boonda tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soab t’a ges tɩ bũmb nins fãa b sẽn segd n paamã, bɩ b mao tɩ b paame. B modg n ges kɩɩbsã la pʋg-kõapã yelle, la b ges tɩ sẽn paam-b sãpoagã me tõog n paam tɩbsgo.kibarã yii Faso.net

Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, karen-saamb a Zãmbatiis BÕNTOOG sega kiba-kɩtbã n wilg t’a yiisa reem paalle, t’a yʋʋrã ya Tẽeg-n-paase. Karen-saamba Zãmbatiis BÕNTOOG roga zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 1963 soabã, Goe sẽn be Lʋmbil Kominda pʋgẽ. A karma Dõosẽ Lekolẽ wã, n paam a bãngr kaset sebr b sẽn boond tɩ sɛtfika wã yʋʋm 1978 soabã.Sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm 1987 soabã, a kẽe Dõosẽ Parwaasã Koralle, b sẽn boond tɩ Korallrĩmlawẽnde. Yʋʋm 1993 soabã, a Zãmbatiis BÕNTOOG bee Zĩyãare, n tʋmd meebã tʋʋma, la a ket n tũud Wẽnnaam sorã. Yʋʋm 1996 soabã, a naag Gilung Parwaasã Koralle, b sẽn boond tɩ Rĩmpʋgbnooma. Yʋʋm 2002 soabã, a yiis a pipi reem Gilung Korallã pʋgẽ.

Rẽ poore, a kẽnga Dõosẽ karen-saamb dãmbã zãmsg zĩigẽ yʋʋm 2018 soabã, n tɩ maan karen-saambdem. Sig-noy kiuug yʋʋm 2019 soabã, a lebg Katolikã karen-saamba. Kell n yɩɩ yʋʋm 2019 soabã, la a yãk yam n dɩk yɩɩl nins b sẽn da yɩɩnd Wẽnd dotã pʋsẽ yʋʋm 1900 soabã n lebg n yɩɩl-ba. B reemã a yiib soabã yʋʋr ra yaa Tẽegre 1. Reem sẽn lebg n pʋgle, ket n yaa Tẽegre. Rẽ n kɩte, t’a pʋd reem-kãng Tẽeg-n-paase. Tẽeg-n-paasã kasɛt pʋga, yaa yɩɩl koe-zut piig n be a pʋgẽ. Soog-m-meng n kɩs kibaya yaa bũmb sẽn be Burkĩna Faso tẽngã sɛb pʋsẽ. La yõ-koglg kaalmã, n paas zu-loeesã buud toor-toor sẽn pɩʋʋgd tẽngã kɩtame tɩ d sʋkd d mense. Sapaolg kiuug rasem 20 yʋʋm 2021, yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 10 la a rasem 23 yʋʋm 2022, Burkĩna Faso tẽngã zãadb ra yalsa Ẽntɛgnetã, la kibay buud toor-toor sẽn da yit Feesbukã zugu.

Na-kẽnd-kãens buudã lebsda kibaya kũuni, la mao tɩ nin-buiidã pẽneg taabã poorẽ. Yaa rẽ fãa n kɩt tɩ bũmb nins sẽn da segd n yɩ faag-faag wa lebg toogo.

Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 29 ne a rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, sodaasã sull n yik n deeg naamã, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n maneg n sigl tɩ bũmb nins fãa sẽn da ka kẽnd sõma wã, tõog n tũ taoore. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ.

Tẽngã taoor soab ratame tɩ noy nins b sẽn na n dɩk tigsgã pʋgẽ wã, bɩ welgr buud ba a ye, ra tol n zĩndi, la b rɩk noy sẽn na n zemes ne nin-buiidã raabo.

Kapitɛnd Marsɛll MEDA kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ rũndã, zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 14 soabã, yaa raar sẽn ya kasenga Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã pʋgẽ. Rẽnd segdame tɩ nebã bas welgr buud toor-toore, la b naag taab yam a ye, la sũur a ye, n tõog n tedg Burkĩna Faso nenga, t’a nin-buiida sak n dɩk b beoog neerã sore, la b me zamaan sẽn ya yõ-koglgo, la taoor kẽnd zamaana.

A kell n le pʋʋsa neb nins fãa sẽn sak n zẽk b naoore, n  wa naag tigsgã pʋgẽ wã. A wilgame tɩ yaa tigsgã baosgẽ la b na n yãk taoor dãmba, la noy nins b sẽn na n tũ n zã tarãzisẽo wã. Yaa rẽ t’a kotẽ, tɩ ned kam fãa mao n wa ne na-kẽndre, sẽn tõe n tũ, n waoog Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã raabo.

Yaa koe-kãng poore, la Kapitɛnd Marsɛll MEDA kõ sore, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR yʋʋr yĩnga  tɩ tʋʋmdã paam n pak a kʋɩlense.

Kibarã yii na-zakẽ kiba-kɩtba nengẽ

Kapitɛnd Yɩbryɩɩm TARWAR yãka zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 14 ne a rasem 15 sẽn watã raare, tɩ Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmb na n seg taab n dɩk noy tãrãzisẽo wã zãab wɛɛngẽ tɩ b boond tɩ Asɩɩsnasnalle.

Yaa lagem-n-taar sula, Pagtɩ politik rãmba, la sula buud toor-toor no-rɛɛsdb la b yãk yã, tɩ b na n naag n zĩnd n bale, la b pʋɩ taab yam dãmba, tẽngã na kẽng taoor yĩnga. Yaa rẽ t’a Asɩl Tãpsoab gʋls sebr n kõ neb nins sẽn sigl seg taabã, n wilg t’a Edi Kõmbeoog pa segd n wa zĩnd tigsgã SEDEPE pagtɩ wã yʋʋr yĩng ye. Tɩ bala, sẽn sɩng ne sigr kiuug yʋʋm 2021 sẽn loogã bãmb a pagtɩ wã taoor dãmb ra sɩbga a Edi Kõmbeoogo t’a ka segd n naag pagtɩ wã no-rɩkr pʋgẽ kiis a yoob tõore. A Asɩll Tãpsoab le pasaame tɩ  b  rɩgla sebr Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kãdensã la yõ-koglgã yell zĩigẽ, sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 21 n wilg bũmb nins sẽn be bãmb ne taab sʋka, pagtɩ wã pʋgẽ.

Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, karen-biis katɛk yii Gibo tẽngã pʋg n kẽn n wilg tɩ b ratame tɩ Gosneer lebg n pak b karen-dotã tɩ b paam n karem. Sẽn sɩng ne kaorengã sẽn sɩng Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, karen-dotã ket n paga b kʋɩlens Sũm soolmã, tɩ bala, karen-saamb ba a ye ka be a tʋʋmd zĩigẽ ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ Gibo karen-biisã yi n kẽn n wilgi, tɩ b sũur ka noom ne ye. A Saadu Ganaba sẽn ya Gibo karen-biisã taoor soab rɩka koɛɛg n wilg tɩ bãmb sẽn yi wã, yaa sẽn na n wilg Burkĩna Faso tẽngã zãadba, tɩ hal kaorengã yikr n tãag bãmb sẽn kẽndã, b karen-dotã ket n pagame, b leb n pa tar karen-saamb dãmb ye. Rẽ n so tɩ b gʋls b su-pa-noaang sebr n wa kõ taoor dãmbã, tɩ b sõng-ba, tɩ b tõog n paam karen-saamb dãmba, Reezẽo pʋgẽ, la b paas yõ-koagendbã sõor Kõngũs ne Gibo sorã zugu. Karen-biisã ba-rãmb kẽer wilgame tɩ b bee kambã poorẽ, tɩ bala, yaa bũmb sẽn segde. Boto, wilgdame tɩ b fãa yaa Burkĩna kamba. Rẽnd pa segd tɩ karen-biis kẽer sɩng kaorengo, tɩ kẽer zĩ n pa mi b sẽn maand a soab ye. B pasaame tɩ Gosneer tʋm-tʋmdb sã n be Gibo tẽngã pʋga, yaa toog ne-a t’a tõog n paam a kiuugã yaoodo. A leb n pa tõe n bool a zak rãmb bɩ a tũud-n-taas ye. Nugẽ bãngã tʋʋm-teed ka le kẽnd ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b rat tɩ b ges zu-loe-kãens fãa yelle. Karen-biisã sẽn yi wã ya a Maru Yɩlbʋʋd sẽn ya Gibo Perfe wã la b kɩs b sũ-pa-noaangã sebre, la yẽ me pʋlmame t’a na taas b kosgã tẽngã zãadba. A Saadu Ganaba ne a karen-bi-taasã raab yaa karen-dotã tõog n lebg n pake.

Kibarã yii Faso.net

Burkĩna Faso kom-bɩɩb n yãk b yam n bool nin-buiidã tɩ ned kam kõ a nug bũmb tɩ b naag taab n maan ninbãan-zoeer tʋʋmde, ne neb nins sẽn be zu-loees pʋgẽ, sẽn kẽed ne nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm-goabã sabaabo.

La b boolã ka lʋɩ muk tʋbrẽ, tɩ bala, nebã sakame n kẽes b toogo. Yaa rẽ n so, tɩ zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2022 soabã pʋgẽ, sẽn sigl-b tʋʋmdã seg kiba-kɩtbã Waogdgo, SIYAWO wã zak pʋg n wilg-ba, b sẽn paam yãagr ninga.

Kom-bɩɩb nins sẽn siglg tʋʋmdã taoor soab a Alẽ TARWAR tɩ boond t’a Alino Faso wilgame tɩ yaa kood toand 400 la futu la b paam yã. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ sɩngrã bãmb raabã ra yaa toand 100, la b sũur yaa noogo, tɩ bala, b raaba pĩdame. B paama toand 400, la b ket n saagdame tɩ b paam n paase.

Sullã taoor soab paasame tɩ sɩngrẽ wã ra yaa Gibo la b ra yãk yam n na n sõnge. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ b pʋd tʋʋmdã yʋʋr tɩ «d naag taab n fãag Gibo»

A wilgame tɩ b sẽn paam woto wã, b na n yãka toand 100 n tɩ kõ Gibo rãmba, la b rɩk sẽn kellã n pʋɩ tẽns a taab me sẽn be zu-loees pʋg wala Pama, Barsaolgo, Solã, Seba la Titao.

Yɩɩ neb 250 n sak n kõ meng ne yamleoogo n tʋmd tʋʋmdã, ned ba a ye pa reeg ba wakɩr ye.

Sẽn na n yɩlẽ n paam tɩ koodã tõog n t’a tẽns nins b sẽn dat n kõ wã, b wilgame tɩ b rɩka tõkr ne tẽngã taoor dãmba, sẽn na yɩl n paam tɩ b sõng-ba.

Yaa rasem a tãab pʋgẽ la b siglg tʋʋmdã tɩ ned fãa kẽng n tɩ kõ a sẽn tar ne yamleoogo. Tʋʋmdã b maan-a-la Waogdgo, Bobo, Kʋdgo, la Tẽnkʋdgo.

Kibarã yii Faso.net

Lefaso.net

Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, sodaas nins sẽn deeg Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022, gãnega na-kẽndr ning b sẽn na n dɩk n zã tẽngã t’a tũ sari sore, waoog taaba, la soog-m-meng pʋgẽ. Yɩɩ Kapitɛnd Faruk Azarya SORGO, n karem sebrã ɛrtebe televisẽo wã zug yʋng wakat a 9 wã kibay kũun sasa.

 Ad na-kẽnda nins sẽn be sebrã pʋga :

Pipi gom-zugu : na-kẽndrã zu-raado

Pipi nug tikri : nand tɩ tẽngã taoor dãmb wa naag taab n zĩnd n gʋls tãrazisẽo wã zãab na-kẽndr sebre, yaa na-kẽnd-kãngã la b tik Burkĩna Faso tẽngã zãab wɛɛngẽ.

Gom-zug a yiib soaba : ƐMPESƐƐRE

Nug-tikr a 2 soaba : yaa ƐMPESƐƐR sodaasã n get tẽngã zãab yelle hal n tɩ ta wakat ning b sẽn na n yãk neb nins sẽn na n lʋɩ tãrãzisẽo wã taoore. Bãmb n get gosneerã tʋʋma. Bãmb n get yõ-koglgã, arzɛkã, sõng taabã, tẽngã taoor kẽnde, la tẽngã tods koglg yelle.

Nug-tikr  a 3 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR sullã sigla wa sẽn pʋgdã ; a tara taoor soaba, taoor soab pʋgdga, la taoor soab pʋgdga a yiib n soaba, ned sẽn get sullã siglg yelle, la yaa sull-kasens a yiib n be a pʋgẽ.

Gom-zug a tãab soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã tʋʋmd sẽn ya a soaba

Nug-tikr a 4 soaba  : yaa ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã n ya tẽngã taoor soaba, la sodaasã fãa taoor soaba

yẽnda n get sari  roogã soog-m-meng yelle. Taoor soabã sã n wa tar gɩdgre, yaa taoor soab pʋgdgã n get rẽ. Sẽn pʋgd-a me sã n wa tar gɩdgre, yaa pʋgdg a yiib n soabã n gete.

Nug-tikr  a 5 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR n get tẽngã soog-m-meng zãabo, tẽngã todse, gosneerã tʋʋma, la nug tigsa nins Burkĩna Faso sẽn maan ne tẽns a taabã waoogre.

Yaa yẽ n get gosneerã siglg yelle, la a tõe n kõ noor ne a nug tikri. Yẽ n segd n ges tɩ gosneer tʋʋma fãa kẽn wa sẽn segde.

Nug-tikr a 6 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã, tara sor n tõe n yãk neb tɩ b lʋɩ gosneer tʋʋm-no-bɛdã, sodaarã tʋʋm noya, la tʋʋm noy a taab taoore, wala laloa wã sẽn gãnege.

Nug-tikr a 7 soaba : taoor soabã le tara sor n tõe kõ tẽns a taaba no-rɛɛsdba, bɩ zamaan-zẽns rãmb sẽn tʋm neb nins  sõor tɩ b tõe n zĩnd Burkĩna Faso tẽngã pʋgẽ. Tẽnsã no-rɛɛsdb la tẽnsã sẽn tʋm b rãmbã segd n wa wilga b sorã kũun sebr ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã nengẽ.

Gom-zug a naas soaba : sari wɛɛngẽ

Nug-tikr a 8 soaba : sari wã roog so a menga,  yaa bʋ-kaood rotã rãmb n  gãnegdb na-kẽnda n tũudẽ.

Gom-zug a nu soaba : nug tika , la zood ne zamaan-zẽnse

Nug-tikr a 9 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã tara sor n tõe n yẽs ne tẽns a taab rãmba, la a tar sor n tõe n tall tʋmd-n-taar nug tikr ne-ba.

Gom-zug a yoob soaba : tẽngã zãab na-kẽndr lebg n gese

Nug-tikr 10 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR sullã rãmb tõe n dɩka na-kẽndr n lebg n ges b na-kẽndrã sebre, la rẽnda tũuda ne sullã neb pʋsʋk sẽn na n wilg tɩ b ratame tɩ b lebg n ges-a.

Gom-zug a yopoe soaba : na-kẽnda sẽn na n baase

Nug-tikr 11 soaba :  ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã sã n sak n tik a nug na-kẽndrã sebr zugu, a wilgdame tɩ b sẽn da togs tɩ tẽngã tẽn-kug-kʋdg b sẽn gʋls sigr kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 1991 soabã yalsame wã,  a lebg n wa a zĩigẽ, b tũuda tẽn-kug kãnga. Bala, a pa gɩdg ƐMPESƐƐR sullã sẽn gʋls a na-kẽndrã sebr ninga wã ye.

Nug-tikr 12 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR sullã sẽn gʋls tẽngã zãab na-kẽndr seb-kãnga wã, a bee na-kẽndr pʋgẽ, hal sẽn sɩng ne bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã.

Nug-tikr 13 soaba : Seb-kãngã sẽn ya ƐPEYƐSƐR taoor dãmbã n gʋls-a n na n tũ n zã tẽngã, b segd n yiis-a-la tẽngã zʋgnall-kaseng ning b sẽn boond tɩ Zʋgnall Ofisɛllã pʋgẽ.

Yaa Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, ƐMPESƐƐR  taoor soabã, n tik a nug sebrã zug

Waogdgo, zĩ-likr kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2022 soabã.

Yaa sẽn tũ ne naam wẽ-n-dɩka sẽn zĩnd bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, n yɩ sabaab tɩ Burkĩna Faso tẽngã leb n paam taoor soab paalga. Yaa rẽ, tɩ nin-sabls tẽng wĩndg sẽn lʋɩtẽ sul-kaseng ning b sẽn boond tɩ SEDEYAWO wã taoor soaba, a Umaru Sisoko Ãmbalo tʋm sullã no-rɛɛsdb Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2022 soabã tɩ b wa sõs ne neb nins sẽn deeg naamã, la rog-n-mikã la dĩinã taoor dãmba.

Sɛkã poore, Nizɛɛr tẽngã na-kʋdgo, a Mahamuudu Yisufu, sẽn le ya sug-koat Burkĩna Faso ne SEDEYAWO sʋkã pẽgame. A wilgame tɩ rog-n-mikã la dĩinã taoor dãmb sɩd kẽesa b toog n sõng tɩ yellã paam tɩɩm. Yɩɩ wakat a sẽn bẽd n wilg kiba-kɩtbã, tɩ b yẽsga yɩɩ sõma. A kell n wilgame tɩ sɛkã pʋgẽ, b togsa SEDEYAWO sullã sẽn dɩk na-kẽnda nins n na n yãag Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã, tɩ b tõog n zã tãrazisẽo wã t’a tũ sore. A Mahamuudu Yisufu wilgame tɩ b sũur yaa noogo, b sẽn paam n seg Kapitɛnd Yibrayɩɩm Tarwarã  A kell n kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ masã, bãmb lebg n kuusẽ,  b kuusa ne bas-m-yam. Bãmb me sã n ta, b na n tɩ togsa sullã taoor soaba, b yẽsgã sẽn yɩ toto. A pʋʋsa kapitɛnd Tarware ne tẽngã taoor dãmb  barka, b sẽn deeg-b ne waoorã yĩnga. Kapitɛnd TARWAR kosa ministɛɛr dãmbã seb-gʋndb tɩ  b vaees mobila nins fãa sẽn be tʋʋm noya zĩisẽ, n bãng b sẽn tõe n tall b rãmb n tʋm. Sodaas nins sẽn deeg naamã taoor soab le kosa ministɛɛr dãmbã tʋm-tʋmdb n yɩlem tɩ b tʋm ne yãgbo. Bala, yaa kiuug a 3 bal n kete, la b segd n sõda tʋʋmdã wa kiis 12 tʋʋmde, b sẽn da segd n tʋma.

Kibayã kẽer wilgame tɩ yaa pa wʋm taab n be neb nins sẽn wẽed n yitã ne  MPP wã Pagtɩ taoor soab a Bala Sakãnd sʋka, rẽ n kɩt tɩ  tãp-biisã yita. B yiibã sabaab yaa sẽn kẽed ne MPP tigs-kaseng b sẽn segd n paam Bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug yʋʋm 2023 yʋʋmdã n wat ne-b yit n basd Pagtɩ wã.

Neb nins sẽn wilg tɩ b pa le naag Mpp pagtɩ wã sʋka, d tõe n sõdga miniisr ning sẽn da get zamaan- zẽns zoodã, a  Alfa Baari, la miniisr ning sẽn da get kʋʋra wã, a BasirYɩsmayɛll Wedraoogo, la depite kʋdg a Lasina Wattara. D sʋkda d mens n getẽ sẽn yit-bã na n tɩ fãoonga Pagtɩ a to, bɩ b na n sigla b Pagtɩ wala a Abdulae Moose ne a poorẽ dãmbã sẽn yi n tɩ viglg bPpagtɩ tɩ boond tɩ Pepeyɛsã.

Yɩɩ bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, la Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soaba, a Albɛɛr Wedraoog kẽng Amerik soolmẽ pʋgẽ, n tɩ zĩnd tigsg a ye pʋgẽ. Sõs-n-kõ taabã, pʋgẽ, a wilgame tɩ b na n lebg n sigla kaorengã.

Permye miniisr Albɛɛr WEDRAOOG kẽnga taoor n paase, tɩ ba Koviid 19 bãag sã n komsa kaorengã ãnduni wã fãa gill pʋgẽ, Burkĩna Faso, yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn be wã koms-a-la wʋsgo.  Bala, yaa neb sõor na  ta milyão la zak n zoe n bas b tẽnse.  Karen-dot sẽn pag sõor  taa bãmb 4000. Karen-dotã sẽn pagã  kɩtame tɩ karen-biis 700 000 baa kaorengo.

La sẽn na n yɩlẽ n paam zu-loe-kãnga tɩɩm, rẽndame tɩ Burkĩna Faso Lekollã na-kẽndre, b lebg n sigl-a n tũnug  na-kẽnd paall ning b sẽn dat n sigla, t’a sõng karen-biisã tɩ b fãa  paam zu-noog a ye.  Yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ ba  zu-loees sã n wa beẽ bɩ a ra tiis kaorengã ye.

Yaa Nasẽo zini sull ning sẽn get kaorengã tɩ b boond tɩ INESKO wã bãmb n sigl seg-taabã Amerik soolmẽ wã.
